original: #AdlersHelmBossScene
translate: #鹰盔堡Boss场景

original: Thank you for all your help so far
translate: 感谢你迄今为止的所有帮助

original: Be sure to talk to Doron and Arra before you go
translate: 在你离开前一定要和多隆和阿拉谈谈

original: I’m sure they’ll help you in any way they can
translate: 我相信他们会尽他们所能帮助你

original: It all began when we found the stairs leading up to the plateau in the mines
translate: 这一切始于我们在矿洞里发现了通往高原的楼梯

original: Stairs like you’ve never seen before; Cut right into the mountain itself and going straight up
translate: 你从未见过的楼梯；直接凿入山体笔直向上

original: Stairs you say?
translate: 你说楼梯？

original: We climbed them and found they made it possible to reach the plateau above us
translate: 我们爬了上去发现它们能让我们到达上方的高原

original: If I were to guess, I’d say we were the first to set foot up there for hundreds, or even thousands of years!
translate: “如果我猜的话，我会说我们是数百甚至数千年来第一批踏上那里的人！”

original: And that’s saying something about the age of the stairs
translate: 这足以说明那些楼梯的年代了

original: What happened then?
translate: 然后发生了什么？

original: I dispatched a small party up onto the plateau to look around a bit but we’re not really equipped for exploration
translate: 我派了一支小队上到高原去稍微探查一下但我们并不真正具备探索的条件

original: So we did what the company would expect
translate: 所以我们做了商会期望的事

original: Send a report to the mainland and return to normal operations
translate: 向大陆发送报告然后恢复正常作业

original: So you found something up on the plateau?
translate: 所以你们在高原上发现了什么？

original: Aye we did
translate: 是的我们发现了

original: The team reported seeing buildings up there in the ice
translate: 小队报告说在冰层中看到了建筑

original: Old but Imperial from what they could tell
translate: 据他们判断虽然古老但是帝国风格的

original: Which is strange because the company has as good maps as any of Gradla and nowhere are there records of Imperial structures
translate: 这很奇怪因为商会拥有和任何人一样好的格拉德拉地图但没有任何关于帝国建筑的记录

original: Least of all up on that Magi-forsaken plateau!
translate: 更不用说在那个被法师遗弃的高原上了！

original: And did the company respond to the reports?
translate: 商会回应了报告吗？

original: That’s the strange part
translate: 这就是奇怪的地方

original: The response came almost immediately - Almost as if the company was expecting the find or something
translate: 回复几乎立刻就来了——几乎就像是商会预料到了这个发现似的

original: We were to make ready to receive an expedition that was to explore the plateau
translate: 我们要做好准备迎接一支来探索高原的考察队

original: Until then, we were told to keep quiet about the find and stay away from the plateau
translate: “在那之前我们被告知要对发现保密并远离高原”

original: They even closed down mining operations!
translate: 他们甚至关闭了采矿作业！

original: I’ve never heard of anything remotely similar happening before
translate: 我以前从未听说过任何类似的事情发生

original: So what happened?
translate: 那么发生了什么？

original: Expedition arrived by ship in no time and set off the next day up onto the plateau
translate: 考察队很快就乘船抵达第二天就出发前往高原

original: That’s the last we saw of them
translate: 那是我们最后一次见到他们

original: Whatever they found up there, I know in my bones it’s what caused the madness that’s been gripping Adler’s Helm
translate: “无论他们在上面发现了什么我骨子里知道那就是导致鹰盔堡陷入疯狂的原因”

original: Embla shoots you a knowing glance
translate: 恩布拉向你投来会意的一瞥

original: We need to get going
translate: 我们得出发了

original: You… you did it?
translate: 你……你做到了？

original: Your eyes, there’s something about them
translate: “你的眼睛有些不一样”

original: I’d say you’ve seen things no man or woman should ever have to!
translate: 要我说你见识了任何男女都不该见识的东西！

original: I don’t want to know what you faced down there in the dark, but tell me this
translate: “我不想知道你在那黑暗中面对了什么但告诉我这个”

original: What of my crew?
translate: 我的队员们怎么样了？

original: Are they gone?
translate: 他们都不在了吗？

original: There's no one else coming out of those mines alive
translate: 没有其他人能活着走出那些矿洞了

original: Lorn trembles and his eyes water up
translate: 洛恩颤抖着眼中涌出泪水

original: The man has lived through horrors untold, hiding for days and days like an animal to stay alive
translate: “这个人经历了难以言说的恐怖像动物一样躲藏了一天又一天才活下来”

original: You feel bad you weren’t at least able to bring him better news
translate: 你为自己至少没能给他带来更好的消息而感到难过

original: They were good men and women
translate: 他们是好男好女

original: The Golden Dead will protect them now
translate: 黄金先祖现在会保佑他们

original: I want to know what happened here!
translate: 我想知道这里发生了什么！

original: Something about Plateau
translate: 关于高原的一些事

original: More about Plateau
translate: 更多关于高原的事

original: Finally the last part about Plateau
translate: 最后关于高原的部分

original: Something about Priory
translate: 关于修院的一些事

original: More about Priory
translate: 更多关于修院的事

original: Finally the last part about Priory
translate: 最后关于修院的部分

original: Whatever you need
translate: 无论你需要什么

original: Tell me again what happened here?
translate: 再跟我说一遍这里发生了什么？

original: Ask about Plateau
translate: 询问高原

original: Ask about Priory
translate: 询问修院

original: #AdlersHelmMerchantScene
translate: #阿德勒斯海姆商人场景

original: I think it’s safe to say you’ve saved our lives
translate: 我想可以说你救了我们的命

original: Or at least prolonged them!
translate: 或者至少延长了我们的寿命！

original: Say, would you be in need of supplies?
translate: “嘿，你需要补给吗？”

original: I was pretty well stocked when things went bad and the least I can do is trade with you at a reasonable rate
translate: 当情况变糟时我储备充足，至少我能以合理的价格和你交易

original: Sure!
translate: 当然！

original: Let's trade!
translate: 我们来交易吧！

original: Looking to trade?
translate: 想交易吗？

original: #AdlersHelmPilotScene
translate: #鹰盔堡引航员场景

original: I’ll be waiting for you right here whenever you’re ready!
translate: 只要你准备好了，我就在这里等你！

original: You set out from Adler’s Helm by one of the surviving light boats and Doran expertly guides you through the narrow straits
translate: 你乘坐一艘幸存的轻型小船从鹰盔堡出发，多兰熟练地引导你穿过狭窄的海峡

original: In no time you find yourself back on the shores which you landed
translate: 很快你就回到了之前登陆的海岸

original: With Doran joining the crew of the Weathermaiden it should now be possible to sail all the way directly to Adler’s Helm
translate: 随着多兰加入天候少女号的船员队伍，现在应该可以直接航行到鹰盔堡了

original: An exhausted-looking young man smiles and bows as you approach
translate: 当你走近时，一个看起来疲惫不堪的年轻人微笑着鞠躬

original: Emperor’s bones, it will be good to get out of here
translate: 帝皇在上，能离开这里真是太好了

original: Say, did you come here by ship?
translate: 话说，你是乘船来的吗？

original: Yes but we had to land on the southern shores
translate: 是的，但我们不得不在南岸登陆

original: I see!
translate: 我明白了！

original: Well, Doran’s my name and the company hired me on as a pilot
translate: 嗯，我叫多兰，商会雇我当引航员

original: I sail with ships making the passing up the bay towards Adler’s to help them navigate the underwater rocks and reefs
translate: 我随船航行，引导它们穿过海湾前往鹰盔堡，帮助它们避开水下的岩石和暗礁

original: Could you do that for us as well?
translate: 你也能为我们这样做吗？

original: That I could indeed!
translate: 我当然可以！

original: We could travel together to where your ship is, then I’ll stay on and help your captain navigate to and from Adler’s all safe and sound
translate: 我们可以一起前往你的船所在的地方，然后我会留下来，帮助你们的船长安全地往返鹰盔堡

original: It’s the least I could do to thank you!
translate: 这是我至少能做的，以表达我的感谢！

original: I’m ready to go when you are
translate: 你准备好了，我就出发

original: We’ll take one of the light boats and I’ll get us down to the southern shore and your ship in no time
translate: 我们乘一艘轻型小船，我很快就能带我们到南岸和你的船那里

original: Not yet!
translate: 还不行！

original: I have some things to do first
translate: 我还有些事要先做

original: Doran looks at you expectantly
translate: 多兰期待地看着你

original: Being holed up like this isn’t for me!
translate: 这样被困在这里可不适合我！

original: #BedRest
translate: 卧床休息

original: The prospect of resting in a proper bed is a rare treat for a mercenary travelling the roads so you should think twice before passing up on it
translate: 对于奔波于道路的雇佣兵来说，能在舒适的床上休息是难得的享受，因此放弃这个机会前你应三思。

original: Make Camp
translate: 扎营

original: # Books
translate: # 书籍

original: #CaliperoScene
translate: #卡利佩罗场景

original: My loyal apprentices
translate: 我忠诚的学徒们，

original: Their joy in life is to serve
translate: 他们人生的乐趣就是侍奉，

original: And they do serve me well, don’t you think?
translate: 而且他们侍奉我侍奉得很好，你不觉得吗？

original: He pats one of them on the cheek only to have the man’s nose start bleeding profusely
translate: 他拍了拍其中一人的脸颊，结果那人的鼻子开始大量流血，

original: They are a bit tired however
translate: 不过他们有点累了，

original: My absence has been a burden on them
translate: 我的离开对他们来说是个负担，

original: I know how you repay these poor things
translate: 我知道你是怎么回报这些可怜的家伙的，

original: Calipero’s face twists into a cruel smile
translate: 卡利佩罗的脸上扭曲出一个残忍的笑容，

original: Thankfully, my ‘sons’ do not have the capacity to question my actions
translate: “幸好，我的‘儿子们’没有能力质疑我的行为”，

original: Their greatest joy in life is serving their master and their ‘ascension’ is the greatest reward their limited minds can imagine
translate: 他们人生最大的乐趣就是侍奉主人，而‘升天’是他们有限的头脑所能想象的最大奖赏，

original: You're deranged
translate: 你疯了，

original: I'll have none of this
translate: 我绝不接受，

original: So, it was you who came to the aid of Calipero the Tempestuous
translate: “那么，是你前来援助暴风卡利佩罗的”，

original: I will say this much
translate: 我要说，

original: You have done me a great service
translate: 你帮了我一个大忙，

original: For that, I am eternally grateful
translate: “为此，我永远感激”，

original: Here is a small token
translate: 这是一点小意思，

original: He gestures to one of his ‘apprentices’ who limps over to you and reverently hands you a large sack filled with coin
translate: 他向一名‘学徒’示意，那学徒一瘸一拐地走到你面前，恭敬地递给你一个装满硬币的大袋子，

original: But there is more to you
translate: 但你还有更多，

original: Calipero muses
translate: 卡利佩罗沉思道，

original: You are a traveler of sorts, yes?
translate: “你算是个旅行者，对吧？”

original: Someone on a quest?
translate: 在执行任务的人？

original: I may have much to offer you yet in terms of aid
translate: 在援助方面，我可能还有很多可以给你，

original: You cannot help but notice that his gaze lingers for a moment too long on Embla standing behind you
translate: 你不由自主地注意到，他的目光在你身后的恩布拉身上停留了太久，

original: What kind of aid?
translate: 什么样的援助？

original: I went there - dancing across the silver-void
translate: 我去过那里——在银色虚空中舞蹈，

original: I saw only shadows but I saw enough
translate: 我只看到了阴影，但我看得够多了，

original: There are secrets in the deep
translate: 深处有秘密，

original: Ancient secrets
translate: 古老的秘密，

original: Enough to draw the Seven Eyes there
translate: 足以将七眼吸引到那里，

original: That is all I can say
translate: 我只能说这么多，

original: Whatever do you need?
translate: 你到底需要什么？

original: I'd like to buy some items from you
translate: 我想从你这里买些物品，

original: About your apprentices
translate: 关于你的学徒们，

original: What happened in the summoning chamber?
translate: 召唤室里发生了什么？

original: What do you know about the Black Priory?
translate: 你对黑修院了解多少？

original: Welcome back to the 'Tower of Ash'
translate: 欢迎回到‘灰烬之塔’，

original: Please, use my facilities as your own
translate: “请随意使用我的设施，就像自己的一样”，

original: I'd like to trade with you
translate: 我想和你交易，

original: Calling forth that which lies beyond is no task for a lesser Magos
translate: 召唤彼方之物可不是次级法师能胜任的任务，

original: However, I am not a lesser Magos
translate: “然而，我可不是次级法师”，

original: The Aether serves at my will and there are very few secrets that the veil can keep from me
translate: 以太听从我的意志，帷幕能瞒过我的秘密少之又少，

original: Alas, it was not so this time
translate: “唉，这次却并非如此”，

original: What answered my call was something different
translate: 回应我召唤的是某种不同的东西，

original: Something much more powerful than I expected
translate: 比我预想的要强大得多的东西，

original: What went wrong?
translate: 出了什么问题？

original: Calipero fixes you with an intense stare
translate: 卡利佩罗用锐利的目光盯着你，

original: The conjunction is growing in strength. ‘It’ is much closer to our world
translate: 交汇的力量在增强。‘它’离我们的世界更近了，

original: So close in fact that it has begun to seep through
translate: 事实上，近得已经开始渗透过来了，

original: But you already know this don’t you?
translate: 但你已经知道这一点了，不是吗？

original: His gaze shifts to Embla
translate: 他的目光转向恩布拉，

original: You're talking about the Dragon
translate: 你在说龙，

original: The apprentices howl in terror and cover their ears
translate: 学徒们惊恐地嚎叫，捂住耳朵，

original: Its seven eyes are fixed on the Outer Isles
translate: 它的七只眼睛紧盯着外岛，

original: Something has been found that was perhaps never intended to see the light of day again
translate: 某种或许本不该再见天日的东西被发现了，

original: That is why you are traveling to the Black Priory
translate: 这就是为什么你要前往黑修院，

original: What can you tell me about the Black Priory?
translate: 关于黑修院，你能告诉我什么？

original: Certainly
translate: 当然，

original: My vaults hold countless wonders for you to peruse
translate: 我的宝库中有无数奇珍供你细览，

original: His eyes glint in a way that does not appear wholly natural
translate: 他的眼睛闪烁着一种不太自然的光芒，

original: #ChamberlainCastleTaken
translate: #ChamberlainCastleTaken

original: No news of our missing citizens?
translate: 还没有我们失踪市民的消息吗？

original: I beg you make haste to Gradla
translate: 我恳求你尽快赶往格拉德拉

original: And if you’ve not already done so, stop by the armory before you go!
translate: 如果你还没去的话，出发前先去一趟军械库！

translate: # 章节_0

original: #Chapter1ArrivalInGlen
translate: #第1章 抵达格伦

original: You shield your face from the cold winds and icy drizzle as you survey the area
translate: 你用手遮挡着脸，抵御寒风和冰冷的细雨，同时环顾四周，

original: In the secluded valley that lies ahead, you spot the unmistakable, shaggy white forms of a flock of goats
translate: 在前方僻静的山谷中，你看到了一群山羊，它们那蓬松的白色身影清晰可辨。

original: You’re just about to make your way towards them when a strange undulating howl echoes through the small valley
translate: 你正要朝它们走去，这时一阵奇怪的起伏嚎叫声回荡在小山谷中，

original: There's more than goats in this area
translate: 这个区域里可不止有山羊。

original: #Chapter1Chamberlain
translate: #第1章 总管

original: From what I hear, these men were bands of local fishermen and sailors!
translate: 据我所知，这些人原本都是本地的渔民和水手！

original: But why would they do something like this?
translate: 但他们为什么要做出这种事？

original: Horryn was their home and for all his shortcomings, there were few Imperial officials as lenient as the governor!
translate: 霍林是他们的家园，而且尽管总督有种种缺点，但像他这样宽厚的帝国官员可不多！

original: Where is the governor now?
translate: 总督现在在哪？

original: I didn't see him as we fle
translate: 我们逃跑时我没看到他，

original: I mean 'made our strategic retreat'
translate: 我是说“进行了战略撤退”，

original: I can only assume he died in the chaos
translate: 我只能推测他死于那场混乱，

original: And the cruelest joke of all
translate: 而最残酷的玩笑是，

original: That leaves me the ranking Imperial Official on the island
translate: 这让我成了岛上职位最高的帝国官员，

original: Farewell for now
translate: 暂时告别了，

original: Driina scowls at you
translate: 德莉娜对你怒目而视，

original: Markus shakes his head dejectedly
translate: 马库斯沮丧地摇了摇头，

original: I’m certainly not going to beg you for aid
translate: 我当然不会乞求你的援助，

original: But I’ll say, if there exists a way to retake the city, I believe it is contingent on the survival of this camp
translate: 但我要说，如果存在夺回城市的办法，我相信那取决于这个营地的存亡，

original: Beyond that, I bid you go to whatever fate awaits you
translate: 除此之外，我祝你踏上任何等待你的命运，

original: What can I do to help then?
translate: 那我能帮上什么忙？

original: The color drains from Markus' face
translate: 马库斯的脸色变得苍白，

original: But… but Driina are you leaving as well?
translate: 但……但是德莉娜，你也要走吗？

original: I need you here in camp
translate: 我需要你留在营地，

original: We've already discussed this!
translate: 我们已经讨论过这个了！

original: I cannot do this without you!
translate: 没有你我做不到！

original: I'm not a leader - I'm a glorified scribe!
translate: 我不是个领袖——我只是个被美化的书记员！

original: Who will keep their spirits up?
translate: 谁来提振他们的士气？

original: And what am I going to do when people start dying from the outbreak?
translate: 当人们开始死于疫病时，我又该怎么办？

original: All the blood and shit and
translate: 所有的血污和秽物，还有……

original: You will find your strength, my old friend
translate: 你会找到你的力量的，我的老朋友，

original: The Golden Dead will guide you
translate: 黄金先祖会指引你，

original: Besides, we both know that nothing will be solved by me waiting here in camp
translate: 再说，我们都知道，我干等在营地里解决不了任何问题，

original: We must try to seize the initiative in whatever way we can
translate: 我们必须想尽一切办法，努力掌握主动权，

original: Driina puts her hand on his shoulder
translate: 德莉娜把手放在他的肩上，

original: Markus lets out a deep sigh before looking up
translate: 马库斯深深叹了口气，然后抬起头，

original: You are right, Driina
translate: 你说得对，德莉娜，

original: As always
translate: 一如既往，

original: Clear your throat
translate: 清了清嗓子，

original: Driina, perhaps you should stay here after all
translate: 德莉娜，也许你终究还是该留在这里，

original: Driina motions towards you,
translate: 德莉娜向你示意，

original: Gallian himself may have provided for us
translate: 伽里安本人或许曾为我们提供过帮助，

original: Markus looks up at you, seemingly having forgotten you were in the tent
translate: 马库斯抬头看着你，似乎忘了你还在帐篷里，

original: I'm looking for a way into Horryn
translate: 我在找进入霍林的路，

original: Driina's gaze could shatter stone
translate: 德莉娜的目光足以粉碎石头，

original: The decision is mine to make And I have made it
translate: 这是我的决定，而且我已经决定了，

original: Now, we have tarried for too long
translate: 现在，我们已经耽搁太久了，

original: Markus, tell our friend here of Horryn’s fate
translate: 马库斯，告诉我们的这位朋友霍林的命运，

original: I fear out path leads there eventually
translate: 恐怕我们的道路最终会通向那里，

original: Go there if you will but entering Horryn may indeed prove a tall order
translate: 你想去就去吧，但进入霍林确实可能极其困难，

original: Township’s been overrun by madmen!
translate: 镇子已经被疯子们占领了！

original: Hundreds lie dead in the street and those who remain cling to life on this barren plot of farmland!
translate: 数百人横尸街头，而幸存者则在这块贫瘠的农田上苟延残喘！

original: As for the city gates, they have been sealed and our attackers have left us with no way back into the city
translate: 至于城门，它们已经被封锁，攻击者没给我们留下任何返回城里的路，

original: But what happened?
translate: 但发生了什么？

original: It started some days ago
translate: 事情发生在几天前，

original: I was awoken in the middle of the night by the governor's guards
translate: 我在半夜被总督的守卫叫醒，

original: They told me we were under attack and that packs of crazed brigands were already roaming the streets, spilling blood by the river-full!
translate: 他们告诉我，我们遭到了攻击，成群结队的疯狂强盗已经在街上游荡，血流成河！

original: I never saw such chaos before
translate: 我从未见过如此混乱，

original: The dead lay strewn in the streets and we had to sneak from corner to corner just to get away with our lives!
translate: 死者横尸街头，我们不得不从一个角落潜行到另一个角落，只为逃命！

original: By some stroke of luck, we came upon Driina and a handful of other guards and managed to make our way to the gate with what survivors we could find!
translate: 凭着几分运气，我们遇到了德莉娜和少数几个守卫，并设法带着我们能找到的幸存者赶到了大门！

original: We set up this camp whilst we
translate: 我们建起了这个营地，而我们……

original: Well frankly I don't know
translate: 唉，坦白说，我不知道，

original: All I can do is try to keep us alive till tomorrow
translate: 我能做的就是努力让大家活到明天，

original: It sounds like you're about to plead for help?
translate: 听起来你像是要恳求帮助？

original: I'd say no
translate: 我会说不，

original: Iben the ranger is keeping the city under watch and he reports that the Reavers have sealed its gates
translate: 游侠伊本正在监视城市，他报告说劫掠者已经封锁了城门，

original: We’ve found no other way of entering it
translate: 我们还没找到其他进入的方法，

original: Though what you expect to find in there save a gruesome death is beyond me
translate: 不过，除了惨死之外，你还指望在里面找到什么，我实在想不通，

original: But what do you intend to do then?
translate: 但那你打算怎么办？

original: Sit here and wait for death?
translate: 坐在这里等死吗？

original: Certainly not!
translate: 当然不！

original: But with the state this camp is in, it’s all we can do to keep death from our throats
translate: 但以这个营地的状况，我们能做的也仅仅是让死亡别那么快降临到我们头上，

original: If we are ever to hold out until reinforcements arrive, much less retake the town, then we must do what we can to gather our strength!
translate: 如果我们想坚持到增援到来，更不用说夺回镇子了，那我们就必须尽一切可能积蓄力量！

original: For now that means food and medicine
translate: 眼下这意味着食物和药品，

original: Regarding that
translate: 说到这个，

original: I best be on my way then
translate: 那我最好这就出发，

original: The Chamberlain
translate: 总管，

original: The man before you has the look of a high-ranking Imperial bureaucrat
translate: 你面前的这个男人有着帝国高级官僚的模样，

original: However, there is little pomp left in him now
translate: 然而，他现在身上几乎没什么排场了，

original: His robes are ragged; his cheeks hollowed; his spectacles cracked
translate: 他的长袍破烂不堪；脸颊凹陷；眼镜也裂了，

original: He mumbles to himself as he despondently pores over stacks of papers and maps
translate: 他沮丧地翻阅着一堆堆文件和地图，嘴里喃喃自语，

original: He looks up at you with a start
translate: 他吃惊地抬头看着你，

original: What's this, then?
translate: 那么，这是怎么回事？

original: More mouths to feed?
translate: 又多了几张嘴要喂？

original: Or, by some miracle, do you come laden with supplies, medicine and men-at-arms?
translate: 或者，奇迹般地，你是带着补给、药品和士兵来的？

original: Driina gives the man a strict look
translate: 德莉娜严厉地看了那人一眼，

original: Markus, we’re in no position to turn allies away
translate: 马库斯，我们没资格把同伴拒之门外，

original: Common courtesy will go a long way
translate: 基本的礼貌会很有帮助，

original: Careful, little man
translate: 小心点，小个子，

original: The man sighs and sinks further back in his seat
translate: 男人叹了口气，更深地陷进椅子里，

original: Forgive me
translate: 原谅我，

original: I'm not myself
translate: 我有些失态了，

original: The world seems to be coming undone and I am left holding the pieces
translate: 世界似乎正在分崩离析，而我却被留下来收拾残局，

original: He wipes his balding head with a piece of cloth
translate: 他用一块布擦了擦他秃顶的脑袋，

original: Markus Stonehold at your service
translate: 马库斯·斯通霍德，愿为您效劳，

original: Chamberlain to the most glorious office of the Governor of Idra
translate: 伊德拉总督最光辉办公室的总管，

original: He makes a sharp little bow, his words dripping sarcasm
translate: 他利落地微微鞠了一躬，话语中充满了讽刺，

original: How may I be of assistance?
translate: 有什么可以帮您的？

original: I'm trying to get to Horryn
translate: 我正设法去霍林，

original: I've come to offer my assistance!
translate: 我是来提供帮助的！

original: We are in need of aid
translate: 我们需要援助，

original: Me?
translate: 我？

original: Aid you?
translate: 援助你们？

original: The man scoffs incredulously
translate: 男人难以置信地嗤笑一声，

original: At present, we'll be blessed by the Dead if we survive another night or two!
translate: 眼下，我们要是能再撑过一两个晚上，就算先祖保佑了！

original: But I need to get to Horryn!
translate: 但我必须去霍林！

original: Markus blinks bewildered
translate: 马库斯困惑地眨了眨眼，

original: He gestures to his papers
translate: 他指了指他的文件，

original: With the governor missing and the camp overflowing, things are chaotic, to say the least
translate: 总督失踪，营地人满为患，至少可以说，情况一片混乱，

original: Any assistance you can offer will surely help me avoid an early grave
translate: 你能提供的任何帮助，肯定都能帮我免于早早入土，

original: Driina offers a sympathetic smile
translate: 德莉娜露出一个同情的微笑，

original: If I... we can help - we will
translate: 如果我……我们能帮忙——我们会的，

original: Nonetheless, I do not know you and though your motives may be pure, I’ve learned a long time ago to be wary of sellswords
translate: 尽管如此，我不认识你，而且就算你的动机可能很纯粹，我很久以前就学会了要提防佣兵，

original: Tell me, why are you here in the first place?
translate: 告诉我，你最初为什么会来这里？

original: The people are starving around us
translate: 我们周围的人正在挨饿，

original: Already the very young and the very old have begun to pass and soon none of us will have the strength to fight should the reavers come for us
translate: 年幼和年老的人已经开始死去，很快，如果劫掠者来袭，我们谁都没有力气战斗了，

original: In other words, we need food and we need it fast
translate: 换句话说，我们需要食物，而且急需，

original: Talk to Frantzo
translate: 去找弗兰佐谈谈，

original: He’s serving as our cook and quartermaster and he might know where to start
translate: 他是我们的厨师兼军需官，他可能知道从哪里着手，

original: You’ll find him just outside this barn
translate: 你会在谷仓外面找到他，

original: And you mentioned a disease outbreak?
translate: 你还提到有疫病爆发？

original: Indeed
translate: 没错，

original: Disease is spreading in camp
translate: 疾病正在营地蔓延，

original: Hierophant Drahl has set up a makeshift infirmary in the main house, but so far he’s had little luck in combating the infection
translate: 大祭司德拉尔在主屋设立了一个临时医务室，但到目前为止，他在对抗感染方面收效甚微，

original: Help him and you will have helped us all
translate: 帮助他就是帮助我们所有人，

original: Talk to Frantzo regarding the dwindling food supplies and Drahl regarding the disease outbreak
translate: 去找弗兰佐谈谈日益减少的食物供应，找德拉尔谈谈疫病爆发的事，

original: And do hurry
translate: 务必快点，

original: People are dying as we speak
translate: 就在我们说话这会儿，都有人在死去，

original: Markus sits where you left him
translate: 马库斯坐在你离开时的位置，

original: Grimly pouring over lists, manifests and maps
translate: 阴郁地翻阅着清单、货单和地图，

original: Pushing his broken spectacles up his nose, he peers up at you
translate: 他把破了的眼镜往鼻子上推了推，凝视着你，

original: You're back
translate: 你回来了，

original: I hope for good news!
translate: 我希望是好消息！

original: Markus sighs deeply
translate: 马库斯深深叹了口气，

original: If there is nothing else, my migraine needs tending to...amongst other things
translate: 如果没有别的事，我的偏头痛需要处理一下……还有其他一些事，

original: The Chamberlain gestures to the piles of papers surrounding him
translate: 总管指了指身边成堆的文件，

original: What do you want to know?
translate: 你想知道什么？

original: Is there no way of getting into Horryn?
translate: 真的没办法进入霍林吗？

original: Any idea who the mad-men who attacked Horryn are?
translate: 知道袭击霍林的那些疯子是谁吗？

original: Regarding work
translate: 关于工作，

original: Nothing for now
translate: 暂时没有，

original: He lets out a sigh
translate: 他叹了口气，

original: Oh, where to start?
translate: 哦，从何说起呢？

original: This camp is a disaster!
translate: 这个营地简直是个灾难！

original: There is no medicine for the sick and wounded while mad-men and beasts bay for our blood at the gates!
translate: 没有药品给伤病员，而疯子和野兽就在大门口渴望着我们的鲜血！

original: The haggard man wipes his brow
translate: 憔悴的男人擦了擦额头，

original: Anything I can do to help?
translate: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

original: What did you need again?
translate: 你刚才需要什么来着？

original: #Chapter1Cook
translate: #第一章厨师

original: Frantzo listens to your description of Embla and strokes his beard
translate: 弗兰佐听着你对恩布拉的描述，捋着胡子

original: I might have seen her, but this hunger is making me hazy
translate: “我可能见过她，但这饥饿让我头昏眼花”

original: Help us find something to eat and chances are it'll clear my memory too
translate: 帮我们找点吃的，说不定也能让我的记忆清晰起来

original: Fair enough
translate: 很公平

original: The name rings a bell
translate: 这名字有点耳熟

original: Hmm, yes, I remember the girl!
translate: “嗯，是的，我想起那个女孩了！”

original: She arrived at my inn a few weeks ago, booked a room for two weeks and payed up front
translate: “她几周前来到我的旅店，订了两周的房间，还预付了房钱”

original: She was polite, kept to herself mostly
translate: “她很有礼貌，大多时候独来独往”

original: Far as I could tell, she was making trips towards the northern coastline
translate: “据我所知，她经常前往北部海岸线”

original: She never gave up any hints as to why, though
translate: “不过，她从未透露过原因”

original: The room was still in her name when the doom came - but I remember thinking I hadn't seen her for days beforehand
translate: 灾难降临时房间还在她名下——但我记得在那之前好几天都没见到她了

original: I wager she was either already dead, or safely on one of her excursions the night everything ended
translate: “我猜她要么已经死了，要么在一切终结那晚正好安全地外出探险了”

original: If you're looking for her and have a death wish, she was staying in the 'Sunset Suite', on the second floor
translate: “如果你要找她，而且不怕死的话，她当时住在二楼的‘落日套房’”

original: My inn, 'The Haven' is...was just off the main square
translate: “我的旅店，‘避风港’，就在主广场边上……曾经是”

original: Where are they?
translate: 它们在哪儿？

original: They are waiting in the enclosure behind you!
translate: 它们就在你身后的围栏里等着呢！

original: They are being kept in a glen up in the foothills!
translate: 它们被关在山麓丘陵的一个峡谷里！

original: Frantzo is thoughtfully peeling onions as he hums a tune in some foreign language
translate: 弗兰佐一边若有所思地剥着洋葱，一边用某种外语哼着小调

original: Good to see you!
translate: 见到你真好！

original: You approach a haggard looking man wearing a threadbare cook's apron
translate: 你走近一个面容憔悴、穿着破旧厨师围裙的男人

original: I don't know what you heard, but there's no food here for you, or anyone
translate: “我不知道你听说了什么，但这里没有食物给你，也没有给任何人的”

original: he growls
translate: 他咆哮道

original: Complain to the chamberlain if you want, just leave me alone
translate: “想投诉就去找总管，别来烦我”

original: The chamberlain said you needed help
translate: 总管说你这里需要帮忙

original: Likewise
translate: 彼此彼此

original: The cook's eyes meet yours for the first time
translate: 厨师第一次正视你的眼睛

original: Honestly, the situation is beyond dire
translate: “说实话，情况糟糕透顶”

original: People are starving by the day and we have no supplies
translate: 人们一天天在挨饿，而我们没有补给

original: The old, the sick the young; they'll all be dying off at this rate
translate: “老人、病人、孩子；照这样下去他们都会死”

original: Got any ideas?
translate: 有什么主意吗？

original: Well, none of us have the strength or courage left to venture out of sight of the camp to hunt and forage
translate: “唉，我们谁也没有力气或勇气走出营地视线范围去打猎和觅食了”

original: The cook looks you up and down
translate: 厨师上下打量着你

original: But you look capable enough
translate: 但你看起来挺有本事的

original: You could go beyond the walls and look for something more substantial?
translate: 你可以到墙外去找些更实在的东西？

original: These people can’t live on vegetable broth alone
translate: 这些人光靠蔬菜汤活不下去

original: They need meat and fat
translate: 他们需要肉和脂肪

original: Especially if there’s fighting to be had
translate: 尤其是如果要打仗的话

original: Any idea where I should look?
translate: 知道我应该去哪儿找吗？

original: I do indeed
translate: 我当然知道

original: Frantzo leans in
translate: 弗兰佐凑近身子

original: Old Jakub owns this farm
translate: 老雅库布拥有这个农场

original: It might not seem like much to a mainlander but here on Idra, this farm here is large enough
translate: “对大陆人来说可能不算什么，但在伊德拉，这个农场已经够大了”

original: You see, Jakub and his family had a large flock of goats when the calamities started
translate: “你看，灾难开始时，雅库布一家有一大群山羊”

original: Right over there in the enclosure behind us
translate: 就在我们身后的围栏里

original: Now, the old man told the chamberlain that the beasts bolted when the calamities started
translate: “后来，老人告诉总管，灾难开始时那些牲畜都惊跑了”

original: That it drove them all insane and that they scattered into the hills
translate: 说它们全都发了疯，四散逃进了山里

original: Well, that may be rightly so but I have my suspicions
translate: “嗯，也许是这样，但我有我的怀疑”

original: You're saying he hid the animals away?
translate: 你是说他藏起了那些牲畜？

original: Look, I can’t say I blame the man
translate: “听着，我也不能怪他”

original: Us refugees have made a mess of his farm
translate: 我们这些难民把他的农场弄得一团糟

original: And if we find hands on those animals we’ll surely fall upon them like locusts
translate: 要是我们找到那些牲畜，肯定会像蝗虫一样扑上去

original: It would ruin him and truly it would be a shame if the man lost his livelihood
translate: 那会毁了他，说真的，如果一个人失去了生计，那太可惜了

original: But better that than having to see children starve
translate: 但总比看着孩子们挨饿要好

original: Now you best get going
translate: 你最好现在就出发

original: I see people have started eying the rats
translate: 我看到人们已经开始盯着老鼠了

original: If what you say is true, you have a chance to save a lot of people here
translate: “如果你说的是真的，你就有机会拯救这里的许多人”

original: All you have to do is to herd them back to camp
translate: 你只需要把它们赶回营地

original: If you don’t tread carefully though there might be trouble with Jakub and his lad but better that than having to see children starve
translate: 不过如果你不小心行事，可能会和雅库布和他儿子起冲突，但总比看着孩子们挨饿要好

original: I knew it!
translate: 我就知道！

original: I bloody knew it!
translate: 我他妈就知道！

original: And you led them right to us I see!
translate: 我看你把它们直接带到我们这儿来了！

original: By the Maidens this will do these poor people good
translate: 以少女们之名，这对这些可怜人大有好处

original: Though I fear for old Jakub if people find out he was hoarding his livestock whilst others were dying
translate: 不过我担心，要是人们发现老雅库布在别人快死的时候囤积牲畜，他会怎么样

original: In any case, we have food now to last us a while and it is all thanks to you
translate: “不管怎样，我们现在有食物能撑一阵子了，这全都多亏了你”

original: I had some questions first
translate: 我先有几个问题

original: Bye
translate: 再见

original: With impeccable timing, the work party of sailors arrives carrying the crates of supplies
translate: “时机恰到好处，水手们组成的劳工队抬着补给箱到了”

original: Frantzo slaps his meaty palms together
translate: 弗兰佐拍了拍他厚实的手掌

original: I knew you could do it {PLAYER}!
translate: 我就知道你能行，{PLAYER}！

original: You’ve saved a lot of lives today
translate: 你今天救了很多条命

original: Not to mention what people would have done to Jakub if it turned out he had been hiding livestock from them
translate: 更别提要是人们发现雅库布对他们藏匿牲畜，会对他做出什么事了

original: I'll see you around
translate: 回头见

original: Well
translate: 嗯

original: What's eating you?
translate: 你有什么烦心事？

original: The cook chuckles darkly
translate: 厨师阴沉地笑了笑

original: What's your story?
translate: 你有什么故事？

original: Ask about Embla
translate: 询问恩布拉的事

original: Goodbye
translate: 再见

original: The cook's eyes widen in hope
translate: 厨师眼中燃起希望

original: So, what news, did you find anything I can put in folk's bellies?
translate: “那么，有什么消息，找到什么能填饱大家肚子的东西了吗？”

original: I found supplies!
translate: 我找到补给了！

original: Good to see you again {PLAYER}!
translate: 又见到你了，{PLAYER}！

original: My story is similar to most folk around here; sudden ruin
translate: 我的故事和这里大多数人差不多；突如其来的毁灭

original: I had an inn, respectable place, right on the main square it was
translate: “我有一家旅店，体面的地方，就在主广场上”

original: So even if I survive this place - seems like I have nothing to go back to
translate: 所以即使我活过了这个地方——似乎也没什么可回去的了

original: I'm sorry to hear that
translate: 听到这个我很难过

original: By the maidens tell me it is so!
translate: 以少女们之名，告诉我这是真的！

original: Don’t wave food in front of the starving!
translate: 别在挨饿的人面前炫耀食物！

original: Where did you find it?
translate: 你在哪儿找到的？

original: We found Jakub's goats!
translate: 我们找到了雅库布的山羊！

original: I purchased supplies from smugglers!
translate: 我从走私者那里买了补给！

original: #Chapter1DeadSailors
translate: #第1章 死亡水手

original: The stench of rotting flesh fills your nostrils
translate: 腐烂肉体的恶臭充斥着你的鼻孔

original: Ahead of you, grotesquely misshapen crustacean horrors feast greedily on the corpses of the dead crew of the Zephyr
translate: 在你前方，奇形怪状的甲壳类怪物贪婪地啃食着西风号死去船员的尸体

original: Blasted horrors!
translate: 该死的怪物！

original: Kat spits through gritted teeth!
translate: 卡蒂咬牙切齿地啐了一口！

original: What manner of force has spawned these creatures?
translate: 是什么样的力量催生了这些生物？

original: #Chapter1DriinaIntro
translate: #第1章 德里娜出场

original: In the center stands a formidable, armored woman
translate: 中央站着一位威严的、身披铠甲的女人

original: She carries an unmistakable air of authority and the insignia on her armour marks her as a cleric of the Order of Sepulchites
translate: 她带着一种不容置疑的权威气质，铠甲上的徽记表明她是葬仪修会的一名牧师

original: The tattered band of refugees surrounding her are agitated and shouting over one another
translate: 围在她身边的衣衫褴褛的难民们情绪激动，互相叫嚷着

original: But there are so few of us!
translate: 但我们的人太少了！

original: Horryn was home to two hundred and we're but a few score left!
translate: 霍林曾有两百人，如今我们只剩下几十个了！

original: cries a ragged man with tears in his eyes
translate: 一个衣衫破烂、眼中含泪的男人哭喊道

original: By the Golden Corpses, there must be survivors!
translate: 以金色尸骸之名，一定还有幸存者！

original: beseeches another
translate: 另一个人恳求道

original: And who are we to send?
translate: 我们又能派谁去呢？

original: Half of us won't live through next Marketday and the other half ain't fit to hold 's much as a stick!
translate: 我们一半人活不过下一个集市日，另一半人连根棍子都拿不稳！

original: an old crone interjects, panic quivering in her voice
translate: 一个老妇插嘴道，声音因恐慌而颤抖

original: The crowd erupts in a cacophony of desperate appeals
translate: 人群爆发出绝望的恳求声，一片嘈杂

original: The cleric raises her arms and the crowd falls silent
translate: 牧师举起双臂，人群安静下来

original: Her sonorous voice rings out
translate: 她洪亮的声音响起

original: We may indeed be cursed
translate: 我们或许确实被诅咒了

original: But Aldon is right - there may yet be survivors in Horryn, and it's my duty to go to their aid
translate: 但奥顿说得对——霍林可能还有幸存者，前去援助他们是我的职责

original: Or, at least, to learn what fate befell them
translate: 或者，至少，去了解他们遭遇了什么命运

original: The assembly errupts again - some blessing the cleric in tears of hope, others clinging to her robes while pleading for her to not risk her life
translate: 集会再次喧闹起来——一些人含着希望的泪水祝福牧师，另一些人则抓着她的长袍恳求她不要冒险

original: Through the crowd, the woman catches sight of you, and nods curtly
translate: 穿过人群，那女人看到了你，并简短地点了点头

original: She turns away and begins to load up on supplies, no doubt intent on making good on her promise to the panicked refugees
translate: 她转过身，开始装载补给，无疑是要兑现她对惊慌失措的难民们的承诺

original: Entering the ragged camp, you notice a small crowd nearby, arranged in an inward looking ring
translate: 走进破败的营地，你注意到附近有一小群人，围成一个向内看的圆圈

original: #Chapter1DriinaMain
translate: #第一章德莉娜主线

original: The reavers came from inside the town
translate: 劫掠者来自镇内

original: I recognized some of them as sailors, fishermen and whalers
translate: 我认出其中一些是水手、渔民和捕鲸人

original: Locals, mostly from old Idran families
translate: 本地人，大多来自古老的伊德拉家族

original: Perhaps they belonged to one of the lodges
translate: 也许他们属于某个会所

original: Driina
translate: 德莉娜

original: The imposing cleric holds up a palm in greeting
translate: 威严的牧师举起手掌致意

original: Welcome to our new home, stranger
translate: 欢迎来到我们的新家，陌生人

original: The people of this island know me as Driina
translate: 这座岛上的人们称我为德莉娜

original: I serve the Golden Dead and this camp - these people - are under my protection
translate: 我侍奉黄金先祖，而这个营地——这些人——都在我的保护之下

original: What brings you here?
translate: 什么风把你吹来了？

original: I was heading to Horryn
translate: 我正要去霍林

original: I'm searching for someone
translate: 我在找一个人

original: A terror from the deep claimed our ship
translate: 深海中的恐怖之物摧毁了我们的船

original: Driina nods and smiles to a passing refugee, before leaning in close to you, and asking in a low voice, "and what business did you have in Horryn?
translate: 德莉娜向一个路过的难民点头微笑，然后凑近你，低声问道：“那么你去霍林有何贵干？”

original: We lost our supplies
translate: 我们丢失了补给品

original: I'd hoped to re-stock
translate: 我本希望补充物资

original: I had hoped to recruit new sword arms
translate: 我本希望招募新的剑士

original: I was looking for someone
translate: 我在找一个人

original: She leans back, her eyes still flinty
translate: 她向后靠去，眼神依然冷峻

original: Are you not aware of the situation here?
translate: 你难道不清楚这里的局势吗？

original: These people say the island is surely doomed
translate: 这些人说这座岛肯定在劫难逃

original: Her eyes bore into you - gauging your reaction
translate: 她的目光紧盯着你——揣度着你的反应

original: And what say you?
translate: 那么你怎么说？

original: I couldn't care less for your troubles
translate: 我对你们的麻烦毫不关心

original: Here on Idra?
translate: 就在伊德拉？

original: That may prove to be a difficult task, given the tempest that's engulfed this island
translate: 考虑到席卷这座岛屿的风暴，这可能会是一项艰巨的任务

original: Driina fidgets with a heavy looking ring on her finger while she listens to your description of Embla
translate: 德莉娜一边听着你描述恩布拉，一边摆弄着手指上一枚看起来很重的戒指

original: She's certainly not in the camp and I can't say I remember seeing her in Horryn
translate: 她肯定不在营地里，而且我也不能说记得在霍林见过她

original: But perhaps that bodes well for your quest
translate: 但也许这对你的任务来说是个好兆头

original: One of the primary tasks of my order is to care for the dead
translate: 我所属修会的主要任务之一就是照料死者

original: And I can say with certainy that I didn't lay to rest anyone matching her description before the fall of Horryn
translate: 而且我可以肯定地说，在霍林陷落之前，我没有安葬过任何符合她描述的人

original: Do you have any suggestions where to look?
translate: 你有什么建议去哪里寻找吗？

original: Beyond travelling to Horryn, you may want to ask around here in camp
translate: 除了前往霍林之外，你或许可以在营地里四处打听一下

original: A few of the merchants survived - perhaps she visited one during her stay
translate: 有几个商人幸存了下来——也许她逗留期间拜访过其中一位

original: We need answers!
translate: 我们需要答案！

original: Driina gestures at the refugees languishing in the camp before continuing
translate: 德莉娜指了指营地里萎靡不振的难民们，然后继续说道

original: And it's my duty to seek them out, if they exist
translate: 而我的职责就是找出答案，如果它们存在的话

original: I must venture to find a way back into Horryn
translate: 我必须冒险找到返回霍林的路

original: And thence somewhere darker, I fear
translate: 恐怕从那里还要去往更黑暗的地方

original: Failing that, the situation here in camp is getting untenable
translate: 如果做不到，营地这里的局势正变得难以为继

original: Anything that can be done to improve it will be a small victory
translate: 任何能改善现状的事情都将是一场小小的胜利

original: Are you planning to go alone?
translate: 你打算独自前往吗？

original: Why not wait for reinforcements?
translate: 为什么不等待增援？

original: I care not for this fools errand!
translate: 我才不在乎这种愚蠢的差事！

original: If I must
translate: 如果我必须如此

original: Doomed or not, it's all dust in the end and I intend to die in armor
translate: 无论是否注定毁灭，最终一切皆为尘土，而我打算穿着护甲死去

original: But, from what I can tell, we must both tread the same terrible path?
translate: 但是，据我所知，我们俩都必须踏上同一条可怕的道路？

original: Though our reasons may differ, surely there is safety to be had in numbers?
translate: 尽管我们的理由可能不同，但人多势众总归更安全吧？

original: Let's join forces
translate: 我们联手吧

original: There is no room for you in my company, but I'll help nontheless
translate: 我的队伍里没有你的位置，但我还是会帮忙

original: I care not for helping
translate: 我对帮忙不感兴趣

original: One way or another, Horryn must be investigated, but I cannot be in two places at once and perhaps I can do more good here in camp after all
translate: 无论如何，霍林必须被调查，但我分身乏术，而且也许我终究能在营地里做更多好事

original: If you go there - please, bring word of what you find
translate: 如果你去那里——请带回你发现的消息

original: However grim those tidings may be
translate: 无论那些消息有多么严峻

original: I can do that
translate: 我能做到

original: I'm not promising anything
translate: 我不做任何承诺

original: Some people only care for their own skin
translate: 有些人只关心自己的安危

original: But look around you - if some measure of compassion for these people touches your heart, I will be here for a short while yet
translate: 但看看你的周围——如果对这些人的一丝怜悯触动了你的心，我还会在这里待一小段时间

original: On second thought, you should join me
translate: 转念一想，你应该加入我

original: I'll consider helping, but I don't want you to join me
translate: 我会考虑帮忙，但我不想让你加入我

original: Our graveyards have been overflowing as of late with stranger killing stranger for no good reason
translate: 近来我们的墓地已经人满为患，陌生人无缘无故地互相残杀

original: And worse, I think, brother and brother, husband and wife
translate: 而且更糟的是，我想，还有兄弟相残，夫妻反目

original: It's become a tide of ruin
translate: 这已经变成了一股毁灭的浪潮

original: I implored the Governor to intervene and investigate, but as usual he did nothing but cower in his villa and peer over his walls
translate: 我恳求总督干预并调查，但像往常一样，他什么也没做，只是蜷缩在他的别墅里，从墙头窥视

original: The Governor?
translate: 总督？

original: There is always hope - in this life or beyond it
translate: 总有希望——无论今生还是来世

original: However, I have seen things these last days that I cannot readily explain or reconcile with my faith
translate: 然而，这些天来我目睹了一些我无法轻易解释或与我的信仰调和的事情

original: Then, a few nights ago, pandemonium erupted
translate: 然后，几天前的夜里，骚乱爆发了

original: Bands of armed men and women roamed the town, hacking down anyone they came across
translate: 成群结队的武装男女在镇上游荡，砍倒他们遇到的任何人

original: Some folks claim those that did not die on the spot were dragged away, to suffer some unknown fate
translate: 有些人声称那些没有当场死去的人被拖走了，去遭受某种未知的命运

original: My order and I joined what sane guardsmen remained in the chaos and tried to stem the tide - but we were driven from the city in the panicked exodus that followed
translate: 我和我的修会加入了混乱中仅存的清醒卫兵，试图遏制这股浪潮——但我们随后在恐慌的大逃亡中被逐出了城市

original: We considered retaking the town, but we had scores of wounded
translate: 我们考虑过夺回镇子，但我们有大量伤员

original: So we retreated, better to save the lives not yet lost
translate: 所以我们撤退了，最好拯救那些尚未失去的生命

original: We set up this camp to regroup and to care for the wounded, but a shadow hangs over us
translate: 我们建立了这个营地以重整旗鼓并照料伤员，但一片阴影笼罩着我们

original: The wounded do not recover, and those still on their feet slowly lose their mind, or hearts
translate: 伤员们无法康复，而那些还能站立的人也渐渐失去理智，或心志

original: What do you intend to do now?
translate: 你现在打算做什么？

original: Driina's face lights for an instant
translate: 德莉娜的脸庞瞬间亮了起来

original: These people - my people - I feel their pain
translate: 这些人——我的人民——我感受到他们的痛苦

original: And we will mourn together, later
translate: 稍后我们会一起哀悼

original: For now, they deserve answers
translate: 但现在，他们理应得到答案

original: And by the Emperors' bones, I will get them some
translate: 以帝皇的骸骨起誓，我会给他们一些答案

original: Then that is the course laid out for us
translate: 那么这就是为我们铺就的道路

original: I pray your resolve may help you through the darkness that lies ahead
translate: 我祈祷你的决心能帮助你度过前方的黑暗

original: I will not barter for what should be an act of compassion, given freely, if that is what you're implying
translate: 我不会为那本该是出于怜悯而自愿给予的行为讨价还价，如果你是在暗示这个的话

original: Either way, I wish you luck
translate: 无论如何，祝你好运

original: I both look forward to and dread seeing you again
translate: 我既期待又害怕再次见到你

original: I have questions
translate: 我有问题

original: A drunken buffoon in my estimation
translate: 依我看，是个醉醺醺的小丑

original: He did not deserve to die however, and I don't think he made it out of Horryn
translate: 然而他不该死，而且我认为他没能逃出霍林

original: Markus, his chamberlain did however
translate: 不过，他的总管马库斯逃出来了

original: I suppose he's the closest we're to a leader at the moment - though he may wish it were not so
translate: 我想他是我们目前最接近领袖的人了——尽管他可能希望并非如此

original: What happened next?
translate: 接下来发生了什么？

original: Let's be off!
translate: 我们出发吧！

original: The Golden Dead watch over you
translate: 愿黄金先祖守护你

original: Then we have nothing to dicuss!
translate: 那我们没什么好谈的了！

original: Begone!
translate: 走开！

original: The cleric turns her back on you and continues her preparations
translate: 牧师转过身去，继续她的准备工作

original: There are long traditions on Idra for the fishermen and sailors to band together in fellowships known as lodges
translate: 在伊德拉，渔民和水手们结成名为会所的团体有着悠久的传统

original: From what I understand, they serve mainly as combines for fair distribution of the day's catch
translate: 据我所知，它们主要作为公平分配当日渔获的联合组织

original: But there are persistent rumors of them serving other purposes too
translate: 但一直有传言说它们也服务于其他目的

original: Rumors?
translate: 传言？

original: Our Order is an Imperial one - the locals would be loath to discuss such things with us - but I've always suspected they practiced pre-Imperial customs of ocean-worship, including offerings to ensure safe travel and bountiful catches
translate: 我们的修会属于帝国——本地人不愿与我们讨论这类事情——但我一直怀疑他们奉行着帝国之前的海洋崇拜习俗，包括献祭以确保航行安全和渔获丰饶

original: Driina looks expectantly at you, one brow arched
translate: 德莉娜期待地看着你，挑起一边眉毛

original: Ask Driina about Embla
translate: 向德莉娜询问恩布拉

original: Who do you think attacked Horryn?
translate: 你认为是谁袭击了霍林？

original: It's time to go
translate: 该出发了

original: Before we leave we should seek out Markus - our leader of sorts
translate: 在我们离开之前，我们应该去找马库斯——我们所谓的领袖

original: He's holed up in the stable trying to organize this mess of a camp
translate: 他躲在马厩里，试图整顿这个混乱的营地

original: Holy Ashes, no one tries harder than him, but the task at hand is monumental and he needs help
translate: 圣灰在上，没有人比他更努力了，但手头的任务艰巨，他需要帮助

original: If you feel the calling, you should seek out Markus - our leader of sorts
translate: 如果你感受到召唤，你应该去找马库斯——我们所谓的领袖

original: Reinforcements?
translate: 增援？

original: From whence?
translate: 从何而来？

original: Even if the Imperial Augers are aware of our plight, relief will still be weeks away if it arrives at all
translate: 即使帝国卜兆师知晓我们的困境，救援也还要数周才能到达，如果它真能到达的话

original: No, our fate is in our own hands and I fear I must bear the brunt of the hardships ahead
translate: 不，我们的命运掌握在自己手中，而且我担心我必须承担起未来艰难困苦的主要压力

original: And you would venture out alone?
translate: 而你要独自冒险出去？

original: Driina looks up at you with steely eyes and offers a curt greeting
translate: 德莉娜用钢铁般的眼神抬头看着你，简短地打了个招呼

original: Golden Dead watch over you
translate: 愿黄金先祖守护你

original: I have some questions for you
translate: 我有些问题要问你

original: I want you to join me!
translate: 我要你加入我！

original: You speak of the leviathan
translate: 你提到了利维坦

original: The fishermen first saw it about a week before the fall of Horryn
translate: 渔民们第一次看到它大约是在霍林陷落前一周

original: I do not know what black depths spawned it, but the natural order of things is fast becoming undone
translate: 我不知道是什么黑暗深渊孕育了它，但事物的自然秩序正在迅速瓦解

original: Tell me, why did you come to this accursed island?
translate: 告诉我，你为什么来到这座被诅咒的岛屿？

original: I'm lookong for someone
translate: 我在找一个人

original: I was bound for Horryn
translate: 我本是要去霍林的

original: But, from what I can tell, we must both tread the same terrible path
translate: 但是，据我所知，我们俩都必须踏上同一条可怕的道路

original: #Chapter1Farmer
translate: #第一章农夫

original: What of them?
translate: 他们怎么了？

original: I found them up in the glen
translate: 我在峡谷里找到的他们

original: What happened to them?
translate: 他们出了什么事？

original: The man mutters something under his breath and spits as a group of refugees pass
translate: 男人低声嘟囔着什么，朝经过的一群难民啐了一口

original: As he notices you lingering he fixes you with a bitter frown
translate: 当他注意到你在徘徊，便对你投来怨恨的皱眉

original: More leeches come to bleed me?
translate: 又有吸血鬼来吸我的血了？

original: Is this your farm?
translate: 这是你的农场吗？

original: He scoffs
translate: 他嗤之以鼻

original: If you can still call it that!
translate: 如果你还能这么叫的话！

original: It's ruined
translate: 全毁了

original: All my crops are trampled and my goats are gone!
translate: 我所有的庄稼都被踩烂了，山羊也没了！

original: We're going to starve next year thanks to this catastrophe!
translate: 多亏了这场灾难，明年我们就要饿死了！

original: Still seems you're better off than the people living in the camp
translate: 看起来你还是比营地里的那些人过得好

original: Spare me the sob-story
translate: 省省你的苦情戏吧

original: A balding man with a hard, wrinkled face the texture of old leather, stands leaning against the wall of the farmhouse
translate: “一个秃顶的男人，面容粗糙、布满皱纹，像旧皮革的质地，倚靠在农舍的墙边”

original: He’s thoughtfully chewing a straw as he dejectedly surveys the muddy chaos that was once his well-kept farm
translate: 他若有所思地嚼着一根稻草，沮丧地审视着这片泥泞的混乱——这里曾是他精心照料的农场

original: Approach
translate: 走近

original: He scoffs and turns his back to you
translate: 他嗤笑一声，转过身去背对着你

original: Wait, I have some questions
translate: “等等，我有些问题”

original: The man's eyes narrow
translate: 男人眯起了眼睛

original: He begins to whittle away at a stick and won't look directly at you
translate: 他开始削一根木棍，不肯直视你

original: It's clear he knows what you're talking about
translate: 显然他知道你在说什么

original: You can't keep hiding such a large herd while the camp starves
translate: 营地都在挨饿，你不能一直藏着这么大一群牲口

original: Your boy is begging to come home
translate: 你的儿子在哀求着要回家

original: I'll keep your herd a secret for a price
translate: 我可以替你保守牲口的秘密，不过得有个价

original: Begging?
translate: 哀求？

original: The boy's soft
translate: 那小子太软弱

original: If he wants to come home he needs to prove himself!
translate: 他要是想回家，就得证明自己！

original: I'm doing this for his own good
translate: 我这是为他好

original: Is it gold you're after then?!
translate: 那你图的是金子喽？！

original: The man’s face goes red as he takes a step towards you
translate: 男人脸涨得通红，朝你逼近一步

original: He stands there for a moment trembling with rage before looking around and becoming aware that the other people of the camp are watching
translate: 他站在那里，气得浑身发抖，过了一会儿环顾四周，意识到营地里的其他人都在看着

original: You’re cruel indeed to fleece an old man so close to his skin
translate: 你可真残忍，连一个几乎一无所有的老人都要敲诈

original: But I can’t lose my animals
translate: 但我不能失去我的牲口

original: Take this, and may your bones be ground to dust
translate: “拿着这个，愿你粉身碎骨”

original: He presses a small pouch of 50 gold into your hand
translate: 他把一小袋50金币塞进你手里

original: Get out of here before I let my axe do the talking!
translate: 快滚，不然就让我的斧头来说话！

original: I'm bringing the animals to the camp one way or another
translate: 不管怎样，我都要把牲口带回营地

original: I want no part in this
translate: 我不想掺和这事

original: The man's face reddens
translate: 男人的脸更红了

original: I can and I will!
translate: 我能，而且我会！

original: It's their fault we're in this mess!
translate: 我们落到这步田地，都是他们的错！

original: Dead
translate: 死了

original: They must be
translate: 肯定死了

original: Ran off into the forest when the sky fell, and nothing survives in that emperor's-foresaken place for long
translate: “天塌下来的时候跑进了森林，在那个帝皇遗弃的地方，什么都活不长”

original: Are you lying to me?
translate: 你在对我撒谎吗？

original: Tell me the truth or I'll be forced to make you
translate: 告诉我实话，否则我就只好逼你说了

original: The old man shifts uncomfortably
translate: 老人不自在地挪动了一下

original: He looks down at his feet and sighs
translate: 他低头看着自己的脚，叹了口气

original: I know it ain't right, but we borrowed hard from the Free-Lenders Guild to build this farm, and my goats...they're all I have left

translate: 对人类来说完全不能食用，但对其他野兽来说也许是一顿美餐？

translate: 一匹死马

translate: 肿胀的尸体已经开始腐烂，肥大的苍蝇在上面嗡嗡作响

translate: 从尸体上割肉

translate: 成群的苍蝇围着你，爬满你每一寸裸露的皮肤

translate: 你将大块令人作呕的肉扔进喂食堆里

translate: 晚餐显然已经上桌了

original: Hide and observe
translate: 潜行并观察

translate: 流着口水的鳞甲野兽笨拙地走进洞穴，分叉的舌头贪婪地品尝着空气

translate: 当这群野兽撕扯腐肉时，一场进食狂乱爆发了

translate: 几秒钟之内肉就消失了，这些可鄙的爬行生物在进食后的困倦袭来时，蹒跚着退回洞穴的深渊

translate: 很快，嘶嘶的鼾声回荡在整个洞穴中

translate: 也许现在悄悄绕过这些野兽会稍微容易一些？

translate: 一堆令人作呕的撕裂腐肉散落在地板上

translate: 更仔细地检查这堆东西

translate: 检查这片区域

translate: 将腐烂的马肉放入堆中

translate: “从足迹的数量和碎骨的数量来看，大量这种生物似乎把这里当作公共进食地”

translate: “除此之外，你只想赶紧远离这股恶臭”

translate: 你听说过像这样的爬行生物在食物充足时会大量进食，然后蹒跚离去，睡上好几天

original: Perhaps this can be used to your advantage?
translate: 也许这能为你所用？

translate: 挥之不去的恶臭也让你觉得这种特殊的物种偏爱腐肉

translate: 一个士兵穿着你猜测是霍林制服的破烂残余

translate: “他看起来饥饿、颤抖且紧张不安”

translate: # 第一章_Glen

translate: 很明显，这些动物是被赶出围栏的

translate: 在崎岖的山麓丘陵中跋涉，你追踪着足迹，直到它们经过一片裸露的岩石。

translate: 你失去了踪迹，在短暂搜寻后，你决定放弃并返回营地。

translate: 守卫们——我觉得我们的新客人是扫兴的家伙，

original: And we all know what happens to those
translate: 我们都知道那种人的下场，

original: You'd be surprised
translate: 你会惊讶的，

original: And I would know who my sweetheart’s new friends are - it’s rude to arrive uninvited; far ruder to leave unannounced
translate: 而且我想知道我的甜心的新朋友是谁——不请自来很无礼；不告而别更无礼

original: #Chapter1Governor_Intro
translate: #第1章 总督引见

original: You're greeted by an opulent and vast reception hall, bursting with music, extravantly dressed guests and tantalising aromas
translate: 你步入一个华丽宽敞的接待大厅，音乐声、衣着奢华的宾客和诱人的香气扑面而来

original: The man addressing you is covered in stately marks of office, but his finery, like his smile, look ill suited to him
translate: 对你说话的男人身上挂满了威严的官职标志，但他的华服，如同他的笑容，看起来与他格格不入

original: The man casts a glance around the lavish occasion, then bows
translate: 男人环顾了一下这奢华的场面，然后鞠了一躬

original: The Governor and Imperial Steward of Idra, Varain Kalthuun, welcomes you to the last bastion of civilisation - who might you be?'
translate: 伊德拉的总督兼帝国总管，瓦兰·卡尔苏恩，欢迎你来到文明最后的堡垒——敢问阁下尊姓大名？'

original: Mercenary
translate: 雇佣兵

original: your worst niughtmare
translate: 你最可怕的噩梦

original: something else
translate: 别的

original: Yes, well, more the merrier I say
translate: 是啊，嗯，我说人越多越热闹

original: This is the place to be
translate: 这里就是该来的地方

original: I'd offer you a tour but discovering it for yourself is half the fun
translate: 我本想带你参观一番，但自己探索才有一半的乐趣

original: Anything I can help you with before you make merry?
translate: 在你寻欢作乐之前，有什么我能帮你的吗？

original: I can think of one or two things
translate: 我能想到一两件事

original: I'll go explore
translate: 我去探索一下

original: GO ORF
translate: 滚开

original: Quite so
translate: 正是如此

original: I'm sure I will bump into you shortly - until then, I only ask you stay out of any room with a closed door
translate: 我相信我们很快会再碰面——在那之前，我只要求你别进任何关着门的房间

original: If you need anything... hah!
translate: 如果你需要什么……哈！

original: You won't
translate: 你不会需要的

original: I'm sure we'll see one another again soon
translate: 我相信我们很快会再见面的

original: Of course
translate: 当然

original: Truly frightful business
translate: 真是可怕的事情

original: I always said that dingy Priory would wreak havoc somehow
translate: 我一直说那个阴暗的修道院迟早会惹出乱子

original: Not much to be done now, of course, other than leave whatever is happening well alone
translate: 当然，现在没什么可做的，除了对正在发生的一切敬而远之

original: It'll blow over
translate: 会过去的

original: Qs again
translate: 又是问题

original: Can you elaborate?
translate: 你能详细说说吗？

original: Horryn MORE
translate: 关于霍林的更多信息

original: Yes sure here are some thoughts: some kind of natural disaster, precipitated by their own folly - idk
translate: 当然，这里有些想法：某种自然灾害，由他们自己的愚蠢引发——我不确定

original: It could all be tainted
translate: 可能全被污染了

original: QUARANTINING
translate: 隔离中

original: What will the mainland say about it?
translate: 大陆那边会怎么说？

original: Backto Qs
translate: 返回问题

original: Coward!!
translate: 懦夫！！

original: OCCASION
translate: 场合

original: justification for just keeping the status quo
translate: 维持现状的借口

original: Saviour xomplex
translate: 救世主情结

original: Once this strangeness blows over, this will be the elite men and women who rebuild into true greatness
translate: 一旦这阵怪事过去，这些精英男女将重建真正的伟大

original: Back to Qs
translate: 返回问题

original: Who's here, anyone famous?
translate: 这里都有谁，有名人吗？

original: WHO'S WHO
translate: 名人录

original: well we got bob, jimmy, the count, the duck, jessie and nefarious the magister
translate: 嗯，有鲍勃、吉米、伯爵、鸭子、杰西和邪恶的魔导师

original: Return to qs
translate: 返回问题

original: Help coming?
translate: 援助会来吗？

original: Nah
translate: 不

original: They don't care
translate: 他们不在乎

original: Monsters in seas even if they could get here
translate: 海里有怪物，就算他们能到这儿

original: They know I can handle things, and I will
translate: 他们知道我能处理，而且我会的

original: Qs
translate: 问题

original: How can I help?
translate: 我能帮什么忙？

original: Have you heard about Horryn?
translate: 你听说霍林的事了吗？

original: What's the occasion?
translate: 这是什么场合？

original: Is help coming?
translate: 援助会来吗？

original: I'm done here
translate: 我完事了

original: #Chapter1GraveDigger
translate: #第1章掘墓人

original: With trembling hands you cut into the pallid flesh and expose the entrails of the corpse
translate: 你用颤抖的双手切开苍白的皮肉，露出尸体的内脏

original: Driina leans in over your shoulder
translate: 德莉娜从你肩头探过身来

original: Those entrails don't look
translate: 那些内脏看起来不太……

original: Her words are cut short as the 'entrails' whip out of the wound in a mass of squirming, eyeless worms!
translate: 她的话戛然而止，因为那些“内脏”从伤口中猛地窜出，变成一团蠕动、无眼的蠕虫！

original: Panicked, you frantically scuttle away from the tiny snapping orifices when Roland charges past you with the shovel raised
translate: 惊慌中，你疯狂地逃离那些张合的小口，这时罗兰高举铁锹从你身边冲过

original: Panicked, you frantically scuttle away from the tiny snapping orifices till your hand instinctivly finds the shaft of the shovel!
translate: 惊慌中，你疯狂地逃离那些张合的小口，直到你的手本能地抓住了铁锹柄！

original: Just as you are about to abandon your grizzley task, when the 'entrails' whip out of the wound in a mass of squirming, eyeless worms!
translate: 就在你准备放弃这可怕的任务时，那些“内脏”从伤口中猛地窜出，变成一团蠕动、无眼的蠕虫！

original: The shovel makes short work of the tiny terrors, until both corpse and monster is reduced to a pulpy mass
translate: 铁锹三下两下就解决了这些微小的恐怖，直到尸体和怪物都化为一滩烂泥

original: Ashen-faced from horror, you push the broken corpses into their graves and quickly begin piling dirt onto them
translate: 你吓得脸色苍白，将破碎的尸体推入墓穴，迅速开始往上面堆土

original: As you work, Driina begins chanting
translate: 你干活时，德莉娜开始吟诵

original: Finish the work
translate: 完成工作

original: I'd rather have you lend a hand Driina
translate: 我更希望你搭把手，德莉娜

original: Your words offer comfort
translate: 你的话语带来慰藉

original: There are two corpses wrapped in linen before you
translate: 你面前有两具裹着亚麻布的尸体

original: Their graves have been dug but they still need to be filled in
translate: 墓穴已经挖好，但还需要填土

original: Examine corpses
translate: 检查尸体

original: The corpses are a man and a woman
translate: 尸体是一男一女

original: Perhaps they were once man and wife
translate: 也许他们曾是夫妻

original: They look well fed and there is no apparent cause of death
translate: 他们看起来营养充足，没有明显死因

original: Driina looks stoically at the pair
translate: 德莉娜坚忍地看着这对男女

original: They are with the Emperors now
translate: 他们现在与帝皇同在

original: Though I wonder what killed them
translate: 不过我想知道是什么杀死了他们

original: Investigate corpses more closely
translate: 更仔细地调查尸体

original: Bury the corpses
translate: 埋葬尸体

original: Place the corpses in their graves
translate: 将尸体放入墓穴

original: They look well fed and there is no apperant cause of death
translate: 他们看起来营养充足，没有明显死因

original: Harvest meat from the corpses
translate: 从尸体上割取肉

original: As you look the corpses over, you notice that their abdomens seem distended beyond that of simple corpse gas
translate: 你仔细查看尸体时，注意到他们的腹部肿胀，超出了普通尸气的程度

original: You apprehensively poke at the swelling and to your horror, the mass begins to squirm and shift!
translate: 你忐忑地戳了戳肿胀处，恐怖的是，那团东西开始蠕动、变形！

original: Hastily bury the corpses
translate: 匆忙埋葬尸体

original: Cut open the corpses
translate: 切开尸体

original: You examine the pair more closely but don't learn anything of interest
translate: 你更仔细地检查了这对男女，但没有发现任何有趣的东西

original: You carve several large slabs of flesh from the well-fed corpses
translate: 你从营养充足的尸体上割下几大块肉

original: You cannot help but think about how hungry you are
translate: 你不禁想到自己有多饿

original: Bury corpses and leave
translate: 埋葬尸体然后离开

original: Driina looks at the man with a sad smile
translate: 德莉娜带着悲伤的微笑看着那个男人

original: The dead must be put in the ground lest disease run rampant
translate: 死者必须入土，以免疾病肆虐

original: But take comfort: tending to the dead is holy work
translate: 但请安心：照料死者是神圣的工作

original: You'll have earned the grace of the Golden Tomb
translate: 你将赢得黄金墓园的恩典

original: The man looks down in shame
translate: 男人羞愧地低下头

original: It's just that it doesn't feel like it is all
translate: 只是感觉并非如此

original: Driina says we need to bury the dead lest disease runs rampant and how it's holy work
translate: 德莉娜说我们必须埋葬死者，以免疾病肆虐，还说这是神圣的工作

original: You mentioned hounds?
translate: 你提到了野狗？

original: Have you lost your mind?
translate: 你疯了吗？

original: I'd die before I'll let you deface these corpses!
translate: 我死也不会让你亵渎这些尸体！

original: The camp needs food and these are more well fed than most!
translate: 营地需要食物，而这些尸体比大多数人都营养充足！

original: Waht are you talking about?
translate: 你在说什么？

original: I'm sorry I don't know what came over me
translate: 对不起，我不知道自己怎么了

original: The flesh of the dead is sacred!
translate: 死者的血肉是神圣的！

original: I'm oath-sworn to protect and care for it and necrophagia is among the foulest of sins!
translate: 我立誓要保护并照料它，食尸是最污秽的罪孽之一！

original: We will feast on flesh!
translate: 我们要享用血肉！

original: You reget is genunine
translate: 你的悔意是真诚的

original: I forgive your transgression
translate: 我原谅你的过犯

original: It is this island - it turns our thoughs unsound
translate: 是这座岛——它让我们的思绪失常

original: Let's just bury these wretches and be done with it
translate: 我们就把这些可怜人埋了，了结此事吧

original: Bury corpses
translate: 埋葬尸体

original: You have lost your mind!
translate: 你疯了！

original: It is just as well we meet our end here
translate: 我们在此了结也好

original: Driina charges at you!
translate: 德莉娜向你冲来！

original: You wipe the grime from your face as you finish the grim task
translate: 你完成这阴森的任务时，抹去脸上的污垢

original: Sadly, you suspect these are far from the last graves that will be made for the poor refugees of Horryn before this is over
translate: 可悲的是，你怀疑在这结束之前，为霍林的可怜难民们挖掘的坟墓远不止这些

original: You place the corpses in their graves and quickly fill them in
translate: 你将尸体放入墓穴，迅速填土

original: It is hard work and the rugged widlerness around you looms threathningly
translate: 这是艰苦的工作，周围崎岖的荒野阴森地逼近

original: As you work, Driina stands above you, chanting
translate: 你干活时，德莉娜站在你上方，吟诵着

original: Your words offer comfort to living and dead both
translate: 你的话语给生者和死者都带来慰藉

original: So many have died the last days without proper burial or recieving their Rites of Sepulcation
translate: 过去几天有太多人死去，没有适当的安葬，也没有接受安葬礼

original: I need to do this
translate: 我必须这么做

original: You finish the work in silence
translate: 你在沉默中完成了工作

original: Driina smiles slightly
translate: 德莉娜微微一笑

original: This offers me some small peace of mind
translate: 这让我内心稍感安宁

original: The darkness of night is pressing in around you and as you prepare to leave you notice movement just past the edge of the darkness
translate: 黑夜的黑暗向你压来，当你准备离开时，你注意到黑暗边缘之外有动静

original: Before you manage to call out, slavering horrors charge at you!
translate: 你还没来得及喊出声，流着涎水的恐怖之物就向你冲来！

original: Haven't you seen 'em?
translate: 你没看见它们吗？

original: Bloody monsters roam the hills in packs!
translate: 该死的怪物成群结队地在山丘上游荡！

original: I ain't never seen hounds like these before
translate: 我从没见过这样的野狗

original: Hulking and diseased-looking
translate: 笨重而病态

original: Come at night they do
translate: 它们夜里来

original: Dig up the graves I dig and eat the dead right out of their very graves!
translate: 挖开我挖的坟墓，把死人直接从墓穴里吃掉！

original: Driina whispers a few words under her breath
translate: 德莉娜低声念了几句

original: The dead?
translate: 死人？

original: In the distance a howl sounds and the man straightens up like some prey animal sensing a predator
translate: 远处传来一声嚎叫，男人像察觉到捕食者的猎物一样直起身子

original: He briefly squints into the perpetual twilight that covers the island before grabbing his shovel and redoubling his efforts towards finishing his work
translate: 他眯着眼看了看笼罩岛屿的永恒暮光，然后抓起铁锹，加倍努力地完成工作

original: Run back to camp - I'll finish the job
translate: 跑回营地——我会完成这活儿

original: Well you better hurry up then
translate: 那你最好快点

original: You approach a man sweating profusely and caked in dirt
translate: 你走近一个汗流浃背、满身泥土的男人

original: He's hunched over and panting, seemingly winded from the hard work of digging graves
translate: 他弯腰喘着气，似乎因挖墓的辛苦工作而气喘吁吁

original: Who goes there!
translate: 谁在那儿！

original: The man jolts to hefting his shovel as a weapon
translate: 男人猛地举起铁锹当作武器

original: I'm not looking for trouble
translate: 我不是来找麻烦的

original: Why so jumpy?
translate: 为什么这么紧张？

original: Why so jumpy he asks!
translate: 为什么这么紧张，他问道！

original: Well since you ask, I drew the short straw and it's fallen upon my wretched shoulders to bury the dead
translate: 好吧，既然你问了，我抽到了下下签，这倒霉差事落到了我可怜的肩上，要埋葬死人

original: He shoots Driina a sulking glance
translate: 他愠怒地瞥了德莉娜一眼

original: And if I don't get back to it, I'll be food for the fell-hounds afore you know it!
translate: 要是我再不回去干活，转眼间我就会成为凶煞野狗的食物！

original: He looks around nervously
translate: 他紧张地环顾四周

original: Why so jumpy she asks!
translate: 为什么这么紧张，她问道！

original: Fell-hounds?
translate: 凶煞野狗？

original: The man looks at you with slight confusion then pushes his shovel into your hands
translate: 男人略带困惑地看着你，然后把铁锹塞到你手里

original: He thanks you profusely and runs back to camp
translate: 他千恩万谢，然后跑回营地

original: Driina nods in approval
translate: 德莉娜赞许地点点头

original: That was a good deed
translate: 那是件善事

original: Get to work
translate: 开始干活吧

original: The grave-digger looks up with a nervous look on his eyes
translate: 掘墓人抬起头，眼神紧张

original: Let me help you
translate: 让我帮你

original: The poor gravedigger looks at you with a grateful smile
translate: 可怜的掘墓人感激地对你微笑

original: He seems to have made no attempt at removing some of the grime that covers him
translate: 他似乎根本没想擦掉身上的一些污垢

original: No doubt he realizes he'll be back to work before long
translate: 无疑他意识到自己不久就得回来干活

original: #Chapter1IagoIntro
translate: #Chapter1IagoIntro

original: You lured me here, just to rob me, like a petty criminal?
translate: 你把我引到这里，就为了像个小毛贼一样抢劫我？

original: Oh, you poor fool - if only you knew who you were dealing with
translate: 哦，可怜的傻瓜——要是你知道自己在跟谁打交道就好了

original: The Queen has many friends in the Freymark
translate: 女王在弗雷马克有许多朋友，

original: Freinds who prefer their dealings be kept from Imperial eyes
translate: 这些朋友希望他们的交易避开帝国的耳目，

original: So when she bids me unfurl the black sails, I do
translate: 所以当她命我升起黑帆，我便照做

original: With pleasure I must add
translate: 而且我得说，我很乐意，

original: Iago smiles broadly
translate: 伊阿戈咧嘴一笑，

original: Who are these 'friends'?
translate: 这些“朋友”是谁？

original: Iago puts his fingertips to his chin in mock umbrage
translate: 伊阿戈将指尖抵在下巴上，佯装恼怒，

original: You imply I exaggerate my exploits?
translate: 你是在暗示我夸大自己的事迹？

original: No doubt I owe you my life, but I will not suffer my honor being questioned!
translate: 毫无疑问我欠你一条命，但我不能容忍我的荣誉受到质疑！

original: I meant no offense
translate: 我无意冒犯，

original: Your honour is intact
translate: 你的荣誉完好无损，

original: My patience is not
translate: 我的耐心可就不一定了，

original: Iago barks a wry laugh
translate: 伊阿戈发出一声苦笑，

original: I consider myself above the petty politics of the Imperials and Freythen
translate: 我自认为超脱于帝国军和弗雷森那套琐碎的政治之上，

original: But - I am loyal to my 'Queen' - who currently sympathises with the Thanes of Freymark
translate: 但是——我忠于我的“女王”——她目前同情弗雷马克的领主们，

original: But if we must discuss politics, let us do so again somewhere warmer, with wine in our bellies
translate: 但如果我们必须讨论政治，不如改天找个更暖和的地方，肚子里灌满酒再谈

original: Seeming to suddenly remember, Iago asks,
translate: 伊阿戈似乎突然想起什么，问道：

original: Things are not right here on Idra, are they?
translate: 伊德拉这里情况不对，是吧？

original: What foulness has transpired here?
translate: 这里发生了什么邪恶之事？

original: Horryn is lost
translate: 霍林失陷了，

original: To what, no-one yet knows
translate: 至于原因，还没人知道

original: Horryn's gone dark
translate: 霍林陷入了一片黑暗，

original: Iago looks askance at you
translate: 伊阿戈斜眼看着你，

original: Well, that won't do, will it?
translate: 嗯，这可不行，对吧？

original: In any case, we should make haste to the queen's lair
translate: 无论如何，我们得赶紧去女王的巢穴

original: Not many places are safer than wherever she is
translate: 没有多少地方比她所在之处更安全了，

original: Before we go, I must ask
translate: 在我们出发前，我得问一句

original: Let's go
translate: 我们走吧，

original: Iago
translate: 伊阿戈，

original: Blessed stranger, I owe you my life!
translate: 受祝福的陌生人，我欠你一条命！

original: When we could not spot the signal as expected, I feared we were trapped!
translate: 当我们没能如期看到信号时，我担心我们中了圈套！

original: But you are not my usual contact - tell me, to whom do I owe this debt of gratitude?
translate: 但你不是我平常的联系人——告诉我，我该向谁表达这份感激之情？

original: Though the gratitude appears genuine, there is a distinct tone of caution in his voice
translate: 尽管感激之情看似真诚，他的声音里却带着明显的谨慎

original: We are allies of the 'Queen'
translate: 我们是“女王”的同伴，

original: I'm a professional
translate: 我是专业人士，

original: That's all
translate: 仅此而已，

original: You thank me too soon
translate: 你谢得太早了，

original: Give up your arms!
translate: 放下武器！

original: Yes I guessed as much!
translate: 没错，我猜到了！

original: Non the less, I owe you my life
translate: 尽管如此，我欠你一条命

original: Had it not been for you we would have been trapped and, I fear, lost to that foul abomination from the deep!
translate: 要不是你，我们恐怕已经身陷绝境，葬身于那来自深渊的污秽异物之口！

original: How so?
translate: 此话怎讲？

original: Nevertheless, I owe you my life
translate: 无论如何，我欠你一条命

original: A foul leviathan of the depths came upon us as soon as we spotted Idra!
translate: 我们一发现伊德拉，一头深渊的污秽利维坦就朝我们扑来！

original: But my ship is fast and the wind was at my back
translate: 但我的船很快，而且顺风，

original: Had it not been, we would be ffeding the fish now
translate: 要不是这样，我们现在已经在喂鱼了

original: Go on
translate: 继续说，

original: Spare me the drama!
translate: 别跟我演戏！

original: Bless the stars, we made it to the realtive safetfy of the outer searocks
translate: 感谢星辰庇佑，我们总算抵达了外围海礁的相对安全地带

original: The leviathan it seems, will not give chase into shallow waters
translate: 看来，那头利维坦不会追进浅水区

original: However, we had gone from the frying pan, into the fire!
translate: 然而，我们刚出油锅，又入火海！

original: Go on!
translate: 继续说！

original: Oh spare me the drama!
translate: 哦，别跟我来这套！

original: Imperials prowl the shores and costs of Idra due to the nature of the cargo we carry and the friends we keep
translate: 由于我们携带的货物和结交的朋友，帝国军在伊德拉的海岸和沿海地带巡逻，

original: We did not dare approach land until the signal was given!
translate: 在信号发出之前，我们不敢靠近陆地！

original: I don't have time for this drama!
translate: 我没时间听你演戏！

original: You've fallen into my trap!
translate: 你中了我的圈套！

original: Now give up your arms!
translate: 现在放下武器！

original: You may sail with me, if you wish it?
translate: 如果你愿意，可以和我一起航行？

original: We'll stay close to the coast, it should be perfectly safe
translate: 我们会紧贴海岸航行，应该绝对安全

original: Thank you - I accept
translate: 谢谢——我接受，

original: We'll meet you there
translate: 我们在那里碰头，

original: I know it was angry, possessed of many tentacles, and had a deep hunger for handsome, daring sailors
translate: 我只知道它怒气冲冲，长着许多触手，而且对英俊勇敢的水手有着深深的渴望

original: Beyond that, the thing is a bloody terrifying mystery to me
translate: 除此之外，那东西对我来说就是个该死的恐怖谜团

original: That about lines up with my experience
translate: 这跟我的经历大致吻合，

original: I doubt it's that discerning, but yes
translate: 我怀疑它没那么挑剔，不过没错

original: Iago grins rakishly
translate: 伊阿戈露出浪荡的笑容，

original: We need your ship!
translate: 我们需要你的船！

original: What do you know of the leviathan?
translate: 你对那头利维坦了解多少？

original: What cargo do you carry?
translate: 你运的是什么货物？

original: It's time we got going
translate: 我们该出发了，

original: I understand your desire - she's quite the beauty
translate: 我理解你的渴望——她确实是个美人，

original: Sleek, trusty - happy so long as she has a few strong hands on her
translate: 线条流畅，忠实可靠——只要有几双强壮的手驾驭她，她就心满意足

original: But I guess you had something more specific in mind?
translate: 但我猜你心里想的是更具体的事？

original: I need to sail into the Black Priory
translate: 我需要航行到黑修院，

original: To get off this rock, for good
translate: 为了永远离开这块破地方

original: Try asking me again - and a little more politely - after we've visited my lady the Queen
translate: 等我们拜访过我的女王之后，再问我一次——而且语气要更礼貌些，

original: And when you can reassure me that the many-legged sea-bastard won't smash us into smithereens
translate: 而且得等你向我保证，那头多腿的海中杂种不会把我们撞成碎片，

original: I will
translate: 我会的，

original: I'll ask however I please
translate: 我想怎么问就怎么问，

original: #Chapter1IagoMessenger
translate: #第一章伊阿戈信使

original: A man with leather-like skin covered in sailor’s tattoos approaches you
translate: 一个皮肤如皮革般粗糙、布满水手纹身的男人向你走来。

original: Greetings m’lord
translate: 您好，大人。

original: Greetings m’lady
translate: 您好，女士。

original: Name’s Donovan, ‘Dono’ for short and I’m here looking for someone a lot like you!
translate: 我叫多诺万，简称‘多诺’，我来这儿就是为了找你这样的人！

original: Well, begging your pardon but you look less covered in shit than the rest of this lot and able to carry a blade m’lord
translate: 嗯，请恕我直言，您看起来比这儿的其他人干净多了，而且能佩刀，大人。

original: Well, begging your pardon but you look less covered in shit than the rest of this lot and able to carry a blade m’lady
translate: 嗯，请恕我直言，您看起来比这儿的其他人干净多了，而且能佩刀，女士。

original: I serve on the vessel ‘Weathermaiden’ and I’m here on the orders of my first-mate Zhara
translate: 我在“天候少女号”上服役，奉大副扎拉的命令来此。

original: I've already talked to Zhara!
translate: 我已经和扎拉谈过了！

original: Dono offers a clumsy bow before making his way out of camp, heading north-west
translate: 多诺笨拙地鞠了一躬，然后离开营地，朝西北方向走去。

original: The man blinks in relief
translate: 那人如释重负地眨了眨眼。

original: Well in that case it seems I’ve done my job exceptionally well!
translate: 哦，那样的话，看来我的任务完成得格外好！

original: May the Mother of Maelstroms guide you in finding Captain Iago!
translate: 愿风暴之母指引你找到伊阿戈船长！

original: Better you talk to her yourself!
translate: 你最好亲自和她谈谈！

original: We’re holed up in a large sea-cave west of here while the ‘maiden’ is undergoing repairs
translate: 我们躲在这西边的一个大海蚀洞窟里，而“少女号”正在修理。

original: Zhara will be waiting for you there
translate: 扎拉会在那里等你。

original: Here, I’ll show you on your map
translate: 来，我指给你看，在你的地图上。

original: Dono indicates the position 66 by 91 on your map of the Outer Isles
translate: 多诺在你外岛地图上指出了66

original: I must ask you do not delay
translate: 我必须请你不要耽搁。

original: Greetings m’Lord
translate: 您好，大人。

original: Greetings m’Lady
translate: 您好，女士。

original: Well, begging your pardon but you look less covered in shit than the rest of this lot and able to carry a blade m’Lord
translate: 嗯，请恕我直言，您看起来比这儿的其他人干净多了，而且能佩刀，大人。

original: Well, begging your pardon but you look less covered in shit than the rest of this lot and able to carry a blade m’Lady
translate: 嗯，请恕我直言，您看起来比这儿的其他人干净多了，而且能佩刀，女士。

original: #Chapter1Iben
translate: #第一章伊本

original: The Reavers are fierce, but they are a poorly organized lot
translate: 劫掠者凶猛，但他们是一群组织涣散的乌合之众

original: With a small troupe of hungry and fearful guardsmen I was able to fight my way to the square and slay many of their numbers
translate: 带着一小队饥饿而恐惧的卫兵，我得以杀到广场，斩杀了他们许多人

original: If this is a trap, I believe it to be a poorly laid one
translate: 如果这是个陷阱，我相信这是个布置得很拙劣的陷阱

original: And what did you have in mind?
translate: 那你有什么想法？

original: The situation inside the city is still unclear but what we do know is that the Reavers have formed factions
translate: 城里的情况仍不明朗，但我们知道劫掠者已经形成了几个势力

original: Though some are doubtlessly still rabid, others may be open to parlaying
translate: 虽然有些人无疑仍然疯狂，但其他人可能愿意谈判

original: If this is so, we might be able to use that to our advantage
translate: 如果是这样，我们或许能利用这一点

original: In other words, we fight when we must but if we can use cunning instead I’m certain the Dead will favor us!
translate: 换句话说，我们该打就打，但如果能用计谋，我确信亡者会眷顾我们！

original: Venture forth!
translate: 即刻启程！

original: Now pay close attention!
translate: 现在仔细听好！

original: Iben leans in intently
translate: 伊本专注地凑近身子

original: You’ll enter Horryn by the Fishermen’s Gate to the south east
translate: 你们将从东南边的渔夫之门进入霍林

original: Once inside you must seek out each of the three Reaver chieftains and put an end to them one way or another
translate: 进去之后，你们必须找到那三个劫掠者首领，用某种方式了结他们

original: We must be careful with a frontal assault
translate: 我们必须小心正面进攻

original: But I suspect there is little cohesion and much infighting among the Reavers
translate: 但我怀疑劫掠者之间缺乏团结，内斗严重

original: Perhaps that can be used to our advantage?
translate: 也许这能为我们所用？

original: As long as the Reavers hold the city and port, they will eventually starve us out
translate: 只要劫掠者控制着城市和港口，他们最终会饿死我们

original: They were able to take it because they had surprise on their side!
translate: 他们能攻下它，是因为占了出其不意的便宜！

original: And now: they rule by terror!
translate: 而现在：他们靠恐怖统治！

original: So long as we sit here, fearful and hungry, they will eventually fall upon us!
translate: 只要我们坐在这里，恐惧又饥饿，他们最终会扑向我们！

original: I say we shit on that!
translate: 我说去他妈的！

original: I have a way into Horryn!
translate: 我有办法进入霍林！

original: Let us venture forth and attempt to free her from these savages!
translate: 让我们即刻启程，试着从这些野蛮人手中解放她！

original: We have men and women here, willing and able to bear arms if called upon
translate: 我们这里有男有女，只要一声令下，都愿意且能够拿起武器

original: A small band of strong swords could slip in using the Fishermen’s Gate, sow chaos among the ranks of the Reavers and open the main gate from inside!
translate: 一小队强壮的剑士可以从渔夫之门潜入，在劫掠者中制造混乱，然后从里面打开主城门！

original: If this was done, I am certain we stand a chance at retaking the city!
translate: 如果做到这一点，我确信我们有机会夺回城市！

original: How would we sow chaos?
translate: 我们怎么制造混乱？

original: From what we learned, the Reavers in the city have formed splinter groups around three chieftains
translate: 据我们所知，城里的劫掠者围绕三个首领形成了分裂的团体

original: Red Kala rules the docks, Oleg the Gray is holed up in the old Fisherman’s Lodge and someone they call ‘the Butcher’ holds his court on the steps of the temple
translate: 红卡菈统治着码头，灰发奥列格盘踞在老渔夫小屋，还有个被他们称为‘屠夫’的人在神庙台阶上设朝

original: While those three mad-men still draw breath, the Reavers are still a danger
translate: 只要那三个疯子还活着，劫掠者就仍是威胁

original: We must put an end to them
translate: 我们必须了结他们

original: Either by force of arms or subterfuge
translate: 无论是用武力还是诡计

original: I am certain a way may be found to pit the fools against each other
translate: 我确信能找到办法让这些蠢货互相残杀

original: Iben’s eyes glimmer with lust for adventure
translate: 伊本眼中闪烁着对冒险的渴望

original: Or is it bloodthirst?
translate: 还是嗜血？

original: So what say ye?
translate: 那么你们怎么说？

original: Shall we make a tale worthy of the skalds?
translate: 我们要创造一段配得上Skald传颂的传奇吗？

original: Let's do it!
translate: 我们干吧！

original: I'll do it but we don't need company
translate: 我会干，但我们不需要同伴

original: That the situation is dire but not hopeless
translate: 局势严峻但并非毫无希望

original: By chance or design, the Fishermen’s Gate to the south-east has been opened
translate: 不知是偶然还是有意，东南边的渔夫之门已经打开了

original: My party and I were able to make it all the way to the square before we encountered reavers
translate: 我和我的队伍一路杀到了广场才遭遇劫掠者

original: I lost men, but we cut their band down before we retreated
translate: 我损失了人手，但我们在撤退前消灭了他们那伙人

original: If we move fast, we may yet be able to take advantage of the gate!
translate: 如果我们行动迅速，也许还能利用那扇门！

original: That sounds like a trap!
translate: 听起来像个陷阱！
