original: For the first time you notice the green-clad man lingering there
translate: 你第一次注意到那个穿着绿衣的男人在那里徘徊

original: He steps into the light as he takes a long drag from his pipe
translate: 他走进光亮处，长长地吸了一口烟斗

original: Get some food Markus
translate: 去吃点东西，马库斯

original: You're no good to any of us if you starve yourself to death
translate: 你要是把自己饿死了，对我们任何人都没好处

original: Soon enough old friend!
translate: 很快了，老朋友！

original: {PLAYER}, this is Iben
translate: {PLAYER}，这位是伊本

original: He is a most useful individual and served the governor well before the calamities befell us
translate: 他是个非常有用的人，在灾难降临之前曾为总督效力

original: Iben’s eyes sparkle and as he puffs a ring of smoke a smile plays across his face
translate: 伊本的眼睛闪闪发光，他吐出一个烟圈，脸上浮现出微笑

original: It is good to see I’m not the only useful individual to be found in these times
translate: 很高兴看到在这种时候，我不是唯一有用的人

original: Iben takes another pull on his pipe as he studies you
translate: 伊本又吸了一口烟斗，打量着你

original: The man’s skin is the texture of well-worn leather and his dark eyes have the keen-ness of a predator
translate: 这人的皮肤如同久经磨损的皮革，黑色的眼睛有着掠食者的敏锐

original: More than anything, this man reminds you of some well-made tool
translate: 最重要的是，这个男人让你想起某种制作精良的工具

original: Or perhaps a weapon?
translate: 或者是一件武器？

original: So, what did you learn in Horryn?
translate: 那么，你在霍林打听到了什么？

original: The smell of cooking food fills the camp and mixes with the sounds of cheers and blessings coming from the ragged lot of starving refugees
translate: 烹饪食物的气味弥漫营地，与那群衣衫褴褛、饥饿的难民发出的欢呼和祝福声交织在一起

original: You enter the makeshift office of Markus to tell him the good news and find him agitatedly pacing back and forth
translate: 你走进马库斯的临时办公室，想告诉他好消息，却发现他焦躁地来回踱步

original: {PLAYER}, I heard the news!
translate: {PLAYER}，我听说了！

original: That is amazing!
translate: 太棒了！

original: You’ve given us a fighting chance!
translate: 你给了我们一线生机！

original: And in the Emperor’s time it seems!
translate: 而且似乎是在帝皇的庇佑下！

original: Iben here has returned from scouting the city and he comes bearing curious news
translate: 伊本刚从城里侦察回来，带来了奇怪的消息

original: Iben, tell {PLAYER} what you just told me!
translate: 伊本，把你刚才告诉我的告诉{PLAYER}！

original: The recent excitement has evidently taken more than expected out of the plump man and Markus slumps heavily into his chair
translate: 最近的激动显然让这个胖男人消耗过度，马库斯重重地瘫倒在椅子上

original: He gestures absent-mindedly to an unlit corner of the room as he catches his breath
translate: 他喘着气，心不在焉地朝房间一个没点灯的角落打了个手势

original: That will also work!
translate: 那也行！

original: There is much to do here in camp to get those able to bear arms ready to storm the gate!
translate: 营地里有很多事要做，要让能拿起武器的人准备好冲击城门！

original: I will lead them through once the signal is given and we will clasp hands over the corpses of our foes!
translate: 一旦信号发出，我就带领他们冲过去，我们将在敌人的尸体上握手！

original: Then woe to those who stand against us!
translate: 那么，与我们为敌者必将遭殃！

original: Iben slaps Markus on the back so briskly that his hat flies off
translate: 伊本猛地一拍马库斯的背，他的帽子都飞了出去

original: As Markus recovers, he begins nervously poring over papers
translate: 马库斯缓过来后，开始紧张地翻阅文件

original: I need to begin the mustering!
translate: 我得开始集结了！

original: They’ll also need supplies and arms for the civilians, and we need to prepare to receive more wounded!
translate: 他们还需要给平民补给和武器，我们还得准备接收更多伤员！

original: I best get to it!
translate: 我最好马上去办！

original: Markus dips his quill in ink and starts scribbling
translate: 马库斯用羽毛笔蘸了蘸墨水，开始奋笔疾书

original: Ask now, while you have the chance!
translate: 趁现在有机会，快问吧！

original: Could there still be survivors in the city?
translate: 城里可能还有幸存者吗？

original: How should we eliminate the Reaver chieftains?
translate: 我们该如何除掉劫掠者首领？

original: Is there a way to open the main gate?
translate: 有办法打开主城门吗？

original: Iben is humming a low tune as the thoughtfully chews his empty pipe when he notices you
translate: 伊本若有所思地咬着空烟斗，低声哼着曲子，这时他注意到了你

original: Ho there {PLAYER}!
translate: 嘿，{PLAYER}！

original: What news?
translate: 有什么消息？

original: Shall we join forces?
translate: 我们要联手吗？

original: We shall indeed!
translate: 我们当然要！

original: I dare say, great deeds lie ahead of us
translate: 我敢说，伟大的功绩就在前方

original: There are two gates in the city
translate: 城里有两座城门

original: The main gate to the north and one to the south, leading to the harbor
translate: 北边的主城门和南边通往港口的城门

original: Both are heavy portcullises and the only way to raise them is to find the nearby mechanism that operates them
translate: 两座都是沉重的落栅门，升起它们的唯一办法是找到附近的操作机关

original: Survivors may be hiding in barricaded houses and perhaps cellars!
translate: 幸存者可能躲在设了路障的房屋里，甚至地窖里！

original: What’s more, the city has a large sewer system and if I were trapped inside with Reavers at my heels, I would certainly consider finding shelter there!
translate: 而且，城里有一套庞大的下水道系统，如果我被困在里面，身后有劫掠者追赶，我肯定会考虑去那里避难！

original: Perhaps that can be used to our advantage
translate: 也许这能为我们所用，

original: #Chapter1IdraLandingLuggage
translate: #第一章伊德拉登陆行李

original: Better yet
translate: 更好的是

original: The combination lock remains sound, meaning the content of the chest is likely still unmolested
translate: “密码锁完好无损，意味着箱子里的东西很可能还没被动过”

original: You best not be getting any ideas with my property, little fishy
translate: “你最好别打我财产的主意，小鱼儿”

original: Basilo growls as he eyes you suspiciously
translate: 巴西洛怀疑地盯着你，咆哮道

original: I think you mean MY property?
translate: 我想你指的是我的财产吧？

original: Wha.. wha… what’cha mean?
translate: 什……什……你什么意思？

original: That just ‘cause she made you live, now you’re somehow entitled to Basilo’s treasures?
translate: “就因为她让你活了下来，你就觉得自己有资格得到巴西洛的宝贝了？”

original: Basilo’s the Mother’s chosen!
translate: 巴西洛是老漩母的宠儿！

original: Not you!
translate: 不是你！

original: Now fuck off and get me that teliscope if you want yer bleeding box!
translate: 现在给我滚开，想要你那该死的箱子就把那个望远镜给我拿来！

original: I choose violence you old fool!
translate: 我选择暴力，你这老傻瓜！

original: Basilo looks surprised and stutters incoherently
translate: 巴西洛一脸惊讶，语无伦次地结巴起来

original: The man’s eyes tear up
translate: 他眼眶湿润了

original: There’s truth in that!
translate: 这话有道理！

original: Basilo knows it in his bones!
translate: 巴西洛打心底里知道！

original: Pox on you: there’s truth in it!
translate: 你该死：这话确实有道理！

original: Have yer bleeding box
translate: 拿上你那该死的箱子吧

original: Basilo goes off to sulk in a corner
translate: 巴西洛走到角落里生闷气去了

original: Open the chest
translate: 打开箱子

original: The chest ahead of you is wet and covered in seaweed
translate: 你面前的箱子湿漉漉的，上面覆盖着海藻

original: It also looks familiar
translate: 它看起来也很眼熟

original: Instantly, you realize this is your luggage from the Zephyr
translate: “你立刻意识到，这是你在西风号上的行李”

original: It had been stowed too well to get to during the mutiny but by some miracle, it made it to shore where it must have been “salvaged
translate: “它在暴动时被藏得太好，没能拿到，但奇迹般地，它漂到了岸边，想必是被‘打捞’了”

original: What old Mother Maelstrom saw fit to bequeath upon me, I’s keeps
translate: “老漩母觉得该赐给我的东西，我就留着”

original: Basilo’s eyes narrow as he fiddles the strap of his club
translate: 巴西洛眯起眼睛，摆弄着棍棒的带子

original: Then again, that’s not to say I mightn’t be willing to make a deal with ya?
translate: “不过话说回来，这也不是说我可能不愿意跟你做个交易？”

original: What did you have in mind?
translate: 你有什么想法？

original: See there’s this man, a stargazer he is, came here a few days ago
translate: “你看，有这么个人，是个看星星的，几天前来了这儿”

original: Perched hisself on that cliff right over there
translate: 就待在那边的悬崖上

original: Basilo points to the cliff that rises over the beach to the east
translate: 巴西洛指向东边海滩上耸立的悬崖

original: Thing is, he was carrying something I can hardly put into words
translate: “问题是，他带着个我难以形容的东西”

original: Is like a tube with glass in it that you use to look at the stars and such!
translate: 就像一根管子，里面有玻璃，用来观察星星什么的！

original: A telescope?
translate: 望远镜？

original: That’s what he called it!
translate: 他就是这么叫的！

original: Old Basilo would love to have it if you can get your way up to where he made camp!
translate: 老巴西洛很想要它，如果你能想办法去他扎营的地方拿到的话！

original: There’s meaning in the stars you see - Old wisdom and such
translate: 你看，星星里有意义——古老的智慧什么的

original: And don’t fret!
translate: 别担心！

original: Basilo saw big ol’ fat crows circling near the camp
translate: 巴西洛看到又大又肥的乌鸦在营地附近盘旋

original: I’ll bet Basilo’s eye that the Stargazer’s dead and rotting and his teliscope’s just waiting to be salvaged!
translate: 我敢用巴西洛的眼睛打赌，那个看星星的已经死了，烂了，他的望远镜正等着被打捞呢！

original: I’d rather you just hand my things over
translate: 我宁愿你把我的东西直接还给我

original: Mother Maelstrom’s favored and all
translate: 老漩母的宠儿什么的

original: As you hand the telescope over to the wreck-picker his eyes light up in a not wholly sane manner
translate: 当你把望远镜递给这个拾荒者时，他的眼睛亮了起来，带着几分疯狂

original: Chest’s yours little fish!
translate: 箱子归你了，小鱼儿！

original: Basilo shouts over his shoulder as he rushes out into the yard with his new prize
translate: 巴西洛头也不回地喊道，拿着新宝贝冲进了院子

original: If you be nosing around Basilo’s treasures you best have something for me!?
translate: 你要是想打巴西洛宝贝的主意，最好给我带点什么！？

original: Basilo barks at you
translate: 巴西洛对你吼道

original: I have the telescope
translate: 我有望远镜

original: #Chapter1IdraLighthouseCave
translate: #Chapter1IdraLighthouseCave

original: The weathered box crumbles as you touch it, revealing an ancient knife of exquisitely carved greenish stone
translate: 当你触碰时破旧的盒子碎裂开来露出一把雕刻精美的绿色石质古刀

original: With trembling hands you pick it up and for a moment the air around you seems to become charged with eldritch energies
translate: 你用颤抖的双手拿起它一瞬间周围的空气似乎充满了诡异能量

original: Sounds die down and your nostrils fill with the metallic tinge of ozone
translate: 声音逐渐消失你的鼻孔里充满了臭氧的金属气味

original: No doubt this is the object Mathias the lighthousekeeper asked you to retrieve
translate: 毫无疑问这就是守塔人马蒂亚斯让你取回的东西

original: No doubt the blade is an object of strange and ancient magics
translate: 毫无疑问这把刀是一件蕴含奇异古老魔法的物品

original: A sickly, wet bubbling sound snaps you back into focus
translate: 一阵令人作呕的湿漉漉的冒泡声将你拉回现实

original: All around you, the clay jars begin to stir and then, one after another, they burst with loud cracks as a thick substance pours from them
translate: 你周围的陶罐开始晃动然后一个接一个地爆裂开来发出响亮的破裂声浓稠的物质从中涌出

original: To your horror, the viscous substance begins to move of its own volition towards you!
translate: 令你惊恐的是那粘稠的物质开始自行向你移动

original: Driina slowly walks around the slab, taking in the strange sight
translate: 德莉娜缓缓绕着石板走动观察着这奇异的景象

original: There is ritual at work here
translate: 这里正在进行某种仪式

original: Though nothing like the Imperial rites of Sepulcation
translate: 尽管与帝国的安葬礼完全不同

original: This is something different
translate: 这是完全不同的东西

original: There is a sense of technicality to it
translate: 其中透着一股技术性的意味

original: Like children observing a parent practicing some complex craft and trying to emulate it
translate: 就像孩子们观察父母练习某种复杂手艺并试图模仿一样

original: She shudders
translate: 她打了个寒颤

original: It terrifies me
translate: 这让我感到恐惧

original: The dead stare indignantly at you with empty eye sockets as you examine their naked forms
translate: 当你检查他们赤裸的身体时死者用空洞的眼窝愤愤不平地凝视着你

original: You find several lesions on them - no doubt caused by the strange instruments that surround them
translate: 你发现他们身上有几处损伤——毫无疑问是由周围那些奇怪的器械造成的

original: As to the purpose of the cuts, you have no idea
translate: 至于这些切口的用途你毫无头绪

original: As you look more closely it becomes clear to you that these are not the incisions that are commonly associated with the removal of organs for embalming
translate: 当你更仔细地观察时你清楚地发现这些并非通常与取出器官进行防腐处理相关的切口

original: In fact, from what you can tell, the corpses’ organs are still intact
translate: 事实上据你判断尸体的器官仍然完好无损

original: This ritual seems to have served another purpose
translate: 这个仪式似乎另有目的

original: Though what, you cannot possibly guess
translate: 但究竟是什么你完全猜不到

original: Carefully brushing away dust and cobwebs you survey the oddly shaped instruments
translate: 你小心地拂去灰尘和蛛网审视着那些形状奇特的器械

original: Their shapes vary from small blades to hooks and other, stranger forms
translate: 它们的形状各异从小型刀片到钩子还有其他更奇怪的形状

original: You have no idea as to their purpose
translate: 你对它们的用途一无所知

original: As you stand there pondering the strange scene before you, your eyes fall on a small wooden box
translate: 当你站在那里思索眼前的奇异景象时你的目光落在一个小木盒上

original: Examine the box
translate: 检查盒子

original: Even a cursory examination reveals that these instruments were likely used on the corpses but as far as you can tell they do not seem to be embalming tools
translate: 即使粗略检查也能发现这些器械很可能用于尸体但就你看来它们似乎不是防腐工具

original: Instead they seem more like primitive imitations of the tools Imperial surgeons use
translate: 相反它们更像是帝国外科医生所用工具的原始仿制品

original: An Ancient Corpse
translate: 一具古尸

original: Two desiccated corpses lie carefully placed on a carved stone slab
translate: 两具干瘪的尸体被精心放置在一块雕刻过的石板上

original: There is a deliberateness in their arrangement that gives the strong impression of forgotten secrets and ancient rituals
translate: 它们的摆放方式透露出一种刻意强烈地暗示着被遗忘的秘密和古老的仪式

original: Scattered about the corpses are several strange looking metal instruments
translate: 尸体周围散落着几件看起来奇怪的金属器械

original: Examine the corpses
translate: 检查尸体

original: Driina, what do you make of this?
translate: 德莉娜，你怎么看？

original: Examine the instruments
translate: 检查器械

original: Sprawled on the ground ahead of you lies the mangled body of a man
translate: 在你前方的地面上躺着一具血肉模糊的男尸

original: Stacked high against the walls behind the poor fellow are crates of goods and you have a feeling you've stumbled upon a smuggler's hideout
translate: 在这可怜的家伙身后的墙边高高堆放着货物箱你感觉自己无意中发现了一个走私者的藏身处

original: One that has seen fairly recent use
translate: 一个最近还在使用的藏身处

original: You enter into the larger chamber ahead and the temperature drops noticeably
translate: 你进入前方更大的房间温度明显下降

original: As the swirling dust and ghostly vapors subside, you make out the intimidating form of an ancient, carved monolith
translate: 随着旋转的尘埃和幽灵般的雾气消散你辨认出一块古老而雕刻的巨石那令人生畏的轮廓

original: Painted on its face, you immediately recognize the crude spiral sign you saw on the standing stones above ground
translate: 在它的表面你立刻认出了你在地面立石上见过的粗糙螺旋符号

original: Painted on its face, you can make out the crude shape of a red spiral
translate: 在它的表面你能辨认出一个粗糙的红色螺旋形状

original: Carefully arranged before the monolith lies two diminutive, desiccated corpses and along the edges of the chamber stand strange urns of unknown design
translate: 巨石前精心摆放着两具干瘪的小尸体房间边缘则立着设计未知的奇怪瓮罐

original: The chamber has an aura of age beyond comprehension and your head begins to spin as you realize you may be the first to set foot in it for millennia
translate: 这个房间散发着一种难以理解的古老气息当你意识到自己可能是数千年来第一个踏入此地的人时你的头开始眩晕

original: We shouldn't be here
translate: 我们不该在这里

original: Kat whispers behind you
translate: 卡蒂在你身后低语

original: The Tunnel
translate: 隧道

original: Creeping through the narrow and cobweb covered tunnel it occurs to you that you’re likely the first to use it in decades
translate: 爬过狭窄且布满蛛网的隧道时你想到自己很可能是几十年来第一个使用它的人

original: It appears that neither the smugglers, nor whoever lies on the other end of the tunnel, knew of its existence
translate: 看来无论是走私者还是隧道另一端的人都不知道它的存在

original: The wall ahead is no doubt another door and you put your shoulder to it
translate: 前方的墙壁无疑是另一扇门你用肩膀顶住它

original: Expecting the massive slab of rock to be heavy, you're surprised to find it easily swings open and you nearly stumble into the room ahead
translate: 本以为这块巨大的石板会很重你惊讶地发现它轻松地转开了你差点跌进前方的房间

original: It occurs to you that given the doors clever design, there would likely have been no way of finding this door from the other side
translate: 你想到鉴于这扇门的巧妙设计从另一边很可能根本无法发现这扇门

original: #Chapter1KataksChild
translate: #第一章 卡塔克的孩子

original: A Scream
translate: 一声尖叫

original: As you make your way through the dense underbrush a terrible, inhuman scream cuts through the forest
translate: 当你穿过茂密的灌木丛时，一声可怕的、非人的尖叫划破了森林

original: You instantly recognize it as the foul abomination that fled from 'Mother' Katak's cottage
translate: 你立刻认出那是从“卡塔克嬷嬷”小屋逃走的邪恶异物

original: No doubt the creature still lives
translate: 毫无疑问那生物还活着

original: A Shadow
translate: 一道阴影

original: You stop dead in your tracks as you suddenly see a shadow in the corner of your eyes
translate: 你突然在眼角瞥见一道阴影，顿时停下了脚步

original: As you turn to look, it's gone
translate: 当你转身去看时，它已消失无踪

original: Then suddenly, an unmistakable piping sounds from behind you
translate: 紧接着，身后突然传来一阵清晰无误的尖啸声

original: You whirl around but once again the source is gone
translate: 你猛地转身，但声音的源头又一次消失了

original: There is no doubt however
translate: 然而毫无疑问

original: Mother Katak's child is stalking you
translate: 卡塔克嬷嬷的孩子正在跟踪你

original: # Chapter_1_Landing
translate: # 章节_1_登陆

original: #Chapter1Landing
translate: #章节1登陆

original: The Shores of Idra
translate: 伊德拉海岸

original: Slowly, you drag yourself from the cold water onto the relative safety of solid rock
translate: 你缓慢地从冰冷的海水中拖曳着身体，爬上相对安全的坚硬岩石

original: You try, and fail, to stagger forwards as exhaustion washes over you in a great, black wave
translate: 你试图踉跄前行，却失败了，疲惫如同一股巨大的黑色浪潮将你淹没

original: Oblivion takes you before you hit the rocky ground
translate: 在你摔倒在嶙峋地面之前，虚无便攫住了你

original: You're awoken by the cacophonous cries of gulls circling you
translate: 你被海鸥在你头顶盘旋时发出的刺耳叫声吵醒

original: Your body is a mass of pain and exhaustion - covered in a thousand cuts and scrapes
translate: 你的身体充斥着疼痛与疲惫——布满了无数割伤和擦伤

original: The large white birds gather around you in eager anticipation
translate: 这些白色的大鸟满怀急切期待地聚集在你周围

original: What a magnificent feast your bloated corpse would make
translate: 你肿胀的尸体将会成为多么丰盛的一顿盛宴啊

original: Not today
translate: 但今天不行

original: Minutes or perhaps hours pass as you lay unmoving - trying desperately to will some warmth back into your body
translate: 几分钟或是几小时过去了，你一动不动地躺着——拼命试图让一丝暖意回到身体里

original: Finally you manage to force your eyes open
translate: 你终于设法强迫自己睁开了眼睛

original: By some miracle you are not only alive, but you find yourself on the shores of the cursed island of Idra
translate: 出于某种奇迹，你不仅还活着，而且发现自己正身处被诅咒的伊德拉岛海岸

original: Strewn around you is the wreckage of the Zephyr
translate: 散落在你周围的是西风号的残骸

original: You see no other survivors
translate: 你没看到其他幸存者

original: Lest you find equipment and companions soon, you may have cheated death in vain
translate: 除非你能尽快找到装备和同伴，否则你这次死里逃生可能只是徒劳

original: #Chapter1LandingCrabCave
translate: #Chapter1LandingCrabCave

original: Large, mis-shapen crabs emerge from the water all around you!
translate: 巨大、畸形的螃蟹从你周围的水中冒了出来！

original: Intentionally or not, the seemingly mindless beasts have lain an ambush for you!
translate: 不管有意无意，这些看似无脑的野兽已经为你设下了埋伏！

original: Fight
translate: 战斗

original: They took the bodies of the drowned!
translate: 它们拖走了溺水者的尸体！

original: Men and women I’ve known for years!
translate: 我认识多年的男男女女！

original: All blue and swollen
translate: 全都发青肿胀

original: Dragged them into this cave
translate: 把它们拖进了这个洞穴

original: Crabs as big as horses!
translate: 像马一样大的螃蟹！

original: How can such a thing be?
translate: 怎么会有这种事？

original: What’s wrong with this place?
translate: 这地方到底怎么了？

original: It occurs to you that the wretch either does not recognize you from the Zephyr or he is too desperate to care
translate: 你意识到这个可怜虫要么没认出你是西风号上的人，要么已经绝望到不在乎了

original: In any case, I was too weak to fight back when I landed and they must have thought I was dead
translate: 不管怎样，我上岸时太虚弱了，没法反抗，它们一定以为我死了

original: Dragged me into the darkness
translate: 把我拖进了黑暗

original: But when I heard those sounds, claws rending dead flesh, something awoke in me!
translate: 但当我听到那些声音，爪子撕裂死肉的声音，我内心有什么东西觉醒了！

original: I kicked and screamed as best I could and they let me go!
translate: 我拼命踢打尖叫，它们就放开了我！

original: I ran as fast as I could but I took a turn in the darkness and ended up here!
translate: 我拼命跑，但在黑暗中拐错了一个弯，结果就到了这里！

original: I could hear them moving about in the caves around me and I didn’t dare try to make it out
translate: 我能听到它们在我周围的洞穴里移动，我不敢尝试逃出去

original: If you hadn’t come here I’d have died from thirst!
translate: 如果你没来，我早就渴死了！

original: The way out should be clear for you now!
translate: 出去的路现在应该畅通了！

original: A Foul Cave
translate: 恶臭的洞穴

original: Eons worth of the sea’s ravage upon the land has given birth to this cave
translate: 大海对陆地亿万年的侵蚀造就了这个洞穴

original: From its depths, a stench of seaweed and rotting flesh rises
translate: 从洞穴深处，升腾起海藻和腐肉的恶臭

original: So foul is it, that it feels like some evil entity attempting to force its way through the pores of your skin, into the core of your being
translate: 如此恶臭，仿佛有什么邪恶实体正试图从你的皮肤毛孔钻入，直逼你的灵魂深处

original: Try to not vomit
translate: 努力不呕吐

original: Your breathing becomes rapid and shallow as your mind is flooded by the image of foul things in the darkness, feasting on the spilling entrails of swollen sea-corpses
translate: 你的呼吸变得急促而浅，脑海中充斥着黑暗中污秽之物啃食肿胀海尸流淌内脏的画面

original: The chamber around you spins and you vomit explosively
translate: 你周围的房间旋转起来，你猛烈地呕吐

original: Feeling utterly empty, you regain your composure after a few minutes
translate: 感觉完全被掏空，几分钟后你恢复了镇定

original: The narrow passages of the cave ahead seem foreboding
translate: 前方洞穴狭窄的通道显得不祥

original: Steeling your resolve, you manage to calm your breathing
translate: 你坚定决心，设法平复了呼吸

original: Though the stench persists, you manage to push the image of foul things in the darkness, feasting on the spilling entrails of swollen sea-corpses, from your mind
translate: 尽管恶臭依旧，你设法将脑海中黑暗里污秽之物啃食肿胀海尸流淌内脏的画面驱散

original: You carry on into the darkness
translate: 你继续向黑暗中前进

original: The corpses of the doomed crew of the Zephyr are arranged around the chambers central column
translate: 西风号遇难船员的尸体被摆放在房间中央柱子周围

original: A pale light shines down from an aperture in the vaulted cave ceiling above, illuminating their bloated features and pale blue skin
translate: 一束苍白的光从上方拱形洞顶的开口照下，照亮了他们肿胀的面容和淡蓝色的皮肤

original: Is there a form of artistry to their arrangement?
translate: 它们的排列是否带有某种艺术性？

original: For a brief moment you almost find it… beautiful?
translate: 有那么一瞬间，你几乎觉得这……很美？

original: The thought comes into your mind unbidden
translate: 这个念头不由自主地涌入你的脑海

original: An interloper
translate: 一个闯入者

original: Stepping between the corpses, you spot a man who you immediately recognize as the Zephyr’s first mate
translate: 在尸体间穿行时，你发现一个男人，立刻认出他是西风号的大副

original: Around his neck, a sturdy chain glimmers and you carefully fish out a strange octagonal amulet, richly filigreed and with the navigational roset of the Nautical Guild carved on it
translate: 他脖子上一条结实的链子闪闪发光，你小心地掏出一个奇特的八角形护符，上面有精美的金银丝细工，并刻有航海行会的导航罗盘图案

original: This is no doubt the Captain’s Seal and is apparently an item that the guild will pay handsomely to have returned to them
translate: 这无疑是船长印章，显然是一件行会愿意花大价钱赎回的物品

original: As you pocket the amulet, you become aware of movement in the waters around you
translate: 当你把护符装进口袋时，你察觉到周围水域中有动静

original: Strange stalked eyes regard you as several of the chitinous horrors emerge
translate: 几只甲壳怪物冒了出来，奇怪的柄眼注视着你

original: No doubt, the abominations have come to feed on the flesh of the dead
translate: 毫无疑问，这些畸形生物是来啃食死者血肉的

original: Or the living
translate: 或者活人

original: Attempt to sneak away
translate: 尝试悄悄溜走

original: Attack the beasts
translate: 攻击这些野兽

original: The abominable creatures snap their claws greedily as they advance towards you!
translate: 这些可憎的生物贪婪地张合着爪子，向你逼近！

original: No doubt intending to make you part of their gruesome display!
translate: 毫无疑问，它们打算让你成为它们恐怖陈列的一部分！

original: You carefully step away from corpse and begin to try and make your way out of the horrid chamber
translate: 你小心地从尸体旁走开，开始试图离开这个可怕的房间

original: Curse me, I have to get out of this hole!
translate: 该死，我得离开这个鬼地方！

original: I don’t even know how long I’ve been in here?
translate: 我甚至不知道我在这里待了多久？

original: It’s like time doesn’t pass right but I’ve not died from thirst yet so it can’t be that long!
translate: 时间好像不对劲，但我还没渴死，所以应该不会太久！

original: I just need to get out!
translate: 我只想出去！

original: Explain the way to the exit
translate: 解释出口的路

original: Hold on
translate: 等等

original: A strangely haunting piping can be heard from the caves ahead
translate: 前方洞穴传来一阵奇异而萦绕心头的笛声

original: Surely it must be the wind?
translate: 肯定是风声吧？

original: Then again, it rises and falls with an eerie sense of musicality that does nothing to set your mind at ease
translate: 然而，它起伏之间带着一种诡异的音乐感，丝毫不能让你安心

original: Forge ahead
translate: 继续前进

original: You had nearly grown accustomed to the foul stench that lingers in these caves, but now it once more assaults your senses with renewed vigor!
translate: 你几乎已经习惯了弥漫在这些洞穴中的恶臭，但现在它再次以更强的势头冲击你的感官！

original: Rolling out of the eastern passage like so many black tendrils probing for a way into the very core of your being
translate: 从东边的通道涌出，如同无数黑色触须，探寻着进入你灵魂深处的途径

original: Whatever lies ahead must be at the center of the rot that permeates this pit
translate: 前方的一切必定是弥漫这个深坑的腐败之源

original: Forge ahead!
translate: 继续前进！

original: You vomit violently and the sounds of your retching echoes through the chamber around you
translate: 你剧烈呕吐，干呕声在周围的房间中回荡

original: With each spasm, your gasping draws in another lung-full of the tainted air until you feel permeated by the foulness
translate: 每一次痉挛，你的喘息都吸入更多污浊的空气，直到你感觉自己被恶臭浸透

original: Where do you end and the filth begin?
translate: 你在哪里结束，污秽又从哪里开始？

original: Through grit alone, you refuse to let the foulness find purchase and you fight down the nausea that wells up inside you
translate: 仅凭毅力，你拒绝让恶臭占据上风，压下了涌上来的恶心感

original: A Survivor
translate: 一个幸存者

original: Who... who goes there?
translate: 谁……谁在那里？

original: A haggard man dressed in the livery of the Nautical Guild huddles apprehensively in the corner of the small chamber you’re standing in
translate: 一个穿着航海行会制服的憔悴男人，惶恐地蜷缩在你所在小房间的角落里

original: His lips are dry and cracked and he appears to be parched
translate: 他的嘴唇干裂，看起来口渴难耐

original: Please tell me you’ve found a way out of this pit!
translate: 请告诉我你找到了离开这个深坑的路！

original: I have!
translate: 我找到了！

original: What are you doing here?
translate: 你在这里做什么？

original: The desperate man wastes no time scrambling past you and towards fresh air and relative safety
translate: 这个绝望的男人毫不耽搁，从你身边挤过去，冲向新鲜空气和相对安全的地方

original: That was Ari!
translate: 那是阿里！

original: Kat seems flustered
translate: 卡蒂显得有些慌乱

original: Poor bastard
translate: 可怜的混蛋

original: Sounds like he’s losing his mind the way he was talking!
translate: 听他说话的样子，像是要疯了！

original: Trapped down here for days?
translate: 被困在这里好几天了？

original: He’s an arse but he didn’t deserve that
translate: 他是个混蛋，但也不该受这种罪

original: None of them did
translate: 他们都不该

original: Andry
translate: 安德里

original: Thanks for finding a way out of that bloody cave!
translate: 谢谢你找到了离开那个该死的洞穴的路！

original: If them crabs hadn't gotten me, the thirst would have
translate: 就算那些螃蟹没弄死我，渴也会渴死我

original: Can you imagine?
translate: 你能想象吗？

original: Slowly going insane in the darkness
translate: 在黑暗中慢慢发疯

original: All alone and dying?
translate: 孤身一人，慢慢死去？

original: Thank you so much!
translate: 太感谢你了！

original: I'll live to see another day!
translate: 我能活着见到新的一天了！

original: By the Golden Dead I’ll be mending my wicked ways if I make it out of here!
translate: 以黄金先祖之名，要是我能活着出去，我一定改邪归正！

original: No more dice and whoring!
translate: 再也不赌博嫖妓了！

original: #Chapter1LandingFarm
translate: #第一章 登陆农场

original: Derelict Farm
translate: 荒废农场

original: The small farm is overgrown and derelict and it appears to be abandoned
translate: 小农场杂草丛生，荒废不堪，似乎已被遗弃

original: At one point, you muse, this must have been a quaint place
translate: 你曾想，这里一定曾是个古雅的地方

original: A good spot to raise a family perhaps?
translate: 或许是个养家糊口的好地方？

original: Suddenly, as if summoned by your very thoughts, the faint but unmistakable sound of children’s laughter is carried on the wind
translate: 突然，仿佛被你的思绪召唤，风中传来微弱但确凿的孩童笑声

original: The sound is oddly distorted with a strange echoing quality and for some reason it chills you to your bones
translate: 声音奇怪地扭曲，带着诡异的回响，不知为何让你脊背发凉

original: The sound is interrupted by a woman’s cry of pain, or perhaps sorrow
translate: 声音被一个女人的痛苦或悲伤的哭喊打断

original: #Chapter1LandingKat
translate: #Chapter1LandingKat

original: Are you sure?
translate: 你确定吗？

original: I would have thought it safer to not go alone
translate: 我本以为不单独行动会更安全

original: On second thought, let's travel together
translate: “仔细想想，我们还是一起走吧”

original: Yes, I'm sure
translate: “是的，我确定”

original: I would have thought it wiser to stick together but I’ll not twist your arm
translate: 我本以为待在一起更明智，但我不会勉强你

original: I’ll see if I can’t find that farm north of here
translate: 我去看看能不能找到北边那个农场

original: You’ll find me there
translate: 你可以在那里找到我

original: Stay safe!
translate: 注意安全！

original: Kat nimbly makes her way along the rocky shoreline and into the fog
translate: 卡蒂敏捷地沿着岩石海岸线前行，消失在雾中

original: Wading out of the freezing surf you lose your footing on the slick stones and fall heavily to the ground
translate: 你涉过冰冷的海浪，在光滑的石头上失去平衡，重重摔倒在地

original: There is a sudden blur of movement in the corner of your eye and as you frantically try to get to your feet you slip again
translate: 眼角余光瞥见一个模糊的身影闪过，你慌忙想要起身，却又滑倒了

original: Standing above you on a large rock is a young woman dressed in Nautical Guild livery
translate: 一块大石上站着一位年轻女子，身穿航海行会的制服

original: Wet, auburn hair clings to her face in the cold wind
translate: “湿漉漉的赤褐色头发在寒风中贴在她脸上”

original: So I would say, that cave to the west is where we should start looking
translate: “要我说，西边那个洞穴应该是我们开始搜寻的地方”

original: You ready to go?
translate: 准备好出发了吗？

original: Let's go!
translate: 我们走！

original: I prefer to travel alone
translate: 我更喜欢独自行动

original: I have some questions first!
translate: 我先问几个问题！

original: Magi’s balls!
translate: 法师的蛋蛋！

original: I was sure I was the only one to make it ashore
translate: 我还以为只有我一个人上了岸

original: The woman leaps from the rocks and helps you back on your feet
translate: 女子从岩石上跳下，扶你重新站起来

original: Looking you up and down, she fetches a wineskin from her belt and offers it to you
translate: “她上下打量了你一番，从腰间取出一个酒囊递给你”

original: The skin is nearly empty save for a last mouthful of brandy
translate: 酒囊几乎空了，只剩最后一口白兰地

original: You drink it down greedily and slowly you feel a modicum of warmth creep into your bones
translate: 你贪婪地一饮而尽，渐渐感到一丝暖意渗入骨髓

original: You recognize the young woman’s face now
translate: 你现在认出了这位年轻女子的脸

original: She must have served on the Zephyr
translate: 她一定曾在西风号上服役

original: She has an arrow cocked on a shortbow and as you squint up at her she draws the string back
translate: 她短弓上搭着一支箭，你眯眼看向她时，她拉开了弓弦

original: Give me one good reason not to end you right now!
translate: 给我一个不现在就了结你的好理由！

original: You recognize the young woman’s face
translate: 你认出了这位年轻女子的脸

original: Mercy!
translate: 饶命！

original: It was nothing personal
translate: 这不是私人恩怨

original: The girl scoffs at you
translate: 女孩对你嗤之以鼻

original: You’re just like the rest of them
translate: 你和他们没什么两样

original: Step on any neck so long as it gets you a leg up
translate: 只要能往上爬，不惜踩在任何人的脖子上

original: That it?
translate: 就这些？

original: She’s red faced with anger
translate: 她气得满脸通红

original: I was when they sold me to the Nautical Guild
translate: 当他们把我卖给航海行会时，我也是

original: Did you know I’m listed in their records as an asset?
translate: 你知道吗，在他们的记录里，我被列为一项资产？

original: A bleeding commodity to use and trade away as they will!
translate: 一件任他们使用和交易的该死的商品！

original: How many nights have I spent dreaming of that bloody ship sinking so I could get away
translate: 多少个夜晚，我梦想着那艘该死的船沉没，好让我逃脱

original: But now that it’s happened
translate: 但现在它真的发生了

original: You were a slave?
translate: 你曾是奴隶？

original: Who sold you?
translate: 谁卖了你？

original: Shut your bleeding mouth before I put an arrow through your neck!
translate: 闭上你的臭嘴，不然我一箭射穿你的脖子！

original: She draws the string back even further and for a long moment you think she’s going to let loose
translate: 她把弓弦拉得更满，很长一段时间你以为她就要放箭了

original: Instead she sighs deeply and lowers her bow
translate: 然而她深深叹了口气，放下了弓

original: One way or another, you did buy me my freedom and I’d be a cursed woman for putting you down as thanks
translate: “不管怎样，你确实给了我自由，我要是恩将仇报，会遭天谴的”

original: Even if I’m stuck here on this bloody island for now
translate: 即使我现在被困在这个该死的岛上

original: I’ll tell you what, help me get away from here and I’ll consider us even?
translate: “这样吧，帮我离开这里，我们就两清了，如何？”

original: You can start by telling me your name
translate: 你可以先告诉我你的名字

original: Katyana’s my name
translate: 我叫卡蒂亚娜

original: The crew calls me Kat
translate: 船员们都叫我卡蒂

original: Or rather they did I suppose
translate: 或者说，他们以前这么叫

original: She looks up and down the beach with a furrowed brow
translate: 她眉头紧锁，环顾着海滩

original: Listen, you have to get up
translate: “听着，你得起来”

original: We need to get off this beach before you freeze
translate: 我们得离开这片海滩，不然你会冻僵的

original: Or worse
translate: 或者更糟

original: Worse?
translate: 更糟？

original: Captain’s seal
translate: 船长的印章

original: It’s a medallion of sorts that is carried on every guild vessel
translate: 那是每艘行会船只上都携带的一种徽章

original: It’s not just for show either
translate: 它也不仅仅是摆设

original: They say the seals are forged by the Magi and that they have secret powers but I don’t know nothing about that
translate: 据说这些印章是由法师锻造的，拥有秘密力量，但我对此一无所知

original: All I know is the guild pays well to have one returned if a ship is ever lost
translate: 我只知道，如果有船只失事，行会愿意出高价收回印章

original: It's always worn by one of the officers, but I don't think the Captain had it on him when the fight broke out
translate: “通常由一名军官佩戴，但打斗发生时，船长好像没带着它”

original: Might have been the First Mate was carrying it and I think he was still alive when the ship sank
translate: 可能是大副带着，而且船沉时他好像还活着

original: We need supplies and shelter first
translate: 我们首先需要补给和庇护所

original: There might be salvage to be had among the wreckage on the beach
translate: 海滩上的残骸中或许能找到些有用的东西

original: I also think I spotted the chimney of a house just north of the cliffs
translate: 我还觉得在悬崖北边看到了一座房子的烟囱

original: A warm fire and some food would go a long way
translate: 温暖的炉火和食物会大有帮助

original: Kat offers you her hand and drags you to your feet
translate: 卡蒂向你伸出手，把你拉了起来

original: She looks pensively towards the west
translate: 她若有所思地望向西方

original: Also, as I said there’s a cave west of here
translate: “还有，我说过西边有个洞穴”

original: I think the crabs dragged off most of the corpses there but what if
translate: 我想螃蟹把大部分尸体都拖到那里去了，但万一

original: What if they’re not all dead?
translate: 万一他们没全死呢？

original: Might be other survivors like you and me
translate: 可能还有其他像你我一样的幸存者

original: What's more, there's a chance one of the officers was carrying the seal when the boat sank
translate: “而且，船沉时可能有一名军官带着印章”

original: If we can find it, the Nautical Guild would give anything to have it returned to them
translate: “如果我们能找到它，航海行会愿意不惜一切代价把它要回去”

original: Seal?
translate: 印章？

original: There’s something wrong about this place
translate: 这地方有点不对劲

original: Can’t you feel it?
translate: 你感觉不到吗？

original: Like a taste in your mouth
translate: 就像嘴里尝到的某种味道

original: And there are beasts
translate: 还有野兽

original: Huge sea creatures I ain’t never seen afore
translate: 我从未见过的巨大海兽

original: I saw them dragging the dead crew-men into a cave west of here
translate: 我看到它们把死去的船员拖进西边的一个洞穴

original: At least I hope they were dead
translate: 至少我希望他们当时已经死了

original: Kat shudders
translate: 卡蒂打了个寒颤

original: What do you suggest?
translate: 你有什么建议？

original: Good
translate: 好

original: I found this bow in a cargo crate
translate: 我在货箱里找到了这把弓

original: We best find you a weapon too as soon as possible
translate: 我们最好尽快也给你找件武器

original: I suspect we’ll need it before long
translate: 我怀疑我们很快就会需要它

original: Together you begin to move, off the beach and towards whatever darkness dwells in the island’s interior
translate: “你们一起动身，离开海滩，向着岛屿深处潜伏的黑暗走去”

original: There’ll be plenty more time for that once we get off the beach
translate: 等我们离开海滩，有的是时间谈这个

original: Are you ready?
translate: 你准备好了吗？

original: You're not coming with me
translate: 你不跟我一起走

original: You’re back?
translate: 你回来了？

original: I see the beasts that roam the shoreline didn’t get the better of you!
translate: 看来在海岸游荡的野兽没能把你怎么样！

original: Let's travel together!
translate: 我们一起走吧！

original: I’ll go with you
translate: 我跟你走

original: Let’s gather what weapons and equipment we can and make for the inland
translate: 我们尽可能收集武器和装备，然后向内陆进发

original: #Chapter1LandingMarita
translate: #第一章登陆玛丽塔

original: Kneeling in the grass, you notice a satchel lying where Martita was kneeling
translate: 跪在草丛中，你注意到玛丽塔刚才跪着的地方放着一个挎包。

original: You get a feeling it was left there for you
translate: 你感觉那是留给你的。

original: Slowly, you regain your composure and get to your feet
translate: 你慢慢恢复镇定，站起身来。

original: Shambling away from the well, you suddenly stiffen
translate: 你蹒跚着离开水井，突然僵住了。

original: Did you just hear something?
translate: 你刚才是不是听到了什么？

original: A child's voice perhaps?
translate: 也许是孩子的声音？

original: Or was just the wind?
translate: 或者只是风声？

original: The woman rocks slowly back and forth as she stares blankly at the well in front of her
translate: 那女人缓缓地前后摇晃，茫然地盯着面前的水井。

original: What has happened?
translate: 发生了什么事？

original: It took them
translate: 它带走了他们

original: Called out to them
translate: 呼唤他们

original: I heard it
translate: 我听到了

original: Funny thing is
translate: 可笑的是，

original: I heard it calling with my voice
translate: 我听到它用我的声音呼唤

original: Oleg and Anja live in the well now
translate: 奥列格和安雅现在住在井里

original: They’re calling for me to join them
translate: 他们在呼唤我下去陪他们

original: Can I help?
translate: 我能帮忙吗？

original: It will never stop
translate: 它永远不会停止

original: It will multiply until it covers all the lands and all the seas
translate: 它会不断繁殖，直到覆盖所有的陆地和海洋

original: And when we are all dead and bones, the conqueror mold will dress our corpses in black mourning veils
translate: 等我们都化为枯骨，黑噬霉菌会给我们的尸体披上黑色的哀悼面纱

original: Her voice is flat and monotone and the strange words almost seem to come from somewhere else
translate: 她的声音平淡单调，那些奇怪的话语仿佛来自别处

original: She then lets out a deep sigh
translate: 然后她深深叹了口气

original: But if I had my children’s bones to bury, it would give me some respite
translate: 但如果我能埋葬孩子们的尸骨，就能让我得到些许慰藉

original: A moment of silence, then the sickening sound of children’s laughter once again rises from the well
translate: 片刻的寂静之后，井中再次响起令人毛骨悚然的孩童笑声

original: The skeletal figure of Marita sits in front of the well, rocking silently back and forth
translate: 玛丽塔骨瘦如柴的身影坐在井前，默默地前后摇晃

original: I have your children's bones
translate: 我带来了你孩子的尸骨

original: Marita looks up at you and blinks as if waking from a dream
translate: 玛丽塔抬头看着你，眨了眨眼，仿佛从梦中醒来

original: Without a word, she gingerly takes the small bundle of bones in her arms as if it was a swaddled infant
translate: 她一言不发，小心翼翼地接过那一小捆尸骨，仿佛抱着一个襁褓中的婴儿

original: She cradles it for a moment and then looks up at you with grateful eyes
translate: 她轻轻抱了一会儿，然后抬起头，眼中充满感激

original: She gently strokes your cheek once and then turns and wanders into the fog
translate: 她轻轻抚摸了一下你的脸颊，然后转身走入雾中

original: You’ve set her free
translate: 你让她解脱了

original: Falling to your knees, you retch violently
translate: 你跪倒在地，剧烈地干呕起来

original: If it is from the conqueror mold or the emotional moment you can’t quite tell
translate: 究竟是因为黑噬霉菌还是情绪激动，你也说不清楚

original: #Chapter1LandingTelescope
translate: #第一章 着陆望远镜

original: You steel yourself and gaze back into the cosmic aberration
translate: 你鼓起勇气，再次凝视那宇宙的异象，

original: A moment stretches into hours, days, eons
translate: “一瞬间延伸成数小时、数日、乃至永恒”，

original: Stars are birthed and die; collapsing in on themselves in cataclysms that shake the very foundations of creation
translate: 星辰诞生又消亡；在撼动造物根基的大灾变中自我坍缩，

original: Open your mind
translate: 敞开你的心灵，

original: As you come to, you are sitting befuddled in the grass near the telescope
translate: “当你回过神来，你正困惑地坐在望远镜旁的草地上”，

original: You have no idea of how much time has passed but you feel like you have traveled impossible distances
translate: 你不知道过去了多少时间，但你感觉自己仿佛穿越了不可思议的距离，

original: For a fleeting moment, you sense profound realizations as they flee your mind like dreams upon waking
translate: “转瞬之间，你感受到深刻的领悟，但它们如醒来时的梦境般从你脑海中溜走”，

original: With a ringing head and a deep feeling of dread creeping in, you vow never to gaze into that accursed telescope again
translate: “伴随着耳鸣和逐渐蔓延的深深恐惧，你发誓再也不去凝视那架被诅咒的望远镜”，

original: Dread fills you as you realize that in the far recesses of your mind, thoughts are now lurking that originated elsewhere
translate: “当你意识到在你心灵深处的隐秘角落，正潜伏着源自他处的思绪时，恐惧充满了你”，

original: Unbidden and utterly alien, their greeting is a droning echo
translate: “它们不请自来，全然异质，它们的问候是嗡嗡作响的回声”，

original: The eyes of the Dragon are opening
translate: 龙的眼睛正在睁开，

original: You vow to never peer through that accursed telescope again
translate: 你发誓再也不透过那架被诅咒的望远镜窥视，

original: A finely wrought telescope used for astronomical observations
translate: 一架用于天文观测的精制望远镜，

original: Its lenses are no doubt the product of some of the Empire’s finest Hyalomancers and allows stars to be observed even in full daylight
translate: 其镜片无疑是帝国最杰出的琉璃术士的杰作，即使在白昼也能观测星辰，

original: Examine the seas
translate: 观察大海，

original: Examine the sky in general
translate: 大致观察天空，

original: Examine the southeastern quadrant of the sky
translate: 观察天空的东南象限，

original: Take telescope
translate: 拿起望远镜，

original: You cannot bring yourself to look in that accursed telescope again
translate: 你再也无法让自己去看向那架被诅咒的望远镜，

original: You look out upon the churning, gray roil that surrounds the windswept shores of Idra
translate: “你眺望着环绕着狂风肆虐的伊德拉海岸的翻腾灰色浊浪”，

original: Far out there, among the great waves and beating winds you swear you momentarily see a great glistening shape shifting just beneath the surface
translate: “在远处，巨浪和狂风之中，你发誓你瞬间看到海面下有一个巨大的闪烁形状在移动”，

original: Whatever madness has befallen this island you are certainly safer here than on any ship out there
translate: 无论这座岛屿遭遇了何种疯狂，你在这里肯定比在海上任何船上都安全，

original: Use the telescope further
translate: 继续使用望远镜，

original: You point the telescope skywards, and after a few moments of searching, you find a gap where the stormy skies have parted just enough to allow you to examine the stars in their firmament
translate: “你将望远镜指向天空，搜寻片刻后，你发现了一处风暴天空裂开的缝隙，刚好足以让你观测苍穹中的星辰”，

original: Examine it more closely
translate: 更仔细地观察，

original: A moment of confusion washes over you as you find yourself utterly disoriented in a sky you should know as well as the back of your hand
translate: 一阵困惑袭来，你发现自己在一片本应了如指掌的天空中完全迷失了方向，

original: The poor astronomer was right
translate: 那位可怜的天文学家是对的，

original: Somehow the stars you see in the sky are utterly alien to you
translate: 不知何故，你看到的天空中的星辰对你来说全然陌生，

original: The realization leaves you chilled to your bones
translate: 这个认知让你寒彻骨髓，

original: Instinctively you look away from the strange stellar vista
translate: 你本能地将目光从这奇异的星景上移开，

original: Look back at the sky
translate: 回望天空，

original: Use the telescope for something else
translate: 将望远镜用于其他用途，

original: Though you realize your knowledge of astronomy is quite lacking, you are nonetheless left with a feeling of wrongness that you can’t quite explain
translate: “尽管你意识到自己的天文学知识相当匮乏，但你仍被一种难以言喻的错谬感所笼罩”，

original: Training the telescope on the southeastern quadrant of the sky your eyes are immediately drawn to what appears to be something akin to a small reddish cluster of stars
translate: 将望远镜对准天空的东南象限，你的目光立刻被一个看起来像是微红色星团的东西所吸引，

original: Though, at first the tiny speck is hardly noticeable, it seems to grow larger as you regard it
translate: “起初，那个微小的斑点几乎难以察觉，但当你注视它时，它似乎在变大”，

original: At once you're struck with the terrible realization that as you are watching it, it is gazing back
translate: “你立刻惊恐地意识到，当你在注视它时，它也在回望你”，

original: Tear your eyes away
translate: 移开你的目光，

original: Hold the gaze
translate: 保持凝视，

original: As you feel tendrils of something utterly alien grasping at your consciousness, you tear yourself away from the telescope in panic
translate: “当你感觉到某种全然异质之物的触须攫住你的意识时，你惊恐地从望远镜前挣脱”，

original: You turn away from the accursed apparatus and decide to never again use it
translate: 你从那被诅咒的仪器前转过身，决定再也不使用它，

original: #Chapter1LandingWell
translate: #第1章着陆井

original: One by one, you pry loose the bones from the writhing of the ganglion
translate: 你一根接一根地从那蠕动的菌瘤结节中撬出骨头

original: Its motions become more and more agitated as you work and a wave of relief washes over you as the last piece comes loose
translate: 随着你的动作，它的蠕动越来越剧烈，当最后一块骨头脱落时，一阵如释重负的感觉涌遍全身

original: Now you must make your way out of this death-trap
translate: 现在你必须设法离开这个死亡陷阱

original: Mold
translate: 霉菌，

original: As you descend deeper into the earthy cave, you realize that the black mold covers most of the walls
translate: 当你深入这个土洞时，你发现黑色的霉菌覆盖了大部分墙壁

original: Even the air is thick with floating black specks
translate: 就连空气中也弥漫着漂浮的黑色微粒

original: Here and there, the mold seems to form nodules
translate: 四处可见，霉菌似乎形成了结节

original: Your mind fills with images of the nodules bursting open in an obscene mockery of birth and black, worm-like tendrils of mold spilling forth into the world
translate: 你的脑海中充满了那些结节爆裂开来的画面，仿佛是对诞生的猥亵嘲弄，黑色的、蠕虫般的霉菌卷须涌向世界

original: An irrational urge to touch the nodes begin to grow inside you
translate: 一股想要触摸这些结节的非理性冲动在你心中滋长

original: Move on
translate: 继续前进，

original: Touch nodes
translate: 触摸结节，

original: Perhaps it’s the thickness of the air, or the sickly miasmas that fill this part of the cave, but stars flash before your eyes
translate: 也许是空气的浓稠，或是弥漫在这洞穴中的病态瘴气，你的眼前闪过星光

original: Your mind is assaulted with images of alien landscapes
translate: 你的脑海被异星景象的画面冲击

original: Cities?
translate: 城市？，

original: No, giant living structures, almost like the coral that the traders from the Sea-Gates sometimes peddle
translate: 不，是巨大的活体结构，几乎就像港门的商贩有时兜售的珊瑚

original: But large
translate: 但非常巨大，

original: So large it almost touches the sky
translate: 如此巨大，几乎触及天空

original: Then you see it
translate: 然后你看到了它，

original: The structures themselves writhe with obscene life
translate: 那些结构本身蠕动着猥亵的生命，

original: Innumerable black worm-like tendrils of black mold cover them
translate: 无数黑色的蠕虫状霉菌卷须覆盖着它们，

original: They beckon you
translate: 它们向你招手，

original: Give in to them
translate: 屈服于它们，

original: Let them take hold
translate: 让它们占据你，

original: In the sky above you something massive shifts
translate: 在你上方的天空中，某个庞然大物移动了，

original: Carry on!
translate: 继续前进！，

original: Give In
translate: 屈服，

original: The Sanctum
translate: 圣所，

original: You feel as if you’re dragged under and into the crushing blackness to unfathomable depths
translate: 你感觉自己被拖入下方，陷入令人窒息的黑暗，坠入深不可测的深渊

original: Stars flash before your eyes again and you once more see the impossible landscapes
translate: 星光再次在你眼前闪过，你又一次看到了那些不可思议的景象

original: Cyclopean edifices of writhing black shapes
translate: 由蠕动黑色形体构成的独眼巨人般的大厦，

original: An age of worms
translate: 蠕虫的时代，

original: You understand now
translate: 你现在明白了，

original: This is not some alien dream-scape
translate: 这不是什么异星的梦境，

original: This is Warda
translate: 这是沃尔达，

original: This is home
translate: 这是家园，

original: And you?
translate: 而你？，

original: You are a high-priest!
translate: 你是一位高阶祭司！，

original: The god-regent of a perfect world!
translate: 完美世界的神之摄政！，

original: And now it is time!
translate: 而现在，时候到了！，

original: The sky sunders!
translate: 天空裂开了！，

original: SEVEN EYES SEE!
translate: 七眼所见！，

original: IT COMES!
translate: 它来了！，

original: GIVE YOURSELF TO IT!
translate: 将你自己献给它！，

original: Gathering all your willpower, you wrest back control of your faculties and forge ahead
translate: 你凝聚起全部的意志力，夺回对自身能力的控制，奋力前行

original: On the wall ahead you spot it
translate: 在前方的墙上，你发现了它，

original: A festering ganglion of black ichor with two small human skulls leering from it
translate: 一个溃烂的黑色脓液菌瘤结节，上面有两个小人类头骨在斜睨着

original: The Children
translate: 孩子们，

original: The two diminutive shapes materialize as if from the very walls themselves
translate: 那两个矮小的身影仿佛从墙壁本身中显现出来

original: Bodies alive with writhing mold, their blank, idiotic faces stare up at you in a grotesque imitation of life
translate: 身体上蠕动着霉菌，他们空洞、痴愚的面孔以一种怪诞的生命模仿仰望着你

original: Your blood runs cold as organs that should never shape human voices spill forth the sound of children laughing
translate: 当那些本不该发出人类声音的器官传出孩童的笑声时，你的血液都凝固了

original: A loud shriek escapes from the horrors and in a maelstrom of writhing blackness, the two pathetic creatures, reshape into lean forms that tower over you
translate: 一声尖啸从这些恐怖之物中传出，在蠕动的黑暗漩涡中，这两个可悲的生物重塑成瘦长的形体，高耸于你之上

original: They do not intend to let you leave
translate: 他们不打算让你离开

original: Try to dash past them and escape
translate: 尝试猛冲过他们身边逃走，

original: Abominations!
translate: 畸形生物！，

original: You attempt to slip past the monstrosities but they have you boxed in
translate: 你试图溜过这些怪物，但他们把你困住了

original: The only way out is now through them
translate: 现在唯一的出路就是穿过他们

original: Stand your ground
translate: 坚守阵地，

original: Feigning left and dashing right, you manage to slip past the mindless creatures and before they manage to regain their bearings, you have clambered up the ropes and escaped the well
translate: 你假装向左，然后向右猛冲，成功溜过了这些无脑的生物，趁他们还没回过神来，你已经攀上绳索，逃出了井

original: As you flop over the rim of the well and onto the ground, a faint “Mother!
translate: 当你翻过井沿，瘫倒在地时，一声微弱的“妈妈！”

original: escapes from below
translate: 从下方传来

original: The Ganglion
translate: 菌瘤结节，

original: The mass of glistening mold pulsates with a grotesque peristaltic motion as you approach it
translate: 当你靠近时，那团闪闪发亮的霉菌以一种怪诞的蠕动方式搏动着

original: Embedded in it is a collection of small animal bones
translate: 其中嵌着一堆小动物的骨头

original: Nonetheless, you have no problems identifying two complete, small human skeletons
translate: 尽管如此，你毫不费力地辨认出两具完整的小型人类骨骼

original: Grab the bones
translate: 抓起骨头，

original: Oblivion
translate: 虚无，

original: You dig your fingers into the black, substance and breathe deeply in tainted air, welcoming the pulsating presence that surrounds you to invade your flesh
translate: 你将手指插入那黑色的物质，深深吸入污浊的空气，欢迎那环绕你的搏动存在侵入你的肉体

original: It does not hesitate and the warmness of unity fills your very being as new life beings
translate: 它毫不犹豫，当新生命开始时，合一的温暖充满了你的整个存在

original: Stars align and the Dragon stirs in the void
translate: 星辰排列，龙在虚空中苏醒

original: Haruma
translate: 哈鲁玛，

original: HARUMA!
translate: 哈鲁玛！，

original: Become one
translate: 合为一体，

original: A Well
translate: 一口井，

original: The well seems ordinary enough until you examine it more closely
translate: 这口井乍看之下很普通，直到你仔细查看

original: A thin layer of slimy black mold seems to cling to its walls and a heavy odor of filth rises from its depths
translate: 一层薄薄的黏滑黑色霉菌似乎附着在井壁上，一股浓重的污秽气味从深处升起

original: You could swear you heard something splash around in the shallow waters
translate: 你发誓你听到浅水中有东西在扑腾

original: A ladder has been placed in the well-shaft and you could easily descend if you wanted to
translate: 井道里放了一架梯子，如果你想的话，可以轻松下去

original: Descend
translate: 下去，

original: A woman sits in the grass ahead of you with the well looming over her
translate: 一个女人坐在你前方的草地上，井在她身后若隐若现

original: She is emaciated, ragged and covered in grime
translate: 她瘦骨嶙峋，衣衫褴褛，满身污垢

original: How long has she been sitting here?
translate: 她在这里坐了多久了？，

original: Weeks?
translate: 几周？，

original: She rocks back and forth
translate: 她前后摇晃着，

original: Almost catatonic
translate: 几乎处于紧张症状态

original: Then, suddenly you hear it again
translate: 然后，你突然又听到了

original: The clear sound of playful children’s laughter rises from the well
translate: 孩童嬉戏的清脆笑声从井中升起

original: The woman wails
translate: 女人哀号起来

original: #Chapter1LeavingLanding
translate: #第1章离开登陆地

original: Emerging from the rocky shores, you survey the dreary interiors of Idra
translate: 从岩石海岸走出，你审视着伊德拉沉闷的内陆

original: Rolling hills and moors cover much of the surrounding areas and tall, jagged mountains rise towards the north
translate: 起伏的丘陵和荒野覆盖了周围大部分地区，高耸嶙峋的山脉向北延伸

original: East of you, a lighthouse can be seen; Its faint light flickering against the gloom
translate: 你的东边可以看到一座灯塔；它微弱的光芒在阴暗中闪烁

original: Beyond that lies a bay and from its far shore the wind carries the foul stench of burning corpses
translate: 再远处是一个海湾，从远处的岸边，风带来了焚烧尸体的恶臭

original: Something is deeply wrong on this island and though you have survived this far, you are still poorly equipped and alone
translate: 这座岛上有什么非常不对劲，尽管你活到了现在，但你仍然装备简陋，孤身一人

original: Nevertheless, you’re here for a reason and according to lord Cato, Embla’s last known location was the township of Horryn
translate: 尽管如此，你来此是有原因的，根据卡托领主所说，恩布拉最后已知的位置是霍林镇

original: Whilst your road leads to Horryn eventually, you must also explore your surroundings well
translate: 虽然你的道路最终通向霍林，但你也必须好好探索周围的环境

original: You need to re-equip and find allies if you are to survive
translate: 如果你想活下去，就需要重新装备并找到同伴

original: As you set out across the blasted landscape, you have a growing feeling that whatever horrific fate has befallen this region it's somehow inexorably tied to your quest
translate: 当你踏上这片荒芜的土地时，你越来越觉得，无论这片区域遭遇了何种可怕的命运，它都与你此行的任务有着某种无法摆脱的联系

original: Something dark and vast is slowly spreading throughout the Outer Isles, tentacles grasping greedily as if searching for something
translate: 某种黑暗而庞大的东西正在外岛群缓慢蔓延，触手贪婪地抓取着，仿佛在寻找什么

original: Great adventures may lie ahead but so does great terror
translate: 前方或许有伟大的冒险，但也有巨大的恐怖

original: Of that you are absolutely certain
translate: 对此你绝对肯定

original: There’s something wrong here on this island
translate: 这座岛上有什么不对劲

original: Something really bad
translate: 非常糟糕的东西

original: Kat suppresses a shiver
translate: 卡蒂忍住了一个寒颤

original: You came here for a reason right?
translate: 你来这里是有原因的，对吧？

original: With mercenaries and all
translate: 带着雇佣兵什么的

original: Had to have been something important?
translate: 一定是很重要的事吧？

original: I was hired to find somebody
translate: 我受雇来找一个人

original: Kat listens intently as you tell her about your quest to find Embla Berryn
translate: 卡蒂专注地听着你讲述寻找恩布拉·贝林的任务

original: Girl’s lucky to have family care for her
translate: 那姑娘真幸运，有家人关心她

original: Kat mumbles
translate: 卡蒂嘟囔道

original: So the old man told you she was last seen in Horryn right?
translate: 所以那个老人告诉你她最后在霍林被人看到，对吧？

original: Well, I’ve been to Horryn
translate: 嗯，我去过霍林

original: Landed there on our last run
translate: 上次跑船时在那里靠过岸

original: I could tell something felt off about the place, but nothing like this
translate: 我能感觉到那地方有点不对劲，但没到这种程度

original: Here’s how I see it, Horryn isn’t far - Just a day’s march to the east around the bay
translate: 我是这么看的，霍林不远——沿着海湾往东走，也就一天的路程

original: However, I think we need to be all clever-like about this
translate: 不过，我觉得我们得放聪明点

original: Make sure we re-arm and maybe even try to pick up a few allies
translate: 确保我们重新武装起来，甚至可能试着找几个同伴

original: If we rush in and end up dead we’re not doing this Embla any good’s what I’m trying to say
translate: 如果我们贸然冲进去，结果死了，那对恩布拉一点好处都没有，我就是这个意思

original: So, we should explore around a bit right?
translate: 所以，我们应该先在周围探索一下，对吧？

original: Gather a bit o’ intelligence and what-not
translate: 收集点情报什么的

original: We need to take it step by step
translate: 我们得一步一步来

original: I'd prefer it if you leave the strategy to me
translate: 我希望你把策略交给我

original: Yeah just like that
translate: 对，就是这样

original: Kat nods
translate: 卡蒂点点头

original: See over there?
translate: 看到那边了吗？

original: Kat points towards the lighthouse to the east,
translate: 卡蒂指向东边的灯塔

original: Lighthouse’s still lit so it’s bound to be manned
translate: 灯塔还亮着，所以肯定有人驻守

original: If we make our way there we might find out more about what’s going on
translate: 如果我们去那里，也许能了解更多情况

original: Might even scrounge up a hot meal
translate: 说不定还能蹭到一顿热饭

original: Let's get a move on
translate: 我们出发吧

original: Any other suggestions?
translate: 还有其他建议吗？

original: Alright, alright!
translate: 好吧，好吧！

original: I didn’t mean to overstep
translate: 我不是有意越俎代庖

original: Just don’t get us killed is what I’m saying
translate: 我只是说，别让我们送命

original: Kat looks at her feet
translate: 卡蒂看着自己的脚

original: So, where to then?
translate: 那么，接下来去哪儿？

original: I'll work something out
translate: 我会想出办法的

original: Kat looks around, squinting against the wind
translate: 卡蒂环顾四周，眯着眼抵御着风

original: She nod’s her head towards the northern shore
translate: 她朝北岸的方向点了点头

original: I suppose any other survivors and wreckage from the Zephyr would be washed up on shore north-west of where we landed, right?
translate: 我想西风号的其他幸存者和残骸应该会被冲上我们登陆点西北方的海岸，对吧？

original: Might be worth a look-see?
translate: 也许值得去看看？

original: Let's head out then!
translate: 那我们出发吧！

original: #Chapter1Leva
translate: #第1章Leva

original: Good to see ya again!
translate: 很高兴再见到你！

original: Just glad to see I’m not the only one left alive
translate: 很高兴看到我不是唯一活下来的人

original: Looking to barter a bit?
translate: 想交换点东西吗？

original: Sure
translate: 当然。

original: # Chapter_1_Lighthouse
translate: # 第1章_灯塔

original: #Chapter1Lighthouse
translate: #第1章灯塔

original: Mathias seems troubled by the questions and shifts uncomfortably
translate: 马蒂亚斯似乎被这些问题困扰，不安地挪动着身体

original: Had an assistant
translate: 曾有个助手

original: Caspar
translate: 卡斯帕

original: Went mad, the fool did!
translate: 疯了，那个蠢货！

original: Had a head full of grand ideas and I kept telling him
translate: 满脑子宏大想法，我一直告诉他

original: This here is a place for the quiet mind
translate: 这里是个需要静心的地方

original: Threw himself from the tower
translate: 从塔上跳了下去

original: Found him broken on the cliffs
translate: 在悬崖下发现他摔得粉身碎骨

original: I can’t be blamed!
translate: 这不能怪我！

original: Mathias’ jaw quivers and his eyes water over
translate: 马蒂亚斯的下巴颤抖着，眼中噙满泪水

original: Mathias begins sobbing
translate: 马蒂亚斯开始抽泣

original: I should have known
translate: 我本该知道的

original: Gotten him off this rock
translate: 让他离开这块礁石

original: When he started talking about the cave and something about a blade calling him I should have known
translate: 当他开始说起洞穴，还有一把刀剑在呼唤他时，我就该知道了

original: I could have saved him but I couldn’t bear the thought of being alone again
translate: 我本可以救他，但我无法忍受再次孤身一人的念头

original: The silence is unbearable!
translate: 这寂静让人无法忍受！

original: Ask about the cave and blade
translate: 询问洞穴和刀剑的事

original: He would babble about the cave underneath here for hours
translate: 他会一连几个小时喋喋不休地说起下面的洞穴

original: I’d tell him those were smuggler’s caves and that he was to leave them alone!
translate: 我告诉他那是走私者的洞穴，让他别去招惹！

original: Smugglers keep to themselves but no telling what they’ll do if you bother em
translate: 走私者向来独来独往，但你要是招惹他们，天知道会怎样

original: As to the 'blade' he talked about, that must’ve been the ravings of a mad man?
translate: 至于他说的那把‘刀剑’，那一定是个疯子的胡言乱语吧？

original: A soul lost to drink and loneliness!
translate: 一个被酒精和孤独吞噬的灵魂！

original: Oh poor boy
translate: 哦，可怜的孩子

original: Mathias wipes his eyes and exhales wearily
translate: 马蒂亚斯擦了擦眼睛，疲惫地叹了口气

original: Then again
translate: 不过话说回来

original: What if it is down there?
translate: 万一它真的在下面呢？

original: The black blade
translate: 那把黑刃

original: Hidden in some ancient recess, glistening in the dark
translate: 藏在某个古老的壁龛里，在黑暗中闪闪发光

original: Mathias’ gaze grows distant for a moment
translate: 马蒂亚斯的目光一时变得遥远

original: If it is, we needs to retrieve the blasted thing and destroy it!
translate: 如果是的话，我们得把那该死的东西找回来，毁掉它！

original: And that's where I come in?
translate: 那就是我该出场的地方了？

original: Would you help an old man set things right?
translate: 你愿意帮一个老人把事情纠正过来吗？

original: I’ll make it worth your while!
translate: 我会让你不虚此行的！

original: Find that black blade and bring it here
translate: 找到那把黑刃，带到这里来

original: I needs to see the thing that took Caspar at least once before we destroy it!
translate: 在毁掉它之前，我至少得看一次那个夺走卡斯帕的东西！

original: The entrance to the cave lies in the gully underneath the broken bridge
translate: 洞穴入口就在断桥下的沟壑里

original: Be careful!
translate: 小心点！

original: I think I've already found the blade in question
translate: 我想我已经找到你说的那把刀剑了

original: You mentioned smugglers?
translate: 你提到过走私者？

original: I should get going
translate: 我该出发了

original: Go to the smuggler-caves beneath the lighthouse and seek the blade that Caspar saw in his dreams
translate: 前往灯塔下的走私者洞穴，寻找卡斯帕在梦中见到的那把刀剑

original: You’ll find the cave entrance underneath the broken bridge but once inside I know nothing save that the blade lies in deepest darkness
translate: 你会在断桥下找到洞穴入口，但一旦进去，我只知道那把刀剑藏在最深沉的黑暗之中

original: Show the ancient dagger
translate: 展示古代匕首

original: I had a few more questions!
translate: 我还有几个问题！

original: Show it!
translate: 拿出来！

original: the old man stammers excitedly
translate: 老人激动地结结巴巴地说

original: As you reveal the blade to him, his eyes widen and he tentatively reaches out for it
translate: 当你把刀剑亮给他看时，他瞪大了眼睛，试探性地伸手去拿

original: It’s… beautiful
translate: 它……真美

original: Then his jaw clenches in determination and he recoils in apparent disgust
translate: 接着他坚定地咬紧牙关，又明显厌恶地缩回手

original: But it’s evil
translate: 但它是邪恶的

original: Cursed I tell you!
translate: 我告诉你，它被诅咒了！

original: Don’t you feel it?
translate: 你感觉不到吗？

original: It has power!
translate: 它有力量！

original: And hunger
translate: 还有饥饿

original: I want nothing to do with this
translate: 我不想和这东西有任何瓜葛

original: Take it and bring it far away from here
translate: 拿走它，带到远离这里的地方去

original: Destroy it!
translate: 毁掉它！

original: All I would ask is you don’t throw it in the ocean
translate: 我只求你一件事，别把它扔进海里

original: There are beings there that would wield it
translate: 海里有些存在会使用它

original: In any case, I promised to make it worth your while and I will
translate: 无论如何，我答应过让你不虚此行，我会做到的

original: Take this!
translate: 拿着这个！

original: The old man hands you an amulet
translate: 老人递给你一个护身符

original: This’ll serve you well on your journeys
translate: 这会在你的旅途中帮上大忙

original: It’ll keep your body strong and free of disease!
translate: 它会让你身体强健，远离疾病！

original: That being said, I would ask another thing of you
translate: 话虽如此，我还想请你帮个忙

original: Horryn went dark, about the same time the animals ran amok
translate: 霍林变得一片漆黑，差不多就在动物们发狂的同时

original: There was smoke on the wind - and screams too, I could swear it
translate: 风中有烟味——还有尖叫声，我敢发誓

original: Sounded like battle
translate: 听起来像是战斗

original: Or perhaps slaughter is more like it
translate: 或者更确切地说，是屠杀

original: But I think there is a camp of sorts just north of town
translate: 但我想镇子北边有个营地之类的地方

original: Ragged tents and such
translate: 破破烂烂的帐篷什么的

original: Survivors perhaps?
translate: 也许是幸存者？

original: I thought about going there to see for myself
translate: 我本想亲自去看看

original: But I changed my mind
translate: 但我改了主意

original: The old man hangs his head dejectedly, before continuing in a whisper
translate: 老人沮丧地垂下头，然后低声继续说道

original: Safer here
translate: 这里更安全

original: Tending to the light
translate: 守着这灯火

original: As you enter the lighthouse gallery, a haggard face peers out at you from the gloom
translate: 当你走进灯塔的廊道时，一张憔悴的脸从昏暗中窥视着你

original: Moving closer, you see it belongs to an old man, who clutches a makeshift spear tightly to his chest
translate: 走近些，你看到那是一个老人，他紧紧抱着一支临时拼凑的长矛贴在胸前

original: Somehow he looks both fearful yet greatly relieved to see you
translate: 不知怎的，他看起来既害怕，又因见到你而大大松了口气

original: Mother of maelstroms!
translate: 风暴之母啊！

original: The man croaks
translate: 男人用沙哑的声音说

original: Who are ye, then?
translate: 那么，你是谁？

original: Who did I summon?
translate: 我召唤来了谁？

original: Come, sit, you must be weary
translate: 来，坐下，你一定累了

original: Sit!
translate: 坐！

original: The man gestures frantically to a battered chair in the corner
translate: 男人疯狂地指向角落里一把破旧的椅子

original: Travellers
translate: 旅行者

original: Nothing more
translate: 仅此而已

original: I was shipwrecked here
translate: 我在这里遭遇了海难

original: By something foul
translate: 被某种邪恶的东西

original: Either way, the tides have brought ye to me!
translate: 不管怎样，潮水把你带到了我身边！

original: I knew my signals and prayers would be answered
translate: 我就知道我的信号和祈祷会得到回应

original: The mother of maelstroms is a cruel mistress, it must be said, it's only fit she repays me in such a darkened hour
translate: 不得不说，风暴之母是个残忍的女主人，她在这种黑暗时刻回报我也算合适

original: What happened here?
translate: 这里发生了什么？

original: We were shipwrecked
translate: 我们遭遇了海难

original: By a leviathan
translate: 被一头利维坦

original: Something foul is growing on Idra
translate: 伊德拉岛上正滋生着某种邪恶之物

original: A taint on the land!
translate: 这片土地上的污点！

original: There are lights!
translate: 有光！

original: Lights as you've never seen; like those sailors from the high north talk of
translate: 你从未见过的光；就像那些来自极北之地的水手们所说的那样

original: But the colors
translate: 但那些颜色

original: It's like they bleed into your very dreams!
translate: 仿佛渗入了你的梦境之中！

original: If you can manage to sleep that is
translate: 如果你还能睡得着的话

original: It got to the animals first though
translate: 不过它先是影响了动物

original: Warped them in both mind and body!
translate: 扭曲了它们的身心！

original: Made 'em cruel and dangerous
translate: 让它们变得残忍而危险

original: I ain't never seen nothing like it!
translate: 我这辈子从没见过这种事！

original: It's unnatural I tell you!
translate: 我告诉你，这不正常！

original: But worse still, Horryn is dead as a tomb!
translate: 但更糟的是，霍林死寂得像座坟墓！

original: Was a right bedlam of cries and screams two days ago - then nothing!
translate: 两天前还是一片哭喊尖叫的混乱——然后就什么都没有了！

original: Not as much as a lit candle at night!
translate: 晚上连一支点着的蜡烛都看不到！

original: Only the deep itself knows the truth of these happenings, but I can tell you this: the island is doomed!
translate: 只有深海本身才知道这些事情的真相，但我可以告诉你：这座岛完了！

original: The sea itself will rise to claim us!
translate: 大海本身会升起，将我们吞噬！

original: I need some information
translate: 我需要一些信息

original: Foolish superstition
translate: 愚蠢的迷信

original: I need proper information!
translate: 我需要确切的信息！

original: There are all manner of beasts in the deep oceans of our world, but never have I seen anything like this!
translate: 我们世界的深海中有着各种各样的野兽，但我从未见过这样的东西！

original: A horror from beyond the natural it was, that pulled down that ship!
translate: 那是一种超乎自然的恐怖之物，把船拖了下去！

original: I saw it all from my tower I did
translate: 我从我的塔上看得一清二楚

original: Though I wish I did not have to bear such a sight
translate: 尽管我但愿自己不必目睹此景

original: I can hardly belive that anyone could survive such a nightmare
translate: 我简直不敢相信有人能从这样的噩梦中幸存

original: I did
translate: 我做到了

original: It matters not
translate: 这不重要

original: How then did the tides release you, when so many others were claimed?
translate: 那么，潮水是如何放过你的，当那么多人都被夺走时？

original: The keeper leans in and fixes you with an unwavering gaze
translate: 守塔人凑近身子，用坚定的目光注视着你

original: Are you blessed?
translate: 你是受到祝福了吗？

original: Or perhaps cursed is more like it?
translate: 或者更应该说，是被诅咒了？

original: Cursed?
translate: 被诅咒？

original: Neither, I think
translate: 我想，都不是

original: Now, what happened here?
translate: 现在，这里发生了什么？

original: Oh you have more important matters to deal with?
translate: 哦，你还有更重要的事要处理？

original: Well, I must keep watching...seeing
translate: 好吧，我必须继续守望……观察

original: The old man trails off, eyes unfocusing
translate: 老人的声音渐渐低了下去，目光涣散

original: Forgive me for not being of more help
translate: 请原谅我没能帮上更多忙

original: We really need to go
translate: 我们真的得走了

original: You're a fool to go!
translate: 你走就是傻瓜！

original: There is nothing beyond the light but despair!
translate: 光芒之外只有绝望！

original: And
translate: 而且

original: The old man sighs
translate: 老人叹了口气

original: But, I'll be here waiting here for you
translate: 但是，我会在这里等你

original: For when you return
translate: 等你回来的时候

original: As I must
translate: 因为我必须如此

original: Anything, ye may ask!
translate: 任何事，你都可以问！

original: We're safe as can be here
translate: 我们在这里尽可能安全

original: The old man seems eager at the prospect of conversation
translate: 老人似乎对交谈的前景很热切

original: Ask about the Santa Fury
translate: 询问圣怒号的事

original: How long have you been alone?
translate: 你独自一人多久了？

original: There are smugglers on Idra?
translate: 伊德拉岛上有走私者？

original: Tell me about Horryn
translate: 跟我说说霍林

original: What did you need me to do again?
translate: 你还需要我做什么来着？

original: Remind me what you needed!
translate: 提醒我你需要什么！

original: Actually, I should make ready to leave
translate: 其实，我该准备离开了

original: This here beacon is all's keeping the horrors of this island from my throat!
translate: 这座灯塔是唯一能阻止岛上恐怖之物扑向我喉咙的东西！

original: Thing is, oil is running low and I got nary a drop left in storage
translate: 问题是，油快用完了，仓库里一滴都不剩了

original: I need you to find me some oil afore darkness takes us!
translate: 我需要你在黑暗吞噬我们之前，给我找些油来！

original: Thing is, the oil was coming from the mainland on ships through Horryn
translate: 问题是，油是从大陆用船经霍林运来的

original: Then things went dark and now there’s no way for me to get to it
translate: 然后一切陷入黑暗，现在我没法去取了

original: If it’s still in Horryn, there’s a good chance it’ll be sitting in one of the warehouses in the harbor
translate: 如果它还在霍林，很可能就放在港口的一个仓库里

original: I'll do my best
translate: 我会尽力的

original: Show oil
translate: 出示油

original: That’s all I ask
translate: 这就是我的全部请求

original: I’ll be waiting here for you, tending the fire as best I can
translate: 我会在这里等你，尽力照看好这火焰

original: I’m running out of oil!
translate: 我的油快用完了！

original: I suspect the shipment is stuck in a warehouse in Horryn and I need you to search for it there
translate: 我怀疑那批货滞留在霍林的一个仓库里，我需要你去那里找找

original: You’ll likely find it in one of the warehouses on the waterfront
translate: 你很可能在滨水区的一个仓库里找到它

original: Give oil
translate: 给予油

original: Blessed Dead, I knew you could do it!
translate: 受祝福的死者啊，我就知道你能做到！

original: If nothing else, seeing the light still burning bright is bound to give people hope!
translate: 至少，看到灯火依然明亮，一定会给人们带来希望！

original: Emperor’s Light and all!
translate: 帝皇之光什么的！

original: Let's hope so!
translate: 但愿如此！

original: All I have to offer in way of reward is my old sword
translate: 我能作为报酬给你的，只有我的旧剑

original: It once served me well but it's getting too heavy for me now
translate: 它曾为我效劳，但现在对我来说太重了

original: Mathias produces an old, but well-crafted broadsword wrapped in cloth
translate: 马蒂亚斯拿出一把用布包裹的、古老但做工精良的阔剑

original: I'll be on my way now
translate: 我现在就上路了

original: Ye're back
translate: 你回来了

original: I knew ye'd seek safe harbor once more, drawn to the light like lost moths
translate: 我就知道你会再次寻找安全的港湾，像迷途的飞蛾被灯火吸引

original: Well then; Sit, rest, make yourself at home
translate: 那么，坐吧，休息一下，别客气

original: There might still be some stew left
translate: 可能还剩些炖菜

original: I found the black blade
translate: 我找到了那把黑刃

original: I have oil for you!
translate: 我给你带来了油！

original: I don't have time to linger!
translate: 我没时间逗留！

original: I can't say I've ever heard about a ship by that name
translate: 我不能说我听说过叫那个名字的船

original: And let me tell you, I've worked this lighthouse for a man’s age and I’ll say this much
translate: 而且我跟你说，我在这灯塔干了大半辈子，我可以这么说

original: There’s no ship to be found around here as far as I know!
translate: 据我所知，这附近根本没有什么船！

original: Idra's thick with them
translate: 伊德拉岛上到处都是他们

original: Carrying wares to the mainland for the Freythen
translate: 为弗雷森往大陆运送货物

original: Island’s riddled with caves and they use them to store their contraband and whatnot
translate: 岛上洞穴密布，他们用这些洞穴来存放违禁品之类的

original: But they keep to themselves and I want no trouble so I let them be
translate: 但他们独来独往，我不想惹麻烦，所以就由他们去了

original: #Chapter1LighthouseMisc
translate: #Chapter1LighthouseMisc

original: For all its alienness, you still recognize the arcane machinery
translate: 尽管它充满异域感，你仍然认出了这台奥术机械

original: An ancient Imperial reticular node
translate: 一个古老的帝国网状节点

original: You suspect this lighthouse was once fueled by reticular energy and that this machine was part of its operation
translate: 你怀疑这座灯塔曾经由网状能量驱动，而这台机器是其运作的一部分

original: The stillness and layer of dust, however, tell you that it's long since fallen into disrepair and that the lighthouse is likely now fueled by common oil
translate: 然而，寂静与积尘告诉你它早已年久失修，而灯塔现在很可能由普通油料驱动

original: As you stand there, beholding the strange machine, you become aware of the scraping of tiny claws in the darkness
translate: 当你站在那里凝视这台奇怪的机器时，你察觉到黑暗中传来微小爪子的刮擦声

original: Then chittering
translate: 接着是吱吱的叫声

original: As you reach for your weapon the strange harmonics of the chittering converge and for the briefest of moments you could have sworn you heard words formed
translate: 当你伸手去拿武器时，那吱吱叫声的奇异谐波汇聚在一起，在那一瞬间你几乎可以发誓你听到了成形的词语

original: Half a dozen beasts launch at you from the dark corners of the room with fangs bared!
translate: 六只野兽从房间的黑暗角落龇着獠牙向你扑来！

original: Creeping through the moldy lighthouse cellar you round a corner and stop dead in your tracks
translate: 你悄悄穿过发霉的灯塔地窖，转过一个拐角，突然停住了脚步

original: Rising up through the core of the tower, is a grotesque-looking metallic monstrosity
translate: 从塔楼核心升起的是一个外形怪诞的金属巨物

original: The strangely organic shapes and odd geometries seem to writhe in the dim light and the burnished sylver coating casts a ghostly reflection on the walls
translate: 那些奇异的有机形状和古怪的几何结构在昏暗的光线中似乎在蠕动，而抛光的银辉金涂层在墙上投下幽灵般的反光

original: #Chapter1LighthouseQuest
translate: 第一章灯塔任务

original: There is nothing more you can do for me right now
translate: 你现在没什么能帮我的了

original: What of it?
translate: 怎么了？

original: What can I do to help?
translate: 我能帮什么忙？

original: About that job
translate: 关于那份工作

original: Remind me what you need
translate: 提醒我你需要什么

original: I have the oil!
translate: 我有油了！

original: Glad to help
translate: 乐意效劳

original: Mathias stares absent mindedly into the fire
translate: 马蒂亚斯心不在焉地盯着火焰

original: I was wondering about something else
translate: 我在想别的事情

original: It's time to leave
translate: 该走了

original: #Chapter1LizardCave
translate: #第一章蜥蜴洞穴

original: The temperature is noticeably higher in this chamber
translate: 这个房间的温度明显更高

original: Strange nest-like structures cover the ground and in each of them, lies a clutch of large yellowish eggs
translate: "奇怪巢穴状的结构覆盖着地面，每个里面都有一窝淡黄色的大蛋"

original: #Chapter1LostSailors
translate: #第一章 失落的船员

original: Hiding along the cliffs, is a lone surviving member of the Zephyr crew
translate: 沿着悬崖躲藏着，是西风号船员中一名孤身幸存的成员

original: They killed them all!
translate: 他们把他们全杀了！

original: Stabbed old Nino right in the throat!
translate: 一刀刺穿了老尼诺的喉咙！

original: And now you've come to finish me?!
translate: 现在你是来结果我的吗？！

original: We need to find somewhere to hide!
translate: 我们得找个地方躲起来！

original: Tell the sailor about the other survivors
translate: 告诉这名船员其他幸存者的事

original: Standing on the edge of the cliff is a crew-man from the Zephyr lucky enough to have made it ashore
translate: 站在悬崖边缘的，是一名西风号的船员，他幸运地登上了岸

original: The man is swaying and looks in shock
translate: 那人摇摇晃晃，看起来惊魂未定

original: I saw it!
translate: 我看见了！

original: By the dead, I just saw it out there!
translate: 以死者之名，我刚刚在外面看见它了！

original: The thing that sunk us!
translate: 就是那东西弄沉了我们！

original: It's still out there!!!
translate: 它还在外面！！！

original: The man begins jabbering incoherently
translate: 那人开始语无伦次地胡言乱语

original: You're back!
translate: 你回来了！

original: Found anyone else alive?
translate: 找到其他活着的人了吗？

original: Emperors watch over you for helping me find the other survivors
translate: 帝皇会保佑你帮我找到其他幸存者

original: You’re always welcome in our camp as far as I’m concerned!
translate: 就我而言，我们的营地随时欢迎你！

original: The man thanks you profusely and hastily makes his way towards the camp where his comrades are waiting
translate: 那人千恩万谢，然后匆匆赶往同伴们等候的营地

original: #Chapter1Maija
translate: #第1章玛伊娅

original: I can't say I remember seeing her
translate: 我不记得见过她

original: Doesn't mean I didn't - my emporium was always busy
translate: 但这不意味着我没见过——我的商场总是很忙

translate: 弗兰佐，营地厨师，曾是主旅馆的老板——你会在马厩附近找到他——如果有人见过她，那一定是他

translate: 几天前，我出城去给一艘捕鲸船送补给

translate: 回来的路上，日落时分，我看到一群人，从霍林郊区徒步向我们冲来，浑身是血，尖叫着

translate: 当镇上的人追上我们时，他们恢复了神智，给我们讲了如此可怕的故事

translate: 关于疯子在夜间横冲直撞的故事

translate: 但他们没有杀死所有人——有些人被带走了——去了谁也不知道的地方

translate: 之后几天，风中传来尖叫声

translate: 显然，已经回不去了

translate: 还有别的事

translate: 注意安全

translate: 尽管她的衣服华贵且是量身定做的，但她卷起袖子，在齐踝深的泥泞中跋涉，从一辆破车上搬下沉重的货箱

translate: 看到一位女士陷入困境，就想伸出援手，是吗？

translate: 看在黄金死者的份上，这该死的就不能等等吗？

translate: 我又不是在做生意！

translate: 她厉声说道

translate: 然后这个可怜的孤独女人就会欠你一份人情？

original: she snarls
translate: 她咆哮道

translate: 我要么自己干，要么就不干！

translate: 女人注意到你在观察她

original: Enjoying the show are we?
translate: 看戏看得开心吗？

translate: 还是你脑子有问题？

translate: 不管怎样，再靠近一步，我就让你好看！

original: The woman snarls
translate: 女人咆哮道

translate: 女人叹了口气，把箱子搬回车上

translate: 原谅我，我有点失常——在这混乱中，我没什么休息

translate: 所有这些关于‘人类末日！’的胡言乱语

original: is starting to wear on me
translate: 开始让我疲惫不堪

original: In any case, I am Maija
translate: 不管怎样，我是玛伊娅

translate: 我在霍林经营——或者说曾经经营——一家商场

original: But you are not from Horryn, are you?
translate: 但你不是霍林人，对吧？

original: Maija's eyes light up with suspicion
translate: 玛伊娅眼中闪过一丝怀疑

original: What brings you to Idra, hmm?
translate: 什么风把你吹到伊德拉来了，嗯？

translate: 我正要去霍林

translate: 我们在海岸附近遭遇了海难

translate: 一次救援任务

translate: 我不再多问了，但看来我商人的直觉是对的

translate: 不管怎样，我们或许还能互相帮助

translate: 玛伊娅把最后一个箱子从破车上搬进她的临时帐篷

translate: 而且我身边还有一小批货物

translate: 我那吝啬的丈夫——可能灯灭时还在攥着铜板——把我们所有的钱都存在大陆的一家银行里

translate: 那该死的银行只和他打交道——我需要取回信用证，才有机会动用那笔钱

original: They should still be in whatever is left of our old store
translate: 它们应该还在我们老店剩下的东西里

translate: 你有什么要卖的？

translate: 询问工作

original: What happened in Horryn?
translate: 霍林发生了什么？

original: I must be on my way
translate: 我得走了

original: Maija
translate: 玛伊娅

original: Good to see you back!
translate: 很高兴看到你回来！

translate: 只有霍林陷落时我带在身边的那些——但我很乐意给你看看

original: They're still the same quality goods I'm known for!
translate: 它们仍然是我闻名的那种优质商品！

original: Show me!
translate: 给我看看！

translate: 然后她转向你，但没有拥抱你，而是从你身边冲过去，双臂抱住了罗兰的腰。

translate: “当心，当心，千万别睡，它会带来潮起潮落的梦，翻腾的大海和可怕的深渊，还有将高山夷平的巨浪。”

translate: 当你转身离开时，不禁对这首“童谣”感到有些不安，思绪飘向了西风号遭遇的恐怖。

translate: 可悲的是，这些船员似乎刚上岸就被残忍杀害了

translate: 可怕的伤口和令人毛骨悚然的肢解告诉你，这一定是疯子的所作所为

translate: 它们窜入黑暗之中，留下你心跳加速
