original: Thankully, it does not seem to venture too close to shore
translate: 幸好，它似乎不会太靠近海岸

original: There is a way we can get one though - and it's imperative that we do so quickly
translate: 不过我们还是有办法弄到一艘的——而且必须尽快

original: We have some cargo here that the Imperial Rescue Mission - slow, but inevitable - would be all too happy to confiscate, along with my liberty
translate: 我们这儿有些货物，帝国救援队——虽然动作慢，但迟早会来——会很乐意没收，连同我的自由一起

original: I can get a boat
translate: 我能弄到船

original: There is one off-shore, awaiting the coded signals that I don't have, because they're stuck in a Harbourmaster's Office that's overrun by twisted creatures
translate: 近海就有一艘，正等着我没有的密码信号，因为信号本困在了港务长办公室，那里已被扭曲的生物占据

original: If the Imperials find the signal book, it's over for me - and no ship for you
translate: 如果帝国军找到了信号本，我就完了——你们也没船了

original: Help me get it back, and I promise we'll ferry you into the Priory before we escape with the cargo
translate: 帮我把它拿回来，我保证在带着货物逃离之前，把你们送到修院

original: Might even come back to pick you up, if you survive
translate: 如果你们活下来，甚至可能回来接你们

original: I have to ask
translate: 我得问问

original: Say no more
translate: 不用多说了

original: I applaud your enthusiasm - but I'm not so sure about your blind trust
translate: 我赞赏你的热情——但我不太确定你的盲目信任

original: Fine, I'll ask some questions
translate: 好吧，我会问些问题

original: You want this doing, or not?
translate: 这事你到底想不想干？

original: Go on?
translate: 继续？

original: Why are you living down here?
translate: 你为什么住在这下面？

original: Where did you come from?
translate: 你从哪里来？

original: How do you feel about the Empire?
translate: 你对帝国有什么看法？

original: What do you know about the Priory?
translate: 你对修院了解多少？

original: # Chapter_1_RefugeeCamp
translate: # 章节_1_难民营

original: #Chapter1RefugeeMother
translate: #第1章难民母亲

original: Driina touches the child’s hands and forehead and examines the child’s mouth
translate: 德莉娜摸了摸孩子的手和额头，检查了孩子的口腔，

original: This infection is beyond me
translate: 这感染我无能为力，

original: she says in a low voice
translate: 她低声说道，

original: Drahl was right
translate: 德拉尔说得对，

original: If this Mother Katak does indeed have a cure, we’ll do well in paying her a visit
translate: “如果这位卡塔克嬷嬷真有解药，我们最好去拜访她一下”，

original: We'll see what we can do
translate: 我们会看看能做些什么，

original: Hannah
translate: 汉娜，

original: A tired-looking young woman is rocking back and forth, cradling a sick-looking child in her arms
translate: “一个面容疲惫的年轻女子来回摇晃着，怀里抱着一个病恹恹的孩子”，

original: The child whimpers in pain as the mother tries desperately to sooth him
translate: 孩子痛苦地呜咽着，母亲拼命想安抚他，

original: Are you Hannah?
translate: 你是汉娜吗？，

original: The woman peers up at you, her eyes wide and desperate
translate: “女人抬头盯着你，眼睛睁得大大的，充满绝望”，

original: What’s it to you?
translate: 关你什么事？，

original: That old arse send you?
translate: 是那个老混蛋派你来的？，

original: Well, it don’t matter now
translate: “唉，现在无所谓了”，

original: My Allyn’s sick
translate: 我的艾琳病了，

original: He needs medicine
translate: 她需要药，

original: Medicine?
Oh, if only I could visit mother Katak
translate: “哦，要是我能去见卡塔克嬷嬷就好了”，

original: The women say she might be able to help my Allyn
translate: 女人们说她也许能救我的艾琳，

original: But Dead Emperors knows if the old woman's even still alive!
translate: 但帝皇才知道那老妇人是不是还活着！，

original: Who is mother Katak?
translate: 卡塔克嬷嬷是谁？，

original: An old woman who has provided us with remedies for as long as I can remember
translate: 一个老妇人，从我记事起就一直给我们提供药方，

original: She lives in the forest deep in the islands interior, but they say it’s not safe to stray from the camp and I couldn't leave my boy in any case
translate: “她住在岛屿深处森林里，但据说离开营地不安全，而且我也无论如何不能丢下我的孩子”，

original: But...you could go?
translate: 但……你可以去？，

original: If you tell her Hannah sent you, she'll know just what I need to cure Allyn's!
translate: “如果你告诉她汉娜让你来的，她就会知道我需要什么来治好艾琳！”，

original: I'll see what I can do!
translate: 我会看看我能做些什么！，

original: I'll do it for the right price
translate: 我会做，但要合适的报酬，

original: Driina, can you help this child?
translate: “德莉娜，你能帮帮这孩子吗？”，

original: The mother clasps your hands
translate: 母亲紧紧握住你的手，

original: The Golden Dead bless you!
translate: 黄金先祖保佑你！，

original: I s'pose the clerics will want the medicine for the camp but I beg this of you
translate: 我猜牧师们会想要这药给营地用，但我求你了，

original: Bring a dose me’ Allyn first
translate: 先给我的艾琳带一剂药来，

original: I don’t think he has long left!
translate: 我觉得她没多少时间了！，

original: She fiddles with something around her neck
translate: 她摆弄着脖子上的什么东西，

original: All I have is this necklace my Petr gave me
translate: 我只有这条项链，是我的彼得给我的，

original: I'll gladly give it up to save my boy
translate: 只要能救我孩子，我很乐意把它给你，

original: And I s'pose the clerics will want the medicine for the camp but I beg this of you
translate: 而且我猜牧师们会想要这药给营地用，但我求你了，

original: I can't help you
translate: 我帮不了你，

original: You've returned
translate: 你回来了，

original: Did you find the medicine?
translate: 你找到药了吗？，

original: The child looks healthier already and his fever appears to have broken
translate: 孩子看起来已经健康多了，烧似乎也退了，

original: Hannah smiles gratefully at you
translate: 汉娜感激地对你微笑，

original: The mother removes the necklace from her neck
translate: 母亲从脖子上取下项链，

original: I can give you my necklace
translate: 我可以把我的项链给你，

original: I don't know how much it's worth, but it's all I have
translate: “我不知道它值多少钱，但这是我全部家当了”，

original: I'll take it
translate: 我收下了，

original: Keep it
translate: 留着吧，

original: Bless the Holy Tombs!
translate: 祝福圣墓！，

original: You don't know how much this means to me
translate: 你不知道这对我意味着什么，

original: And little Allyn!
translate: 还有小艾琳！，

original: Hannah gingerly feeds her child a piece of bread dipped in the foul brew
translate: 汉娜小心翼翼地喂孩子吃了一块蘸了那难闻药水的面包，

original: The child offers a slight grimace at the taste but seems no worse for wear
translate: 孩子尝到味道微微做了个鬼脸，但似乎并无大碍，

original: What about my reward?
translate: 我的报酬呢？，

original: #Chapter1Roland
translate: #第一章罗兰

original: Howling laughter fills the air as the mad-men charge towards you!
translate: 狂笑声响彻空气，那群疯子朝你冲了过来！

original: The man licks his sore lips excitedly
translate: 那人兴奋地舔着干裂的嘴唇

original: You… you hear it too?
translate: 你……你也听到了？

original: The call?
translate: 那个呼唤？

original: I do!
translate: 我听到了！

original: Where... or what, is it coming from?
translate: 它来自……哪里，或者是什么东西？

original: Straining to see through the dense fog, you finally spot them
translate: 透过浓雾竭力望去，你终于发现了他们

original: A group of men prowling the shoreline like carrion-eaters looking for dead flesh
translate: 一群人在海岸线上徘徊，如同食腐者寻找死尸

original: They are unkempt and dressed in rags with bare torsos and broad shoulders adorned by a strange mixture of sailor's tattoos and crude symbols
translate: 他们蓬头垢面，穿着破布，裸露着躯干，宽阔的肩膀上混杂着水手纹身和粗糙的符号

original: They carry an assortment of cruel-looking, rusted tools turned to weapons
translate: 他们拿着各式各样锈迹斑斑、模样残忍的工具，改造成了武器

original: Gibbering chatter, laughter and whimpering drifts across the fog in a steady stream, Whoever these men are, their minds are long gone
translate: 含混不清的喋喋不休、笑声和呜咽声源源不断地飘过浓雾。不管这些人是谁，他们的神智早已丧失

original: You sit still until a group of them passes you by
translate: 你一动不动地坐着，直到一队人从你身边走过

original: Perhaps you might be able to slip past them?
translate: 也许你能悄悄溜过去？

original: Call out to the men
translate: 朝那些人喊话

original: Leave quietly
translate: 悄悄离开

original: The spiral patterns look oddly familiar though you are certain you’ve never seen it before
translate: 螺旋图案看起来异常熟悉，尽管你确定从未见过

original: It’s something deeper
translate: 那是某种更深层的东西

original: Something primal
translate: 某种原始的东西

original: It draws you in!
translate: 它吸引着你！

original: Here - to this place
translate: 这里——来到这个地方

original: This is the beginning and the end
translate: 这是起点也是终点

original: The Reavers notice you staring
translate: 劫掠者们注意到你在盯着看

original: You hear it don’t you?
translate: 你听到了，不是吗？

original: The call of... what?
translate: ……什么的呼唤？

original: The men fan out and regard you with a cruel glare
translate: 那些人散开，用残忍的目光打量着你

original: I’m going to enjoy this
translate: 我会很享受这个

original: one of them snarls as he draws a rusty dagger
translate: 其中一人咆哮着，拔出一把生锈的匕首

original: I'm going to put you down like a rabid dog!
translate: 我要像打死疯狗一样干掉你！

original: Let's be civil about this!
translate: 我们文明点解决这事！

original: You see a figure, thrashing violently at something, obscured by the low fog
translate: 你看到一个人影，正猛烈地击打着什么东西，被低矮的雾气遮住

original: Whatever this person is doing, it's producing loud crunching, wet squelches, and a stream of curses
translate: 不管这人在做什么，都发出了响亮的嘎吱声、湿漉漉的啪叽声和一串咒骂

original: Move closer
translate: 靠近些

original: You see the scene for what it is
translate: 你看清了眼前的景象

original: Roland, soaked through and spattered with ichor, is laying waste to a number of grotesque looking creatures with a piece of driftwood
translate: 罗兰浑身湿透，溅满污血，正用一根浮木痛击一群奇形怪状的生物

original: He snarls like a wounded beast and his eyes are black with rage
translate: 他像受伤的野兽般咆哮，双眼因暴怒而发黑

original: As the last of the horrid beasts falls twitching back into the shallows, Roland snaps his gaze to you - dead eyes staring at some distant point on the horizon behind you
translate: 当最后一只可怖的怪物抽搐着倒回浅滩时，罗兰猛地将目光转向你——死寂的双眼盯着你身后地平线上的某个远点

original: Eventually, the tension drains from his muscles, and he lowers his makeshift weapon
translate: 终于，他肌肉中的紧张感消散了，放下了临时武器

original: Thought I was carrion they did
translate: 他们以为我是腐肉

original: I nearly was
translate: 我差点就是了

original: I didn't think you'd make it
translate: 我没想到你能活下来

original: Seems I've got a few lives left in me, for all they're worth
translate: 看来我还剩几条命，不管它们还值多少

original: Roland sighs deeply and slumps down onto a nearby rock
translate: 罗兰深深叹了口气，瘫坐到附近的一块岩石上

original: You tried to save me
translate: 你试图救我

original: You bloody idiot
translate: 你这个该死的白痴

original: Not exactly the thanks I was expecting
translate: 这可不是我期待的道谢方式

original: The mission needs you
translate: 任务需要你

original: Was half hoping I wouldn't
translate: 我本来有点希望自己没被救

original: He looks around at the driftwood and chunks of flesh, bobbing around your ankles
translate: 他环顾四周，看着浮木和肉块在你脚踝周围漂荡

original: It's about time I payed my debts
translate: 是时候偿还我的债了

original: You wanted to die?
translate: 你想死？

original: I'm counting on you to get this job done
translate: 我指望你完成这趟活

original: I think it's best we part ways
translate: 我觉得我们最好分道扬镳

original: There's no room for being a bloody hero in work like this
translate: 在这种活计里，没有当什么狗屁英雄的余地

original: It's just shit, blood, and bad men doing worse things to others
translate: 只有烂事、鲜血，和坏人对着别人做更坏的事

original: It's about time I paid my debts
translate: 是时候偿还我的债了

original: And yet, here we are
translate: 然而，我们却在这里

original: You sound like you didn't want to be saved
translate: 你听起来好像不想被救

original: Spoken like a true mercenary!
translate: 说得真像个十足的雇佣兵！

original: There might be hope for one of us after all
translate: 我们中或许终究还有人有希望

original: Well, now there's work to be done
translate: 好了，现在有活要干了

original: What do you mean?
translate: 你什么意思？

original: As you say
translate: 随你怎么说

original: But heed this: if you want to survive you need to drop the bloody heroics
translate: 但听好了：如果你想活下去，就得丢掉那该死的英雄主义

original: This business makes your hands dirty - and nothing gets them clean again
translate: 这行当会弄脏你的手——而且再也洗不干净

original: Trust me on that
translate: 相信我这话

original: Speaking of which, I suppose I still work for you
translate: 说到这个，我想我还在为你干活

original: We should get going
translate: 我们该动身了

original: I'm counting on you
translate: 我指望你了

original: Let's get going
translate: 我们出发吧

original: Roland looks out across the uncaring sea
translate: 罗兰眺望着冷漠无情的大海

original: Not many get to be my age in our line of work
translate: 干我们这行的，没几个人能活到我这个岁数

original: The things that I've seen - that I've done
translate: 我见过的——我做过的那些事

original: Memories like that prey upon you
translate: 那样的记忆会折磨你

original: Like bloody wolves circling a camp, with the fire dying out
translate: 就像该死的狼群围着营地，篝火渐渐熄灭

original: Second you let your guard down, they pounce
translate: 你一放松警惕，它们就会扑上来

original: Your time isn't over yet, old man
translate: 你的时辰还没到，老家伙

original: Why don't you retire?
translate: 你为什么不退休？

original: So would you rather I'd let you die?
translate: 那你宁愿我让你死掉？

original: I tried, once
translate: 我试过，一次

original: The quiet only made the memories louder
translate: 安静只会让记忆更喧嚣

original: You wait, expecting Roland to elaborate
translate: 你等待着，以为罗兰会详细说明

original: He merely stares blanky ahead
translate: 他只是茫然地盯着前方

original: We need to be on our way
translate: 我们得上路了

original: No I
translate: 不，我

original: Rolands words catch in his throat
translate: 罗兰的话哽在喉咙里

original: He thinks for a moment and then looks up at you with a determined look
translate: 他思索片刻，然后抬起头，带着坚定的神情看着你

original: When my time is up, my time is up
translate: 我的时辰到了，那就是到了

original: Do you understand?
translate: 你明白吗？

original: Alright Roland
translate: 好吧，罗兰

original: Roland nods solemnly, brushes a sticky glob of ichor off his arm, and trudges over to you
translate: 罗兰郑重地点点头，掸掉胳膊上一块黏糊糊的污血，步履沉重地朝你走来

original: His lips part as if to speak, but he hesitates
translate: 他嘴唇微张，像是要说话，却又犹豫了

original: Let's just go
translate: 我们走吧

original: The brute scowls at you for a moment
translate: 那个粗人朝你皱眉瞪了一会儿

original: If that's what you want, I'm not going to stop you
translate: 如果你真想这样，我不会拦你

original: Maybe I'll rest at that Lighthouse awhile
translate: 也许我会在那座灯塔休息一阵

original: No hard feelings
translate: 没有恶意

original: On second thoughts, I'm going to need you
translate: 转念一想，我还是需要你

original: Roland does not seem to hear you
translate: 罗兰似乎没听见你的话

original: Instead he is staring intently ahead
translate: 相反，他正专注地盯着前方

original: There are men in the fog
translate: 雾里有人

original: I thought I heard them earlier
translate: 我之前好像听到他们的动静了

original: I'm certain they're not from the Zephyr and I'd wager they're less than friendly
translate: 我确定他们不是西风号上的人，而且我敢打赌他们绝非善类

original: I don't care if you're itching for a fight or not, but either way - we should tread carefully
translate: 我不管你手痒想打架还是不想，但无论如何——我们都得小心行事

original: I don't care if you're itching for a fight or not, but either way - you should tread carefully
translate: 我不管你手痒想打架还是不想，但无论如何——你都该小心行事

original: Rolands slinks off into the thick fog
translate: 罗兰悄悄溜进了浓雾之中

original: He smiles a toothless grin
translate: 他咧嘴一笑，露出没牙的笑容

original: That’s the question ain’t it?
translate: 问题就在这儿，不是吗？

original: The men lower their weapons
translate: 那些人放下了武器

original: When you’re ready, Father is waiting for you
translate: 等你准备好了，【父亲】在等你

original: In Horryn
translate: 在霍林

original: Without another word the men turn and wander off into the fog
translate: 那些人没再多说一句话，转身消失在雾中

original: Soon they are gone
translate: 很快他们就不见了

original: I’ll have you talking once I stick this knife in your gut!
translate: 等我把这刀捅进你肚子，你就会开口了！

original: The largest of the group steps menacingly towards you
translate: 那群人中块头最大的一个气势汹汹地朝你逼近

original: If it's a fight you want
translate: 如果你想打架

original: Look closer at the men's tattoos
translate: 仔细看看那些人身上的纹身

original: I'm here to join you!
translate: 我是来加入你们的！

original: #Chapter1SealFollowUp
translate: #第一章 追踪封印

original: Snapping out of it, you force your mind back to the issue at hand
translate: 你猛地回过神来，强迫自己将注意力转回到眼前的问题上。

original: For now, there is little to be done about the amulet and you best be on your way
translate: 眼下，关于这枚护符你无能为力，最好还是继续赶路。

original: No doubt the information stored inside this device is its true value to the Nautical Guild
translate: 毫无疑问，这个装置中储存的信息才是它对航海行会的真正价值所在。

original: The Zephyr was sunk by some unknown horror and the Guild would pay dearly to learn more about such a dire threat to its operations
translate: 西风号被某种未知的恐怖之物击沉，而公会愿意花大价钱来了解这种对其运营构成严重威胁的东西。

original: Then again, you did play some role in the ship's demise as well and that information might also be gleaned from the device
translate: 不过话说回来，你确实也在船只的毁灭中扮演了某种角色，而那段信息也可能从这个装置中被提取出来。

original: Carefully examining the device you discover it has a complex mechanical inner working
translate: 仔细检查这个装置后，你发现它有着复杂的机械内部构造。

original: In part, that mechanism seems to allow the user to perform complicated navigational calculations
translate: 在某种程度上，这个机械装置似乎能让使用者进行复杂的导航计算。

original: But more so, the device seems to have a core of mnemonic runes
translate: 但更重要的是，这个装置似乎有一个记忆符文的核芯。

original: Perhaps it serves as a form of captain’s log?
translate: 也许它充当着某种船长日志？

original: This artifact is not mundane and you’re inclined to agree with Kat that it might be worth something to the Nautical Guild
translate: 这件器物并非凡品，你倾向于同意卡蒂的看法，它对航海行会可能有些价值。

original: Or someone else
translate: 或者对其他人。

original: Beyond that, the strange amulet is beyond your ken
translate: 除此之外，这枚奇怪的护符超出了你的理解范围。

original: Stepping into the fresh air you pull the strange octagonal Guild Seal from your pocket and examine it more closely
translate: 走进清新的空气中，你从口袋里掏出那枚奇怪的八角形公会徽章，更仔细地端详起来。

original: The dark metallic surface is covered in intricately carved lines and symbols
translate: 深色的金属表面布满了精细雕刻的线条和符号。

original: It reminds you of a mix between a compass and an astrolabe
translate: 它让你想起指南针和星盘的结合体。

original: Try to think if you've heard about something like this before
translate: 试着回想一下，你以前是否听说过类似的东西。

original: Try to examine its inner workings
translate: 试着检查它的内部构造。

original: You feel the weight of the strange device in your hands
translate: 你感受到手中这奇怪装置的重量。

original: For a moment you're back on the deck of the Zephyr
translate: 一瞬间，你仿佛又回到了西风号的甲板上。

original: Monstrous tentacles rise above the ship like strange alien towers
translate: 巨大的触手如异界高塔般从船上方升起。

original: Terrified screams fill the air
translate: 惊恐的尖叫声响彻空中。

original: You shudder
translate: 你打了个寒颤。

original: Kat’s voice snaps you out of it
translate: 卡蒂的声音将你拉回现实。

original: If we ever get off this bloody island and back to the mainland, the Guild will pay well to have that returned
translate: “如果我们能离开这该死的岛屿回到大陆，公会会出高价收回这东西。”

original: All I ask is you remember who told you about it
translate: 我只要求你记住是谁告诉你的。

original: Don't worry
translate: 别担心。

original: We'll split the coin
translate: 我们会平分这笔钱。

original: You can keep the coin
translate: 你可以留着钱。

original: All I want is to be done with the Guild
translate: 我只想和公会一刀两断。

original: Be free to wander as I like
translate: 自由自在地四处游荡。

original: Maybe wander up to my brother and stick a knife in his fat gut
translate: 也许溜到我哥哥那里，往他那肥肚子上捅一刀。

original: Your brother?
translate: 你哥哥？

original: Twas my older brother who sold me off to the Guild
translate: 是我哥哥把我卖给了公会。

original: I was bloody twelve!
translate: 我当时才十二岁！

original: Twenty years is what I owe them on account of that bastard
translate: 因为那个混蛋，我欠他们二十年。

original: I’ve already wasted 10 years
translate: 我已经浪费了十年。

original: Her voice breaks for a moment before steel creeps back into her otherwise soft features
translate: 她的声音哽咽了一下，随即坚毅又回到了她那原本柔和的面容上。

original: Like I said; gutting the bastard will go a long way towards setting things right
translate: 就像我说的，给那混蛋开膛破肚，能大大地让事情回到正轨。

original: And the amulet will help you somehow?
translate: 那护符能帮到你吗？

original: Sure, I’m free enough for now, but the Guild doesn’t like to let their assets go and they have a way of catching up with those who jump ship
translate: “当然，我现在算是自由了，但公会不喜欢放走他们的资产，他们有办法追上那些跳船的人。”

original: Even someone as lowly as me
translate: 即使是我这样卑微的人。

original: Dangling a recovered captain’s seal in front of them is exactly the kind of thing that might sway them
translate: 在他们面前晃着一枚找回的船长徽章，正是那种可能动摇他们的事情。

original: We'll do what we can!
translate: 我们会尽力的！

original: I’m liking you more and more
translate: 我越来越喜欢你了。

original: Let’s start by getting off this bloody island alive!
translate: 我们先从活着离开这该死的岛屿开始吧！

original: Kat’s eyes narrow slightly as if she tries to get a read on you
translate: 卡蒂微微眯起眼睛，仿佛在试图看透你。

original: Let’s just get moving
translate: 我们赶紧动身吧。

original: We might have our work cut out just getting off this bloody island
translate: 光是离开这该死的岛屿，可能就够我们忙的了。

original: You have indeed heard about this type of device before
translate: 你以前确实听说过这种装置。

original: As you understand it, it allows the officers of a Nautical Guild ship to operate the vessel’s complicated navigational instruments
translate: “据你所知，它能让航海行会船只的军官操作船上复杂的导航仪器。”

original: But more than that, it also serves as a device that records the captain’s log
translate: “但更重要的是，它也是一个记录船长日志的装置。”

original: #Chapter1Shepherd
translate: #Chapter1Shepherd

original: The pale-faced youth looks at you with desperation
translate: 脸色苍白的少年绝望地看着你

original: What about them?
translate: 它们怎么办？

original: I talked to your dad
translate: 我和你父亲谈过了

original: We're to take the goats to camp
translate: 我们要把山羊带到营地去

original: These goats are going to the camp
translate: 这些山羊要去营地

original: Never mind
translate: 算了

original: I have some questions
translate: 我有几个问题

original: I have to go
translate: 我得走了

original: Stay here for now
translate: 暂时待在这里

original: The boy lets out a pathetic yelp as he swings his staff at you!
translate: 男孩挥杖向你打来，发出一声可怜的尖叫！

original: Before you can step aside, Roland’s fist shatters the boy’s jaw
translate: 你还没来得及闪开，罗兰的拳头就打碎了男孩的下巴

original: He tumbles to the ground and with a sickening crack, his skull smashes open against a large rock
translate: 他摔倒在地，随着一声令人作呕的碎裂声，他的头骨在一块大石头上撞开了花

original: His swing goes wild and he tumbles to the ground
translate: 他挥杖落空，摔倒在地

original: There her remains, sobbing
translate: 她留在原地，抽泣着

original: You fail to get another word out of him and decide it’s best to be on your way
translate: 你没法再从他嘴里问出什么，决定还是继续赶路为好

original: Lead the animals away
translate: 把动物们带走

original: He clings to his blanket with trembling fingers
translate: 他用颤抖的手指紧紧抓着毯子

original: I...I don't know
translate: 我……我不知道

original: Nothin' on Idra should be able to make a sound like that
translate: 伊德拉岛上不该有东西能发出那种声音

original: Whatever it is, it ain't human
translate: 不管那是什么，都不是人类

original: I never see 'em
translate: 我从没见过它们

original: Every night the mist rolls in, and then shapes appear just outside the circle of my fire
translate: 每晚雾气涌来，然后篝火光圈之外就会出现一些影子

original: And then I...I can feel 'em!
translate: 然后我……我能感觉到它们！

original: The boy starts to sob
translate: 男孩开始抽泣

original: I know they're there, but no matter how terrified I am, I can't stay awake!
translate: 我知道它们就在那里，但无论我多害怕，我就是无法保持清醒！

original: I always fall asleep, and when I wake up the next morning
translate: 我总是会睡着，等第二天早上醒来

original: The boy drops his head into his trembling hands
translate: 男孩把头埋进颤抖的双手里

original: I never see 'em do it, but every mornin' there are fresh marks on my goats...on me
translate: 我从没亲眼看见它们动手，但每天早上我的山羊身上……还有我身上，都会出现新的痕迹

original: They're feeding on us, I know they are!
translate: 它们在吸食我们，我知道就是这样！

original: The goats suddenly get to their feet, bleating nervously
translate: 山羊们突然站了起来，不安地咩咩叫着

original: Their gazes are fixed on something beyond the grey sea-mist that constantly blanks Idra
translate: 它们的目光紧盯着灰色海雾之外的什么东西，那海雾常年笼罩着伊德拉

original: The youth sinks to the ground and begins sobbing loudly
translate: 少年瘫坐在地，开始大声抽泣

original: You don’t get any more sense out of him and there is nothing left to do but lead the animals away
translate: 你从他嘴里再也问不出什么，除了把动物们带走，别无他法

original: Huddled inside a hollow mountain crevice is a young man surrounded by half a dozen goats
translate: 一个年轻人蜷缩在山间一处凹陷的岩缝里，身边围着五六只山羊

original: He is shivering violently beneath a worn blanket, his gaunt face pale in the dim light
translate: 他在一条破旧的毯子下剧烈地颤抖着，憔悴的脸庞在昏暗的光线中显得苍白

original: The goats look no healthier
translate: 山羊们看起来也同样不健康

original: W-w-who goes there!?
translate: 谁……谁在那儿！？

original: Keep away - I've got nothing for you!
translate: 离远点——我没什么可给你的！

original: Who are you?
translate: 你是谁？

original: You're Jakub's boy, I presume?
translate: 我猜，你是雅库布的儿子？

original: The boy looks up at you with wide, too-trusting eyes
translate: 男孩抬起头，用一双睁得大大的、过于轻信的眼睛看着你

original: M-my name is Aiden
translate: 我……我叫艾登

original: I live at a farm just outside of Horryn
translate: 我住在霍林城外的一个农场里

original: Dar trusts me to
translate: 我爸信任我

original: Why are you out here?
translate: 你为什么在这里？

original: It isn't safe
translate: 这里不安全

original: I
translate: 我

original: I'm doin' my part for the family!
translate: 我在为家里尽一份力！

original: An inhuman shriek once again cuts through the mountains
translate: 一声非人的尖叫再次划破山间

original: The boy freezes in terror
translate: 男孩吓得僵住了

original: What was that?
translate: 那是什么？

original: The shepherd eyes you suspiciously
translate: 牧羊人怀疑地看着你

original: I m-might be
translate: 我……可能是

original: Did he
translate: 他是不是

original: Before he can finish an inhuman shriek once again cuts through the mountains
translate: 他话没说完，一声非人的尖叫再次划破山间

original: Working as fast as you can, you get the ragged flock moving and set off towards the camp
translate: 你以最快速度赶着这群破衣烂衫的山羊，朝营地出发

original: No, wait!
translate: 不，等等！

original: Aiden looks suddenly terrified
translate: 艾登突然露出惊恐的神色

original: I...I can't go!
translate: 我……我不能走！

original: My dar told me if I bring the goats back to the farm, the chamberlain will slaughter them for food and it'll be the end for ma and dar!
translate: 我爸跟我说过，要是我把山羊带回农场，总管就会把它们宰了当食物，那我和爸妈就都完了！

original: What if I talk to your father?
translate: 要是我去跟你父亲谈谈呢？

original: It makes no difference
translate: 那也没用

original: I'm taking these goats to camp
translate: 我要把这些山羊带到营地去

original: The young man shudders in relief
translate: 年轻人如释重负地颤抖了一下

original: I know of hidden trails - we'll be in the camp in no time!
translate: 我知道一些隐秘的小路——我们很快就能到营地！

original: The goats start bleeting
translate: 山羊们开始咩咩叫

original: But we must hurry!
translate: 但我们得赶紧！

original: Lead the way
translate: 带路吧

original: I’m not going to let you do that!
translate: 我不会让你这么做的！

original: The scrawny teen struggles to his feet brandishing his shepherd's staff
translate: 瘦骨嶙峋的少年挣扎着站起来，挥舞着他的牧羊杖

original: If I lose these animals my dar’ll kill me!
translate: 要是我丢了这些牲口，我爸会杀了我的！

original: Don't do anything stupid now
translate: 现在别做傻事

original: I need to rethink this
translate: 我得再想想

original: Fine by me
translate: 我没意见

original: attack
translate: 攻击

original: The boy shivers from cold and exhaustion
translate: 男孩又冷又累，瑟瑟发抖

original: Wh… what now?
translate: 现……现在怎么办？

original: Why haven't you just left?
translate: 你为什么不干脆离开？

original: About the animals
translate: 关于那些动物

original: I need to go
translate: 我得走了

original: The boy somehow looks even paler than he did last time you saw him
translate: 男孩看起来比上次你见到他时更苍白了

original: I don’t know how much longer we can take it
translate: 我不知道我们还能撑多久

original: We need to talk?
translate: 我们需要谈谈？

original: The boy is clearly heartbroken, but he makes no effort to move
translate: 男孩显然心都碎了，但他没有要动的意思

original: Alright, if that's what dar wants
translate: 好吧，如果这是爸的意思

original: You'd do that for me?
translate: 你愿意为我这么做？

original: Oh, Golden Dead bless you!!
translate: 哦，黄金先祖保佑你！！

original: I'll be back soon
translate: 我很快就回来

original: My dar would kill me
translate: 我爸会杀了我的

original: He sent me up here to keep the goats safe and I’m not leaving until he permits it!
translate: 他派我到这里来保护山羊，没有他的允许，我是不会离开的！

original: The lad’s eyes water up
translate: 少年的眼眶湿润了

original: #Chapter1Smugglers
translate: #第一章走私者

original: We've been holed up in these bloody caves for too long - a little bloodshed might do us good
translate: 我们在这该死的洞穴里躲得太久了——流点血或许对我们有好处

original: The furthest warriors draw their bows, as the lead figure strides towards you, blade in hand
translate: 最远处的战士拉开弓，领头的人手持刀剑大步向你走来

original: Roland, any ideas?
translate: 罗兰，有什么主意吗？

original: I yield!
translate: 我投降！

original: None the less, trouble's found you
translate: 尽管如此，麻烦还是找上了你

original: And you're not leaving until she says so
translate: 而且她没发话，你就别想走

original: So put down your weapons, or these tunnels are about to get very slippery
translate: 所以放下武器，否则这些隧道很快就会变得非常滑溜

original: You want them?
translate: 你想要它们？

original: Come get them
translate: 来拿啊

original: Fine!
translate: 好吧！

original: We'll yield
translate: 我们投降

original: Smugglers
translate: 走私者

original: Hold it!
translate: 站住！

original: Comes a shout from the shadows ahead
translate: 前方的阴影中传来一声大喝

original: Move any closer and you'll move no more
translate: 再靠近一步，你就再也动不了了

original: You can just make out the faint silhouettes of a group of armed warriors
translate: 你只能勉强辨认出一群武装战士的模糊轮廓

original: Forgive me - I'll leave!
translate: 请原谅——我这就走！

original: You have no idea who you're messing with
translate: 你根本不知道你在招惹谁

original: We're the kind of folks who prefer to be left well alone
translate: 我们是那种喜欢独处的人

original: The kind who don't brook no interference from strangers
translate: 那种不容陌生人干涉的人

original: The figures creep slowly out of the murk
translate: 人影从黑暗中缓缓爬出

original: Being able to see them better does not reassure you
translate: 看得更清楚并没有让你安心

original: We're here to offer our services
translate: 我们是来提供服务的

original: If you want a fight, I'm happy to oblige?
translate: 如果你想打架，我很乐意奉陪？

original: We're not looking for trouble
translate: 我们不是来找麻烦的

original: Truly
translate: 真的

original: Oh, it's not really that easy now is it?
translate: 哦，现在可没那么简单了，不是吗？

original: You know we're here now
translate: 你现在知道我们在这儿了

original: And you could be anyone
translate: 而你可能是任何人

original: The voice trails off, and one of the figures makes a high-pitched chuckle
translate: 声音逐渐消失，其中一个人发出尖声的轻笑

original: You want to bleed?
translate: 你想流血吗？

original: Just ask!
translate: 尽管开口！

original: Listen, we're not looking for trouble
translate: 听着，我们不是来找麻烦的

original: You don't say?
translate: 是吗？

original: The voice coos
translate: 那声音轻柔地说

original: Tell me, little lamprey, do you know who you're dealing with here?
translate: 告诉我，小七鳃鳗，你知道你在跟谁打交道吗？

original: Please enlighten me
translate: 请指教

original: I don't care
translate: 我不在乎

original: You all bleed the same
translate: 你们流的血都一样

original: I'm sure you are but the Queen will be the judge of that
translate: 我相信你是，但女王会做出判断

original: Now drop your fucking weapons and come with me!
translate: 现在放下你他妈武器，跟我走！

original: If you want my weapons, come and get them!
translate: 想要我的武器，就来拿啊！

original: I'll yield
translate: 我投降

original: There's a staccato laugh from the darkness
translate: 黑暗中传来断断续续的笑声

original: I can't deny we're in dire need of fresh blood, thanks to these interesting times
translate: 我不能否认，由于这个有趣的时代，我们急需新鲜血液

original: I'd be happy to introduce you to the Queen herself - I'll even vouch for your enthusiasm
translate: 我很乐意把你引荐给女王本人——我甚至可以担保你的热情

original: But by the Mother of Maelstroms, I can't let you go armed
translate: 但以漩涡之母的名义，我不能让你带着武器

original: Guests!
translate: 宾客！

original: I would see you in my quarters
translate: 我要在我的住处见你

original: Do not keep me waiting
translate: 别让我久等

original: And Armand - let them keep their weapons
translate: 还有阿曼德——让他们保留武器

original: Any decent assassin would have shut you up long ago
translate: 任何一个像样的刺客早就让你闭嘴了

original: Aye aye m'lady
translate: 是，夫人

original: Armands offers a shallow bow
translate: 阿曼德微微鞠躬

original: You heard the lady
translate: 你听到夫人说的了

original: Make yourself at home in our little corner of luxury
translate: 在我们这小小的奢华角落里随意些

original: Armand gestures towards the tunnels beyond with a theatrical gesture
translate: 阿曼德夸张地朝远处的隧道做了个手势

original: A womans voice rings through the caves with such authority that the would-be combatants stop dead in their tracks
translate: 一个女人的声音在洞穴中响起，充满威严，让那些即将动手的斗士们顿时停住

original: Armand!
translate: 阿曼德！

original: What is this nonsense?
translate: 这是什么胡闹？

original: You'd add dead guests to the list of curses befalling us?
translate: 你想让死去的宾客也加入降临在我们身上的诅咒清单吗？

original: Fool!
translate: 蠢货！

original: Armand
translate: 阿曼德

original: A deep voice rings out through the caves
translate: 一个低沉的声音在洞穴中回荡

original: Then, backlit by torches, you notice a woman overlooking the scenes from a high ledge
translate: 然后，在火把的背光中，你注意到一个女人从高高的岩架上俯瞰着这一切

original: We have guests, I see
translate: 我们有客人了，我明白了

original: I think it would behoove us to treat them with what hospitality we can muster, no?
translate: 我认为我们应该尽我们所能款待他们，不是吗？

original: You hear the shadowy sentinels immediately sheathe or stow their weapons
translate: 你听到阴影中的哨兵们立刻收刀入鞘或收起武器

original: Aye, m'lady!
translate: 是，夫人！

original: the man called Armand calls back respectfully
translate: 那个叫阿曼德的男人恭敬地回应

original: Roland strides towards the oncoming assailant, his figure looming over him, making him seem more beast than man,
translate: 罗兰大步走向逼近的袭击者，他的身影笼罩着对方，让他看起来更像是野兽而非人类

original: Your archers might get me but I'll make damn sure you and I go together little man
translate: 你的弓箭手或许能干掉我，但我保证会拉你垫背，小个子

original: The shadowy figure stops dead in his tracks as Roland's voice rumbles menacingly through the tunnel
translate: 当罗兰的声音在隧道中威胁性地隆隆作响时，那个阴影中的人影顿时停住脚步

original: As you disarm, you find yourself at the mercy of the shadowy figures
translate: 当你解除武装时，你发现自己任由那些阴影中的人影摆布

original: Even through the darkness, you can make out the white teeth of the leader's cruel grin
translate: 即使在黑暗中，你也能看清领头者残忍笑容中的白牙

original: This was a bad idea
translate: 这是个坏主意

original: Out of the corner of your eye, you can see Iben shift ever so slightly to put you between him and your would be assailants
translate: 从眼角余光中，你看到伊本微微移动，把你挡在他和那些潜在的袭击者之间

original: #Chapter1UWMaze
translate: #Chapter1UWMaze

original: You utter an underwater scream of pain and terror but before you can act further, the creature has retreated back into one of the holes
translate: 你发出一声水下痛苦与恐惧的尖叫，但还没来得及进一步行动，那生物就已缩回其中一个洞里

original: Swim south
translate: 向南游

original: Quickly rummaging through the poor fellows belongings, you try not to think about your own dwindling air supply
translate: 你快速翻找着这个可怜人的遗物，尽量不去想自己日渐稀薄的空气储备

original: In a pouch on his belt you find a handful of coins and a key
translate: 在他腰带上的一个袋子里，你找到了一把硬币和一把钥匙

original: Now, you’ve lingered too long already and you must move on
translate: 现在，你已经耽搁太久了，必须继续前进

original: Tunnels lead to the north and west
translate: 隧道通往北方和西方

original: Swim north
translate: 向北游

original: Swim west
translate: 向西游

original: You break the surface and find yourself back in the cave system where you started
translate: 你浮出水面，发现自己回到了最初出发的洞穴系统

original: For all its bleakness, you nonetheless feel a sense of relief at returning to this area

original: In any case
translate: 不管怎样

original: The old man reaches into the leather pouch and pulls out a handful of strange coins that look nothing like standard Imperial coinage
translate: 老人把手伸进皮袋，掏出一把奇怪的硬币，看起来完全不像标准的帝国钱币

original: Though they are no doubt valuable, they’re covered in greenish grime that make them almost look more like sea-shells than coins
translate: 虽然它们无疑很值钱，但上面覆盖着绿色的污垢，让它们看起来更像是贝壳而不是硬币

original: Bounty from the deep!
translate: 来自深海的赏金！

original: Handed down from me da’ who got it from me granda’
translate: 从我老爹那儿传下来的，他又是从我爷爷那儿得来的

original: He used to say granda’ was so strong in the old faith that Mother Maelstrom would let him go down into the deep and visit with them who live there
translate: 他常说爷爷在旧信仰中如此强大，老漩母会让他下到深海去拜访住在那里的他们

original: Came back with sacks of this he did
translate: 他回来时带了好几袋这东西

original: Nice a place as ever you'll see!
translate: 你见过的最好的地方！

original: Warm fire, roof over your head
translate: 温暖的炉火，头顶有屋顶

original: Marita’s good to old Basilo letting him stay here
translate: 玛丽塔对老巴西洛很好，让他住在这里

original: Take care of her in return Basilo does
translate: 作为回报，巴西洛照顾她

original: She spends all her time playing in the yard with her kids these days and she forgets to eat
translate: 这些天她整天在院子里和孩子们玩耍，忘了吃饭

original: Some days I have to feed her to make sure she don’t waste away
translate: 有些日子我得喂她，确保她不会消瘦下去

original: The old man smiles warmly
translate: 老人温暖地微笑着

original: There are children here?
translate: 这里有孩子？

original: The fireplace casts a warm glow across the piles of old fishbones, broken furniture and strange trinkets that litter the ruined home
translate: 壁炉的温暖光芒洒在散落于破败家中的旧鱼骨、破家具和奇怪小饰品堆上

original: Basilo hums contently to himself
translate: 巴西洛心满意足地哼着歌

original: Let's trade
translate: 我们交易吧

original: Where did you get all that coin?
translate: 你那些硬币都是从哪儿来的？

original: What's wrong with the well?
translate: 那口井怎么了？

original: What happened to this place?
translate: 这个地方发生了什么？

original: I've choosen to end you!
translate: 我选择结束你！

original: The Wreck Picker
translate: 残骸拾荒者

original: A lanky man with skin like sun-dried leather stares slack-jawed at you
translate: 一个瘦高男人，皮肤像晒干的皮革，张着嘴呆呆地盯着你

original: He’s dressed in rags and with a wide brimmed hat and a large bundle of scrap slung over his shoulder
translate: 他穿着破布，戴着一顶宽边帽，肩上扛着一大捆废料

original: Do Basilo’s eyes deceive him?
translate: 巴西洛的眼睛欺骗了他吗？

original: More ghosts?
translate: 更多鬼魂？

original: Or did the sea spit you back out alive?
translate: 还是大海把你活着吐了回来？

original: Not many are that lucky!
translate: 没多少人那么幸运！

original: Your eyes fall on the crude spiked club that hangs in his belt
translate: 你的目光落在他腰带上挂着的粗糙尖刺棍棒上

original: Basilo makes his living picking at what the mother of maelstroms does not swallow
translate: 巴西洛靠捡拾风暴之母没有吞下的东西为生

original: And it’s been rich pickings as of late
translate: 最近收获颇丰

original: Crates and barrels and even the odd fleshy morsel!
translate: 板条箱、木桶，甚至偶尔还有肉块！

original: The man bares a row of blackened teeth in what you assume is a smile
translate: 男人露出一排发黑的牙齿，你猜那是在微笑

original: Rich pickings?
translate: 收获颇丰？

original: What's the club for?
translate: 那棍棒是干什么用的？

original: Listen here; Basilo has a proposal for you!
translate: 听着；巴西洛有个提议给你！

original: The man smiles in greedy anticipation
translate: 男人贪婪地笑着，充满期待

original: Shore’s bursting with bounty today!
translate: 今天海岸上满是赏金！

original: Man can make a fortune if he sets his mind to it
translate: 一个人要是下定决心，就能发大财

original: Basilo will be warming his bones up at the old abandoned farm house right behind us
translate: 巴西洛会在我们身后那座废弃的老农舍里暖暖身子

original: Find me there!
translate: 去那儿找我！

original: I had some questions
translate: 我有些问题

original: The club is caked in dried blood and of crude design
translate: 棍棒上沾满了干涸的血迹，设计粗糙

original: It has the look of a tool used well and often
translate: 看起来是一件用得很顺手的工具

original: Basilo offers up a chuckle that is chillingly out of place as he pats it
translate: 巴西洛拍了拍它，发出一声不合时宜、令人毛骨悚然的轻笑

original: Every now and then, Mother Maelstrom offers up little fish that have a bit of fight left in them
translate: 时不时地，老漩母会献上一些还有点儿挣扎力气的小鱼

original: All Basilo does is help put them to rest
translate: 巴西洛所做的只是帮它们安息

original: How many 'fish' did you put to sleep today?
translate: 你今天让多少条“鱼”睡着了？

original: He looks taken aback by the question
translate: 他看起来被这个问题吓了一跳

original: Basilo did them all nice
translate: 巴西洛把它们都好好处理了

original: Just like father taught him!
translate: 就像父亲教他的那样！

original: Anyone still squirming gets a knock on his shell till he’s good and floppy
translate: 任何还在扭动的，就在它壳上敲一下，直到它彻底软趴趴

original: Not to worry
translate: 别担心

original: Been doing it for years
translate: 干这行好多年了

original: Used to help my da’ hold em down while he did the knocking
translate: 以前常帮我老爹按住它们，让他来敲

original: Quick as you like
translate: 要多快有多快

original: Basilo offers an eager smile as if to reassure you that he’s very good at what he does
translate: 巴西洛露出热切的笑容，仿佛在向你保证他非常擅长他所做的事

original: You murder survivors to steal their belongings?
translate: 你谋杀幸存者，偷他们的东西？

original: You monster!
translate: 你这个怪物！

original: Basilo fidgets in obvious discomfort at not understanding what you’re trying to get at
translate: 巴西洛明显不安地坐立不安，不明白你想说什么

original: The drowned men belong to Mother Maelstrom!
translate: 淹死的人属于老漩母！

original: Doesn’t matter if a few of them manage to wriggle onto shore for a last gulp of air
translate: 就算有几个能挣扎着爬上岸吸最后一口气也没关系

original: They’re drowned men nonetheless and all Basilo is doing is sending them back to where they belong
translate: 他们终究是淹死的人，巴西洛所做的只是把他们送回他们该去的地方

original: That’s the way we used to do on these islands
translate: 我们过去在这些岛上就是这么做的

original: Now, most folk have forgotten
translate: 如今，大多数人都忘了

original: But not me
translate: 但我没忘

original: Not Basilo
translate: 巴西洛没忘

original: My family has been here for a long time
translate: 我的家族在这里很久了

original: You deserve death!
translate: 你该死！

original: The man slinks off into the fog, heading north
translate: 男人溜进雾中，向北走去

original: As his form dissolves into the nothingness of the mist, you can hear him muttering to himself excitedly
translate: 当他的身影消失在虚无的雾气中时，你能听到他兴奋地自言自语

original: No need for Basilo to risk his hide!
translate: 巴西洛没必要拿自己的皮肉冒险！

original: You seem fit enough and I’ve got coin!
translate: 你看起来够结实，而且我有硬币！

original: I’ll buy whatever you bring me
translate: 你带什么来我都买

original: Might even have a piece or two to sell if you’re interested
translate: 如果你感兴趣，我甚至可能有一两件东西要卖

original: Just beware them clippers
translate: 只是要当心那些钳子

original: Clippers?
translate: 钳子？

original: I'd rather end you right here!
translate: 我宁愿就在这里了结你！

original: Not here out in the cold!
translate: 别在这外面受冻！

original: Find Basilo up by the farmhouse
translate: 到农舍那边找巴西洛

original: Might even have some soup cooking for you
translate: 说不定还给你煮了点儿汤

original: There's the one who cheated Mother Maelstrom!
translate: 这就是那个欺骗了老漩母的人！

original: And loaded with trinkets for old Basilo perhaps?
translate: 也许还带着给老巴西洛的小玩意儿？

original: There might be some fine coin in it for you
translate: 你可能会因此得到一些不错的硬币

original: The old man shakes a worn leather pouch at you that clinks with the sound of coins
translate: 老人朝你晃了晃一个破旧的皮袋，发出硬币的叮当声

original: Stay as long as ye like
translate: 想待多久就待多久

original: Just don’t drink the water in the well
translate: 只是别喝井里的水

original: Best not drink the water there
translate: 最好别喝那儿的水

original: Tastes funny and gives you strange dreams
translate: 味道怪怪的，还会让你做奇怪的梦

original: Besides, the children mostly use it for their games these days
translate: 再说，这些天孩子们主要用它来玩游戏

original: #Chapter1WreckSailors
translate: #第一章 西风号船员残骸

original: The ragged band of survivors fan out around you like a pack of starved predators
translate: 这群衣衫褴褛的幸存者像一群饥饿的掠食者一样在你周围散开，

original: Currents brought us straight ashore so if the Dead are with us, any survivors would have landed on this here shoreline
translate: 洋流把我们直接冲上了岸，所以如果死者与我们同在，任何幸存者都会在这片海岸线上登陆，

original: You might want to start by searching the cliffs just to the north
translate: 你或许可以从搜索北边的悬崖开始，

original: Also others are bound to have landed in the same area where you landed
translate: 而且其他人肯定也在你登陆的同一区域上岸了，

original: Finally there is a lighthouse to the south-east and some may have headed there
translate: 最后，东南方有一座灯塔，有些人可能去了那里，

original: What do you know of this island?
translate: 你对这座岛了解多少？

original: I had other questions
translate: 我还有别的问题，

original: If you come across any more of my men, tell them where to find me
translate: 如果你遇到我更多的弟兄，告诉他们到哪里找我，

original: Both I and the guild will thank you if you do
translate: 如果你这么做，我和公会都会感谢你，

original: Snow turns his back on you and joins his men around the fire
translate: 斯诺转过身去，加入火堆旁他的同伴中，

original: But you are not all to blame
translate: 但也不能全怪你，

original: It seems our journey was doomed no matter!
translate: 看来我们的旅程无论如何都注定要失败！

original: That thing!
translate: 那个东西！

original: What was it?
translate: 那是什么？

original: And this island
translate: 还有这座岛，

original: There is something terribly wrong here!
translate: 这里有什么非常不对劲！

original: All I know is we need to work together if we are to survive!
translate: 我只知道，要想活下去，我们就得齐心协力！

original: All I know is that it's each man for himself now
translate: 我只知道，现在只能各顾各的了，

original: The man's eyes flash from sorrow to rage in an instant
translate: 那人的眼神瞬间从悲伤转为愤怒，

original: Before you know it he draws his dagger
translate: 你还没反应过来，他就拔出了匕首，

original: What can I do for you?
translate: 我能为你做什么？

original: What was it that attacked the Zephyr?
translate: 袭击西风号的是什么东西？

original: What do you know of this place?
translate: 你对这个地方了解多少？

original: About the other survivors
translate: 关于其他幸存者，

original: I found your men
translate: 我找到了你的人，

original: I've been here before, years ago
translate: 我以前来过这里，多年前，

original: Didn't leave Horryn back then but it was nothing but a backwater port like any other
translate: 那时没离开过霍林，但它不过是个和其他地方一样的偏僻港口，

original: Full of people not too fond of strangers and superstitious fishermen
translate: 到处都是不太喜欢陌生人的居民和迷信的渔民，

original: Nothing like now
translate: 和现在完全不一样，

original: Don't you feel it?
translate: 你没感觉到吗？

original: Air smells strange, like right before a thunder-storm!
translate: 空气闻起来怪怪的，就像雷暴来临前一样！

original: And the beasts!
translate: 还有那些野兽！

original: I tell you, I've sailed 'round the Empire for near on twenty years and I've never seen creatures like these!
translate: 我告诉你，我在帝国周边航行了快二十年，从没见过这样的生物！

original: And then there are the men
translate: 然后还有那些人，

original: The men?
translate: 那些人？

original: We saw men stalking the fog
translate: 我们看到有人在雾中潜行，

original: Dangerous men I thought
translate: 我觉得是危险的人，

original: Then I came across some of their handy-work
translate: 然后我看到了他们的一些杰作，

original: Tommyn and Dill the cabin boy
translate: 汤米恩和见习水手迪尔，

original: Black arrows in their back the both of them
translate: 两人背上都中了黑箭，

original: Best to keep far away from them
translate: 最好离他们远点，

original: Where should I look for survivors?
translate: 我该去哪里找幸存者？

original: Your group is growing I see?
translate: 我看你的队伍在壮大？

original: It always is with you mercenaries
translate: 你们这些雇佣兵总是这样，

original: And honest men lose their lives!
translate: 而老实人却丢了性命！

original: I had not expected to see you alive mercenary!
translate: 我没想到还能见到你活着，雇佣兵！

original: But you stood up for us on the Zephyr and you saved the lives of some of my men so I'm glad you made it
translate: 但你在西风号上为我们挺身而出，还救了我一些弟兄的命，所以我很高兴你活了下来，

original: Your captain was in the right so I was glad to
translate: 你的船长做得对，所以我也乐意帮忙，

original: Your crew didn't deserve to be slaughtered
translate: 你的船员不该被屠杀，

original: It was a means to an end
translate: 那只是达到目的的手段，

original: Nonetheless, it did us little good
translate: 尽管如此，这对我们没什么好处，

original: I've never seen anything like that beast before
translate: 我以前从没见过那样的野兽，

original: The way it tore the ship appart?
translate: 它把船撕碎的方式？

original: Something is wrong here!
translate: 这里有什么不对劲！

original: What curse has befallen us?
translate: 我们遭到了什么诅咒？

original: All I know is that we need to work together if we are to survive!
translate: 我只知道，要想活下去，我们就得齐心协力！

original: It's each man for himself now
translate: 现在只能各顾各的了，

original: Back to finish the job?
translate: 回来完成工作？

original: Well, ship's gone
translate: 唉，船没了，

original: So the captain and most of my mates!
translate: 船长和我大多数同伴也是！

original: But by the depths you won't have me without a fight!
translate: 但以深渊之名，我不会束手就擒！

original: Snow spits at you
translate: 斯诺朝你吐口水，

original: Roland leans in and whispers in a low voice
translate: 罗兰凑过来低声耳语，

original: Remember, these are guilders
translate: 记住，这些是公会的人，

original: If the guild finds them and they talk, it'll mean trouble
translate: 如果公会找到他们，他们又乱说，那就有麻烦了，

original: Then a fight you shall have!
translate: 那就打吧！

original: Calm down lest I end you here and now!
translate: 冷静点，不然我现在就了结你！

original: I'm sorry for how it turned out
translate: 事情变成这样，我很抱歉，

original: A gaunt-faced man that looks like he's spent more years at sea than ashore stands before you
translate: 一个面容憔悴、看起来在海上待的年头比在陆地上还多的男人站在你面前，

original: If you recall, this was the Zephyr's first mate
translate: 如果你还记得，这是西风号的大副，

original: You remember his crewmates calling him 'Snow'
translate: 你记得他的船员同伴叫他“斯诺”，

original: He glares at you with a set jaw and clenched fists
translate: 他咬紧牙关，握紧拳头，怒视着你，

original: He offers a smile that doesn't quite reach his eyes as you apporach
translate: 当你走近时，他露出一个笑意未达眼底的微笑，

original: Greet the man
translate: 向那人打招呼，

original: I've never seen anything like it
translate: 我从没见过这样的东西，

original: There are beasts in the depths but nothing like this!
translate: 深渊里有野兽，但从没有这样的！

original: It was like something out of a sailors nightmare!
translate: 简直就像水手噩梦里的东西！

original: Blessed dead, how will we ever get off this island?
translate: 祝福的死者啊，我们到底要怎么离开这座岛？

original: There’s safety in numbers and every face from the old crew that turns up in camp here is a boon
translate: 人多力量大，每一个出现在营地里的老船员都是好事，

original: Especially considering how many were lost
translate: 尤其是考虑到我们失去了那么多人，

original: In any case, I hear from the crew that you’ve been doing good work!
translate: 不管怎样，我听船员说你干得不错！

original: We haven’t much, but we scraped together a small bag of gold for you
translate: 我们没什么东西，但还是凑了一小袋金币给你，

original: Snow hands you a small, worn pouch of coins
translate: 斯诺递给你一个破旧的小钱袋，

original: That being said, it appears it might be too soon for celebration
translate: 话虽如此，看来现在庆祝还为时过早，

original: Aye - that they did
translate: 是啊，他们确实做到了，

original: And it cost the lives of many a good man
translate: 而这让许多好人丢了性命，

original: The man looks at you for a moment and his eyes begin to water from sorrow, anger and exhaustion
translate: 那人看了你一会儿，他的眼睛因悲伤、愤怒和疲惫而开始湿润，

original: Why did you do it?
translate: 你为什么要这么做？

original: Gold?!
translate: 金币？！

original: She was such a fine ship!
translate: 她曾是那么出色的一艘船！

original: And us crewmen - we were like brothers!
translate: 而我们船员——我们就像兄弟一样！

original: And now both ship and men lie broken on these cursed cliffs!
translate: 而现在，船和人都在这些被诅咒的悬崖上支离破碎！

original: It was just a job
translate: 那只是一份工作，

original: Things got out of hand
translate: 事情失控了，

original: You had it coming
translate: 你们是自找的，

original: Sorry are you?
translate: 你很抱歉？

original: Tell that to men who were dragged under by that leviathan!
translate: 去跟那些被利维坦拖下深渊的人说吧！

original: Tell that to the guild when they hear of this!
translate: 等公会听说这事，你去跟他们说吧！

original: Calm down man!
translate: 冷静点，伙计！

original: You leave me no choice!
translate: 你让我别无选择！

original: A small group of exhausted figures sit huddled around a small campfire
translate: 一小群疲惫的身影蜷缩在一小堆篝火旁，

original: You recognize them immediately as a small group of survivors from the Zephyr
translate: 你立刻认出他们是西风号的一小群幸存者，

original: One of them suddenly notices you and the men stumble to their feet; Some grasping for makeshift weapons and others looking around for a way to flee!
translate: 其中一人突然注意到你，那些人踉跄着站起来；有些人抓起临时武器，另一些人则四处张望寻找逃跑的路！

original: One of the men suddenly notices you and the men stumble to their feet, smiling at you and waving you over to their meager fire
translate: 其中一人突然注意到你，那些人踉跄着站起来，朝你微笑，挥手让你到他们微弱的火堆旁，

original: Approach peacefully
translate: 和平地靠近，

original: Calm down?
translate: 冷静？

original: I say there's one of you and more of us!
translate: 要我说，你只有一个人，我们人多！

original: Of that I have no doubt
translate: 对此我毫不怀疑，

original: But if there is at least a shred of decency left in you, I'll beg this small favor
translate: 但如果你还有一丝良知，我恳求你帮个小忙，

original: Aye, there is no disagreeing with this
translate: 是啊，这没什么好不同意的，

original: Though my men and I have naught to offer save our fire and what shelter these huts may provide
translate: 虽然我和我的人除了这堆火和这些棚屋能提供的遮蔽之外，没什么可给你的，

original: There are beds inside if you require, but little else
translate: 如果你需要，里面有床，但别的就没什么了，

original: There is one last thing
translate: 还有最后一件事，

original: A favor I'd ask of you
translate: 我想请你帮个忙，

original: You may have already seen her, but a portion of the Zephyr lies upon the shore up along the coast north-west of here
translate: 你可能已经看到了，西风号的一部分船体就搁在西北方向沿岸的岸上，

original: It breaks my heart to see the old girl like this
translate: 看到老姑娘这副模样，我心都碎了，

original: See, our duty to her doesn’t end with her sinking
translate: 你看，我们对她的责任并不会随着她的沉没而结束，

original: She’s still the property of the Guild
translate: 她仍然是公会的财产，

original: As is any cargo she was carrying
translate: 她运载的任何货物也是，

original: We were unable to get to her before but the tides seem to have shifted her now and I sent a small group out there to see if they couldn’t find a way into her
translate: 我们之前没法靠近她，但现在潮水似乎把她冲动了，我派了一小队人去那里，看看能不能找到进去的路，

original: And?
translate: 然后呢？

original: Snow looks down
translate: 斯诺低下头，

original: That was hours ago
translate: 那是几个小时前的事了，

original: Too long
translate: 太久了，

original: Something’s wrong or they would be back by now
translate: 出事了，不然他们现在早该回来了，

original: Now, you’ve done a lot for us and I’m almost afraid to ask for more but I need to know what happened to my boyos
translate: 现在，你为我们做了很多，我几乎不敢再要求更多，但我需要知道我的兄弟们出了什么事，

original: Snow looks at you pleadingly
translate: 斯诺恳求地看着你，

original: Dead bless you
translate: 死者保佑你，

original: As I said, the wreckage lies just a few hundred yards up the coast
translate: 就像我说的，残骸就在沿海岸往北几百码的地方，

original: Watch your back and be ready for anything
translate: 小心背后，做好一切准备，

original: More bloodshed
translate: 更多的流血，

original: I fear this island may be the end of us all yet
translate: 我担心这座岛最终会是我们所有人的葬身之地，

original: At least the wreckage might be safe enough to explore now
translate: 至少现在残骸可能足够安全，可以探索了，

original: The supplies she carries may keep us going for weeks
translate: 她运载的补给可能够我们撑好几个星期，

original: I’m ashamed to say I have nothing to offer you besides the promise that the Nautical Guild will not forget your service
translate: 我很惭愧地说，除了航海行会不会忘记你的帮助这个承诺之外，我没什么可给你的，

original: A lifetime under the mast is thanks enough for a Guilder isn’t it?
translate: 一辈子在桅杆下生活，对一个公会成员来说就是足够的感谢了，不是吗？

original: Kat offers sarcastically
translate: 卡蒂讽刺地说道，

original: Good bye
translate: 再见，

original: #Chapter1WreckSpotted
translate: 第一章 发现沉船

original: The ship is utterly shattered with its hull broken in half
translate: 船体彻底碎裂，船身断成两半。

original: It seems impossible that the ship would have remained afloat for long enough to settle on these cliffs in its current condition
translate: 以这艘船目前的状态，它似乎不可能在海上漂浮足够长的时间，最终搁浅在这些悬崖上。

original: It’s almost as if something placed it here
translate: 简直就像是什么东西把它放在这里一样。

original: Though for what reason, you can only guess
translate: "至于原因，你只能猜测。"

original: You spot a makeshift plank bridge leading up into the shattered hull
translate: 你发现一座临时搭建的木板桥，通向破碎的船体。

original: As far as you can tell there is currently no way into the ship, though that may change as it shifts in the tides
translate: 就你目前所见，现在还没有办法进入船内，不过随着潮汐变化，情况可能会改变。

original: Laying ahead of you like some gargantuan beached sea-creature, are the smashed remains of the Zephyr
translate: 西风号的残骸横陈在你面前，就像一头搁浅的巨型海兽。

original: You shudder to think of the monstrosity that caused the demise of the once-elegant ship
translate: 一想到导致这艘曾经优雅的船只毁灭的怪物，你就不寒而栗。

original: What manner of terror was that creature?
translate: 那究竟是怎样一种恐怖生物？

original: Kat muses as if reading your mind
translate: 卡蒂若有所思，仿佛看穿了你的心思。

original: #Chapter1ZephyrSurvivors
translate: #第1章西风号幸存者

original: One of the wretched surviors from the Zephyr
translate: 西风号上可怜的幸存者之一

original: The man looks torn, tattered and exhausted
translate: 这个男人看起来衣衫褴褛、疲惫不堪

original: As you approach the sailor shrinks back in terror whilst avoiding your gaze
translate: 当你靠近时，水手恐惧地退缩，同时避开你的目光

original: Talk to Snow if you want something
translate: 如果你想找斯诺，就和他谈谈

original: As you approach the sailor offers a tired, but grateful smile
translate: 当你靠近时，水手露出了疲惫但感激的微笑

original: # Chapter_2_Horryn
translate: 章节2_霍林

original: #Chapter2HorrynCastleMainHall
translate: #第二章霍林城堡主厅

original: Ahead, three figures clad in tattered robes sit bound and kneeling
translate: 前方，三个身穿破烂长袍的人被绑着跪在地上

original: One is sobbing loudly and the second sits trembling in a puddle of his own piss
translate: 一个在大声啜泣，另一个坐在自己的尿液中瑟瑟发抖，

original: The third however, face covered by a hood, seems more composed - and familiar
translate: 然而第三个，脸被兜帽遮住，看起来更镇定——而且有些眼熟

original: Slowly, from the shadow something emerges
translate: 慢慢地，从阴影中有什么东西浮现出来

original: Twice the size of a man yet oddly graceful the being is utterly alien in every fashion
translate: 这个生物有两人高，却出奇地优雅，在各方面都完全异于常人，

original: You have no doubt you, at last, find yourself in the presence of ‘Father’
translate: 你毫不怀疑，你终于来到了‘【父亲】’面前

original: The Father-beast stalks over to the first captive, all the while breathing heavily and wheezing as if not accustomed to breathing air
translate: 父兽大步走向第一个俘虏，同时沉重地喘息着，仿佛不习惯呼吸空气

original: Slowly, its four-fingered hand reaches out towards the man’s head, grasping it as easily as a grown man would grasp an apple
translate: 慢慢地，它四指的手伸向那人的头，像成年人抓苹果一样轻松地抓住

original: It pulls the poor wretch close and for a moment, its horrible yellow eyes seem to peer into the man’s mind
translate: 它将这个可怜虫拉近，有那么一瞬间，它可怕的黄色眼睛似乎窥视着那人的思想

original: The creature emits a strange trilling sound and then, with terrifying ease, crushes the man’s skull like an egg
translate: 这个生物发出一种奇怪的颤音，然后以可怕的轻松，像捏碎鸡蛋一样捏碎了那人的头骨

original: The creature moves down the line and the process repeats
translate: 这个生物沿着队列移动，过程重复，

original: Once again, it gazes deeply into the eyes of the terrified prisoner almost as if it is looking for something
translate: 它再次深深地凝视着惊恐的囚犯的眼睛，几乎像是在寻找什么，

original: Cry out
translate: 喊出声来，

original: But once again the wretch is found wanting
translate: 但又一次，这个可怜虫被发现有欠缺，

original: Fragments of brain and skull, spray across the hall
translate: 脑浆和头骨碎片飞溅在大厅里，

original: Your attempt to cry out sticks in your throat
translate: 你想要喊叫的尝试卡在喉咙里，

original: 'Father' stalks down the line to the final victim
translate: ‘【父亲】’沿着队列走向最后一个受害者，

original: The beast lets out a strange trilling sound as it fixes its gaze on the third person
translate: 这个野兽发出奇怪的颤音，同时将目光锁定在第三个人身上，

original: For the first time you notice that unlike the others, she’s not bound at the wrists
translate: 你第一次注意到，与其他人不同，她的手腕没有被绑住

original: With steady hands she pulls back her hood and even with all the years past you immediately recognize her
translate: 她用稳健的双手拉下兜帽，即使过了这么多年，你立刻认出了她，

original: Embla
translate: 恩布拉，

original: As if sensing your presence, she turns her head slightly towards you
translate: 仿佛感知到你的存在，她微微转头朝向你

original: Even in the dim light you get a feeling that she’s smiling
translate: 即使在昏暗的光线中，你感觉她在微笑，

original: Then the creature looms over her
translate: 然后那个生物笼罩在她上方，

original: The creature’s eyes go wide as it reaches towards her
translate: 当它向她伸手时，它的眼睛睁大了，

original: If it was searching for something, it must have found it!
translate: 如果它一直在寻找什么，那它一定找到了！

original: Roaring in triumph, it lunges but at the moment of impact the room instead explodes with white light
translate: 它胜利地咆哮着，猛扑过去，但在撞击的瞬间，房间反而爆发出白光

original: The heavy metallic smell of ozone mixes with the stench of burned flesh as the creature staggers backwards clutching its eyes in pain!
translate: 沉重的金属臭氧味与烧焦肉体的恶臭混合在一起，那个生物痛苦地抓着双眼踉跄后退！

original: Embla collapses on the floor as the surrounding cultists howl in shock and terror
translate: 恩布拉倒在地板上，周围的邪教徒们惊恐地嚎叫，

original: Most flee in wild panic whilst a handful instead scramble for weapons to stand in defense of their wounded master
translate: 大多数人在狂乱中逃跑，而少数人则争抢武器，以保卫他们受伤的主人，

original: The creature may have been temporarily blinded but flailing wildly in insane rage, it’s mad with rage and none the less formidable
translate: 这个生物可能暂时失明了，但在癫狂的愤怒中疯狂挥舞，它怒不可遏，依然令人生畏
