original: #GradlaMinesAmbush1
translate: #GradlaMinesAmbush1

original: You enter a larger chamber and are struck by the temperature of the air
translate: 你进入一个更大的洞室，空气的温度让你猛然一惊，

original: It appears to be getting unnaturally warm the deeper you venture into the mines
translate: 似乎随着你深入矿洞，温度变得异常地热，

original: Suddenly, the shifting of stones captures your attention and you become aware of large eyes regarding you from the darkness
translate: "突然，石头的移动声吸引了你的注意，你意识到黑暗中有一双大眼睛在注视着你"

original: As you take an apprehensive step backwards, the horrors step into the dimness of the chamber
translate: "当你忐忑不安地向后退了一步时，那些恐怖之物踏入了洞室的昏暗之中"

original: The hulking horrors from the deep, move with deadly grace as they slowly fan out in an attempt to encircle you
translate: "那些来自深处的庞大恐怖之物，以致命的优雅移动着，缓缓散开，试图包围你"

original: Suddenly one of them lunges - Its arms outstretched and fingers splayed!
translate: 突然，其中一个扑了过来——它的双臂伸展，手指张开！

original: Are they trying to take you alive?
translate: 它们是想活捉你吗？

original: Charge!
translate: 冲锋！

original: #GradlaMinesAmbush2
translate: #格拉德拉矿场伏击2

original: As you enter the room you walk into a wall of warm, damp air
translate: 当你进入房间时，你撞上了一堵温暖潮湿的空气墙

original: The stifling atmosphere causes your clothing to stick to your body and your head goes light
translate: 令人窒息的空气让你的衣服粘在身上，头也开始发晕

original: You try to push ahead but halt once again as stars flash before your eyes and a ringing rises in your ears
translate: 你试图继续前进，但眼前金星乱冒，耳中嗡嗡作响，只得再次停下

original: Embla squints into the darkness
translate: 恩布拉眯着眼看向黑暗深处

original: We are getting close
translate: 我们快到了

original: A presence
translate: 一个存在

original: Ancient
translate: 古老

original: Powerful
translate: 强大

original: Suddenly Embla cries out in pain as she sinks to her knees
translate: 突然，恩布拉痛苦地叫出声来，双膝跪地

original: As you rush to aid her, a horrid clicking noise sounds from the darkness
translate: 当你冲过去帮她时，黑暗中传来一阵可怕的咔嗒声

original: Embla, get up!
translate: 恩布拉，起来！

original: Hulking shapes emerge from the darkened tunnels around you
translate: 巨大的身影从你周围黑暗的隧道中浮现

original: One of them steps into the dim circle of light
translate: 其中一个踏入了昏暗的光圈

original: It regards you with huge, yellow eyes full of alien intellect
translate: 它用一双巨大的黄色眼睛注视着你，眼中充满了异样的智慧

original: To your horror, organs never meant for human speech croak forth words
translate: 令你惊恐的是，那些本不该用于人类语言的器官沙哑地吐出了话语

original: More vesselsss come to usssss!
translate: 更多容器……来到我们身边……！

original: Sheee will be pleasssssed!
translate: 她……会很高兴……！

original: Die you foul beasts!
translate: 去死吧，你们这些肮脏的野兽！

original: #GradlaMinesMainChamber
translate: #格拉德拉矿场主室

original: You take a step toward the massive creature and as she rears up and bellows, the utter futility of attempting to fight her dawns on you!
translate: 你向那巨大的生物迈出一步，当她直立起来并咆哮时，你意识到试图与她战斗完全是徒劳的！

original: Flee
translate: 逃跑

original: Your pathetic attempt at bravery comes to a sudden and terrible end as you are torn limb from limb by the ancient and terrible creature
translate: 你那可悲的勇敢尝试突然而可怕地结束了，你被那古老而可怕的生物撕成了碎片。

original: Your quest has ended
translate: 你的任务结束了。

original: You spin on your heel and flee the breeding chamber as fast as you can
translate: 你转身以最快的速度逃离了繁殖室。

original: It is too late however
translate: 然而已经太迟了。

original: The Queen’s ire is up and with surprising grace and agility the ancient beast gives chase through the narrow tunnels of the mine
translate: 女王怒火中烧，这头古老的巨兽以惊人的优雅和敏捷在矿场狭窄的隧道中追赶着你。

original: Make for the exit
translate: 冲向出口。

original: Turn and charge at her instead
translate: 转身向她冲锋。

original: Run towards the trapped tunnel
translate: 跑向设有陷阱的隧道。

original: Sprinting blindly through the winding tunnels, panic takes you
translate: 在蜿蜒的隧道中盲目冲刺，恐慌攫住了你。

original: There is no way to outrun this creature and nowhere to hide
translate: 没有办法跑过这个生物，也无处可藏。

original: Relentlessly, the ancient Queen chases you down and tears you limb from limb
translate: 无情地，古老的女王追上了你，将你撕成碎片。

original: Looming menacingly above you, the Queen positions herself between you and her cocooned ‘vessels’
translate: 女王威胁性地耸立在你上方，挡在你和她那些结茧的“容器”之间。

original: You can’t help but notice that beyond her, to the north, is another chamber where you can barely make out what appears to be a robed figure
translate: 你不禁注意到，在她身后北边，是另一个房间，你勉强能辨认出一个似乎是穿着长袍的身影。

original: Attack the Queen
translate: 攻击女王。

original: Carefully sneak away
translate: 小心地溜走。

original: You emerge into a large natural cave
translate: 你进入了一个巨大的天然洞穴。

original: The atmosphere here is tropical and strange writhing growths cover the walls
translate: 这里的气氛如同热带，奇怪的蠕动生长物覆盖着墙壁。

original: Slowly, you make your way towards one of the nodules and become aware of a strange wheezing sound
translate: 慢慢地，你走向其中一个结节，并注意到一种奇怪的喘息声。

original: Could it be… breathing?
translate: 难道是……呼吸声？

original: As light falls on the first of the cocoons you realize, to your horror, that you’ve found the lost citizens of Horryn
translate: 当光线照在第一个茧上时，你惊恐地意识到，你找到了霍林失踪的市民。

original: You carefully lean in to examine one of the hapless victims but nearly cry out in alarm when the poor man opens his eyes
translate: 你小心地俯身检查其中一个不幸的受害者，但当那个可怜的人睁开眼睛时，你差点惊叫出声。

original: He moans and looks around with confused swimming eyes
translate: 他呻吟着，用迷茫、游移不定的眼神环顾四周。

original: As he fixes on you, his mouth moves as if to speak
translate: 当他注视着你时，他的嘴动了动，仿佛要说话。

original: Slowly and painfully two words escape him
translate: 缓慢而痛苦地，他吐出了两个字。

original: Kill me
translate: 杀了我。

original: At that very moment, the low growl of a massive creature reverberates through the tunnels
translate: 就在那一刻，一个巨大生物低沉的咆哮声在隧道中回荡。

original: She’s here
translate: 她来了。

original: Embla whispers in a tone half reverence and half terror
translate: 恩布拉低声说道，语气半是敬畏半是恐惧。

original: The ground shakes as the huge beast slowly moves towards you
translate: 地面震动，巨大的野兽缓缓向你移动。

original: What was first mercifully obscured by darkness now comes into view
translate: 最初被黑暗仁慈地遮蔽的东西现在显现出来。

original: Standing more than twice as tall as the Deep-Ones you have battled before, this creature is enormous and no doubt lethal beyond compare
translate: 这个生物比你之前战斗过的深潜者高出两倍多，体型巨大，无疑具有无与伦比的致命性。

original: Now revealed in all her glory, it becomes clear to you
translate: 现在她完全显露出来，你明白了。

original: She is a queen-mother and you are standing in her breeding chamber
translate: 她是一位女王母亲，而你正站在她的繁殖室里。

original: You reemerge into the horrid breeding-chamber, and once again the giant Queen emerges from the darkness
translate: 你重新进入可怕的繁殖室，巨大的女王再次从黑暗中现身。

original: You hold your breath in terror as you carefully take a step backwards
translate: 你恐惧地屏住呼吸，小心地向后退了一步。

original: The beast-queen watches you intently but it seems you are in luck
translate: 野兽女王专注地注视着你，但看来你运气不错。

original: The instinct to remain with her brood is stronger than the instinct to kill
translate: 留在后代身边的本能比杀戮的本能更强烈。

original: Realizing you can never outrun her, you have but one chance
translate: 意识到你永远跑不过她，你只有一个机会。

original: The trapped tunnel!
translate: 设有陷阱的隧道！

original: The creature is nearly at your heels as you round the last corner and spot the trigger-rope
translate: 当你绕过最后一个拐角并看到触发绳时，那生物几乎就在你身后。

original: Your lungs are on fire from breathing the thick, dust-laden air and with a final spasm of effort you lunge for the rope
translate: 你的肺因呼吸着浓重、充满灰尘的空气而灼痛，你用尽最后的力气扑向绳子。

original: Pull the rope!
translate: 拉绳子！

original: And catch it as you slide along the floor
translate: 并在滑过地板时抓住了它。

original: The beam snaps like a twig and instantly gravity asserts its dominance over rock!
translate: 横梁像细枝一样折断，重力瞬间对岩石施加了支配！

original: Countless tons crash down in an instant, utterly turning the body of the gargantuan abomination into so much gore
translate: 无数吨岩石瞬间崩塌，将那庞大畸形生物的身体彻底砸成了肉泥。

original: Falling rocks pummel you and then a huge billowing cloud of choking dust fills the remaining tunnel
translate: 落石击打着你，然后一大团令人窒息的滚滚尘埃充满了剩余的隧道。

original: Couching madly and stumbling about in the dark you nonetheless manage to get your bearings
translate: 你在黑暗中疯狂咳嗽、跌跌撞撞，但还是设法辨明了方向。

original: Slowly, you make your way to the exit and into fresh air
translate: 慢慢地，你走向出口，呼吸到了新鲜空气。

original: For now you must recover from the ordeal and wait for the dust to settle
translate: 现在你必须从这场磨难中恢复过来，等待尘埃落定。

original: #GradlaMinesSpottedExit
translate: #格拉德拉矿洞发现出口

original: I’m not sure
translate: 我不确定

original: I suspect the Deep-Ones never made it to the plateau
translate: 我怀疑深潜者从未到达过高原

original: They are creatures of the sea and though they are dangerous enough on land, their reach is limited
translate: 它们是海洋生物，虽然在陆地上也足够危险，但它们的影响范围有限

original: Perhaps that is why they were breeding with humans?
translate: 也许这就是它们与人类繁衍的原因？

original: To make hybrids?
translate: 为了制造混血？

original: What other dangers could be waiting for us then?
translate: 那么还有什么其他危险在等着我们？

original: Embla’s voice drops to a whisper
translate: 恩布拉的声音低至耳语

original: The seven eyes of the Dragon are fixed on the Priory
translate: 龙的七只眼睛紧盯着修道院

original: I can feel it
translate: 我能感觉到

original: It writhes in the void, coveting that which lies below the Priory
translate: 它在虚空中扭动，觊觎着修道院之下的东西

original: Its tendrils are grasping!
translate: 它的触须正在抓取！

original: Your head spins and for an instance you again imagine hearing the chanting of some long dead language in the darkness
translate: 你头晕目眩，一瞬间你再次想象在黑暗中听到某种早已消亡的语言的吟唱

original: Let's not speak of such things here in the darkness
translate: 我们别在这黑暗中谈论这些事了

original: Let’s move on
translate: 我们继续前进吧

original: The statues of two robed figures loom ominously over a doorway carved directly into the mountain with uncanny precision
translate: 两尊身着长袍的雕像阴森地矗立在一扇以不可思议的精准度直接凿入山体的门洞上方

original: Beyond, a narrow stair with oddly proportioned steps ascends steeply
translate: 门后，一道台阶比例奇特的狭窄楼梯陡峭地向上延伸

original: The faintest of wisps of cool mountain air can be felt coming down through the shaft
translate: 能感觉到最微弱的一缕凉爽山风从竖井中吹下

original: These stairs are not part of the mines
translate: 这些楼梯不是矿洞的一部分

original: says Embla as she stares up at the statues in reverence
translate: 恩布拉敬畏地仰望着雕像说道

original: They were built by those who built the Priory
translate: 它们是由建造修道院的人建造的

original: So they lead up to the plateau?
translate: 那么它们通向高原？

original: Yes, I believe they do
translate: 是的，我相信是这样

original: Once we ascend, we’ll be within striking distance of the Priory
translate: 一旦我们登上去，我们就会进入修道院的攻击范围

original: For all we have faced so far, I suspect there is yet much danger ahead
translate: 尽管我们已经面对了这么多，我怀疑前方还有很多危险

original: In other words, we must be well prepared before we set out
translate: 换句话说，我们出发前必须做好充分准备

original: Danger?
translate: 危险？

original: From the Deep-Ones?
translate: 来自深潜者？

original: #GradlaSpotted
translate: #发现格拉德拉

original: Land ho!
translate: 看到陆地了！

original: sounds the cry from the crows nest
translate: 瞭望台上传来呼喊声

original: Iago offers you a spyglass
translate: 伊阿戈递给你一个望远镜

original: There!
translate: 那里！

original: Fogbanks to the north
translate: 北边有雾堤

original: Gradla’s southern shore
translate: 格拉德拉的南岸

original: If I remember correctly the coastline is littered with underwater reefs and dangerous to navigate
translate: 如果我没记错的话 海岸线上遍布水下暗礁 航行十分危险

original: I fear we cannot follow it without being forced into deeper waters and within grasp of the Behemoth
translate: 恐怕我们无法沿着海岸航行 否则会被迫进入更深的水域 落入海怪的魔爪

original: Embla, what now?
translate: 恩布拉，现在怎么办？

original: Embla closes her eyes for a moment as if recalling some distant memory
translate: 恩布拉闭了一会儿眼睛 仿佛在回忆某个遥远的记忆

original: The Priory lies on the plateau of the mountain chain that dominates Gradla’s inland
translate: 修道院坐落在横贯格拉德拉内陆的山脉高原上

original: As far as I know, the Cabal expedition landed at a small mining-village called Adler’s Helm and proceeded from there
translate: 据我所知，秘盟考察队在一个叫鹰盔堡的采矿小镇登陆，并从那里出发

original: Iago, what do you recommend?
translate: 伊阿戈，你有什么建议？

original: Iago carefully scans the emerging shoreline
translate: 伊阿戈仔细扫视着逐渐显现的海岸线

original: I suspect we will not be able to reach Adler’s Helm without exposing ourselves to the dangers of the high seas
translate: 我怀疑我们无法在不暴露于公海危险的情况下抵达鹰盔堡

original: If you are to reach the village, you must land on the southern shore and then travel overland
translate: 如果你们要到达那个村庄，就必须在南岸登陆，然后走陆路

original: Let's make landfall!
translate: 我们登陆吧！

original: Try as you might you will neither be able to exorcise the memories, nor ever make sense of them
translate: 无论你如何努力，你既无法驱散那些记忆，也永远无法理解它们

original: #GradlaSpottedVulcano
translate: 格拉德拉发现火山

original: Ahead, a volcanic peaks of mount Karaban rises steeply
translate: 前方，卡拉班山的火山峰陡峭地耸立着。

original: It lies there like some giant of titanic proportions that is thankfully still asleep
translate: 它像某个巨大无比的巨人一样躺在那里，幸好还在沉睡。

original: If it were to awaken however
translate: 然而，如果它苏醒过来，

original: You shudder at the thought, thankful that your journey takes you in a different direction
translate: 你一想到这个就打了个寒颤，庆幸你的旅程是往另一个方向去的。

original: #GradlaTownEnter
translate: #格拉德拉镇入口

original: Something about DeepOnes
translate: 关于深潜者的一些事

original: More about DeepOnes
translate: 更多关于深潜者的事

original: Finally the last part about DeepOnes
translate: 最后关于深潜者的部分

original: I need to be on my way
translate: 我得赶路了

original: We’ll stay here and for now you can bloody well find your own place to hide
translate: 我们会留在这里，现在你他妈自己找个地方躲起来吧

original: Come back once it’s safe and we’ll see if we can’t scrounge up some supplies and a warm bed for you
translate: 等安全了再回来，我们看看能不能给你凑点补给和一张暖和的床

original: Also
translate: 还有，

original: Be careful and don’t lead those bloody things here if things go bad!
translate: 小心点，要是情况不妙，别把那些该死的东西引到这里来！

original: World's gone mad!
translate: 世界疯了！

original: All began with us finding those odd stairs leading up to the plateau with those strange ruins
translate: 一切都始于我们发现了那些通往高原的奇怪阶梯，上面有那些古怪的废墟

original: The Company sent an expedition here to investigate it and all
translate: 商会派了一支考察队来调查这一切

original: They set off up onto the plateau and then - nothing
translate: 他们出发上了高原，然后——就没了音讯

original: That is until the ‘events’ started!
translate: 直到那些‘事件’开始！

original: Events?
translate: 事件？

original: Started with my crew getting these strange dreams
translate: 一开始是我的船员们做了些奇怪的梦

original: Then we saw lights dance up over the plateau and heard strange sounds
translate: 然后我们看到高原上方有光芒舞动，还听到了奇怪的声音

original: Howls almost
translate: 几乎是嚎叫声

original: Then came the ‘things’ from the sea
translate: 接着海里的‘东西’就来了

original: The man’s voice shakes with terror
translate: 男人的声音因恐惧而颤抖

original: What 'things'?
translate: 什么‘东西’？

original: Things that should not be
translate: 不该存在的东西

original: Scaled things that walk like men
translate: 长着鳞片、像人一样行走的东西

original: They fell upon us in the night and we didn’t stand a chance
translate: 它们在夜里袭击了我们，我们毫无还手之力

original: I’m not ashamed to say, the only reason I’m still alive is I hid like a frightened child
translate: “我不怕承认，我还活着的唯一原因就是我像个吓坏了的孩子一样躲了起来”

original: Emperor’s bones I even pissed myself
translate: 帝皇在上，我甚至尿了裤子

original: Strange thing is, it seems the monster tried to drag people away alive if they could
translate: “奇怪的是，那些怪物似乎尽量把人活着拖走”

original: Dragged them right into the mines if you can believe it
translate: 直接拖进了矿洞，信不信由你

original: There were screams at first
translate: 起初还有尖叫声

original: Such horrible screams
translate: 那么可怕的尖叫

original: But they stopped soon enough
translate: 但很快就停了

original: We almost thought they’d left and that we could make a run for it!
translate: 我们差点以为它们走了，我们可以逃跑了！

original: Then the ships started arriving
translate: 然后船只开始抵达

original: Mad-men sailing all manners of vessels!
translate: 疯子们驾驶着各种各样的船只！

original: Was like they didn’t even try to land properly
translate: 他们好像根本没打算好好靠岸

original: They just beached the ships or ran them onto the reef but that didn’t matter
translate: 他们直接把船冲上沙滩或撞上礁石，但那都无所谓

original: The sea-creatures emerged from the mine to claim the offerings the madmen had brought
translate: 海里的生物从矿洞里出来，接收那些疯子带来的祭品

original: Fresh captives
translate: 新的俘虏

original: What happened to the captives?
translate: 俘虏们怎么样了？

original: The madmen chanted as the captives were dragged into the mine, same as my crew
translate: “疯子们吟唱着，俘虏们被拖进矿洞，就像我的船员们一样”

original: We heard them scream as well
translate: 我们也听到了他们的尖叫

original: I shudder to think what’s going on down there in the darkness
translate: 一想到那黑暗中的情形，我就不寒而栗

original: What can you tell me about the mines?
translate: 关于矿洞，你能告诉我些什么？

original: As you enter the mining camp you are greeted by the sight of carnage
translate: 当你进入采矿营地时，映入眼帘的是一片屠杀景象

original: Dead horses and animals litter the small plaza and the only visible sign of life is a lone dog
translate: 死马和动物散落在小广场上，唯一可见的生命迹象是一条孤零零的狗

original: We’ve seen this before
translate: 我们以前见过这种场面

original: Embla looks around thoughtfully
translate: 恩布拉若有所思地环顾四周

original: You saw the wrecked ships as we came in, right?
translate: 我们进来时你看到那些沉船了吧？

original: At least some of them came from Horryn and that means there may at least be Reavers about
translate: 至少有些船来自霍林，这意味着附近可能有劫掠者

original: Pst!
translate: 嘘！

original: Hey you!
translate: 嘿，你！

original: a voice whispers loudly from the nearby building
translate: 附近建筑里传来一个声音，大声地低语

original: By the Golden!
translate: 以黄金之名！

original: Company’s mounted a rescue!
translate: 商会派人来救援了！

original: A wild-eyed man is peering at you through a slit in the door
translate: 一个眼神狂乱的男人正透过门缝窥视着你

original: What company?
translate: 什么商会？

original: The… the Gildendelve Mining Charter!
translate: 是……是吉尔登德尔夫矿业特许公司！

original: Do you mean to say the company didn’t send you?!
translate: 你是说商会没派你们来？！

original: Well, aren’t we all fucked then
translate: “好吧，那我们不都完蛋了”

original: Big Lorn, they called me
translate: “他们叫我大个子洛恩”

original: I’m the foreman here at the mines
translate: 我是这矿洞的工头

original: Or, I used to be is more like it
translate: “或者说，曾经是更准确”

original: Crew’s all dead or taken into the mines!
translate: 我的手下全死了，或者被拖进了矿洞！

original: Me and a handful of others have been hiding here for days but all the rest are gone!
translate: 我和其他几个人在这里躲了好几天，但其余的人都没了！

original: And begging your pardon, we’re staying right where we are until help arrives!
translate: 恕我直言，在救援到来之前，我们就待在这儿不动！

original: What, you won't let me in?
translate: 什么，你不让我进去？

original: I shouldn’t even be talking to you!
translate: 我甚至不该跟你说话！

original: It’ll draw them here and they’ll drag us into the mines as well!
translate: 这会把它们引来，它们也会把我们拖进矿洞的！

original: We’re not coming out until it’s safe and that’s that!
translate: 安全之前我们不会出去，就这样！

original: The man begins to slide shut the hatch in the door
translate: 男人开始把门上的小窗关上

original: I need more information!
translate: 我需要更多信息！

original: Ore mines
translate: 铁矿

original: It’s an older mine that the Company reclaimed
translate: 这是商会重新开采的一个老矿

original: We were expanding the western tunnels when we broke into an older part of the cave
translate: 我们在扩建西侧隧道时，打通了洞穴的一个更古老的部分

original: That’s where we found the stairs
translate: 我们就是在那里发现了阶梯

original: Stairs?
translate: 阶梯？

original: Listen, I don’t want to talk anymore about this right now
translate: “听着，我现在不想再谈这个了”

original: We found the stairs, Company sent their expedition up onto the plateau and whatever they found, things went to shit!
translate: 我们发现了阶梯，商会派了考察队上高原，不管他们发现了什么，事情就变得一团糟！

original: Kill those things in the mine and I’ll be a lot more talkative
translate: 把矿洞里的那些东西干掉，我就会健谈得多

original: I'd best get going then
translate: 那我最好这就动身

original: Well, be quick about it!
translate: 好吧，快点！

original: They could be back any time!
translate: 它们随时可能回来！

original: What's happened here?
translate: 这里发生了什么？

original: Who are 'they'?
translate: ‘他们’是谁？

original: The hatch in the door slides open and a pair of haggard eyes stare out apprehensively
translate: 门上的小窗滑开了，一双憔悴的眼睛担忧地向外张望

original: You’re still alive?
translate: 你还活着？

original: Is it safe to come out?
translate: 出来安全吗？

original: Not yet but I need to talk!
translate: 还不安全，但我需要谈谈！

original: #HorrynAmbush
translate: #霍林伏击

original: The men whirl around at the sound, and elation spreads across their faces as they spot you
translate: 那些人闻声猛然转身，一看到你，脸上便浮现出欣喜之色

original: Dragging their captives along, the reavers fan out around you with moronic grins and weapons drawn
translate: 劫掠者们拖着俘虏，带着愚蠢的狞笑，拔出武器，在你周围扇形散开

original: One of them makes a piercing whistle and it's echoed by another behind you - a new group of six reavers file into the street, cutting off any chance you had at a retreat
translate: 其中一人吹了一声刺耳的口哨，你身后随即有人应和——一队新的六名劫掠者鱼贯涌入街道，彻底断绝了你撤退的任何可能

original: You spring stealthily out of hiding, determined to get within killing range before your foes spot you
translate: 你悄无声息地从藏身处跃出，决心在敌人发现你之前进入击杀范围

original: Your heart pounds in your chest as you prepare to strike the first blow!
translate: 当你准备发起第一击时，心脏在胸膛里剧烈跳动！

original: But a piercing whistling cuts through the silence and stops you dead in your tracks
translate: 但一声刺耳的口哨划破寂静，让你当场僵住了

original: You whirl around to see another group of six reavers file into the street behind you, cutting you off from your escape route
translate: 你猛然转身，看到另一队六名劫掠者鱼贯涌入你身后的街道，切断了你的逃生路线

original: Elated laughter sounds from the first group as they notice the prey now caught between them and their comrades
translate: 第一群人注意到猎物现在被夹在他们和同伙之间，发出了兴高采烈的笑声

original: The reavers fan out around you, dragging their captives along, with moronic grins and weapons drawn
translate: 劫掠者们拖着俘虏，带着愚蠢的狞笑，拔出武器，在你周围扇形散开

original: An 'end'?
translate: 一个“终结”？

original: There are no ends here!
translate: 这里没有终结！

original: Only new beginnings... new life!
translate: 只有新的开始……新生！

original: The men roar with laughter
translate: 那些人狂笑起来

original: I am not
translate: 我不是

original: But He is waiting for you
translate: 但祂在等着你

original: He has so much to show you
translate: 祂有那么多东西要给你看

original: When you're ready
translate: 当你准备好的时候

original: We've come to put and end to you!
translate: 我们是来终结你的！

original: The man's breathing deepens in perverse delight as he pulls his hostage's head back by her long, auburn hair
translate: 那人抓住人质长长的赤褐色头发，将她的头向后扯去，呼吸因反常的愉悦而变得粗重

original: A thousand young will heed her call!
translate: 千万子嗣将听从她的召唤！

original: He places the knife across the woman's throat
translate: 他把刀横在那女人的喉咙上

original: A THOUSAND YOUNG WILL HEAR HER CALL!
translate: 千万子嗣将聆听她的召唤！

original: Stop!!
translate: 住手！！

original: Before you can react, the big man slits the poor woman's throat
translate: 你还没来得及反应，那个大汉就割开了可怜女人的喉咙

original: Blood gushes forth as she stumbles towards you with utter panic in her eyes!
translate: 她跌跌撞撞地朝你走来，眼中满是极度的恐慌，鲜血喷涌而出！

original: Driina lunges towards her and frantically begins the hopeless task of stopping the bleeding
translate: 德莉娜冲向她，疯狂地开始进行那徒劳的止血工作

original: In the ensuing chaos, half of the wicked pack falls upon you from behind as the leader and a handful of his lackeys slip away with the surviving hostages
translate: 在随之而来的混乱中，一半的恶徒从背后向你扑来，而首领和他手下的几个喽啰则带着幸存的人质溜走了

original: As you approach the city-square, panicked cries of fear, pain and despair echo across the plaza
translate: 当你接近城市广场时，恐惧、痛苦和绝望的惊慌哭喊声在广场上回荡

original: You move closer and spy a large group of reavers rounding up and binding villagers
translate: 你走近些，发现一大群劫掠者正在围捕并捆绑村民

original: The poor souls are bloodied and abused and the reavers tie them in ranks as though they intend to march them away
translate: 这些可怜人满身是血，饱受凌虐，劫掠者将他们成排捆绑，仿佛打算把他们押走

original: Call to the reavers
translate: 向劫掠者喊话

original: The brute stares at you for a moment, then smiles
translate: 那个粗人盯着你看了一会儿，然后笑了

original: He stabs his dagger into the woman’s thigh and she screams in shock and pain
translate: 他将匕首刺入那女人的大腿，她因震惊和剧痛而尖叫起来

original: Blood sprays uncontrollably from the wound as he pushes her roughly towards you
translate: 他粗暴地将她推向了你，鲜血从伤口不受控制地喷溅而出

original: She stumbles into your arms, her face a mask of pleading and terror
translate: 她跌入你的怀中，脸上写满了恳求和恐惧

original: The wound is deep but she may yet be saved
translate: 伤口很深，但她或许还有救

original: Attempt to bind her wounds!
translate: 尝试为她包扎创伤！

original: You cannot threaten me
translate: 你威胁不了我

original: All that can change now is just how many vessels Father will offer up to Her by the day's end
translate: 现在唯一能改变的，只是【父亲】在今天结束之前会向祂献上多少容器

original: Can't you see?
translate: 你难道不明白吗？

original: This is your chance to be part of something so much bigger than yourself!
translate: 这是你参与一项远比自己更伟大的事业的机会！

original: Fine - take them!
translate: 好吧——带走他们！

original: Take the rest but leave the auburn woman
translate: 带走其他人，但留下那个赤褐色头发的女人

original: You're all insane!
translate: 你们全都疯了！

original: The wound is too deep and the bleeding too severe
translate: 伤口太深，失血太严重了

original: The woman bleeds out in your arms
translate: 那女人在你怀中失血而死

original: As you look around the pack of reavers have fled with their hostages and the plaza now lies empty
translate: 当你环顾四周时，那群劫掠者已带着人质逃走，广场现在空无一人

original: Driina holds the dead woman's hand as she recites a prayer under her breath
translate: 德莉娜握着死去女人的手，低声念诵着祷文

original: The wound has cut one of the large blood vessels in her thigh and the situation is dire
translate: 伤口切断了她大腿中的一条大血管，情况万分危急

original: Acting quickly, you loosen your belt and wrap it around her leg
translate: 你迅速行动，解开腰带，缠在她腿上

original: Using a stick you craft a tourniquet and manage to apply enough pressure to halt the bleeding
translate: 你用一根棍子做了个止血带，并设法施加了足够的压力止住了流血

original: The woman’s life has been saved
translate: 这女人的命保住了

original: You sit with the woman and catch your breath
translate: 你坐在那女人身边，喘了口气

original: Out of the fog, coming from the Fisherman’s Gate, a thin wretch of a man limps into view
translate: 从渔夫大门方向的雾气中，一个瘦弱不堪的男人一瘸一拐地出现在视野里

original: Natia!!
translate: 娜蒂亚！！

original: By the Golden Dead: you saved her!
translate: 以黄金先祖之名：你救了她！

original: Philip rushes to her side with tears streaming down his face
translate: 菲利普泪流满面地冲到她身边

original: No doubt, the poor man followed you into the city to look for his wife
translate: 毫无疑问，这个可怜的男人是跟着你进城来找他妻子的

original: She needs a safe place to rest!
translate: 她需要一个安全的地方休息！

original: Our old home is nearby
translate: 我们的老家就在附近

original: It will have to do!
translate: 只能将就一下了！

original: Philip picks up his wife and leads you a short way through the mist to a meager home
translate: 菲利普抱起他的妻子，领着你穿过雾气走了一小段路，来到一处简陋的家

original: As you follow Driina places a hand on your shoulder and offers a soft smile
translate: 当你跟随时，德莉娜将一只手放在你肩上，露出了温柔的微笑

original: A small reprieve amongst all this suffering, no?
translate: 在这无尽的苦难中稍得喘息，不是吗？

original: One of the struggling captives manages to break free
translate: 一名挣扎的俘虏设法挣脱了束缚

original: She is swiftly caught and her throat slit for the trouble
translate: 她很快就被抓住，并因此被割开了喉咙

original: The other captives cry out in terror
translate: 其他俘虏惊恐地大叫起来

original: Laughing, the reavers pull the rest to their feet and make for the opposite side of the square, towards the keep that looms over Horryn
translate: 劫掠者们大笑着，把其余的人拉起来，朝广场的另一边走去，走向那座俯瞰着霍林的城堡

original: We must act now, or all will be lost!
translate: 我们必须立刻行动，否则一切都将无法挽回！

original: Driina hisses
translate: 德莉娜嘶声说道

original: Stay hidden
translate: 保持隐蔽

original: As the cries of the captives echo across the empty square, you tread cautiously back the way you came
translate: 当俘虏们的哭喊声在空旷的广场上回荡时，你小心翼翼地沿着来时的路往回走

original: A whistle cuts painfully through the eerie silence
translate: 一声口哨刺痛了这诡异的寂静

original: You whirl around to see another group of six reavers file into the street behind you, cutting off your retreat
translate: 你猛然转身，看到另一队六名劫掠者鱼贯涌入你身后的街道，切断了你的退路

original: Elated laughter spills from the first group, as they turn back to exult in their freshly caught quarry
translate: 兴高采烈的笑声从第一群人那里传来，他们转过身来，为刚抓到的猎物而欢欣鼓舞

original: As the cries of the captives being dragged away echo in the empty square, Driina looks you straight in the eyes, measuring your resolve
translate: 当被拖走的俘虏们的哭喊声在空旷的广场上回荡时，德莉娜直视着你的眼睛，掂量着你的决心

original: Before you can muster a response, she steps from your hiding place
translate: 你还没来得及做出回应，她就从你们的藏身处走了出去

original: Her voice booms across the square
translate: 她的声音响彻广场

original: By the Golden Dead - stand and answer for your crimes!
translate: 以黄金先祖之名——站出来为你们的罪行负责！

original: The man's voice rises, speaking as much to the other reavers as to you
translate: 那人的声音提高，既是对你说，也是对其他劫掠者说

original: We stand at the dawn of a new age - of old masters, reclaiming their rightful thrones!
translate: 我们正站在一个新时代的黎明——古老的主人们，正在夺回他们应得的王座！

original: And you will all play your part in ushering it in
translate: 而你们所有人都将在引领这个时代到来的过程中扮演自己的角色

original: The hooded man smiles cruelly at Driina
translate: 那个戴兜帽的男人对德莉娜露出了残忍的微笑

original: The reavers close in around you
translate: 劫掠者们向你围拢过来

original: This ends now!
translate: 现在就做个了断！

original: What now?
translate: 现在怎么办？

original: Steady on
translate: 稳住

original: Roland whispers as he grabs your wrist, pulling you back into the shadows
translate: 罗兰抓住你的手腕，将你拉回阴影中，低声说道

original: There's plenty more of them than us - attacking head on is a poor bet even for me
translate: 他们人数比我们多得多——即使对我来说，正面攻击也是个糟糕的选择

original: Wait till they move and we'll take their rear
translate: 等他们行动，我们就抄他们的后路

original: Might even the odds before they know what's hit 'em
translate: 或许能在他们反应过来之前扳回劣势

original: We'll wait!
translate: 我们等！

original: We attack now!
translate: 我们现在就攻击！

original: Not in a rush to die anymore Roland?
translate: 不再急着去送死了吗，罗兰？

original: Roland scowls
translate: 罗兰皱起了眉头

original: I may be shitty company, but that doesn't mean I'm happy to let my comrades throw their lives away on a whim
translate: 我也许是个糟糕的同伴，但这不意味着我愿意看着我的战友们凭一时冲动就白白送命

original: The man points his blade at you
translate: 那人用刀剑指向你

original: We will meet again soon!
translate: 我们很快就会再见的！

original: He whistles loudly and the pack sets off at a run, driving the hostages before themselves like pigs to the slaughter
translate: 他大声吹响口哨，那群人便跑了起来，像赶着待宰的猪一样驱赶着面前的人质

original: Roland puts a heavy hand on your shoulder
translate: 罗兰将一只沉重的手搭在你肩上

original: If we had fought them it would have been the end of the hostages
translate: 如果我们当时和他们打起来，那些人质就完了

original: Now, at least, we may yet have a chance to rescue them
translate: 现在，至少，我们或许还有机会救出他们

original: Behind you Driina sinks to her knees and sobs from rage and helplessness
translate: 在你身后，德莉娜跪倒在地，因愤怒和无助而啜泣

original: You tell yourself that combat would certainly have resulted in the death of the hostages
translate: 你告诉自己，战斗肯定会导致人质死亡

original: At least now you may yet find a second chance to rescue them
translate: 至少现在，你或许还能找到第二次机会去救他们

original: A hulk of a man steps to the fore, dressed only in ragged trousers and a half hood
translate: 一个身材魁梧的男人走上前来，只穿着破烂的裤子和一件半截兜帽

original: His swollen barrel chest is covered in sailor tattoos
translate: 他肿胀的桶状胸膛上布满了水手纹身

original: He hefts a rusty serrated dagger, and drags a terrified woman behind him by her auburn hair
translate: 他掂着一把生锈的锯齿匕首，抓着一个惊恐女人的赤褐色头发，将她拖在身后

original: He smiles serenely as he approaches, revealing a few remaining, yellow teeth
translate: 他走近时安详地微笑着，露出几颗残留的黄牙

original: You have no idea how glad I am to see you here!
translate: 你不知道我在这里见到你有多高兴！

original: There is no scorn or malice in his voice
translate: 他的声音里没有轻蔑或恶意

original: Only genuine joy
translate: 只有纯粹的喜悦

original: You're truly blessed to be a part of this
translate: 能参与其中，你真是有福

original: He slowly, almost tenderly places the knife against the womans throat as he speaks
translate: 他一边说着，一边缓慢地，几乎是温柔地，将刀抵在女人的喉咙上

original: Are you the one they call 'Father'?
translate: 你就是他们称为“【父亲】”的人吗？

original: A part of what?
translate: 参与什么？

original: The man's breathing deepens in perverse delight as he pulls his hostage's head back by her long auburn hair
translate: 那人抓住人质长长的赤褐色头发，将她的头向后扯去，呼吸因反常的愉悦而变得粗重

original: We bring these children to Father’s flock
translate: 我们把这些孩子带到【父亲】的羊群中

original: You are free to roam and frolic with my brothers and sisters
translate: 你可以自由地与我的兄弟姐妹们一起漫步嬉戏

original: I’m sure Oleg or Kala will welcome you with open arms!
translate: 我相信奥列格或卡菈会张开双臂欢迎你！

original: Let the villagers go!
translate: 放了那些村民！

original: Not a chance!
translate: 休想！

original: #HorrynAmbush
translate: #霍林伏击

original: As you approach the city-square, panicked cries of fear, pain and dispair echo across the plaza
translate: 当你接近城市广场时，恐惧、痛苦和绝望的惊慌哭喊声在广场上回荡

original: Acting quickly you quickly loosen your belt and wrap it around her leg
translate: 你迅速行动，解开腰带，缠在她腿上

original: Out of the fog, coming fromthe Fisherman’s Gate, a thin wretch of a man limps into view
translate: 从渔夫大门方向的雾气中，一个瘦弱不堪的男人一瘸一拐地出现在视野里

original: He hefts a rusty cleaver, and drags a terrified woman behind him by her auburn hair
translate: 他掂着一把生锈的剁肉刀，抓着一个惊恐女人的赤褐色头发，将她拖在身后

original: A small reprieve amongst all this suffering, no
translate: 在这无尽的苦难中稍得喘息，不是吗，

original: Good bye!
translate: 再见！

original: You meet someone for the first time
translate: 你第一次见到某人

original: More intro exposition
translate: 更多介绍性说明

original: You have formed a first impression and are ready to act
translate: 你已经形成了第一印象，准备行动

original: So, what will it be?
translate: “那么，你想要什么？”

original: Show me your wares
translate: 让我看看你的货物

original: I have only the finest wares!
translate: 我只有最好的货物！

original: #HorrynCastlePrisoners
translate: 霍林城堡囚犯

original: A hush falls over the crowd
translate: 人群陷入一片寂静

original: I know her
translate: 我认识她

original: says the woman
translate: 那女人说

original: They took her in the last group
translate: 他们在最后一批带走了她

original: She’s with ‘Father’ now
translate: 她现在和“【父亲】”在一起

original: I need to go but let me try picking these locks first
translate: 我得走了，但让我先试试撬这些锁

original: Now!
translate: 快！

original: Moans and soft sobs mix with the stench of unwashed bodies and rotting corpses
translate: 呻吟和轻声啜泣与未清洗身体和腐烂尸体的恶臭混杂在一起

original: Packed densely in the castle's cells stand rows and rows of men and women
translate: 城堡牢房里密密麻麻地站着一排排男男女女

original: No doubt those who were taken alive when Horryn fell
translate: 毫无疑问，这些是霍林陷落时被活捉的人

original: At first they recoil in terror at the sight of you
translate: 起初，他们一看到你就吓得退缩

original: Then, as they realize you’re not their cruel captors, madness overcomes them as they grasp desperately at you through the bars
translate: 然后，当他们意识到你不是残忍的抓捕者时，疯狂攫住了他们，他们隔着栅栏拼命地抓住你

original: Water!
translate: 水！

original: comes the cry from parched throats
translate: 干渴的喉咙里发出呼喊

original: Calm yourselves!
translate: 冷静！

original: I'll try to help as best I can!
translate: 我会尽力帮忙！

original: You find a bucket of water and a ladle and quickly distribute water as best you can to the desperate prisoners
translate: 你找到一桶水和一把长柄勺，尽快给绝望的囚犯们分水

original: A haggard woman who looks like she’s aged a decade in the last days grabs your hand and kisses it
translate: 一个憔悴的女人，看起来在过去几天里老了十岁，抓住你的手亲吻

original: The Golden Dead has sent you!
translate: 黄金先祖派你来了！

original: We’ll be free soon - I can feel it in my bones!
translate: 我们很快就能自由了——我能感觉到！

original: What's happening here?
translate: 这里发生了什么？

original: We were dragged from our homes!
translate: 我们被从家里拖了出来！

original: When the Reavers went mad, they went from house to house
translate: 劫掠者发疯时，他们挨家挨户地搜查

original: Killing some and taking others
translate: 杀掉一些人，带走另一些人

original: It was like they knew exactly who to take and who to kill
translate: 就好像他们确切知道该带走谁、该杀掉谁

original: It was insanity
translate: 那简直是疯狂

original: Pure insanity!
translate: 纯粹的疯狂！

original: I’ll never forget the screams and cries
translate: 我永远不会忘记那些尖叫和哭喊

original: Her hand begins to tremble
translate: 她的手开始颤抖

original: Another woman places her arms around her in a comforting gesture and continues
translate: 另一个女人用双臂搂住她，做出安慰的姿态，继续说道

original: They’ve been keeping us here for days with no food and little water
translate: 他们把我们关在这里好几天了，没有食物，只有很少的水

original: But in the last hours they’ve been coming and taking groups of three or four
translate: 但在过去几个小时里，他们不断来带走三四人一组的人

original: Up to see ‘Father’
translate: 上去见“【父亲】”

original: Those who go… don’t come back
translate: 那些去的人……再也没有回来

original: I'm looking for someone
translate: 我在找一个人

original: A woman named Embla
translate: 一个叫恩布拉的女人

original: To the dismay of the desperate prisoners you fail to pick the massive locks
translate: 令绝望的囚犯们沮丧的是，你没能撬开巨大的锁

original: These people must be left to their own devices for now
translate: 这些人现在只能靠自己了

original: Perhaps another way of freeing them can be found ahead?
translate: 也许前面能找到另一种解救他们的方法？

original: With great difficulty, you manage to pick the massive locks
translate: 费了很大劲，你终于撬开了巨大的锁

original: Slowly the exhausted prisoners exit their cells and make their way towards the secret exit
translate: 疲惫的囚犯们慢慢走出牢房，朝秘密出口走去

original: Whatever comes next, you have at least done some good
translate: 无论接下来发生什么，你至少做了一些好事

original: #HorrynCastleQuartermaster
translate: #霍林城堡军需官

original: An aging guard is muttering annoyed to himself as he compares the stocks of the armory with the content of a list
translate: 一位年迈的守卫一边对照清单清点军械库的库存，一边恼火地自言自语。

original: As you enter the armory he’s quite unable to hide his annoyance
translate: 你走进军械库时，他完全无法掩饰自己的恼怒。

original: Yes, yes!
The saviors of Horryn are to be given all possible aid - I know!
translate: 霍林的救星们理应得到一切可能的援助——我知道！

original: Is there a problem here?
translate: 这里有什么问题吗？

original: Not for you
translate: 对你来说没有。

original: I’m the one left sorting out this mess of a supply situation
translate: 是我被留下来收拾这个烂摊子的补给状况。

original: I’ve been ordered to assist you as best I can
translate: 我奉命尽力协助你。

original: Here’s the best I can
translate: 这就是我能做到的最好了。

original: There should be some gear laying around that I haven’t gotten around to inventorying yet
translate: 这里应该有些我还没来得及清点的装备散落着。

original: Take it and use it as you please
translate: 拿去吧，随你怎么用。

original: Secondly, I am to sell you supplies at a ’favorable’ rate
translate: “其次，我得按‘优惠’价格卖给你补给。”

original: The quartermaster shudders at the very thought
translate: 军需官光是想到这个就不寒而栗。

original: Let's see what you have then!
translate: 那让我看看你有什么！

original: You need something?
translate: 你需要什么吗？

original: #HorrynCastleRetaken
translate: #霍林城堡收复

original: Markus smiles at you with an optimism that is utterly malplaced given the gravity of the situation
translate: 马库斯对你露出乐观的微笑，但在如此严峻的形势下，这种乐观完全不合时宜

original: Then it is decided!
translate: 那就这么定了！

original: Aid is not long for the people of Horryn!
translate: 霍林的人民很快就能得到援助！

original: Before you go, be sure to visit the armory in the western part of the keep
translate: “在你离开之前，一定要去城堡西侧的军械库看看。”

original: If there is any material aid we can offer, you shall have it!
translate: “如果我们能提供任何物资援助，你尽管拿去！”

original: May the Golden Dead keep their hand over you!
translate: 愿黄金先祖保佑你！

original: Iago bow deeply
translate: 伊阿戈深深鞠躬

original: M’lady
translate: 小姐

original: I, Iago zha Droma, shall answer your call for aid!
translate: “我，伊阿戈·扎·德罗马，将响应你的求援！”

original: You could never ask for a better ship and crew to carry us all to our dooms than my ‘Weathermaiden’
translate: 你再也找不到比我的‘天候少女号’更好的船和船员，来载着我们所有人奔赴末日了

original: If indeed this is to be, there is much work to be done
translate: “如果真要如此，那还有很多工作要做。”

original: If you will allow it, I shall return to my crew and begin preparations
translate: “如果你允许，我将回到我的船员那里开始准备。”

original: And where was that again?
translate: 再说一遍，在哪里？

original: My crew is currently lying in hiding in a large cave north-west of here while the ‘Maiden’ undergoes repairs
translate: 我的船员目前正躲藏在西北边的一个大洞穴里，而‘天候少女号’正在维修

original: In case you’ve not already been there, I shall note down the position in your journal
translate: “如果你还没去过那里，我会把位置记在你的日志里。”

original: Join us there when you are ready to set sail
translate: 等你准备好启航时，就来那里与我们会合

original: Iago shakes you hand, nods to Embla and makes haste to rejoin his ship and crew
translate: 伊阿戈握了握你的手，向恩布拉点点头，然后匆忙赶回他的船和船员那里

original: We'll meet again soon!
translate: 我们很快就会再见！

original: Your head reels and your body aches
translate: 你头晕目眩，浑身酸痛

original: For the first time in a long while you allow yourself to acknowledge how truly exhausted you are
translate: 长久以来，你第一次允许自己承认，你真的是筋疲力尽了

original: Nonetheless, a cloud appears to have lifted ever so slightly with the death of the fell creature
translate: 尽管如此，随着那邪恶生物的死亡，笼罩的阴云似乎稍稍散去了一些

original: It is as if the feeling of wrongness that pervades the island is diminished - though certainly not gone
translate: 仿佛弥漫全岛的那种不对劲的感觉减弱了——尽管肯定没有消失

original: Painfully you get to your feet
translate: 你痛苦地站起身来

original: There, in front of you lies the scion you were sent to find
translate: 就在你面前，躺着那个你奉命来寻找的后裔

original: Embla of House Berryn
translate: 贝林家族的恩布拉

original: Go to her
translate: 去她身边

original: Markus stammers as he searches for words
translate: 马库斯结结巴巴地寻找着言辞

original: He gets up, calls for one of the guards, then changes his mind, turns around sharply and produces a piece of paper and a quill but ultimately fails to think of anything useful to do with it
translate: 他站起身，叫来一名守卫，然后又改变主意，猛地转过身，拿出一张纸和一支羽毛笔，但最终想不出拿它们做什么有用的事

original: Ultimately he turns back to you and Emlba with a mask of utter dejection on his face
translate: 最终，他转向你和恩布拉，脸上满是沮丧

original: Gradla
translate: 格拉德拉

original: Embla looks at the corpse of the Father for a moment then back at Markus
translate: 恩布拉看了【父亲】的尸体片刻，然后转向马库斯

original: Though there is much I do not know yet, I will say this much
translate: “虽然我还有很多不知道的事，但我要说这么多。”

original: Chaos engulfs the Outer Isles and the force that drives it is rising
translate: 混乱吞噬了外岛群，而驱动它的力量正在崛起

original: For whatever reason, Gradla lies at the center of this conjunction
translate: “无论出于什么原因，格拉德拉都处于这场灾变的中心。”

original: The Empire will not come for us and, though we cannot escape the outer isles, I believe a fast ship and a skilled captain could make it to the shores of Gradla
translate: “帝国不会来救我们，而且，虽然我们无法逃离外岛群，但我相信一艘快船和一位熟练的船长能够抵达格拉德拉的海岸。”

original: If we can force a landing, we may have a chance at stopping the conjuncture before the Outer Isles are lost forever
translate: “如果我们能强行登陆，或许有机会在外岛群永远沦陷之前阻止这场灾变。”

original: Rescue the lost souls of Horryn and at the same time deal with this ‘conjuncture’!
translate: 拯救霍林迷失的灵魂，同时应对这场‘灾变’！

original: Embla says nothing
translate: 恩布拉一言不发

original: But if no help is coming from the mainland, we have no one to turn to but you {PLAYER}
translate: “但如果大陆没有援助到来，我们能求助的就只有你了，{PLAYER}。”

original: Truly, we cannot ask this of you!
translate: “真的，我们不能要求你这么做！”

original: I have neither men nor much equipment to offer!
translate: 我既没有人手，也没有多少装备可以提供！

original: There is no doubt you speak the truth Embla
translate: 毫无疑问，你说的是实话，恩布拉

original: I came here to bring you back to the mainland Embla - nothing more
translate: 我来这里是为了带你回大陆，恩布拉——仅此而已

original: You're insane
translate: 你疯了

original: Embla sits up slowly
translate: 恩布拉慢慢坐起身

original: She’s pale and sick-looking
translate: 她脸色苍白，一副病容

original: The raw expenditure of Reticular energy took its toll on her
translate: 网状能量的剧烈消耗让她付出了代价

original: I knew it was going to be you
translate: 我就知道会是你

original: It’s always you
translate: 总是你

original: And I’m glad every time
translate: 而且每次我都很高兴

original: What do you mean 'every time'?
translate: “每次”是什么意思？

original: We’ve been here before a thousand times and we’ll be here again and again until the universe itself ends
translate: 我们之前已经来过这里上千次了，而且还会一次又一次地来，直到宇宙本身终结

original: Slowly and unsteadily, Embla gets to her feet
translate: 恩布拉缓慢而不稳地站起身来

original: For the first time she looks you in the eyes
translate: 她第一次直视你的眼睛

original: A tired smile comes across her face
translate: 她脸上露出疲惫的微笑

original: {PLAYER}, it really is good to see you
translate: “{PLAYER}，见到你真好。”

original: Your father dispatched me
translate: 你的父亲派我来的

original: You are here because you have to be
translate: 你在这里是因为你必须在这里

original: As am I
translate: 我也是

original: We always have and we always will
translate: 我们一直如此，也将永远如此

original: Here, on the ship… under the Priory
translate: “在这里，在船上……在修院之下。”

original: She looks at you intently
translate: 她专注地看着你

original: Almost pleadingly, as if willing you to recall a memory so old it all but faded
translate: 几乎是恳求地，仿佛希望你回忆起一段古老得几乎褪色的记忆

original: I don't understand?
translate: 我不明白？

original: Suddenly a look of confusion falls over her face
translate: 突然，她脸上浮现出困惑的神情

original: I’m sorry
translate: 对不起

original: I… forgot where we were
translate: 我……忘了我们在哪里

original: When we were
translate: 我们何时

original: {PLAYER}, there is something so wrong here
translate: “{PLAYER}，这里有些非常不对劲的地方。”

original: And much worse than you realize
translate: 而且比你意识到的要糟糕得多

original: That thing, the ‘Father’!
translate: “那个东西，‘【父亲】’！”

original: The people and animals changing!
translate: 人和动物都在变化！

original: Even… even time is wrong
translate: 甚至……甚至时间都不对劲

original: I don’t fully understand it but something is causing it
translate: 我不完全明白，但有什么东西在引发这一切

original: Drawing it here
translate: 把它引到这里

original: Drawing… us here
translate: 把我们……引到这里

original: This isn't making sense
translate: 这说不通

original: Embla draws a deep breath and closes her eyes
translate: 恩布拉深吸一口气，闭上了眼睛

original: For a moment she is quiet
translate: 她安静了片刻

original: Forgive me - I know
translate: 原谅我——我知道

original: I’m only beginning to understand it myself
translate: 我自己也才刚刚开始理解

original: For now, I’ll tell you what you
translate: “现在，我会告诉你你……”

original: Suddenly the heavy tramp of armored feet echo throughout the keep as the beleaguered remnants of the Horryn city guard make their way to the main hall
translate: 突然，沉重的盔甲脚步声在城堡中回荡，霍林城市守卫的残部正走向主厅

original: Ineptly brandishing a sword, Markus is bringing up the rear
translate: 马库斯笨拙地挥舞着一把剑，走在队伍最后

original: The former chamberlain and now de-facto leader of Horryn looks even more thin and drawn then when you first met him but nonetheless, there is a small glimpse of triumph in his eye
translate: 这位前任总管、如今霍林的实际领袖，看起来比你第一次见到他时更加消瘦憔悴，但尽管如此，他眼中仍闪过一丝胜利的光芒

original: Markus!
translate: 马库斯！

original: You’ve done it!
translate: 你做到了！

original: We’ve
translate: 我们……

original: He’s cut short as his gaze falls upon the grotesque corpse of the ‘Father’
translate: 他的目光落在‘【父亲】’那怪异的尸体上，话说到一半就停住了

original: By Gallian the Great, protect us all!
translate: “以伟大的伽里安之名，保佑我们所有人！”

original: How can such things exist?
translate: 这种东西怎么可能存在？

original: Where did it
translate: 它从哪里……

original: He tires, and fails to fight back the nausea
translate: 他感到疲惫，没能忍住恶心

original: While Markus retches in disgust, Embla meets your eyes
translate: 当马库斯厌恶地干呕时，恩布拉与你目光相遇

original: It is clear that she has much to say but now is not the time or place
translate: 很明显，她有很多话要说，但现在不是时候，也不是地方

original: Wordlessly you agree that both questions and answers will have to wait for now
translate: 你无言地同意，问题和答案都只能暂时等待

original: Markus, are you okay?
translate: “马库斯，你还好吗？”

original: Markus slumps heavily down in a chair as he catches his breath
translate: 马库斯重重地瘫倒在椅子上，喘着气

original: He tries hard to avoid looking at the corpse sprawled on the floor
translate: 他竭力避免去看地上那具摊开的尸体

original: Once more we owe our fortunes to you, {PLAYER}
translate: “我们又一次欠你人情了，{PLAYER}。”

original: Sadly, the situation is dire
translate: “可悲的是，局势非常严峻。”

original: So many were taken by the Reavers and there are hardly any left!
translate: 那么多人被劫掠者抓走，几乎没剩下什么人了！

original: We found but a few dozen survivors in the dungeons where there should be hundreds!
translate: 我们在地牢里只找到了几十个幸存者，而那里本该有数百人！

original: Where have they all gone?
translate: 他们都去哪儿了？

original: Embla answers
translate: 恩布拉回答

original: I’m afraid I have the answer to that
translate: 恐怕我知道答案

original: There was a method to the Reaver’s madness
translate: 劫掠者的疯狂是有章法的

original: Those they took were taken for a reason
translate: 他们抓走那些人是有原因的

original: The ones Father approved were gathered together and placed on ships
translate: 那些被【父亲】认可的人被集中起来，送上了船

original: Markus’ face goes white
translate: 马库斯的脸变得煞白

original: Wh… why?
translate: 为……为什么？

original: For what possible purpose?
translate: 到底是为了什么目的？

original: I can’t tell you for what purpose but I think I know where they went at least
translate: 我不能告诉你是什么目的，但我想我至少知道他们去了哪里

original: North to the island of Gradla
translate: 向北，去了格拉德拉岛

original: No doubt there is much more to Embla’s story than she’s willing to share with Markus
translate: 毫无疑问，恩布拉的故事远不止她愿意告诉马库斯的这些

original: Markus thinks for a moment
translate: 马库斯思索了片刻

original: There are rumors that there are smugglers held up in the sea-caves on the north-western coast
translate: 有传言说，西北海岸的海蚀洞窟里藏着一伙走私者

original: As much as I detest smugglers it can’t be denied that they are some of the finest sailors to grace these oceans
translate: 尽管我非常厌恶走私者，但不可否认，他们是这片海洋上最出色的水手

original: I would begin my search there!
translate: 我会从那里开始搜寻！

original: Look around!
translate: 看看周围！

original: Even if I agreed to follow you, there is no way to get to the mainland
translate: “即使我同意跟随你，也没有办法回到大陆。”

original: We wouldn’t even make it out of the Outer Isles before the horrors of the deep would drag us down
translate: 我们甚至还没离开外岛群，就会被深渊的恐怖拖入海底

original: If there is a way back home, it goes through Gradla
translate: “如果有回家的路，那一定经过格拉德拉。”

original: Then our path leads to Gradla
translate: 那么我们的道路通向格拉德拉

original: Embla looks deeply into your eyes
translate: 恩布拉深深地凝视着你的眼睛

original: I have never in my life been more lucid {PLAYER}
translate: 我这辈子从未如此清醒过，{PLAYER}

original: There are events set in motion that you have not even begun to fathom
translate: 有些事件已经启动，你甚至还没开始理解

original: The depth of her conviction shakes you
translate: 她信念的深度震撼了你

original: I was paid to do a simple job!
translate: 我只是受雇来做一份简单的工作！

original: Not some suicide mission!
translate: 不是什么自杀式任务！

original: I believe you
translate: 我相信你

original: To Gradla it is
translate: 那就去格拉德拉

original: Embla smiles warmly
translate: 恩布拉温暖地笑了

original: Then it is settled
translate: 那就这么定了

original: We make for Gradla and whatever fate awaits us there
translate: 我们前往格拉德拉，无论那里等待着我们的是什么命运

original: As for a ship and captain, the vessels here in Horryn are ruined and surely there is not a captain alive that will brave the seas at this time?
translate: “至于船和船长，霍林这里的船只都毁了，而且肯定没有活着的船长敢在这个时候出海吧？”

original: Iago?
translate: 伊阿戈？

original: Hmm, I may have an idea
translate: “嗯，我可能有个主意。”

original: Refer to the smugglers hiding in the sea-cave to the north-west
translate: 指的是藏在西北边海蚀洞窟里的走私者

original: Markus?
translate: 马库斯？

original: Any suggestions?
translate: 有什么建议吗？

original: You explain how you found the crew of the Weathermaiden hiding in a sea-cave to the north-west of town as Markus listens intently
translate: 你解释了你如何发现天候少女号的船员藏在镇子西北边的海蚀洞窟里，马库斯专注地听着

original: I would indeed begin my search there!
translate: 我确实会从那里开始搜寻！

original: Then that is what I will do!
translate: 那我就这么做！

original: #HorrynCastleSpotted
translate: #发现霍林城堡

original: The man laughs maniacally
translate: 男人疯狂地大笑。

original: We’ll stand here again and again and again and you’ll take my hand soon enough!
translate: 我们会一次又一次地站在这里，你很快就会握住我的手！

original: You always do
translate: 你总是这样。

original: Prisoners?
translate: 囚犯？

original: the man asks slowly as if he doesn’t understand the question
translate: 男人慢慢地问道，仿佛不明白这个问题。

original: Then a broad smile spreads across his face
translate: 然后他脸上绽开灿烂的笑容。

original: Oh, they’re not prisoners
translate: “哦，他们不是囚犯。”

original: They are acolytes
translate: 他们是侍僧。

original: Chosen ones
translate: 被选中的人。

original: Father will weigh them and the ones he finds worthy… they go on the ships
translate: 【父亲】会衡量他们，那些他认为值得的人……他们会登上船。

original: Such wonders they will see
translate: 他们将看到如此奇观。

original: The man’s tone is dream-like
translate: 男人的语气如梦似幻。

original: Die scum!
translate: 去死吧，人渣！

original: Take me to him
translate: 带我去见他。

original: The small band of Reavers stand swaying in the halflight of the dimly lit room
translate: 一小群劫掠者站在昏暗房间的半明半暗中摇晃着。

original: They look pale and drawn and their eyes distant
translate: 他们脸色苍白、憔悴，眼神遥远。

original: It strikes you that, in their fervor, they have likely neither eaten or slept in the last days of chaos
translate: “你突然意识到，在他们的狂热中，在混乱的最后日子里，他们很可能既没吃也没睡。”

original: These men are being driven beyond their limit
translate: 这些人被驱使到了极限。

original: By what, you don’t dare speculate
translate: “被什么驱使，你不敢猜测。”

original: One of them blinks a few times as he notices you, and an oddly beatific smile falls over his face as their lethargy is replaced by the prowling aspect of some predator
translate: “其中一人注意到你时眨了几下眼睛，一种奇异的幸福微笑浮现在他脸上，他们的倦怠被某种捕食者的潜行姿态所取代。”

original: You immediately recognize the man as the leader of the first Reaver band you came across when you entered Horryn
translate: 你立刻认出这个男人是你进入霍林时遇到的第一支劫掠者队伍的首领。

original: You came
translate: 你来了。

original: His voice is hoarse and dry and there is a genuine note of gratitude in it
translate: 他的声音嘶哑而干涩，其中带着真诚的感激。

original: He’s waiting, you know
translate: “他在等，你知道的。”

original: It’s your turn now to go to Father
translate: 现在轮到你去见【父亲】了。

original: Let me take you
translate: 让我带你去。

original: He offers you a shaking hand
translate: 他向你伸出一只颤抖的手。

original: Take me to Father
translate: 带我去见【父亲】。

original: What are you doing to the prisoners?
translate: 你对囚犯们做了什么？

original: I'm here to put you down!
translate: 我是来干掉你的！

original: The band flocks around you and swiftly leads you through the ravaged halls of the keep
translate: 这群人聚集在你周围，迅速带你穿过城堡被蹂躏的大厅。

original: Cries of terror echo faintly ahead and though you are no doubt being driven towards their source, you cannot help but feel… a calling
translate: “前方隐约传来恐怖的哭喊声，尽管你无疑正被带向它们的源头，你却不禁感到……一种召唤。”

original: You must go this way
translate: 你必须走这边。

original: You always have and you will do so a thousand times again
translate: 你一直如此，而且还会再这样做一千次。

original: You arrive at your destination
translate: 你到达了目的地。

original: The keep’s great hall
translate: 城堡的大厅。

original: Robed figures line the walls, bathed in the lambent light of foul sorcery
translate: “穿着长袍的身影排列在墙边，沐浴在邪恶巫术的柔和光芒中。”

original: Go
translate: 去吧。

original: someone whispers
translate: 有人低语。

original: He’s ready for you
translate: 他为你准备好了。

original: #HorrynChiefsDead
translate: #霍林酋长之死

original: You stand dazed, surveying the carnage around you
translate: 你茫然地站着，环顾四周的杀戮景象

original: The three Reaver chieftains lie dead
translate: 三名劫掠者酋长倒在地上，已经死去，

original: Now the one they call Father awaits you inside the still occupied keep
translate: 现在，那个被他们称为【父亲】的人正在仍被占据的城堡里等着你，

original: The sound of footsteps interrupt your thoughts and you whirl around ready for another melee
translate: 脚步声打断了你的思绪，你猛地转身，准备迎接另一场近战，

original: To your surprise you see the surviving soldiers of the Horryn guard bolstered by armed refugees!
translate: 你惊讶地看到，霍林守卫的幸存士兵在武装难民的支援下！

original: Moving methodically from house to house, they begin the task of retaking the ravaged town
translate: 他们有条不紊地逐屋推进，开始了夺回这座被蹂躏城镇的任务

original: Cries of jubilation mix with the anguished cries of people finding the corpses of former loved ones
translate: 欢庆的呼喊与人们发现昔日亲人尸体时的痛苦哭喊交织在一起，

original: Nonetheless, it does not take long for life to creep back into the desolate streets
translate: 尽管如此，没过多久，生机便悄然回到了荒凉的街道上

original: One of the soldiers approaches you
translate: 一名士兵向你走来，

original: {PLAYER}, I bring word from the chamberlain!
translate: {PLAYER}，我带来了总管的口信！

original: He’s requested you find him at the tavern over by the temple
translate: 他请你到神殿旁边的酒馆去找他，

original: He asks you make haste
translate: 他请你尽快前往，

original: The young man offers a short bow and continues on his way
translate: 年轻人简短地鞠了一躬，然后继续赶路。

original: #HorrynClothierScene
translate: #霍林裁缝场景

original: #HorrynCryptBloom
translate: #霍林墓室绽放

original: You awaken with a start
translate: 你猛然惊醒

original: You are lying sprawled on the cold stone floor of the tomb
translate: 你正四肢摊开躺在冰冷的墓室石地板上

original: There is no telling how long you’ve been there, but the irritation in your eyes and lungs has subsided
translate: 不知道你在那里待了多久，但你眼睛和肺部的刺痛感已经消退了

original: Kat grabs your arm, wild-eyed and tears streaming
translate: 卡蒂抓住你的手臂，眼神狂乱，泪流满面

original: She tries to say something, then gives up
translate: 她想说些什么，却又放弃了

original: Get up
translate: 起身

original: Driinas face is wet from sweat as she continually and wordlessly recites some prayers
translate: 德莉娜的脸上满是汗水，她不停地默念着祈祷词

original: As you address her, she stops suddenly and fixes you with her gaze
translate: 当你向她说话时，她突然停下，凝视着你

original: This is madness given form
translate: 这是疯狂具现化的形态

original: And in this, the most sacred of places
translate: 而且是在这最神圣的地方

original: The home of the dead!
translate: 死者的家园！

original: She draws her breath and seems to compose herself
translate: 她深吸一口气，似乎让自己镇定下来

original: We must venture to stamp out this foulness
translate: 我们必须冒险去铲除这污秽之物

original: What can we do?
translate: 我们能做什么？

original: This city is built on ancient foundations
translate: 这座城市建在古老的地基之上

original: There are crypts below that are far more ancient than this
translate: 下方有比这里古老得多的墓室

original: That must be where this abomination is being spawned
translate: 那一定就是这异物滋生之处

original: Then again, this is no coincidence
translate: 不过，这绝非巧合

original: Whatever madness has befallen Idra, this is all part of that same curse
translate: 无论伊德拉遭遇了何种疯狂，这都是同一诅咒的一部分

original: And for now, there are still living that need our aid!
translate: 眼下，还有活人需要我们的援助！

original: As much as it pains me to leave this foulness alive in the crypt, we must press onwards and through to the castle
translate: 虽然让这污秽之物在墓室中存活令我痛心，但我们必须继续前进，穿过这里前往城堡

original: All I ask is this
translate: 我只要求这一点

original: Once we retake the city, we will come back here and restore the sanctity of this place!
translate: 一旦我们夺回城市，我们就会回到这里，恢复此地的神圣！

original: I'm with you Driina!
translate: 我支持你，德莉娜！

original: As you scramble to your feet, you have a chance to take in the strange growths that fill the chamber for the first time
translate: 当你挣扎着站起身时，你第一次有机会看清充斥整个房间的奇怪生长物

original: Examine the tentacles
translate: 检查触手

original: Alien, tentacle-like roots burst obscenely from the floor before branching off into a myriad of smaller partitions that seem to spread throughout the entire complex
translate: 异形、触手般的根系从地板下淫秽地爆出，然后分叉成无数更小的分支，似乎遍布整个建筑群

original: The growths seem to writhe with peristaltic motion and as you draw near, strands lift up and reach greedily towards you
translate: 这些生长物似乎在蠕动，当你靠近时，细丝抬起，贪婪地伸向你

original: You've seen this before
translate: 你以前见过这个

original: In the well near the farmhouse where you landed on Idra
translate: 在伊德拉登陆点附近农舍的水井里

original: {PLAYER}, lets be on our bloody way yeah?
translate: {PLAYER}，我们赶紧上路吧，好吗？

original: Kat spits as she backs away towards the door
translate: 卡蒂啐了一口，一边向门口退去

original: Examine the tentacles more closely
translate: 更仔细地检查触手

original: You fail to learn anything new about the strange organism
translate: 你未能了解到关于这奇怪生物的任何新信息

original: The growths seem to shudder with anticipation
translate: 这些生长物似乎在期待中颤抖

original: Perhaps you have read of this before?
translate: 也许你以前读到过这个？

original: Have you encountered this in nature somewhere?
translate: 你曾在自然界某处遇到过这个吗？

original: Driina, what is happening here?
translate: 德莉娜，这里发生了什么？

original: A fine dust whirls up as you progress through the chamber, filling your eyes and nose with a burning sensation that sends you into an uncontrollable fit of sneezing and eventually, retching
translate: 当你穿过房间时，扬起一阵细尘，让你的眼睛和鼻子充满灼烧感，使你无法控制地打喷嚏，最后干呕起来

original: The sound booms in the echoing chamber and makes your ears ring as stars flash before your eyes
translate: 声音在回荡的房间里隆隆作响，震得你耳鸣，眼前金星直冒

original: As you reel to escape the invasive spores, you end up crawling on hands and knees towards the exit
translate: 当你踉跄着躲避侵入性的孢子时，最终只能手脚并用地爬向出口

original: A mist seems to be filling the room, or is it simply your vision fading to black?
translate: 似乎有雾气弥漫房间，还是只是你的视线逐渐变黑？

original: Fight the sensation
translate: 抵抗这种感觉

original: This organism defies any known taxonomy
translate: 这种生物违背了任何已知的分类学

original: But there are books
translate: 但有书

original: Forbidden books, that speak of such things
translate: 禁书，提到过这类东西

original: Algion of Yrr wrote of how he saw vast squirming masses shift in the pale light of distant stars
translate: 伊尔的阿尔吉昂写道，他看见巨大的蠕动团块在遥远星辰的苍白光芒中移动

original: And certain, unspeakable Shaddu-Wahit texts talk of the “crawling doom” that came to Errawhan
translate: 而某些不可言说的沙杜-瓦希特文献提到了降临埃拉万的“爬行末日”

original: You shudder - it is best not to think of such things
translate: 你打了个寒颤——最好还是别想这些事

original: Strangely, through the dim veil, you see something
translate: 奇怪的是，透过昏暗的帷幕，你看到了什么

original: Basalt towers loom across a dead landscape
translate: 玄武岩塔楼在死寂的景观中隐现

original: A strange piping reverberates through all your being
translate: 一种奇怪的笛声在你全身回荡

original: As you crawl on hands and knees, you can clearly feel the cold tile floor of the crypt
translate: 当你手脚并用地爬行时，你能清晰地感觉到墓室冰冷的瓷砖地板

original: Yet you find yourself... elsewhere
translate: 然而你发现自己……在别处

original: Now a wind blows across the blasted desolation
translate: 现在一阵风吹过这片荒芜的废墟

original: Standing just ahead of you, yet impossibly far away, is a tall figure dressed in flowing tattered robes
translate: 就在你前方，却又遥不可及地站着一个高大的身影，穿着飘逸的破烂长袍

original: It raises its hand towards its face and again the strange piping sounds
translate: 它抬起手靠近面部，那奇怪的笛声再次响起

original: All is black
translate: 一片漆黑

original: You manage to cover your face with a piece of clothing and as you shield your face from the impossible vista in the mist, you struggle to gain control of your breathing
translate: 你设法用一块布遮住脸，当你遮挡雾气中那不可思议的景象时，你努力控制住呼吸

original: A howling wind mixes with the piping and for a moment you hear the fluttering of tattered robes
translate: 呼啸的风与笛声交织，一时间你听到破烂长袍的飘动声

original: Instinctively you continue covering your eyes
translate: 你本能地继续遮住眼睛

original: Then, cutting through the maddening noise you hear a voice as clear as crystals
translate: 然后，穿透那令人发狂的噪音，你听到一个如水晶般清澈的声音

original: Drinna is reciting a prayer
translate: 德莉娜正在念诵祈祷词

original: Then, as suddenly as it started, all is silent
translate: 然后，就像开始时一样突然，一切归于寂静

original: Relief floods through you as you look up and find yourself still in the darkened tomb chamber
translate: 你抬头发现自己仍在昏暗的墓室中，如释重负

original: Kat grabs your arm with wild-eyes
translate: 卡蒂眼神狂乱地抓住你的手臂

original: She looks as if she's going to say something, then gives up
translate: 她看起来好像要说什么，然后又放弃了

original: You do not know what to make of the strange organism before you
translate: 你不知道该如何理解眼前的奇怪生物

original: It most closely resembles some strange fungal growth, but even that is only in the most general of terms
translate: 它最像某种奇怪的真菌生长物，但即使这样也只是最笼统的说法

original: You have never seen anything like it before
translate: 你以前从未见过类似的东西

original: In fact, you feel certain that this “thing” is utterly alien to our world
translate: 事实上，你确信这个“东西”完全不属于我们的世界

original: From whence it came however, you can only guess
translate: 然而，它从何而来，你只能猜测

original: #HorrynCryptBloom
translate: #霍林墓室绽放

original: #HorrynCryptEmbalming
translate: #霍林地穴防腐室

original: Driina begins searching through a pile of tomes on a nearby table
translate: 德莉娜开始翻找附近桌子上的一堆典籍，

original: Her face, still ashen-grey, pales even further as her attention turns to the corpse in the center of the room
translate: 她的脸，原本就灰白如死灰，当注意力转向房间中央的尸体时，变得更加苍白了

original: Driina, what is this room?
translate: 德莉娜，这是什么房间？

original: Driina presses her palms lightly against her face before removing them in a gesture that reminds you of an unmasking
translate: 德莉娜轻轻将手掌贴在脸上，然后移开，那动作让你想起摘下面具的样子，

original: An embalming chamber
translate: 一间防腐室，

original: This is where our acolytes preserve the sacred flesh of our dead
translate: 这是我们侍僧保存死者圣洁遗体的地方，

original: Driina does not look at you as she speaks, her attention already reclaimed by one of the tomes
translate: 德莉娜说话时没有看你，她的注意力已经被其中一本典籍重新吸引

original: For those touched by the Reticulum, the veil between the living and the dead is thinner
translate: 对于那些被魔网触及的人来说，生者与死者之间的帷幕更薄

original: Though the flesh may die, an….echo persists
translate: 尽管肉身会死，但……一种回响依然存在

original: With a shake of her head, Driina slams the book shut
translate: 德莉娜摇了摇头，猛地合上了书

original: This is not the time for theology
translate: 现在不是讨论神学的时候，

original: We must press on
translate: 我们必须继续前进，

original: Stepping into this room, you are at once terrified and awestruck by the alien-ness mixed with sanctity
translate: 踏入这个房间，你立刻被一种混合着神圣的异样感所震慑，既恐惧又敬畏

original: A room not meant for common eyes where the imperial priesthood plies it's strange and sacred rituals
translate: 一个不为凡人所见的房间，帝国祭司在此进行其奇异而神圣的仪式，

original: The room before you is like none you have ever seen
translate: 你眼前的房间与你见过的任何房间都不同，

original: A creeping sensation tingles down your spine as you take in the terrifying array of ancient tomes, jars filled with strange liquids, and what appears to be a corpse wrapped in stiff, white cloth
translate: 当你看到那令人恐惧的古老典籍、装满奇怪液体的罐子，以及一具似乎裹在僵硬白布中的尸体时，一阵毛骨悚然的感觉沿着脊椎蔓延

original: #HorrynCryptEmbalming
translate: #霍林地穴防腐室

original: Driina sighs sadly
translate: 德莉娜悲伤地叹了口气，

original: Stepping into this room, you are at once terrified and awestruck by a sense of sacred otherworldliness
translate: 踏入这个房间，你立刻被一种神圣的彼岸感所震慑，既恐惧又敬畏

original: A room not meant for common eyes where the holy order of Sepulchites performs its esoteric rituals
translate: 一个不为凡人所见的房间，葬仪修会的神圣教团在此举行其秘仪，

original: As you approach the entrance to the large vault, you can’t help but notice the slightest of drafts in the otherwise stale air of the crypt
translate: 当你走近大墓室的入口时，你不由自主地注意到，在这原本沉闷的墓室空气中，有一丝极其微弱的气流

original: The secret tunnel must lie somewhere inside
translate: 秘道一定就在里面的某个地方

original: #HorrynCryptEntrance
translate: #霍里恩墓室入口

original: The corpse belongs to a young man with sunken cheeks and a shaved head
translate: 这具尸体属于一个脸颊凹陷、剃光了头的年轻男子

original: A faded tattoo on his forehead marks him as an acolyte of the temple
translate: 他额头上一个褪色的纹身表明他是神殿的侍僧

original: His face is a mask of pain, terror or, more likely, both
translate: “他的脸上凝固着痛苦、恐惧，或者更可能是两者兼有的表情”

original: As you carefully shift him, intestines spill out with a wet squelch
translate: “当你小心地挪动他时，肠子随着一声湿漉漉的噗嗤声流了出来”

original: Try to determine the cause of death
translate: 尝试判断死因

original: Driina steps away from the corpse and whispers a prayer beneath her breath
translate: 德莉娜从尸体旁退开，低声念了一句祷文

original: Her eyes are wide with fear as she takes in the mangled display before her
translate: 她惊恐地睁大眼睛，看着眼前血肉模糊的景象

original: This is not the work of Reavers…. something else is afoot
translate: 这不是劫掠者的手笔……有别的事情在酝酿

original: This man tended the sacred flesh of the dead
translate: 这个人曾照料死者的圣洁遗体

original: These tombs
translate: 这些墓穴

original: she trails off, and then, as if deciding something, gives a sharp shake of her head
translate: “她话音渐弱，然后，仿佛下定了什么决心，猛地摇了摇头”

original: Come
translate: 来吧

original: We must find the cause of this carnage
translate: 我们必须找出这场屠杀的原因

original: In the fluttering light of the tomb you can tell her face has turned ashen gray
translate: 在墓室摇曳的光线下，你能看出她的脸色变得灰白

original: Let's be on our way
translate: 我们出发吧

original: Where to now?
translate: 现在去哪儿？

original: The youth is too mangled to determine a cause of death, but it is clear from the sheer amount of blood at your feet that this was not a quick and painless end
translate: “这个年轻人被摧残得太厉害，无法判断死因，但从你脚下大量的血迹可以清楚看出，这绝非迅速而无痛苦的终结”

original: After examining the corpse, you are horrified to discover the youth’s abdomen has been torn apart by claws or…fingers?
translate: “检查完尸体后，你惊恐地发现，年轻人的腹部是被爪子……还是手指撕开的？”

original: Stranger still are the thin, purple strands festering inside of the wound
translate: “更奇怪的是，伤口里溃烂着细细的紫色丝状物”

original: As you enter the dimly lit crypt, your senses are immediately assaulted by the scent of fresh carnage
translate: “当你进入光线昏暗的墓室时，一股新鲜屠杀的气味立刻冲击着你的感官”

original: The scent is still faint enough that you are sure whatever awaits you below has not been dead for long
translate: 气味仍然很淡，足以让你确信，下面等待着你的东西死去还没多久

original: Your suspicions are soon confirmed; at the foot of the stairs ahead of you lies the mangled remains of a man in white, bloodstained robes
translate: “你的怀疑很快得到了证实；在你前方的楼梯脚下，躺着一具身穿白色血迹斑斑长袍、血肉模糊的男尸”

original: Examine the corpse
translate: 检查尸体

original: With one final glance at the corpse, you push aside your fear and delve into the blackness ahead
translate: “最后看了一眼尸体，你抛开恐惧，一头扎进前方的黑暗之中”

original: The shadowy expanse of the crypt stretches before you
translate: 墓室幽暗的广阔空间在你面前延伸

original: Whatever is happening here, you must venture deeper into the darkness if you wish to find your way into the Keep above
translate: “无论这里正在发生什么，如果你想找到通往上方要塞的路，就必须冒险深入更深的黑暗”

original: Driina peers into the darkness ahead
translate: 德莉娜凝视着前方的黑暗

original: I am unsure of the tunnel’s exact location, save that it lies somewhere in the deep crypts to the south
translate: “我不确定那条隧道的具体位置，只知道它位于南边深层墓室的某处”

original: However, given what we have discovered here, I would advise we explore this level for clues before moving on
translate: “不过，鉴于我们在这里的发现，我建议我们先探索这一层，寻找线索，然后再继续前进”

original: #HorrynCryptEntrance
translate: #霍里恩墓室入口

original: His face is a mask of pain, terror, or more likely, both
translate: “他的脸上凝固着痛苦、恐惧，或者更可能是两者兼有的表情”

original: #HorrynCryptFinal
translate: #HorrynCryptFinal

original: The Wight King emits a roaring scream as, one by one, the lids of the surrounding sarcophogi fly open
translate: 尸妖王发出震耳欲聋的尖叫，周围的石棺盖一个接一个地飞开

original: In the lingering dust, five gaunt, yellow-fanged creatures emerge from their graves
translate: 在弥漫的尘埃中，五只枯瘦、长着黄色獠牙的生物从墓穴中爬出

original: Wishing to put an end to the tomb’s horrifying curse, you give the ancient sword to the King
translate: 为了终结这座墓穴的恐怖诅咒，你将古剑交给了国王

original: He takes it from you eagerly, and then, with a final sigh that echoes eerily throughout the crypt, the ancient creature returns once more to his slumber
translate: 他急切地从你手中接过剑，然后，随着一声在墓穴中诡异回荡的最后叹息，这古老的生物再次陷入了沉睡

original: Standing atop the stone dais is the emaciated form of what appears to have once been a King
translate: 石台上站着一个形销骨立的身影，看起来曾是一位国王

original: Rust has long since destroyed much of its royal armor, and what little flesh remains on its skeletal form is covered in the same crawling, purple fungus that seems to infect these tombs
translate: 锈蚀早已毁坏了他大部分的皇家护甲，他那骷髅身躯上仅存的少许皮肉，也覆盖着似乎感染了这些墓穴的、蠕动的紫色真菌

original: DIE ABOMINATION!
translate: 去死吧，畸形生物！

original: I command you to bring me the usurper’s blade
translate: 我命令你把篡位者的刀剑给我带来

original: Return without it and your life is forfeit
translate: 空手而归的话，你的性命就没了

original: The undead King has not moved from his place atop the dais
translate: 不死生物国王仍站在石台上，一动不动

original: The fungus growing within him seems to writhe with renewed vigor at your approach
translate: 随着你的靠近，他体内生长的真菌似乎以新的活力蠕动起来

original: Why have you returned?!
translate: 你为什么回来了？！

original: I have your sword!
translate: 我带来了你的剑！

original: I've come to end you!
translate: 我是来终结你的！

original: You present the sword taken from Joran the Usurper’s tomb
translate: 你拿出了从篡位者约兰的墓中取来的剑

original: Is this the sword that was stolen from you?
translate: 这就是从你那里偷走的那把剑吗？

original: The Wight King surges forward
translate: 尸妖王猛冲向前

original: The Lake Blade!
translate: 湖中剑！

original: Giiiivveee iiittt ttooo mmee!
translate: 给……给……给我！

original: I'll keep it for myself
translate: 我要自己留着

original: Take it!
translate: 拿去吧！

original: You do not know?
translate: 你不知道吗？

original: the wight bellows
translate: 尸妖咆哮道

original: I am Enar
translate: 我是埃纳尔

original: All-King, Lord of Idra, Wielder of the mighty Lake Blade!
translate: 众王之王，伊德拉的领主，强大的湖中剑的持有者！

original: And why do you linger here?
translate: 那你为何在此徘徊？

original: The wight emits a pained moan as he reaches for the empty sheath at his waist
translate: 尸妖发出一声痛苦的呻吟，伸手摸向腰间空空的剑鞘

original: I shall not rest until I have reclaimed the blade Joran the Usurper stole from me!
translate: 不夺回篡位者约兰从我这里偷走的剑，我绝不罢休！

original: I have your blade!
translate: 我带来了你的剑！

translate: #霍林地穴交汇处,

original: The terrifying sight of their clawed, bloodied fingers reaching toward you conjures the image of the torn-apart corpse at the crypt’s entrance
translate: "他们那沾满鲜血的利爪手指向你伸来的恐怖景象，让你想起了地穴入口处那具被撕碎的尸体"

original: You steel yourself, determined you will not meet the same end
translate: "你鼓起勇气，决心不会落得同样的下场"

original: Driina peers into the blackness straight ahead
translate: 德莉娜凝视着正前方的黑暗,

original: These corridors lead to the crypt’s tombs, where we shall find the entrance we seek
translate: "这些走廊通往地穴的墓室，我们将在那里找到我们要找的入口"

original: Alas, I know not which path is the correct one, and which may lead us to….whatever madness lies ahead
translate: "唉，我不知道哪条路是正确的，哪条路会带我们走向……前方那未知的疯狂"

original: Furthermore, the gate ahead appears to be locked
translate: "此外，前方的大门似乎锁上了"

original: The shuffling of bare feet on stone sounds from down the corridor to your left
translate: 左侧走廊深处传来赤脚在石地上拖曳的声音,

original: You are not alone
translate: 你并非独自一人,

original: Vague shapes linger just at the edge of darkness
translate: 模糊的身影在黑暗的边缘徘徊,

original: Who goes there?
translate: 谁在那里？,

original: Driina shouts
translate: 德莉娜喊道,

original: An unmistakable tremble has crept into her voice
translate: 她的声音中明显带着一丝颤抖,

original: You arrive at a dimly lit junction with an intricate mosaic at its center
translate: 你来到一个光线昏暗的交汇处，中央有一幅精美的马赛克图案,

original: Four paths lay before you
translate: 四条路展现在你面前,

original: As you take in your surroundings, you notice fresh smears of blood leading into the eastern tunnel
translate: "当你观察四周时，你注意到新鲜的血迹延伸向东边的隧道"

original: The path ahead is barred by a locked gate
translate: 前方的路被一扇锁着的大门挡住了,

original: Moving closer, you notice the faint flicker of movement out of the corner of your eye
translate: "走近时，你注意到眼角余光中有微弱的动静"

original: Slowly, the shadows moving toward you morph into familiar, humanoid shapes
translate: "慢慢地，向你移动的阴影变成了熟悉的人形轮廓"

original: Survivors?
translate: 幸存者？,

original: Or perhaps assailants?
translate: 还是袭击者？,

original: You just manage to catch a glimpse of emaciated flesh and sharp, yellow fangs before the creatures are upon you
translate: "你只来得及瞥见消瘦的皮肉和锋利的黄色獠牙，那些生物就扑了上来"

original: Who drags me from the black stars!?
translate: 谁把我从黑色星辰中拖了出来！？

original: screams the skeletal figure
translate: 骷髅身影尖叫道。

original: As it emerges from the billowing dust, its regal, ancient armour seems to glimmer in the faint light
translate: 当它从滚滚尘埃中出现时，它那帝王般的古老盔甲在微光中似乎闪烁着光芒

original: A thousand curses are too few!!!
translate: 一千个诅咒都嫌太少！！！

original: The creature raises its sword in the air as it charges toward you!
translate: 那生物高举利剑，向你冲锋而来！

original: Pushing as hard as you can, you are met with an unnatural resistance, almost as if something is holding the lid shut from within
translate: 你竭尽全力推动，却遇到一股不自然的阻力，仿佛有什么东西从内部紧紧按住棺盖

original: Perhaps there is another way of opening this tomb?
translate: 也许有别的办法打开这座墓穴？

original: You are met with an unnatural resistance, almost as if something is holding the lid shut from within
translate: 你遇到一股不自然的阻力，仿佛有什么东西从内部紧紧按住棺盖

original: Straining with all your might, you overpower the unknown force and stumble forward as the lid suddenly shifts
translate: 你使出浑身力气，压倒了那股未知的力量，随着棺盖突然移动，你踉跄向前

original: There is little time to catch your breath, for something is emerging from the newly opened tomb
translate: 你几乎没有时间喘息，因为有什么东西正从新打开的墓穴中浮现

original: The beautifully carved sarcophagus before you features an effigy depicting a man with sharp aquiline features and a stern gaze
translate: 你面前雕刻精美的石棺上有一尊雕像，描绘了一个有着鹰钩鼻和严厉目光的男人。

original: Open the sarcophagus
translate: 打开石棺，

original: Shouting the name, your voice echoes inside the vaulted crypt
translate: 你喊出那个名字，声音在拱顶墓穴中回荡

original: For a moment, all is silent
translate: 一时间，万籁俱寂

original: And then, with a booming crack, the lid is violently flung open
translate: 然后，随着一声轰然巨响，棺盖被猛烈地掀开

original: The momentum sends you tumbling to the floor, leaving you desperately scrambling to regain your footing as something begins to emerge from the newly opened tomb
translate: 这股力量让你摔倒在地，你拼命挣扎着想要重新站稳，而有什么东西正开始从新打开的墓穴中浮现

original: The lid begins to slide off as you push against it until, suddenly, a hissing screech emits from the interior of the sarcophagus
translate: 当你用力推动时，棺盖开始滑开，直到突然，石棺内部发出一声嘶嘶的尖叫

original: The lid trembles violently as it is forced back into place by some unholy force within
translate: 棺盖剧烈颤抖，被内部某种邪恶的力量强行推回原位。

original: Someone or something is pitting its will against you!
translate: 有什么人或东西正在用意志与你对抗！

original: Attempt to force it open
translate: 试图强行打开它，

original: Call out to "Joran the Usurper
translate: 呼唤“篡位者约兰”

original: #HorrynCryptSwordTomb
translate: 霍林墓穴剑冢

original: #HorrynFirgolQuestGiverScene
translate: #霍林菲尔戈任务给予者场景

original: A grimy woman with a haggard look on her face approaches you
translate: 一个面容憔悴、满身污垢的女人向你走来

original: You get the impression she would normally be quite beautiful but starvation, disease and constant fear has erased that from her features
translate: “你感觉她原本应该相当美丽，但饥饿、疾病和持续的恐惧已经将那份美丽从她脸上抹去了”

original: Perhaps for good
translate: 也许永远地，

original: Please, they say you are looking for a way off of this island!
translate: “求你了，听说你在寻找离开这座岛的方法！”

original: I’m Julia
translate: 我是茱莉亚，

original: My sister, Ylia, lives in a small village called Firgol on the island north of here
translate: “我的妹妹，伊莉娅，住在北边岛上一个小村庄，叫菲尔戈”

original: I was supposed to travel to her before this all broke out and she must be worried sick that I have not arrived yet
translate: 我本该在这一切爆发之前就去找她的，她一定担心得要命，因为我还没到，

original: She wrings her hands
translate: 她绞着双手，

original: I’m in no condition to travel now and so should your travels take you to Firgol, would you please seek out Ylia?
translate: “我现在身体状况无法旅行，所以如果你的旅途会经过菲尔戈，能请你去找伊莉娅吗？”

original: Tell her that I’m still alive and not to worry?
translate: 告诉她我还活着，让她别担心？

original: I’m sure they have all kinds of troubles themselves up there and I wouldn’t want her to spend time worrying about me as well
translate: 我相信他们那边也有各种麻烦，我不想让她再花时间为我担心，

original: I'll see if I can't find her
translate: 我会看看能不能找到她，

original: May the Golden bless you
translate: 愿黄金之神祝福你，

original: I’m sure my sister can spare a few coins once you tell her the good news
translate: 我相信等你告诉她这个好消息，我妹妹会拿出几枚硬币给你的，

original: A few tears of joy leave streaks on her soot-covered face
translate: 几滴喜悦的泪水在她满是煤灰的脸上留下痕迹，

original: Hello there!
translate: 你好啊！

original: Looking for something?
translate: 在找什么吗？

original: Are you Ylia?
translate: 你是伊莉娅吗？

original: Do you have a sister in Horryn?
translate: 你在霍林有个姐姐吗？

original: Why yes that’s me!
translate: 啊，对，就是我！

original: My sister you say?
translate: 你说我姐姐？

original: You must mean Julia?
translate: 你一定是说茱莉亚？

original: I’m expecting her to visit me any day now!
translate: 我正等着她随时来看我呢！

original: She apologies for being late but at least she’s still alive
translate: 她为迟到道歉，但至少她还活着，

original: Tell Ylia about Horryn
translate: 告诉伊莉娅关于霍林的事，

original: Ylia looks more surprised than horrified
translate: 伊莉娅看起来更多是惊讶而不是恐惧，

original: Are you sure you’re not mistaken?
translate: 你确定你没搞错吗？

original: Julia is not late at all
translate: 茱莉亚根本没有迟到，

original: In fact she’s still not due until a day or two!
translate: 事实上，她还要一两天才到！

original: And what’s this you’re saying about Horryn?
translate: 还有你说的霍林是怎么回事？

original: We’ve had no news of any calamities!
translate: 我们根本没听说有什么灾难！

original: I can assure you I’m not mistaken
translate: 我可以向你保证我没搞错，

original: Well, I’m not sure what to say about this
translate: “嗯，我不知道该说什么好”

original: I suppose that it’s good my sister is safe if we are indeed talking about the same person
translate: 我想，如果我们说的确实是同一个人，那我姐姐安全就好，

original: Thank you in any case
translate: 无论如何，谢谢你，

original: I was promised payment
translate: 有人答应给我报酬，

original: As the woman goes about her chores you meet Embla’s eyes
translate: 当那女人去忙她的活计时，你与恩布拉目光相遇，

original: The woman was late for her arrival two days before she even supposed to set out?
