translate: 那女人在她本该出发的两天前就迟到了？

original: A misunderstanding perhaps?
translate: 也许是个误会？

original: Though I fear this is just another expression of the madness that grips these isles
translate: 但我担心这只是笼罩这些岛屿的疯狂的另一表现，

original: Ylia looks slightly taken aback
translate: 伊莉娅看起来有点吃惊，

original: Oh
translate: 哦，

original: Yes I suppose you’re right
translate: 是的，我想你是对的，

original: I don’t have much but here are a few gold-pieces at least
translate: 我没什么钱，但至少这里有几枚金币，

original: Now goodbye
translate: 那么再见了，

original: I’m in no condition to travel now and so should your travels take you to Firgol, would you please seek out Ylia
translate: 我现在身体状况无法旅行，所以如果你的旅途会经过菲尔戈，能请你去找伊莉娅吗？

original: #HorrynFishermanGates
translate: #霍林渔夫大门

original: For the refugees in the camp, hunger and disease is the greatest danger for now
translate: 对于营地里的难民来说，饥饿和疾病是目前最大的危险

original: Until we find a way to enter the city, we must do what we can to deal with the problems at hand
translate: 在我们找到进入城市的方法之前，我们必须尽力处理眼前的问题

original: Finding food and medicine
translate: 寻找食物和药品

original: I say we return to the camp and offer our help Marcus the chamberlain
translate: 我建议我们返回营地，向总管马库斯提供帮助

original: He's holed up in the stable
translate: 他躲在马厩里

original: People are dying inside as we stand here
translate: 我们站在这里的时候，里面正有人在死去

original: I swore an oath to fight for those who cannot and every second we waste here I desecrate that oath
translate: 我发誓要为那些无力战斗的人而战，我们在这里浪费的每一秒都是在亵渎那个誓言

original: There are people dying outside these walls as well
translate: 这些城墙外也有人在死去

original: What do we suggest we do?
translate: 我们建议怎么做？

original: A large, worn steel gate bars this entrance
translate: 一扇巨大、破旧的铁门挡住了这个入口

original: You shake it and find it securely locked with no visible way of forcing it open
translate: 你摇了摇它，发现它锁得很牢，没有明显的办法可以强行打开

original: Looking around, you take in the battlements of the walled city
translate: 环顾四周，你打量着这座有城墙城市的城垛

original: For a city this size, they are impressive
translate: 对于这样规模的城市来说，它们令人印象深刻

original: As if reading your mind Roland offers laconically
translate: 仿佛看穿了你的心思，罗兰简洁地说道

original: These walls were built to keep people out
translate: 这些城墙是为了把人挡在外面而建的

original: They seem to be doing a good job
translate: 它们似乎做得很好

original: It may prove more difficult than you originally thought to find a way into the city
translate: 找到进入城市的方法可能比你最初想的要困难得多

original: Though you feel certain that clues to Embla’s fate lie inside the beleaguered city, it seems that for now, fate has conspired to place an insurmountable obstacle in your way
translate: 尽管你确信关于恩布拉命运的线索就在这座被围困的城市里，但眼下看来，命运似乎合谋在你面前设置了一道无法逾越的障碍

original: Until a solution presents itself, you must look elsewhere for purpose and surely there are many on this accursed island whose life will depend on your resolve
translate: 在解决办法出现之前，你必须另寻目标，而在这座被诅咒的岛上，肯定有许多人的生命将取决于你的决心

original: Driina lets out an uncharacteristic scream of rage as she kicks the door heavily before slumping down against the wall
translate: 德莉娜一反常态地发出一声愤怒的尖叫，重重地踢了一脚门，然后瘫倒在墙边

original: As in response to her anger, somewhere deep inside the beleaguered city a manic laughter cackles briefly
translate: 仿佛是对她愤怒的回应，被围困的城市深处某处短暂地响起一阵狂笑

original: Are you okay?
translate: 你还好吗？

original: What do we do now?
translate: 我们现在怎么办？

original: Driina looks up and casts a sorrowful gaze out across the ocean
translate: 德莉娜抬起头，悲伤地望向大海

original: Foaming surfs beat the shore and gulls cry greedily overhead
translate: 泡沫翻涌的海浪拍打着海岸，海鸥在头顶贪婪地鸣叫

original: She sniffles and wipes her eyes as her face stiffens into a resolute mask
translate: 她抽了抽鼻子，擦了擦眼睛，脸上浮现出坚定的神情

original: You’re right
translate: 你说得对

original: The poor wretches huddling in the camp are hardly better off
translate: 那些蜷缩在营地里的可怜人也好不到哪里去

original: For now, we need to do what we can for them
translate: 眼下，我们需要为他们尽我们所能

original: What do you suggest we do?
translate: 你建议我们怎么做？

original: #HorrynFlopHouseScene
translate: #霍林廉价旅馆场景

original: A matronly woman with red cheeks and impressively bad teeth gives you a suspicious look
translate: 一位脸颊通红、牙齿坏得惊人的主妇模样的女人怀疑地打量着你

original: You’re either looking for a bed and a bowl of stew or you ain’t got nuffin to do here!
translate: 你要么是来找张床和一碗炖菜的，要么就甭在这儿瞎晃悠！

original: Let's see what you have to offer!
translate: 让我瞧瞧你有什么可拿出手的！

original: #HorrynFrantzo
translate: #HorrynFrantzo

original: You say goodbye and leave
translate: 你道别后离开

original: Have a look!
translate: 快来看看！

original: Rooms are being cleaned and we even have warm food on the stove
translate: 房间正在打扫，炉子上甚至还有热食

original: Finally the last part about Menu
translate: 最后是关于菜单的部分

original: You may ask some questions!
translate: 你可以问一些问题！

original: Show me your list of services!
translate: 给我看看你的服务清单！

original: Ask about Rumors
translate: 打听传闻

original: Something about Rumors
translate: 关于传闻的一些事

original: More about Rumors
translate: 更多关于传闻的事

original: Finally the last part about Rumors
translate: 最后是关于传闻的部分

original: #HorrynGallian
translate: #霍林伽里安

original: Driina sighs
translate: 德莉娜叹了口气

original: Truly there are many things you do not understand about this world
translate: 确实，你对这个世界还有很多不了解的地方

original: It nourishes me to stand in this hall and find its altar unmolested by the madness that has engulfed this island
translate: 站在这座大厅里，看到祭坛未被吞噬这座岛的疯狂所亵渎，这让我感到滋养

original: Tenderly, she touches the base of the statue and offers a whispered prayer
translate: 她温柔地触碰雕像的底座，低声祈祷

original: Why is he masked?
translate: 他为什么戴着面具？

original: He looks so frail
translate: 他看起来如此虚弱

original: You worship a corpse
translate: 你崇拜一具尸体

original: Madness
translate: 疯狂

original: It symbolizes the sacrifices he made when he built the world we see around us today
translate: 这象征着他缔造我们今日所见世界时所做的牺牲

original: The cost of all those touched by the reticulum is indeed steep in the end
translate: 所有被魔网触碰之人最终付出的代价确实高昂

original: We must never forget that
translate: 我们绝不能忘记这一点

original: But why is he masked?
translate: 但他为什么戴着面具？

original: The elegant marble statue looms over you
translate: 优雅的大理石雕像赫然耸立在你面前

original: Unblemished and pristine
translate: 洁白无瑕

original: An emaciated form, dressed in ragged robes frozen mid-gesture while unmasking
translate: 一个消瘦的身形，穿着破烂的长袍，凝固在摘下面具的动作中

original: Gallian - the first Emperor - presides over the serene temple interior
translate: 伽里安——第一任帝皇——主宰着这宁静的圣殿内部

original: Driina reverently presses her palms lightly against her face and then removes them in a gesture reminding you of the statue
translate: 德莉娜虔诚地将手掌轻轻贴在脸上，然后移开，这个动作让你想起那座雕像

original: Driina?
translate: 德莉娜？

original: The Emperors are very old
translate: 帝皇们非常古老

original: Often several hundred years
translate: 往往有数百岁

original: They are also beyond powerful - one with the Reticulum
translate: 他们也强大无比——与魔网融为一体

original: One can only imagine the effect it has on their physical form
translate: 只能想象这对他们的肉体形态有何影响

original: Perhaps it is best that the common folk never have to see the price of such power
translate: 或许最好让平民永远不必看到这种力量的代价

original: For a moment, a shadow falls over the room - then it passes
translate: 片刻间，一道阴影笼罩房间——然后消散

original: You must be on your way
translate: 你该上路了

original: Nothing
translate: 没什么

original: They are our Golden Dead and we must give praise that they watch over us
translate: 他们是我们的黄金先祖，我们必须赞美他们守护着我们

original: Driina offers a comforting smile
translate: 德莉娜露出安慰的微笑

original: Shall we be on our way?
translate: 我们出发吧？

original: Emperors don masks when they ascend to the throne
translate: 帝皇在登基时戴上面具

original: Being amongst the oldest and most powerful of the Magi, they are already more-than-human
translate: 作为最古老、最强大的法师之一，他们早已超越凡人

original: When they don the mask, it symbolizes that they have risen beyond even their brethren
translate: 当他们戴上面具，象征着他们甚至超越了同袍

original: And they are never seen without it?
translate: 他们从不以不戴面具示人吗？

original: The Emperor is never seen without their mask save by the Excubitors of the Imperial Palace
translate: 帝皇从不以不戴面具示人，唯有皇家禁卫军能见到

original: The silence hangs for a moment
translate: 沉默悬停了片刻

original: There is something unsaid
translate: 有些话未说出口

original: #HorrynGates
translate: #霍林大门

original: The gates to Horryn loom before you
translate: 霍林的大门赫然耸立在你面前

original: The massive portcullis is down, however, and there's no way to open it from this side
translate: “然而，巨大的落栅门已经落下，从这一侧无法打开”

original: On the other side, you see the dead, piled atop one another, up against the portcullis
translate: “在另一侧，你看到死者堆积如山，紧贴着落栅门”

original: They must have died trying to escape the town, caught between the gates and whatever assailants were in the town with them
translate: “他们一定是在试图逃离镇子时死去的，被困在大门和镇中袭击者之间”

original: Driina's face is ashen
translate: 德莉娜脸色苍白

original: I knew these people
translate: 我认识这些人

original: I delivered their children and cared for their dead
translate: 我接生过他们的孩子，照料过他们的逝者

original: To see them like this
translate: 看到他们这般模样

original: I will have vengeance
translate: 我要复仇

original: She sets her jaw
translate: 她咬紧牙关

original: There is another way
translate: 还有另一条路

original: The Fisherman's Gate
translate: 渔夫之门

original: We follow the walls east, and then south
translate: “我们沿着城墙向东，然后向南”

original: The town beyond the gate seems entirely still, and empty
translate: “大门后的镇子似乎完全寂静，空无一人”

original: But you doubt you've seen an end to the horrors within
translate: 但你怀疑镇内的恐怖远未结束

original: In any case, you must find another way in
translate: “无论如何，你必须找到另一条进去的路”

original: #HorrynGuardCaptainScene
translate: #霍林守卫队长场景

original: I’m ashamed to say me and a handful of my lads ended up captured by Reavers
translate: 我很惭愧地说，我和几个手下最终被劫掠者俘虏了

original: They started killing us off one by one
translate: 他们开始一个接一个地杀掉我们

original: Real slow while the rest were forced to watch
translate: 动作很慢，其他人被迫看着

original: Or even
translate: 甚至

original: Her eyes grow glassy then she shakes her head defiantly
translate: 她的眼神变得呆滞，然后倔强地摇了摇头

original: Then the mad-men suddenly started infighting!
translate: 然后那些疯子突然开始内讧！

original: Like bloody animals!
translate: 就像该死的动物一样！

original: But at least we managed to flee
translate: 但至少我们设法逃跑了

original: And who are you?
translate: 你是谁？

original: Best of luck and stay safe
translate: 祝你好运，注意安全

original: She holds up her hands in apology
translate: 她举起双手表示歉意

original: I’m sorry!
translate: 对不起！

original: Without your aid, we’d all be dead
translate: “没有你的帮助，我们早就死了”

original: It’s just that me and the boyos missed most of the fighting and it pains me to see we had to rely on mercenaries to keep Imperial citizens safe
translate: 只是我和兄弟们错过了大部分战斗，看到我们不得不依靠雇佣兵来保护帝国公民的安全，这让我很痛心

original: Indeed, I don't remember seeing you on the battlefield
translate: “确实，我不记得在战场上见过你”

original: As I said, people are streaming back into town
translate: “正如我所说，人们正涌回城里”

original: A lot more people than were at the refugee camp in fact!
translate: 事实上，比难民营里的人多得多！

original: Isn't that a good thing?
translate: 这不是好事吗？

original: Yes it is
translate: 是的，是好事

original: A lot of people did what I did and hid until the terror passed
translate: 很多人像我一样躲起来，直到恐怖过去

original: But not this many
translate: 但没这么多人

original: Let me ask you this
translate: 让我问你这个问题

original: Once a Reaver washes off the paint and blood and shit and puts regular clothing back on, is he still a Reaver?
translate: “一旦劫掠者洗掉身上的颜料、血迹和污秽，穿上普通衣服，他还是劫掠者吗？”

original: Are you saying Reavers are hiding amongst the regular people?
translate: 你是说劫掠者藏在普通人中间？

original: That’s the thing, isn’t it
translate: “问题就在这儿，不是吗”

original: The Reavers were regular people
translate: 劫掠者曾经是普通人

original: Friends and neighbors
translate: 朋友和邻居

original: Family even
translate: 甚至是家人

original: Most of them lie dead now or have fled Horryn
translate: 他们中的大多数现在已经死了，或者逃离了霍林

original: But not all
translate: 但不是全部

original: I think some of them just took off their rags and just went right back to being ordinary people
translate: 我觉得有些人只是脱掉破布，直接回去做普通人了

original: Food for thought
translate: 值得深思

original: What did you need?
translate: 你需要什么？

original: How did you say you survived the Reavers?
translate: 你说你是怎么从劫掠者手中活下来的？

original: How are things going in Horryn?
translate: 霍林的情况怎么样了？

original: Look lively boys
translate: 打起精神来，伙计们

original: The savior of Horryn graces our halls!
translate: 霍林的救星光临我们的大厅了！

original: A tall woman dressed in platemail with a greatsword on her back offers a short bow
translate: 一个身穿板甲、背着巨剑的高个子女人微微鞠躬

original: You’re unsure if she’s being sarcastic or not
translate: 你不确定她是不是在讽刺

original: How about some gratitude?
translate: 来点感激之情如何？

original: I didn't see you out there, fighting!
translate: “我没看到你在外面战斗！”

original: Who are you, loudmouth?
translate: “你是谁，大嘴巴？”

original: I trust all is well?
translate: 我相信一切都好吧？

original: We hid under the docks like bloody rats
translate: 我们像该死的耗子一样躲在码头下面

original: For days we hunkered down
translate: 我们蹲守了好几天

original: Ate limpets and drank salt water
translate: 吃帽贝，喝盐水

original: Had no weapons and my men were all exhausted or hurt so we just stayed there
translate: 没有武器，我的人都筋疲力尽或受了伤，所以我们只能待在那里

original: I suppose surviving doesn’t make you a hero
translate: 我想活下来并不能让你成为英雄

original: But here we are and I intend to make the most out of it
translate: 但我们在这里，我打算充分利用这一点

original: That's all for now I guess
translate: 我想现在就这样吧

original: She sighs
translate: 她叹了口气

original: And you are?
translate: 你是？

original: Name’s Vivian Laruto
translate: 我叫薇薇安·拉鲁托

original: I’m the newly minted captain of the city-guard
translate: 我是新任命的城卫队长

original: It would appear the city’s stock of officers is running low indeed
translate: 看来城里的军官储备确实不多了

original: You don't sound too sure of yourself?
translate: 你听起来不太自信？

original: Put me on the street to wrestle with thugs and drunkards any day!
translate: 让我上街去和暴徒、醉汉搏斗，我随时都行！

original: But this - being captain - is a bit of a change of pace for me
translate: 但这个——当队长——对我来说有点节奏变化

original: A lot more responsibility as you can probably guess
translate: 你可能猜得到，责任重了很多

original: Especially now with the city in ruins and people streaming back in to pick up the pieces of their lives
translate: 尤其是现在城市一片废墟，人们涌回来收拾生活的残局

original: I can imagine
translate: 我可以想象

original: That reminds me
translate: 这倒提醒了我

original: With more people streaming in, you’ll find the streets a bit more busy
translate: “随着更多人涌入，你会发现街道更繁忙一些”

original: Even more businesses are open as well now and I recommend you spend some time looking around before you continue on your travels
translate: 现在也有更多店铺开门了，我建议你在继续旅行之前花点时间四处看看

original: At least be sure to get a hot meal and a warm bed!
translate: 至少一定要吃顿热饭，睡个暖床！

original: I'll do that
translate: 我会的

original: Noted
translate: 记下了

original: Isn't that a good thing
translate: 这不是好事吗？

original: Once a Reaver washes off the paint and blood and shit and puts regular clothing back on, is he still a Reaver
translate: “一旦劫掠者洗掉身上的颜料、血迹和污秽，穿上普通衣服，他还是劫掠者吗？”

original: Are you saying Reavers are hiding amongst the regular people
translate: 你是说劫掠者藏在普通人中间？

original: #HorrynGuardLedgerScene
translate: #霍林守卫账本场景

original: The boy’s jaw goes slack at first
translate: 男孩的下巴先是松弛下来

original: Then the smallest hint of resolve comes across his face
translate: 然后脸上浮现出一丝决心的迹象

original: He’s determined to face his end standing up and he lunges at you!
translate: 他决心站着面对自己的结局，向你扑来！

original: The boy’s weapon lowers slightly
translate: 男孩的武器微微垂下

original: I’m guarding the eastern harbor tower
translate: 我在守卫东边的港口塔楼

original: So don’t you get any ideas - This is Imperial property!
translate: 所以别打什么主意——这是帝国财产！

original: You know, it's pretty safe out there now
translate: “你知道，现在外面相当安全了”

original: You could just leave
translate: 你可以直接离开

original: I need to get to that shelf behind you
translate: 我需要到你身后的那个架子那儿去

original: As you enter the chamber a pale young man in ill-fitting armor belonging to the Horryn city guard staggers backwards
translate: 当你进入房间时，一个身穿不合身的霍林城市守卫护甲的苍白年轻人踉跄后退

original: He holds his weapon before him in trembling hands
translate: 他用颤抖的双手把武器举在身前

original: Don’t come any closer!
translate: 别再靠近了！

original: I know how to use this!
translate: 我知道怎么用这个！

original: Do you now... boy?
translate: 你真的会吗……小子？

original: Roland grumbles as he stalks into the room next to you
translate: 罗兰咕哝着大步走进房间，来到你身边

original: Put that away before you get hurt!
translate: 把那东西收起来，免得受伤！

original: Take it easy
translate: 放轻松

original: I'm not going to hurt you
translate: 我不会伤害你

original: I was asked to guard this tower and by the Golden, that is what I’m going to do!!!
translate: “我奉命守卫这座塔，以黄金之名，我就要这么做！！！”

original: His voice breaks into the falsetto of someone not quite past their teenage years
translate: 他的声音破音成了还未完全度过青春期的人的假声

original: Roland takes a step forwards, causing the boy to let out a pathetic whimper
translate: “罗兰向前迈了一步，引得男孩发出一声可怜的呜咽”

original: Want to die for duty, hm?
translate: 想为职责而死，嗯？

original: I just want to talk a bit
translate: 我只是想聊几句

original: You leave me no choice
translate: 你让我别无选择

original: Y-you’re not?
translate: 你——你不是？

original: Then what are you doing here?
translate: 那你在这里做什么？

original: These records are Imperial property and I’m not letting you have them!
translate: 这些记录是帝国财产，我不会让你拿走的！

original: Now back away!
translate: 现在退后！

original: It's pretty safe out there now
translate: 现在外面相当安全了

original: You can leave if you want to
translate: 如果你想走，可以离开

original: The chamberlain sends orders
translate: 总管下达了命令

original: It's safe out there now and you can leave
translate: 现在外面安全了，你可以离开

original: Lie
translate: 撒谎

original: About what?!
translate: 关于什么？！

original: It's pretty safe out there now!
translate: 现在外面相当安全了！

original: The young man brandishes his weapon with trembling hands
translate: 年轻人用颤抖的双手挥舞着武器

original: Halt!
translate: 站住！

original: I need to talk to you
translate: 我需要和你谈谈

original: As if to confirm your words, the shouts of the boy's comrades echo from the plaza
translate: “仿佛是为了证实你的话，男孩同伴们的喊声从广场传来”

original: A wave of relief washes over the his face
translate: 一阵宽慰涌上他的脸庞

original: Golden bless me!
translate: 黄金保佑我！

original: He pushes past you and flees into the city without looking behind
translate: 他从你身边挤过去，头也不回地逃进了城里，

original: #HorrynHierophant
translate: #霍林大祭司

original: The old man gives you a determined nod before producing a large key from his robes
translate: 老人坚定地向你点了点头，然后从他的长袍中取出一把大钥匙，

original: Inserting it into the main door’s keyhole, he turns it with great effort until something clicks inside
translate: 他将钥匙插入大门的锁孔，费力地转动，直到里面传来咔嗒一声，

original: The perfectly balanced doors of the temple swing open soundlessly
translate: 神殿那完美平衡的大门无声地打开，

original: The temple’s pristine interior lies in stark contrast to the rest of the town and something about the aura of silence feels off
translate: 神殿内部一尘不染，与镇上的其他地方形成鲜明对比，而沉默光环中有些不对劲，

original: Enter
translate: 进入，

original: Do you have anything for sale?
translate: 你有什么要出售的吗？

original: The desecrated temple stands as a sad reminder of the last days’ calamities
translate: 这座被亵渎的神殿是最后几天灾难的悲伤提醒，

original: Standing in front of the main gates with eyes closed in prayer is Hierophant Drahl
translate: 大祭司德拉尔闭着眼睛站在大门前祈祷，

original: As you approach you can make out a simple prayer of gratitude to the long line of deceased Emperors that now watch over the Gallian people
translate: 当你走近时，你能听出那是一段简单的感恩祈祷，献给那些如今守护着伽里安人民的长串已故帝皇，

original: For all their savagery, it seems the mad-men were not able to breach the gates of the temple
translate: 尽管他们野蛮至极，那些疯子似乎还是没能攻破神殿的大门，

original: Drahl’s voice is a mixture of gratitude and disbelief
translate: 德拉尔的声音中混合着感激与难以置信，

original: He opens his eyes and looks at you for the first time
translate: 他睁开眼睛，第一次看向你，

original: A small miracle perhaps?
translate: 也许是个小小的奇迹？

original: Markus sent me
translate: 马库斯派我来的，

original: And he could have found no better hero for what lies ahead!
translate: 对于即将到来的事，他找不到比你更好的英雄了！

original: You seek a way into the keep and in their infinite wisdom, I believe our forefathers have provided for us
translate: 你在寻找进入城堡的路，而我相信，我们祖先以其无穷的智慧，已经为我们准备好了，

original: As Markus no doubt told you, it is said that a tunnel exists between the keep and the temple
translate: 正如马库斯无疑告诉你的那样，据说在城堡和神殿之间有一条隧道，

original: I’ve always considered it a bit of a myth and in any case we’ve never had cause to search for it
translate: 我一直认为这有点像是传说，而且无论如何，我们从未有理由去寻找它，

original: Until now that is
translate: 直到现在，

original: Where do you suggest we search?
translate: 你建议我们去哪里找？

original: If the tunnel does indeed exist, I can say with absolute certainty that its entrance lies in the catacombs beneath the temple
translate: 如果隧道确实存在，我可以绝对肯定地说，它的入口就在神殿下方的地下墓穴中，

original: In the crypts of the deepest, oldest portions would indeed be where I would place my faith
translate: 在最深处、最古老区域的地窖中，正是我会寄予信心的地方，

original: Then that is where I will search!
translate: 那么我就在那里寻找！

original: Have you found a way into the keep yet?
translate: 你找到进入城堡的路了吗？

original: As I said
translate: 正如我说的，

original: Seek out the tombs in the deepest part of the crypt!
translate: 去墓穴最深处寻找那些坟墓！

original: Blessed Dead watch over you!
translate: 愿受祝福的死者守护你！

original: I wish to talk
translate: 我想谈谈，

original: I do indeed!
translate: 我确实有！

original: It’s not much given the circumstances but I have a selection of potions and concoctions in addition to my healing services
translate: 考虑到目前的情况，东西不多，但除了我的医疗服务外，我还有一些药水和合剂可供选择，

original: #HorrynHogs
translate: #霍林猪

original: The small farmhouse seems desolate and abandoned
translate: 这座小农舍看起来荒凉而废弃

original: The only sign of life is a pack of grotesquely swollen hogs, feeding greedily on something deep in the mud
translate: 唯一的生命迹象是一群怪异肿胀的猪，贪婪地在泥泞深处啃食着什么

original: When you catch a glimpse through a brief break in the frenzy, you realize it's the corpses of what must have been their former owners
translate: 当你在狂乱中短暂瞥见时，你意识到那是它们前主人的尸体

original: Infernal swine
translate: 地狱般的猪

original: Driina spits behind you
translate: 德莉娜在你身后啐了一口

original: These hogs look like more than a handfull
translate: 这些猪看起来可不好对付

original: Best be careful lest we all end up with a tusk in the gut
translate: 最好小心点，免得我们都被獠牙捅穿肚子

original: Roland grumbles
translate: 罗兰咕哝道

original: The grotesquely hulking swine look like they'd happily make you their next meal, if you were to disturb them
translate: 这些怪异庞大的猪看起来如果你打扰它们，它们会很乐意把你当作下一顿美餐

original: Carry on
translate: 继续前进

original: #HorrynIagoCaptured
translate: #HorrynIagoCaptured

original: Sitting on the cold floor is a man in heavy chains
translate: 冰冷的地板上坐着一个戴着沉重锁链的男人，

original: As you approach, he looks up and from underneath his long unkempt hair his eyes glint and the vaguest outline of a smile flashes across his face
translate: “当你走近时，他抬起头，从他那蓬乱的长发下，眼中闪过一丝光芒，脸上掠过一丝若有若无的笑意。”

original: Finally!
translate: 终于！

original: I thought you’d never get here!
translate: 我还以为你们永远不会来了！

original: You are my ticket out of this hole!
translate: 你们是我离开这个鬼地方的门票！

original: And not a moment too soon I might add!
translate: 而且我得说，来得正是时候！

original: The man shuffles to his feet and dusts himself off as if preparing to leave
translate: 男人拖着脚站起来，掸了掸身上的灰尘，仿佛准备离开，

original: First of all I have no idea what you’re talking about and secondly, surely you realize you’re chained up?
translate: “首先，我完全不知道你在说什么；其次，你肯定意识到自己被锁链锁着吧？”

original: A minor inconvenience!
translate: 小小的不便而已！

original: The Blind Maiden has brought you thus far and no doubt the rest of the solution to this little conundrum is about to present itself
translate: 盲眼少女已将你们带到这里，毫无疑问，解决这个小难题的其余部分即将显现，

original: Iago zha Droma is not fated to spend the rest of his life rotting away in chains
translate: 伊阿戈·扎·卓玛命中注定不会在锁链中腐烂余生，

original: If the Blind Maiden favors you so, how did you end up in this hole?
translate: “如果盲眼少女如此眷顾你，你怎么会落到这个洞里？”

original: The Maiden merely deals us our hands of cards; it is for us to play them
translate: 少女只是给我们发牌；如何出牌取决于我们自己，

original: I, perhaps, played my last hand poorly
translate: “我，也许，上一手牌打得太糟了”

original: A small lover’s quarrel stemming from a simple misunderstanding led to a series of unfortunate events that landed me here
translate: 一场源于简单误会的恋人小争吵，导致了一连串不幸的事件，把我送到了这里，

original: He rattles his chains as if to emphasize his plight
translate: 他晃动着锁链，仿佛在强调自己的困境，

original: But the Maiden kisses me again and here you are
translate: 但少女再次亲吻了我，于是你们就来了，

original: My rescue!
translate: 我的救星！

original: Oh, is that so?
translate: “哦，是吗？”

original: All I ask of you is that you intercede on my behalf to the Queen
translate: 我只请求你们替我向女王求情，

original: Though she certainly loves me madly, she has also decided that I am to meet my end chained up in this oubliette shit-hole
translate: “尽管她确实疯狂地爱着我，但她也决定让我在这个地牢粪坑里戴着锁链了此残生”

original: For the briefest of moments Iago loses his composure and the slightest hint of desperation creeps into his voice
translate: 有那么一瞬间，伊阿戈失去了镇定，声音中流露出一丝绝望，

original: Hold on, I have some questions first
translate: “等等，我先问几个问题”

original: Iago looks at you impatiently
translate: 伊阿戈不耐烦地看着你，

original: Why exactly are you chained up here?
translate: 你到底为什么被锁在这里？

original: Why should I help you?
translate: 我为什么要帮你？

original: I'll be back
translate: 我会回来的，

original: Has the Blind Maiden ordained my freedom yet?
translate: 盲眼少女已经注定我获得自由了吗？

original: Not yet but I have some questions first!
translate: 还没有，但我先问几个问题！

original: Not yet
translate: 还没有，

original: There is not a sea on Warda untouched by Ombarian hulls
translate: 沃尔达上没有一片海域不曾被奥姆巴利亚的船体划过，

original: I do not deny that we whisper tales of such things when we are safe on dry land with a cup of wine in our hands
translate: 我不否认，当我们安全地待在陆地上，手握一杯酒时，我们会低声讲述这类传说，

original: Of things older than time that dwell in the unfathomable depths of the seas
translate: 关于那些比时间更古老、栖息在海洋深不可测的深渊中的存在，

original: But to hear of one in this age, and to encounter it no less!
translate: “但在这个时代听说，甚至还遭遇了它！”

original: Such things should not be
translate: 这种事情不该存在，

original: It is madness given form
translate: 那是疯狂具现化的形态，

original: A shadow passes over the man’s face
translate: 男人的脸上掠过一道阴影，

original: Where is your ship now?
translate: 你的船现在在哪里？

original: I had some other questions for you
translate: 我还有其他问题要问你，

original: We limped into a safe haven in one of this island’s excellent more ‘private’ coves
translate: 我们蹒跚驶入这座岛屿一个绝佳的更“私密”的小海湾里的安全港，

original: My crew awaits there as we make repairs and forage for supplies
translate: 我的船员在那里等待，我们进行修理并搜寻补给，

original: Let’s just say there is a reason Idra is so prized amongst those who fly the black sails
translate: 这么说吧，伊德拉在那些挂黑帆的人中如此受珍视是有原因的，

original: Iago winks at you
translate: 伊阿戈对你眨了眨眼，

original: So you’re a smuggler then?
translate: 那么你是个走私者？

original: Kat blurts out with not a little awe in her voice
translate: 卡蒂脱口而出，声音中带着不小的敬畏，

original: Iago fixes her with sultry gaze
translate: 伊阿戈用撩人的目光盯着她，

original: Why 'smuggler' is such a vulgar term
translate: 哎呀，“走私者”这词多粗俗啊，

original: I am a gentleman, a zhenor of the seas
translate: “我是位绅士，海上的哲诺尔”

original: 'Flying black sails' is a common euphemism for smugglers in the Empire
translate: “挂黑帆”在帝国是走私者的常见委婉说法，

original: What were you carrying?
translate: 你当时运的是什么？

original: Do not think me a petty criminal for carrying proscribed goods
translate: 别以为我运送违禁品就是个卑劣的罪犯，

original: There are men and women in this Empire who yearn for freedom from the yoke of their eunuch masters
translate: 这个帝国有男男女女渴望摆脱他们阉人主子的枷锁，获得自由，

original: Freedom costs blood
translate: 自由需要鲜血，

original: As well as steel and other, more… exotic wares
translate: “还有钢铁和其他更……奇特的货物”

original: Men such as me provide them
translate: 像我这样的人为他们提供这些，

original: As does the ‘Queen’ in her own way
translate: “女王”也以她自己的方式提供，

original: We needed supplies and since she and I are old friends I made my way here to parlay a deal
translate: 我们需要补给，而她和我是老朋友，所以我来到这里商谈一笔交易，

original: No doubt I overestimated our friendship
translate: 毫无疑问，我高估了我们的友谊，

original: Ah why indeed!
translate: 啊，确实为什么！

original: Iago’s laughter comes out strained
translate: 伊阿戈的笑声听起来很勉强，

original: As I said: ‘tis nothing but a lover’s quarrel!
translate: 如我所说：这不过是一场恋人的争吵！

original: A trifle
translate: 小事一桩，

original: I assure you
translate: 我向你保证，

original: I am certain, if you intercede on my behalf to the Queen, and make sure to tell her I’m terribly regretful, she will see reason and let me be on my merry way
translate: “我确信，如果你替我向女王求情，并务必告诉她我非常懊悔，她会通情达理，让我愉快地离开”

original: I'm not sure I believe you
translate: 我不确定我相信你，

original: Because Iago zha Droma is the finest captain to ever grace the Outer Isles with his sails
translate: 因为伊阿戈·扎·卓玛是外岛群有史以来最杰出的船长，

original: Besides, if you find another captain, brave or stupid enough to venture out to sea in these dire times, I shall dance on my mother’s grave!
translate: “再说，如果你能找到另一个船长，勇敢或愚蠢到在这种危急时刻出海，我就在我母亲的坟上跳舞！”

original: Iago leans in and his voice drops
translate: 伊阿戈凑近，压低了声音，

original: Horror stalks the depths around Idra
translate: 恐怖在伊德拉周围的深渊中潜行，

original: I have seen it with my own eyes!
translate: 我亲眼见过！

original: I know
translate: 我知道，

original: It sunk our ship as we came in!
translate: 我们进港时它击沉了我们的船！

original: Then you know what I speak of. ‘The Terror of Idra’
translate: 那你知道我说的是什么了。“伊德拉的恐怖”，

original: Many a ship must have shared your fate in these last, dark weeks
translate: “在这过去黑暗的几周里，肯定有许多船遭遇了和你们一样的命运”

original: It fell upon us as well when we passed Sylo’s Teeth
translate: 我们经过西洛牙礁时，它也袭击了我们，

original: Many of my men were swept off deck and large gouges were torn from the sides of my beautiful ship
translate: 我的许多手下被从甲板上卷走，我美丽的船两侧被撕开了巨大的裂口，

original: What happened?
translate: 发生了什么？

original: Were it not for the grit of my crew and the blessed ship-wrights who shaped the magnificent hull of the ‘Oruda’ we would have met our end as you did
translate: 要不是我的船员坚韧不拔，以及塑造了“奥鲁达号”壮丽船体的受祝福的造船匠们，我们就会像你们一样葬身海底，

original: Instead we were able to slip from its grasp and make our way past the reefs and into shallower waters where the behemoth could not follow
translate: 相反，我们得以从它的魔爪中逃脱，穿过礁石，进入海怪无法跟进的浅水区，

original: What is the nature of this behemoth?
translate: 这海怪的本质是什么？

original: And where is your ship now?
translate: 你的船现在在哪里？

original: #HorrynMaija
translate: #霍林·玛雅，

original: Ask about Wares
translate: 询问货物

original: Ask about Something
translate: 询问某事

original: Something about Wares
translate: 关于货物的事

original: Something about Something
translate: 关于某事的事

original: More about Something
translate: 更多关于某事

original: Finally the last part about Something
translate: 最后关于某事的部分

original: #HorrynOuterRetakenChamberlain
translate: #霍林外城区夺回总管,

original: Markus is standing by the inn’s fireplace warming his frozen fingers when he sees you
translate: 马库斯正站在旅馆的壁炉旁暖着他冻僵的手指，这时他看到了你，

original: His face lights up
translate: 他面露喜色，

original: Hail {PLAYER}!
translate: 向您致敬，{PLAYER}！

original: The savior of Horryn!
translate: 霍林的救星！,

original: His voice breaks half way through the greeting and a coughing fit overcomes him
translate: 他的声音在问候中途沙哑，一阵咳嗽袭来，

original: I think I’ve caught a cold
translate: 我想我是感冒了，

original: Though considering what we’ve been through I think I should count myself lucky
translate: 不过考虑到我们经历的一切，我想我应该算幸运的了，

original: Come, join me by the fire while we talk
translate: "“来，我们边烤火边谈”"

original: Thanks to your bravery, we’ve retaken most of Horryn and we now have access to supplies and shelter
translate: "“多亏了你的勇敢，我们夺回了霍林的大部分地区，现在有了补给和住所”"

original: The refugees have been streaming back in from the camp
translate: 难民们正从营地陆续返回，

original: They’re desperate to learn the fate of loved ones or property that was left behind
translate: 他们急切地想知道亲人的命运或遗留的财产，

original: Understandably so
translate: 这可以理解，

original: He lets out a sigh and leans in
translate: 他叹了口气，凑近说道，

original: However, were it not for the fact that I would have a mutiny on my hands, I would have kept them in the camp for now
translate: "“然而，要不是怕引发暴动，我本想让他们暂时留在营地”"

original: Things are much more dangerous here in Horryn than they realize
translate: 霍林这里的情况比他们意识到的要危险得多，

original: As far as my men report, the Reavers in the inner city seem to have been slain or driven off
translate: "“据我手下报告，内城的劫掠者似乎已被杀死或赶走”"

original: However, the one they call… ‘Father’ still occupies the keep in the south-west corner of the harbor
translate: "“然而，他们称之为……‘【父亲】’的那个家伙仍占据着港口西南角的要塞”"

original: He’s barricaded himself inside with the remainder of his pack and that’s not the worst of it
translate: 他带着残部把自己封锁在里面，而这还不是最糟的，

original: Reports are coming in that dozens of townsfolk were taken alive by the Reavers and taken to the keep
translate: 有报告称，数十名镇民被劫掠者活捉并带进了要塞，

original: I dread even contemplating what they are going through if they are still alive
translate: 我甚至不敢去想，如果他们仍活着，正在遭受什么，

original: We must purge Horryn of this remaining ‘infestation’ and, if the Holy Tombs will it, rescue the captives
translate: "“我们必须清除霍林残余的‘虫群’，如果圣墓庇佑，救出俘虏”"

original: A frontal assault is out of the question
translate: 正面进攻绝无可能，

original: The keep is well defended when held by a determined enemy and I have not the man-power to attempt it
translate: 要塞在顽敌手中固若金汤，而我没有足够兵力去尝试，

original: There is hope however
translate: 不过还有希望，

original: Hierophant Drahl, shared an ancient legend with me
translate: "“大祭司德拉尔与我分享了一个古老的传说”"

original: When the current temple was constructed, a secret tunnel between it and the keep was reportedly build
translate: "“据说，在建造现在的神殿时，神殿与要塞之间修建了一条秘道”"

original: It served the purpose of allowing the governor in the keep to escape through the temple in case of a siege or, alternatively, it made it possible for the clergy to seek shelter inside the keep if need be
translate: "“其目的是让要塞中的总督在被围困时能通过神殿逃脱，或者，让神职人员必要时能进入要塞避难”"

original: Ironically, the tunnel was constructed centuries ago and since Horryn has seen very little warfare, it’s never been used
translate: "“讽刺的是，这条秘道建于几个世纪前，而霍林鲜有战事，所以从未用过”"

original: In other words, it’s very existence is… less than ensured
translate: "“换句话说，它的存在本身……并不确定”"

original: Markus offers a sheepish smile
translate: 马库斯露出腼腆的微笑，

original: Nonetheless, at this time the secret tunnel is our best bet
translate: "“尽管如此，眼下这条秘道是我们最好的机会”"

original: Hierophant Drahl is waiting for you outside the temple
translate: 大祭司德拉尔正在神殿外等你，

original: Meet him there and he’ll fill you in
translate: 去那里见他，他会告诉你详情，

original: Also, among the refugees returning were Maija and our blacksmith
translate: "“另外，返回的难民中有玛伊娅和我们的铁匠”"

original: Both have opened their stores for you if you need to resupply
translate: 如果你需要补给，他俩的店铺都已为你开门，

original: And lastly {PLAYER}
translate: 最后，{PLAYER}，

original: Please be careful
translate: 请务必小心，

original: I fear dangers ahead, far exceed those behind you
translate: "“我担心前方的危险，远胜于你身后的”"

original: May the Golden Dead lend you strength
translate: 愿黄金先祖赐予你力量，

original: Talk to Hierophant Drahl at the temple
translate: 去神殿找大祭司德拉尔谈谈，

original: He'll tell you about the secret entrance!
translate: 他会告诉你秘道入口的事！,

original: #HorrynPilgrimLeaderScene
translate: #霍林朝圣领袖场景

original: There isn’t much to do!
translate: 没什么可做的！

original: They say no ships are coming or going and in any case the region seems far too dangerous for us to venture into for now
translate: 他们说没有船进出，而且无论如何，这个地区现在对我们来说太危险了，不敢冒险进入

original: It would seem we’re stuck here for now
translate: 看来我们暂时被困在这里了

original: That's a shame
translate: 真可惜

original: A group of weather-beaten travelers, clad in ragged robes, occupy the innermost beds of the flophouse
translate: 一群饱经风霜的旅行者，穿着破烂的长袍，占据了廉价旅馆最里面的床铺

original: One of them smiles dejectedly at you
translate: 其中一人沮丧地对你微笑

original: Hello there brother
translate: 你好，兄弟

original: I’m Thomas
translate: 我是托马斯

original: I lead this little troupe on our pilgrimage to the Outer Isles
translate: 我带领这个小剧团去外岛群朝圣

original: That is, until all this madness started
translate: 也就是说，直到这一切疯狂开始

original: Hello there sister
translate: 你好，姐妹

original: Pilgrimage?
translate: 朝圣？

original: How did you manage to survive the reavers?
translate: 你们是怎么从劫掠者手中活下来的？

original: Driina shakes her head in disapproval
translate: 德莉娜不以为然地摇了摇头

original: All I can say is that I promise it’s worth the toil
translate: 我只能说，我保证这辛苦是值得的

original: You’ll feel like a new man by the end
translate: 到最后你会感觉自己焕然一新

original: Then again, if you don’t have the heart for it there’s little I can say or do to change your mind
translate: 不过话说回来，如果你没有这个心思，我也没什么可说的或做的来改变你的想法

original: You’ll feel like a new woman by the end
translate: 到最后你会感觉自己焕然一新

original: Hmm
translate: 嗯

original: Indeed!
translate: 确实！

original: We came by boat from the mainland to see the five shrines of the Outer Isles
translate: 我们从大陆乘船来参观外岛群的五座神龛

original: It’s a lesser known route and it takes you far from any inn
translate: 这是一条鲜为人知的路线，会带你远离任何旅馆

original: That is perhaps why I feel it can be such a powerful experience
translate: 也许这就是为什么我觉得它能成为如此强大的体验

original: To complete the route requires true devotion
translate: 完成这条路线需要真正的虔诚

original: Not that it matters now
translate: 不过现在这都不重要了

original: It seems my comrades and I are stuck in Horryn
translate: 看来我和我的同伴们被困在霍林了

original: What do you indend to do now?
translate: 你现在打算做什么？

original: Aha!
translate: 啊哈！

original: I think I've seen one of the pilgrim shrines!
translate: 我想我见过其中一座朝圣神龛！

original: Thomas suddenly looks you over for a moment
translate: 托马斯突然打量了你一会儿

original: You have the look of a mercenary about you
translate: 你看起来像个雇佣兵

original: Perhaps you’d be interested in taking on the pilgrimage?
translate: 也许你有兴趣进行这次朝圣？

original: It would fortify both your mind and your body and it would help make the sites safe for the rest of us when we’re finally able to travel again
translate: 这会强化你的身心，而且当我们最终能够再次旅行时，这也有助于为我们其他人确保这些地点的安全

original: Hmm, perhaps
translate: 嗯，也许吧

original: We have nothing to offer you as compensation but I swear that fulfilling the pilgrimage will be worth it
translate: 我们没有什么可以给你作为报酬，但我发誓完成朝圣是值得的

original: That is, if you have the stamina to see it through
translate: 也就是说，如果你有毅力坚持到底的话

original: Driina grabs your elbow softly
translate: 德莉娜轻轻抓住你的手肘

original: I really think we should listen to the man
translate: 我真的觉得我们应该听这个人的

original: What exactly does it entail?
translate: 这具体包括什么？

original: As I said, there are five shrines scattered throughout the Outer Isles
translate: 正如我所说，外岛群上散布着五座神龛

original: To complete the pilgrimage, you must visit each of them and spend no less than 8 hours at each site in deep meditation while you recite the Pilgrim’s Prayer
translate: 要完成朝圣，你必须拜访每一座神龛，在每个地点花至少8小时进行深度冥想，同时背诵朝圣者祷文

original: Pilgrim’s Prayer?
translate: 朝圣者祷文？

original: We’ll teach you the prayer before you go and note down the general directions to each of the shrines in your journal
translate: 在你出发前，我们会教你祷文，并在你的日志中记下每座神龛的大致方向

original: You should consult it before setting out
translate: 出发前你应该查阅一下

original: And don’t worry
translate: 别担心

original: You can complete the pilgrimage in any order!
translate: 你可以按任意顺序完成朝圣！

original: This all sounds like a lot of work!
translate: 这听起来工作量很大！

original: Thomas looks invigorated at the prospect of sending you off on the pilgrimage and smiles warmly at you whilst placing his hands on your shoulders
translate: 想到要送你踏上朝圣之旅，托马斯显得精神焕发，他温暖地对你微笑，同时将双手放在你的肩膀上

original: Brother, there is nothing more for me to say
translate: 兄弟，我没什么可说的了

original: If the will to complete the pilgrimage lives within you, it will be so
translate: 如果完成朝圣的意志存在于你心中，那就一定会实现

original: Now, be on your way and best of luck!
translate: 现在，上路吧，祝你好运！

original: Driina bows respectfully to the weatherbeaten man
translate: 德莉娜恭敬地向这位饱经风霜的男人鞠躬

original: Sister, there is nothing more for me to say
translate: 姐妹，我没什么可说的了

original: Thomas smiles warmly at you
translate: 托马斯温暖地对你微笑

original: You have the look of enlightenment upon you
translate: 你身上有开悟的神采

original: It gladdens my heart to see
translate: 看到这让我心生欢喜

original: I pray that my comrades and I shall soon follow
translate: 我祈祷我和我的同伴们很快也能如此

original: Thomas looks at you and squints slightly
translate: 托马斯看着你，微微眯起眼睛

original: You’ve not completed the pilgrimage yet I see
translate: 我看你还没完成朝圣

original: I can always tell who has and who hasn’t
translate: 我总能看出谁完成了，谁没有

original: Don’t give up!
translate: 别放弃！

original: You may have
translate: 你可能已经

original: One of the shrines is right here on Idra!
translate: 其中一座神龛就在伊德拉这里！

original: Oh, I was really hoping to see them all again
translate: 哦，我真的很希望能再次看到它们全部

original: What’s more, I had hoped to be able to bring my companions there as well
translate: 而且，我本来还希望能把我的同伴们也带到那里去

original: Thomas sighs deeply
translate: 托马斯深深地叹了口气

original: So what do you plan to do now?
translate: 那么你现在打算做什么？

original: Thomas nods towards the proprietor
translate: 托马斯朝店主点了点头

original: We would all be dead were it not for the lady of the house
translate: 要不是这位女主人，我们早就死了

original: She hid us under the floorboards when the Reavers came and we were able to ride out the worst of it
translate: 劫掠者来的时候，她把我们藏在地板下，我们才得以躲过最糟糕的时刻

original: And you said you're pilgrims?
translate: 你说你们是朝圣者？

original: #HorrynRatMaze
translate: #霍林鼠巷

original: A circular chamber with three exits
translate: 一个有三条出口的圆形房间

original: The one to the west opens up into a larger, lit passage
translate: 西边的出口通向一条更大、有照明的通道

original: North
translate: 北

original: East
translate: 东

original: Exit west into the underhalls
translate: 向西出口进入地下大厅

original: A bend in the tunnel leads south or east
translate: 隧道的一个弯道通向南方或东方

original: Drawn on the wall is a vulgar graffiti of two naked male forms that appear to be... wrestling
translate: 墙上画着粗俗的涂鸦，两个裸体男性形象似乎在……摔跤

original: South
translate: 南

original: This room is a dead end
translate: 这个房间是死胡同

original: Written on the wall in chalk is the graffiti
translate: 墙上用粉笔写着涂鸦

original: Esteban is a donkey-fucker!
translate: 埃斯特班是驴日的！

original: Besides the checkerboard patterned floor, this is an otherwise inconspicuous chamber with exits leading north and west
translate: 除了棋盘格图案的地板，这个房间原本不起眼，有出口通往北和西

original: West
translate: 西

original: A fairly large, vaulted chamber with four exits
translate: 一个相当大的拱顶房间，有四个出口

original: The floor seems sticky with some kind of slimy mold that appears to be spreading from a large drain
translate: 地板似乎粘着某种黏糊糊的霉菌，似乎是从一个大排水口蔓延开来的

original: A junction where three tunnels converge
translate: 三条隧道交汇的路口

original: The Rat Queen rules here!
translate: 鼠后统治这里！

original: The exit to the east smells faintly of sewage
translate: 东边的出口隐约有污水的气味

original: This is a dead end
translate: 这是死胡同

original: Nothing to see here
translate: 这里没什么可看的

original: A large square chamber with four central pillars
translate: 一个大的方形房间，有四根中央柱子

original: A skeletal corpse sits leaning up against one of the pillars
translate: 一具骷髅尸体靠在一根柱子上坐着

original: Tunnels lead off into all four cardinal directions
translate: 隧道通向四个主要方向

original: A large, octagonal chamber with four exits
translate: 一个大的八角形房间，有四个出口

original: The one leading north stinks of sewage and leads back to the sewer tunnels
translate: 北边的出口臭气熏天，通向污水隧道

original: A chalk arrow is drawn on the wall leading west
translate: 墙上画着一个粉笔箭头指向西

original: Exit north into the sewers
translate: 向北出口进入下水道

original: A chamber where the worked stone of the easter wall has collapsed causing dirt and rocks to spill into the room
translate: 一个房间，东墙的加工石料坍塌，导致泥土和岩石涌入房间

original: The wet stench of mold hangs thick in the air
translate: 空气中弥漫着潮湿的霉菌恶臭

original: Tunnels exit to the north and west
translate: 隧道出口通往北和西

original: A tall chamber with a tapering ceiling
translate: 一个高高的房间，天花板逐渐变窄

original: A beam of light shines down from above, illuminating a piece of chalk graffiti
translate: 一束光从上方照下来，照亮了一处粉笔涂鸦

original: Magi have no balls - but fuck us nonetheless!
translate: 法师没有蛋蛋——但还是操我们！

original: Exits lead south and west and the one towards the west stinks of sewage
translate: 出口通往南和西，西边的那个臭气熏天

original: You have emerged into the underhalls of Horryn
translate: 你已经进入了霍林的地下大厅

original: Faint music can be heard ahead and the air smells of spice and perfume
translate: 前方传来微弱的音乐声，空气中弥漫着香料和香水的气味

original: The narrow tunnels of the Rat-Raze opens up into the rancid sewers underneath Horryn
translate: 鼠巷的狭窄隧道通向霍林地下腐臭的下水道

original: The Rat Maze
translate: 鼠巷

original: The tunnel leads back into “The Rat Maze
translate: 隧道通向“鼠巷”

original: Enter at your own risk!
translate: 进入风险自负！

original: The tunnel ahead is dark and narrow and seems to be of pre-imperial construction
translate: 前方的隧道又黑又窄，似乎是前帝国时期的建筑

original: Rats scuttle in and out and ahead you can see it branching in multiple directions
translate: 老鼠窜来窜去，前方你可以看到它分叉成多个方向

original: If you proceed, you must keep your wits, and sense of direction, about you
translate: 如果你继续前进，你必须保持机智和方向感

original: #HorrynRatQueenScene
translate: #霍林鼠后场景

original: SOmething about C
translate: 关于C的一些事

original: More about C
translate: 更多关于C的事

original: Finally the last part about C
translate: 最后关于C的部分

original: How curious: you're clearly not from Idra; you've not made the mistake of attacking us; you appear not to know me
translate: 真奇怪：你显然不是伊德拉人；你没有犯下攻击我们的错误；你似乎不认识我

original: I seek answers
translate: 我寻求答案

original: I seek fortune
translate: 我寻求财富

original: I doubt you’ll find much in these halls
translate: 我怀疑你在这些厅堂里找不到什么

original: Nonetheless, you are welcome to enjoy my hospitality and... business
translate: 尽管如此，欢迎你享受我的款待和……生意

original: So long as your blade stays in your sheath and your tongue remains courteous
translate: 只要你的剑留在鞘中，舌头保持礼貌

original: The queen takes a long draw from a hookah pipe as she stares intently at you
translate: 女王从水烟管中长长吸了一口，同时专注地盯着你

original: Thank you m'lady
translate: 谢谢您，女士

original: May I ask you some questions?
translate: 我可以问您一些问题吗？

original: I'll go where I like
translate: 我想去哪儿就去哪儿

original: For now, I have questions!
translate: 现在，我有问题！

original: Retrieve the harbormaster’s ledger for me
translate: 替我取回港务长的账本

original: Look for it in the eastern sea-tower
translate: 去东边的海塔里找

original: You can find it by following the eastern jetty all the way around to the entrance of the harbor
translate: 沿着东防波堤一路绕到港口入口就能找到

original: Do that, and I shall consider sparing that fool Iago’s life
translate: 做到这点，我就会考虑饶了那个傻瓜伊阿戈的命

original: You hand the ledger to the Queen who in turn hands it off to one of her lackeys without even looking
translate: 你把账本交给女王，她看都没看就转手递给了一个手下

original: The man flips through it and offers the queen a short nod
translate: 那人翻了翻，向女王微微点头

original: She waves her hand in an uninterested gesture and a burly pair of gentlemen slink off into the shadows
translate: 她漠不关心地挥了挥手，两个魁梧的绅士溜进了阴影中

original: One of them is carrying a large ring of keys
translate: 其中一人拎着一大串钥匙

original: What about it?
translate: 那又怎样？

original: What was I supposed to do again?
translate: 我又该做什么来着？

original: I have the ledger!
translate: 我拿到账本了！

original: The men standing around roar in laughter and jeers
translate: 站在周围的人哄堂大笑，嘲弄起来

original: Iago bows deeply and backs away
translate: 伊阿戈深深鞠躬，向后退去

original: He grabs you by the arm as you leave
translate: 你离开时，他抓住你的胳膊

original: You are looking for a captain, yes?
translate: 你在找一位船长，对吧？

original: Well, you’ll find no better suited ship or crew than the Weathermaiden
translate: 嗯，你找不到比天候少女号更合适的船或船员了

original: I’ll go ahead and rejoin them in the sea-cave to the north-west of here
translate: 我先走一步，去西北边的海蚀洞窟与他们会合

original: Make your preparations and then seek me out once you are ready
translate: 做好准备，一旦就绪就来找我

original: Together we will bid a fond farewell to this barren rock
translate: 我们将一起深情告别这块不毛之地

original: Iago tips his non-existent hat and leaves
translate: 伊阿戈抬了抬并不存在的帽子，离开了

original: At some point you may find yourself in search of a ship, no?
translate: 总有一天你可能会需要一艘船，不是吗？

original: Once my ship is ready to sail again we shall make our way off this barren rock
translate: 一旦我的船准备好再次起航，我们就离开这块不毛之地

original: Someone throws an overripe fruit
translate: 有人扔了一个熟透的水果

original: As he does so he whispers to you “I think it is best we make ourselves scarce
translate: 他一边这么做，一边对你低语：“我想我们最好赶紧溜走

original: The natives seem to be getting restless
translate: 本地人似乎开始躁动不安了

original: You amuse me
translate: 你让我觉得有趣

original: I shall lend my ear
translate: 我会倾听

original: For now
translate: 暂时

original: About that ledger
translate: 关于那个账本

original: I met Iago
translate: 我见到了伊阿戈

original: What is this place?
translate: 这是什么地方？

original: How did you end up here?
translate: 你是怎么沦落到这里的？

original: The queen’s eyes flash at you and for a moment you feel as if lightning is about to strike
translate: 女王眼中闪过一道光，一瞬间你感觉仿佛闪电即将劈下

original: Then she relaxes back into her self-assured pose
translate: 然后她放松下来，恢复了自信的姿态

original: That man is nothing to me
translate: 那个男人对我来说什么都不是

original: He is to rot at my pleasure
translate: 他活该烂在这里，全凭我高兴

original: What is his crime?
translate: 他犯了什么罪？

original: The queen cast a brief glance at a young man standing nearby
translate: 女王瞥了一眼站在附近的一个年轻人

original: His face reddens and a faint smile plays across his lips
translate: 他脸红了，嘴角泛起一丝微笑

original: That is, until he realizes the hot water he’s in and remembers an important task that needs doing somewhere else before scuttling off
translate: 也就是说，直到他意识到自己处境不妙，想起还有重要任务要去别处完成，然后匆匆溜走

original: Iago is a worm whose appetite is too big for his own good
translate: 伊阿戈是条胃口太大、自不量力的蠕虫

original: Nothing else
translate: 没别的了

original: What is your interest in him?
translate: 你对他有什么兴趣？

original: He's asked me to put in a good word for him to you
translate: 他让我替他在你面前美言几句

original: Has he now?
translate: 是吗？

original: Well, he is clever when that mood strikes him and you’ll certainly find no finer captain in the outer isles
translate: 嗯，他兴致来的时候很聪明，在外岛群你肯定找不到比他更好的船长了

original: For old times sake, I shall offer him this much
translate: 看在旧情的份上，我就给他这点面子

original: The Harbormaster of Horryn is no doubt food for the crabs
translate: 霍林的港务长无疑已成了螃蟹的食物

original: Or at least for those beasts that roam the streets above
translate: 或者至少成了上面街道上游荡的野兽的食物

original: However, he kept meticulous journals and ledgers
translate: 然而，他保留了详尽的日志和账本

original: Ledgers full of information that reflect poorly on my associates
translate: 账本里满是会对我同伙不利的信息

original: It would be a shame, albeit not unlikely, that these ledgers might have been lost in the calamities that have swept Horryn
translate: 这些账本可能在席卷霍林的灾难中丢失，虽然并非不可能，但会是个遗憾

original: Where should we look for them?
translate: 我们该去哪里找？

original: The Harbormaster kept a storage of his records in the eastern tower that flanks the entrance to the harbor
translate: 港务长把他的记录存放在港口入口旁东侧塔楼的储藏室里

original: Just follow the eastern jetty, along the sea-wall until you arrive at the tower
translate: 沿着东防波堤，顺着海堤走，直到到达塔楼

original: With the current chaos that reigns above, I’m sure it’s as easy as walking in and walking out again
translate: 眼下上面混乱不堪，我敢肯定就像走进去再走出来一样简单

original: Do this for me, and I’ll consider sparing the life of that wretch of a manling
translate: 替我办成此事，我就会考虑饶了那个可怜虫的命

original: I already have them!
translate: 我已经拿到了！

original: I'll consider it
translate: 我会考虑的

original: I had some more questions first though
translate: 不过我先还有些问题

original: The pair return with Iago dangling comically between them and forcefully deposit him on the stone floor at the queen’s feet
translate: 那两人回来了，伊阿戈滑稽地吊在他们中间，被重重扔在女王脚边的石地上

original: He slowly and painfully stumbles to his feet while rubbing his sore wrists
translate: 他揉着酸痛的手腕，缓慢而痛苦地踉跄站起

original: The Blind Maiden has delivered
translate: 盲眼少女已经送达

original: My dear queen, I am ever your
translate: 我亲爱的女王，我永远是您的

original: The Queen’s retort cut’s like a rapier
translate: 女王的反驳像刺剑一样锋利

original: Not another word out of your mouth lest I geld you. {PLAYER}, I thank you for your service but it is time for you to be on your way
translate: 再敢多说一个字，我就阉了你。{PLAYER}，感谢你的效劳，但你现在该走了

original: Seeing this scoundrel before me makes my men and me salivate for roasted peacock and I assure you
translate: 看到这个恶棍在我面前，让我和手下们都馋起了烤孔雀，我向你保证

original: That would not be a pretty sight
translate: 那场面可不会好看

original: Iago, I don't want you joining me
translate: 伊阿戈，我不想让你加入我

original: You return
translate: 你回来了

original: I have some more questions
translate: 我还有些问题

original: About that quest
translate: 关于那个任务

original: A place for free spirits and the free flow of enterprise
translate: 一个供自由灵魂和自由事业流通的地方

original: The Empire would call us thieves, smugglers and brigands but the same Empire would rather starve thousands to death than upset the delicate balance of their taxes and tariffs
translate: 帝国会称我们为盗贼、走私者和强盗，但同一个帝国宁愿让成千上万的人饿死，也不愿打乱他们税收和关税的微妙平衡

original: So instead, we scuttle about like rats in dark places
translate: 所以，我们反而像老鼠一样在暗处窜来窜去

original: We gnaw at the foundations of that swollen corpse
translate: 我们啃噬着那具肿胀尸体的根基

original: But for all our mischief, they cannot help but love us
translate: 但尽管我们如此捣蛋，他们还是忍不住爱我们

original: They writhe in our muck!
translate: 他们在我们的污秽中挣扎！

original: In the rare spices, fine oils, exotic magicks and potent poisons that flow into the Heartlands thanks to those like me
translate: 多亏了像我这样的人，稀有的香料、上好的油、异域的魔法和强效的毒素才得以流入心脏地带

original: So please
translate: 所以，请吧

original: Cavort in pleasures most carnal while you are here
translate: 在此尽情享受最肉欲的欢愉吧

original: No secrets ever leave these halls
translate: 任何秘密都不会离开这些厅堂

original: The queen offers a telling smile
translate: 女王露出了一个意味深长的微笑

original: Not another word out of your mouth lest I geld you
translate: 再敢多说一个字，我就阉了你，

original: {PLAYER}, I thank you for your service but it is time for you to be on your way
translate: {PLAYER}，感谢你的效劳，但你现在该走了

original: #HorrynReaverAltar
translate: #霍林劫掠者祭坛

original: This tablet has claimed many minds
translate: 这块石板已经夺走了许多人的心智

original: The Reavers were once sane men
translate: 劫掠者曾经是理智的人

original: Now they are murderous beasts and I know in my blood, this helped spark their madness
translate: “如今他们是凶残的野兽，我凭直觉知道，这东西助长了他们的疯狂”

original: She spits on the tablet
translate: 她朝石板吐了口唾沫

original: I wonder... did they catch it in their nets by chance?
translate: 我好奇……他们是在渔网中偶然捞到它的吗？

original: Or were there deeper, darker forces at work?
translate: “还是说有更深、更黑暗的力量在作祟？”

original: Loot the altar
translate: 搜刮祭坛

original: Examine the artifact more closely
translate: 更仔细地检查这件器物

original: A hideous simulacrum of an altar stands before you
translate: 一座丑陋的仿制祭坛矗立在你面前

original: The large stone slab is smeared with blood and feces, and obscenely decorated with the rotted eggs of sea birds and the bones of small creatures
translate: “巨大的石板上涂抹着血和粪便，还猥亵地装饰着海鸟的腐蛋和小动物的骨头”

original: A small pile of coins and precious stones have been placed upon it as well
translate: 上面还放着一小堆钱币和宝石

original: Its most striking feature, however, is the weathered, greenish stone tablet that serves as a centerpiece
translate: “然而，它最引人注目的特征是那块作为中心装饰的、风化发绿的石板”

original: Leaning in and in the dim light, you can make out line upon line of faint carvings and grotesque imagery covering the tablet
translate: “凑近在昏暗的光线下，你能辨认出覆盖石板的一行行模糊的雕刻和怪诞的图像”

original: It seems to writhe and contort in impossible ways and for a moment you can almost hear whispering
translate: 它似乎以不可能的方式扭动变形，有那么一瞬间你几乎能听到低语

original: Pull Away
translate: 抽身退开

original: You pull back from the hideous artifact and for some reason your mind resounds with a single thought
translate: 你从那件可怖的器物前退开，不知为何，你的脑海中回荡着一个念头

original: The tablet came from the unknowable depths of the sea
translate: 这块石板来自不可知的深海深渊

original: No doubt an item of power and value... to the right person
translate: 毫无疑问，对合适的人来说，这是一件充满力量与价值的物品……

original: Driina shudders
translate: 德莉娜打了个寒颤

original: This is an artifact of pure evil
translate: 这是一件纯粹邪恶的器物

original: Driina, what is this thing?
translate: “德莉娜，这是什么东西？”

original: You carefully place the tablet in your bags before picking through the offal covering the rest of the altar for what precious items you find there
translate: 你小心地将石板放入背包，然后从覆盖祭坛其余部分的污秽中挑拣出你找到的珍贵物品

original: Your bags feel heavy as you heft them over your shoulder
translate: 当你把背包甩到肩上时，感觉沉甸甸的

original: You force yourself to scan the tablet and its hideous carvings
translate: 你强迫自己扫视石板及其可怖的雕刻

original: The scripture makes little sense to you but there are images as well
translate: 经文对你来说毫无意义，但上面还有图像

original: Suggestive images
translate: 引人遐想的图像

original: However, you decide that you lack the required knowledge to make sense of them and quickly look away
translate: “然而，你认定自己缺乏理解它们所需的知识，于是迅速移开了视线”

original: Taking a deep breath, you force yourself to look upon the hideous carvings again
translate: “深吸一口气，你强迫自己再次看向那些可怖的雕刻”

original: You fail to make any further sense of the writing but your eyes linger on the crude renditions of humanoid figures
translate: 你未能进一步理解那些文字，但你的目光停留在粗糙的人形描绘上

original: Some appear to be men, or at least man-like
translate: “有些看起来是男人，或者至少是类人生物”

original: Small and pathetic, they kneel in worship of others, much larger and monstrous figures
translate: “它们渺小而可悲，跪着崇拜其他更大、更畸形的存在”

original: In another series of images, the subject matter becomes more disturbing still
translate: “在另一系列图像中，主题变得更加令人不安”

original: Squatting obscenely, the larger horrors embrace the smaller men and in a grotesque imitation of lovers, it appears as if they are kissing deeply
translate: “那些更大的恐怖存在猥亵地蹲着，拥抱着较小的人类，以一种怪诞模仿恋人的姿态，看起来仿佛在深吻”

original: You feel nausea rising up and look away from the hideous tablet
translate: 你感到一阵恶心，从可怖的石板上移开了视线

original: #HorrynReaverChief1
translate: #HorrynReaverChief1

original: Oh the Butcher’s a good boy but he’s truly gone astray
translate: 哦，屠夫是个好孩子，但他真的误入歧途了

original: Blood-drunk I say
translate: 我说，被血冲昏了头

original: I’ve seen it before
translate: 我以前见过

original: Once you taste the flesh and blood and guts of the weak, your hands just start going by themselves
translate: 一旦你尝过弱者的血肉和内脏，你的手就会不由自主地动起来

original: Becomes like gutting fish
translate: 就像剖鱼一样

original: Knife in - knife out
translate: 刀进——刀出

original: Oleg smiles broadly as he imitates a sawing motion with his hand
translate: 奥列格一边模仿锯东西的动作，一边咧嘴笑着

original: But the Father still needs him - The tablets are whispering it to me!
translate: 但【父亲】还需要他——石板正对我低语着这件事！

original: Seek him out in front of the temple, over in the western part of town, and tell that to him!
translate: 去神殿前面找他，就在镇子的西边，把这话告诉他！

original: I have some other questions
translate: 我还有其他问题

original: About the other chieftains
translate: 关于其他首领

original: A shadow falls over Oleg’s face
translate: 一片阴影掠过奥列格的脸

original: Father is a great man
translate: 【父亲】是个伟人

original: I was the one to receive the word from the Deep but Father was the one who was truly chosen
translate: 我是从深渊接收到话语的人，但【父亲】才是真正被选中的那个

original: I won’t lie
translate: 我不撒谎

original: I was jealous!
translate: 我曾嫉妒过！

original: I hated him for it!
translate: 我为此恨过他！

original: The tablets came to me after all!
translate: 毕竟石板是来找我的！

original: Why was he the one to receive the gift?!
translate: 为什么是他得到了恩赐？！

original: What is his 'work'?
translate: 他的“工作”是什么？

original: He sighs
translate: 他叹了口气

original: Then again, his work is so important
translate: 不过，他的工作如此重要

original: So… beautiful even I cannot begin to comprehend it
translate: 如此……美妙，我甚至无法开始理解

original: And we must all play our part in it
translate: 我们都必须在这其中扮演自己的角色

original: My siblings will fall in line and you have been chosen for the task
translate: 我的兄弟姐妹们会服从安排，而你已被选中执行这项任务

original: Oh do not worry!
translate: 哦，别担心！

original: You’ll meet him soon enough and all will be made clear
translate: 你很快就会见到他，一切都会明了

original: It is whispered
translate: 这是低语

original: Sweet little sister Kala!
translate: 可爱的小妹妹卡菈！

original: She and her brood caught more of the prey than any other!
translate: 她和她的手下抓到的猎物比谁都多！

original: Sniffed them out from their cellars and attics and cupboards and sent them to Father!
translate: 把他们从地窖、阁楼和碗柜里嗅出来，送到【父亲】那里！

original: Though he only takes the fit
translate: 尽管他只收合适的

original: The very young and very old were left for her to play with
translate: 太年幼和太年老的都留给她玩弄

original: Oleg chuckles genially
translate: 奥列格和蔼地轻声笑着

original: I fear she’s grown bored and lazy now that there’s hardly more prey to be had
translate: 我担心她现在变得无聊又懒惰，因为几乎没什么猎物可抓了

original: She just sits around and stews over in the pack-house on the docks now
translate: 她现在就坐在码头的帮会屋里闷闷不乐

original: It’s time she was reminded that she has a role to play yet!
translate: 是时候提醒她，她还有角色要扮演！

original: Prey?
translate: 猎物？

original: Do you mean people?
translate: 你是指人吗？

original: The old man smiles serenely and appears to either not hear or not comprehend your question
translate: 老人平静地微笑着，似乎没听见或没理解你的问题

original: The filthy pack of robed and hooded mad-men roar in insane anger and charge towards you as they draw strangely curved blades and cruel looking axes!
translate: 那群肮脏的、穿着长袍戴着兜帽的疯子发出癫狂的怒吼，拔出形状怪异的弯刀和凶残的斧头，向你冲来！

original: Tell me about Kala!
translate: 跟我说说卡菈！

original: Tell me about the Butcher!
translate: 跟我说说屠夫！

original: Tell me about the Father!
translate: 跟我说说【父亲】！

original: I have other questions
translate: 我还有其他问题

original: The band of madmen file out of the lodge and into the city
translate: 那群疯子从屋里鱼贯而出，进入城市

original: Keeping your distance, you follow them as they set up an ambush in the plaza
translate: 你保持距离，跟着他们，看他们在广场设下埋伏

original: Like mangey, starving wolves they fidget with the anticipation of bloodshed
translate: 像患了疥癣的饿狼，他们因期待流血而坐立不安

original: Finally their quarry arrives
translate: 终于，他们的猎物来了

original: The Butcher and his filthy brood prowl into the square with weapons drawn
translate: 屠夫和他那群肮脏的手下拔出武器，潜行进入广场

original: An arrow is loosened and then mad cries from the ambushers fill the air as a furious melee erupts!
translate: 一支箭射出，随后伏击者的疯狂喊叫响彻空中，一场激烈的近战爆发了！

original: Savage blades make bloody work
translate: 野蛮的刀剑制造着血腥的成果

original: Intestines spill, blood pours and limbs are torn from bodies
translate: 肠子溢出，鲜血喷涌，四肢从躯体上被撕下

original: Screams of pain and terror mix with the howls and snarls of men utterly lost to insane bloodlust
translate: 痛苦与恐惧的尖叫与完全陷入癫狂嗜血欲望的男人们的嚎叫和咆哮交织在一起

original: The Butcher finds Oleg on the field and with a mighty swing the old man is slain
translate: 屠夫在战场上找到了奥列格，一记猛击，老人便被杀死了

original: As the fiend tears his ‘brother’s’ hearth from his chest, he howls in triumph
translate: 当这个恶魔从他“兄弟”的胸膛里扯出心脏时，他胜利地嚎叫着

original: As the screams die down and all the savagery is sated, the ground is slick with blood
translate: 当尖叫声平息，所有的暴行都得到满足，地面被鲜血浸得滑腻

original: Hulking and dark with grime and gore the Butcher stands panting in the center of the battlefield surrounded by his few surrounding men
translate: 屠夫高大黝黑，满身污垢和血污，气喘吁吁地站在战场中央，身边围着几个手下

original: In the darkness his eyes burn like white hot coals
translate: 黑暗中，他的眼睛像白热的煤块一样燃烧

original: As he raises his bloody axe towards you, an inhuman scream echoes across the plaza
translate: 当他向你举起血淋淋的斧头时，一声非人的尖叫响彻广场

original: It seems the mad-man has one more sacrifice yet to make!
translate: 看来这个疯子还要再献祭一个！

original: Attack!
translate: 攻击！

original: What?!
translate: 什么？！

original: My patience is limited!
translate: 我的耐心有限！

original: About your tablets
translate: 关于你的石板

original: Regarding the other chieftains
translate: 关于其他首领

original: I'm here to end you!
translate: 我是来终结你的！

original: It's time I left
translate: 我该走了

original: An old man,graying but endowed with a physique sculpted by a lifetime of hard manual labor, looks up at you as you approach
translate: 一个头发花白、但体格因一生艰苦体力劳动而健壮的老人，在你走近时抬头看着你

original: A smile of genuine surprise spreads warmly across his face in a manner that stands in stark contrast to the grotesque surroundings
translate: 一种真诚的惊讶笑容温暖地绽放在他脸上，与周围怪诞的环境形成鲜明对比

original: Ah!
translate: 啊！

original: You came!
translate: 你来了！

original: You were expecting me?
translate: 你在等我？

original: Your coming was whispered
translate: 你的到来被低语过

original: Such are the blessings of the Depths
translate: 这就是深渊的祝福

original: Cast your nets and receive the bounty
translate: 撒下你的网，收获恩赐

original: All my life I’ve been at sea
translate: 我一生都在海上

original: Wind and rain and frozen fingers
translate: 风、雨和冻僵的手指

original: And let me tell you
translate: 让我告诉你

original: Them Imperial hymns never did me any good
translate: 那些帝国赞美诗从没给我带来过好处

original: Twasn't afore we started using the old incantations that the Deep started rewarding us
translate: 直到我们开始使用古老的咒语，深渊才开始奖赏我们

original: And rewarded me it did
translate: 它确实奖赏了我

original: The Whispering Tablets came to me
translate: 低语石板来到了我身边

original: That’s where we first received the deep word and that’s where I heard of your coming
translate: 我们就是在那里第一次接收到深渊的话语，也是在那里我听到了你的到来

original: Whispering tablet?
translate: 低语石板？

original: The Butcher has stolen your tablets!
translate: 屠夫偷了你的石板！

original: Aye
translate: 是啊

original: The words of the Deep - written in stone
translate: 深渊的话语——刻在石头上

original: Given to me and me alone
translate: 赐予我，且只赐予我一人

original: Those two upstarts, Kala and that butcher, covet it and even the Father himself pretends he no longer needs it
translate: 那两个暴发户，卡菈和那个屠夫，觊觎它，就连【父亲】自己也假装不再需要它

original: No longer needs me
translate: 不再需要我

original: A flash of anger comes across the face of the kindly old man
translate: 这位和蔼的老人脸上闪过一丝愤怒

original: But I’ll remind him
translate: 但我会提醒他

original: I’ll make the Father remember
translate: 我会让【父亲】记起来

original: How?
translate: 怎么做？

original: Sister Kala and brother Butcher have lost their way
translate: 卡菈妹妹和屠夫弟弟迷失了方向

original: All the bloodshed has gone to their heads and they’ve strayed!
translate: 所有的杀戮冲昏了他们的头脑，他们误入歧途了！

original: Lost their way!
translate: 迷失了方向！

original: Meanwhile, the Father has gone to the keep to begin the holy work
translate: 与此同时，【父亲】已经前往要塞开始神圣的工作

original: He’s left it to me to put my wayward siblings right
translate: 他留给我来纠正我那些任性的兄弟姐妹

original: Or put them down
translate: 或者除掉他们

original: Like diseased dogs
translate: 像处理病狗一样

original: And you think I'll help you?
translate: 你觉得我会帮你？

original: It does not matter what I think
translate: 我怎么想并不重要

original: The tablets whispered and here you are
translate: 石板低语了，于是你就在这里

original: Before this is over you will have more blood on your hands
translate: 在这件事结束之前，你手上会沾上更多的血

original: So much more blood
translate: 多得多的血

original: Go to them
translate: 去找他们

original: Tell them to return to the family or suffer the consequences
translate: 告诉他们回归家族，否则承担后果

original: The Butcher is culling the flock in front of the temple and you’ll find Kala holding court at the east-end of the docks
translate: 屠夫正在神殿前剔除羊群，你会在码头东端找到卡菈在主持集会

original: Begone now and do not return until you are done
translate: 现在走吧，不完成就别回来

original: Not so fast
translate: 别急

original: I have questions!
translate: 我有问题！

original: Oleg pauses a moment and then smiles conspiratorily
translate: 奥列格停顿片刻，然后露出阴谋般的微笑

original: Kala!
translate: 卡菈！

original: Together we’ll slay brother Butcher and once we feast on his putrid entrails, she’ll make a fine consort for old Oleg!
translate: 我们一起杀掉屠夫弟弟，等我们享用了他腐烂的内脏后，她会成为老奥列格的好配偶！

original: Go to her!
translate: 去找她！

original: Tell her that together we shall put an end to the Butcher’s obstinance and win Father’s favor!
translate: 告诉她，我们一起终结屠夫的顽固，赢得【父亲】的青睐！

original: What do you want?
translate: 你想要什么？

original: I have some questions!
translate: 我有些问题！

original: The robed cultists stop dead in their tracks as they spot you
translate: 穿长袍的邪教徒们一看到你，就猛地停住了脚步

original: You
translate: 你

original: You're not supposed to be here!
translate: 你不该在这里！

original: Come here so I can gut you!
translate: 过来，让我剖了你！

original: Oleg sent me!
translate: 奥列格派我来的！

original: INTERLOPER!
translate: 闯入者！

original: DIE!
translate: 死！

original: The Reavers appear taken aback, not knowing what to say
translate: 劫掠者们似乎吃了一惊，不知该说什么

original: Instead they say nothing, whirl around and clamber up the ladder leading to the surface
translate: 他们反而一言不发，猛地转身，爬上通往地面的梯子

original: What in the depths are you doing back here?!
translate: 你他妈的怎么又回到这里来了？！

original: To arms lads!
translate: 拿起武器，伙计们！

original: Yes?
translate: 嗯？

original: I've taken the tablets for myself!
translate: 我把石板据为己有了！

original: Can I see them?
translate: 我能看看吗？

original: Tell me more about them!
translate: 多告诉我一些关于它们的事！

original: The man eyes you suspiciously
translate: 那人怀疑地看着你

original: They’re none of your fucking business is what they are!
translate: 它们就是他妈的不关你的事！

original: They came to me and me alone!
translate: 它们是来找我的，只找我一人！

original: It was MY nets that caught them and my boat that carried them ashore!
translate: 是我的网捞到了它们，是我的船把它们运上岸！

original: Not the Butcher, not Kala and not even Father himself!
translate: 不是屠夫，不是卡菈，甚至不是【父亲】本人！

original: ME!
translate: 是我！

original: Oleg wipes a drop of sweat from his brow
translate: 奥列格从额头上擦去一滴汗

original: Now, you best get going
translate: 现在，你最好出发

original: He offers a polite, slight smile
translate: 他礼貌地微微一笑

original: I have more questions!
translate: 我还有问题！

original: Oleg chuckles fatherly
translate: 奥列格慈祥地轻声笑着

original: Oh my, no
translate: 哦，天哪，不行

original: They are for me and me alone
translate: 它们是给我的，只给我一人

original: They lie in darkness; safe and untouched by the filth of my wayward siblings
translate: 它们躺在黑暗中；安全，未被我那任性的兄弟姐妹们的污秽所触及

original: What can you tell me about them?
translate: 关于它们，你能告诉我什么？

original: I had some other questions
translate: 我还有些别的问题

original: The man’s eyes widen in shock and rage
translate: 那人震惊而愤怒地瞪大了眼睛

original: What have you done!?
translate: 你做了什么！？

original: You’re unraveling the thread!
translate: 你在拆散线索！

original: Are you mad??!
translate: 你疯了吗？？！

original: You’ll pay for this!
translate: 你会为此付出代价！

original: Oleg instinctively senses the truth in your words and his eyes widen in shock and terror
translate: 奥列格本能地察觉到你话中的真相，他震惊而恐惧地瞪大了眼睛

original: Then, utter rage
translate: 然后，彻底的愤怒

original: That upstart!
translate: 那个暴发户！

original: I gave him a chance to come to my side and he betrays me instead?!
translate: 我给了他机会站到我这边，他却背叛了我？！

original: And now you say he intends to make an offering of me?!
translate: 现在你说他打算拿我当祭品？！

original: We shall see who’s bones will be laid out in the sun to dry come dawn!
translate: 我们走着瞧，看天亮时谁的骨头会被摆在太阳下晒干！

original: Children, sharpen your blades!
translate: 孩子们，磨利你们的刀剑！

original: We’ll get the jump on the upstart yet!
translate: 我们还能抢先一步对付那个暴发户！

original: Watch them leave
translate: 看着他们离开

original: What if you ask Kala to ally with you?
translate: 如果你让卡菈与你结盟呢？

original: #HorrynReaverChief1
translate: #HorrynReaverChief1

original: Oleg smiles broadly as he imitates a sawing motion with his hands
translate: 奥列格一边模仿锯东西的动作，一边咧嘴笑着

original: Savage blades do bloody work
translate: 野蛮的刀剑制造着血腥的成果

original: The Whispering tablets came to me
translate: 低语石板来到了我身边

original: Begon now and do not return until you are done
translate: 现在走吧，不完成就别回来

original: #HorrynReaverChief1GateGuard
translate: #HorrynReaverChief1GateGuard

original: The men lick their lips in greedy anticipation
translate: 这些人贪婪地舔着嘴唇，充满期待

original: To arms!
translate: 拿起武器！

original: they bellow
translate: 他们吼道

original: Yes you will
translate: 是的，你会的

original: Oleg is waiting for you inside
translate: 奥列格在里面等你

original: The man offers a toothless grin
translate: 那人露出没牙的笑容

original: You spot a pair of reavers dressed in a bizarre assortment of ragged robes, hoods and antlered masks guarding the gate to what appears to be a decrepit villa
translate: 你发现两个劫掠者，穿着奇异的破烂长袍、兜帽和鹿角面具，守卫着一座看似破旧别墅的大门

original: The pair notices you and they grin cruelly as they heft their weapons before suddenly stopping
translate: 那两人注意到你，残忍地咧嘴笑着，举起武器，然后突然停住

original: The antlered man leans in and whispers in the hooded one's ear
translate: 戴鹿角面具的人凑近戴兜帽的人耳边低语

original: Their grins fade
translate: 他们的笑容消失了

original: You’re welcome to our lodge!
translate: 欢迎来到我们的营地！

original: He’s been expecting you
translate: 他一直在等你

original: What?
translate: 什么？

original: Iben looks tense and whispers out of the corner of his mouth
translate: 伊本神情紧张，从嘴角低声说道

original: We got lucky before
translate: 我们之前运气好

original: These madmen are not to be trifled with and we will do well to employ some cunning in dealing with them
translate: 这些疯子可不好惹，我们最好用点计谋对付他们

original: Roland chimes in
translate: 罗兰插话道

original: Little man's right
translate: 小个子说得对

original: I’m not afraid to get my hands dirty but we are few and we don’t know their true numbers yet
translate: 我不怕弄脏手，但我们人少，还不知道他们到底有多少人

original: We shall see
translate: 走着瞧吧

original: Oleg’s a great man!
translate: 奥列格是个伟人！

original: The Father might have forgotten it but he is the oldest of us
translate: 【父亲】可能忘了，但他是我们中最年长的

original: Was him who pulled the tablets out of the depths and he’s still their keeper
translate: 是他从深渊中捞出了石板，至今仍是它们的守护者

original: And as long as he is, his word carries more weight than any of us!
translate: 只要他还是，他的话就比我们任何人都更有分量！

original: The Father would do well not to forget that!
translate: 【父亲】最好别忘了这一点！

original: Tablets?
translate: 石板？

original: The man smiles serenely
translate: 那人平静地微笑着

original: No need
translate: 没必要

original: Oleg hisself is waiting for you inside
translate: 奥列格本人正在里面等你

original: Go to him now
translate: 现在就去见他吧

original: I had some more questions
translate: 我还有些问题

original: The men look puzzled
translate: 那些人一脸困惑

original: Why would we?
translate: 我们为什么要？

original: Oleg says not to and his words come from the depths themselves
translate: 奥列格说不用，他的话来自深渊本身

original: He had the tablets even before the father came to us
translate: 早在【父亲】来到我们身边之前，他就有了石板

original: What tablets?
translate: 什么石板？

original: Tell me more about Oleg!
translate: 多告诉我一些奥列格的事！

original: You mustn't tarry
translate: 你不能再耽搁了

original: Oleg very much wishes to speak with you
translate: 奥列格非常想和你谈谈

original: Tell me more about this Oleg!
translate: 多告诉我一些这个奥列格的事！

original: Why are you not attacking me?
translate: 你们为什么不攻击我？

original: I have no time for you madmen!
translate: 我没时间陪你们这些疯子！

original: The whispering tablets
translate: 低语石板

original: Ones that came up in our nets
translate: 从我们的网里捞上来的

original: From the deep and the Mother herself!
translate: 来自深渊和母亲本人！

original: The ones that make you
translate: 那些让你

original: The other reaver grabs his arm and he catches himself
translate: 另一个劫掠者抓住他的胳膊，他回过神来

original: Best you see Oleg
translate: 你最好去见奥列格

original: He’ll tell you all you needs to know
translate: 他会告诉你所有你需要知道的

original: #HorrynReaverChief1GateGuard
translate: #HorrynReaverChief1GateGuard

original: He had the tablets even before the Father came to us
translate: 早在【父亲】来到我们身边之前，他就有了石板

original: The woman snarls and bares her fangs as she draws a wickedly curved blade and lunges at you!
translate: 那女人咆哮着露出獠牙，拔出一把邪恶的弯刀向你扑来！

original: The woman in front of you is tall and sinewy
translate: 你面前的这个女人身材高大，肌肉强健，

original: Her face is painted and bloody and her teeth have been filed into fangs
translate: 她的脸上涂着彩绘，沾满血迹，牙齿被磨成了獠牙，

original: She licks her lips greedily as you approach
translate: 当你靠近时，她贪婪地舔着嘴唇，

original: So what have we here?
translate: 瞧瞧，我们这儿来了什么？

original: Fresh playthings for the brood?
translate: 给这群崽子们的新玩具？

original: Come to taste the blade?
translate: 来尝尝刀子的滋味？

original: The Butcher has stolen the tablets from Oleg
translate: 屠夫从奥列格那里偷走了石板，

original: Oy!
translate: 喂！

original: Don’t you know who you’re talking to?
translate: 你不知道你在跟谁说话吗？

original: One of the flanking reavers spit in your direction
translate: 一个侧翼的劫掠者朝你的方向啐了一口，

original: This is Queen Kala herself and you’re about to have the honor of being gutted by her!
translate: 这位就是卡菈女王本人，你马上就有幸被她开膛破肚了！

original: The assembled reavers howl and jeer
translate: 聚集的劫掠者们嚎叫着，嘲弄着，

original: I'll be the one doing the gutting!
translate: 开膛破肚的人会是我！

original: Silence!
translate: 安静！

original: Kala yells in a voice that could cut glass
translate: 卡菈用足以划破玻璃的声音喊道，

original: The reavers scuttle fearfully into the shadows
translate: 劫掠者们惊恐地窜入阴影之中，

original: I am bored
translate: 我无聊了，

original: You will entertain me; One way or another
translate: 你得给我找点乐子；不管用什么方式，

original: Did one of my 'siblings' send you?
translate: 是我的哪个“兄弟姐妹”派你来的？

original: Siblings?
translate: 兄弟姐妹？

original: Did Oleg’s tablets command him to send you?
translate: 是奥列格的石板命令他派你来的？

original: Or was it the Butcher perhaps?
translate: 还是说，是屠夫？

original: So busy with the slaughter that he sends others to do his knife-work for him?
translate: 忙着屠杀，忙到派别人来替他动刀子？

original: I bring word from Oleg
translate: 我带来了奥列格的口信，

original: He reminds you that he holds the Whispering Tablets and that you owe him your allegiance
translate: 他提醒你，低语石板在他手里，你该向他效忠，

original: The woman flashes her disfigured teeth in a savage gesture
translate: 那女人露出畸形的牙齿，做出一个野蛮的表情，

original: Oleg is king of shit
translate: 奥列格是狗屎之王，

original: The old man’s teeth have gone soft and if the Father’s eye is still on any of us, it’s not on Oleg any more
translate: “那老家伙的牙口已经软了，如果【父亲】的目光还落在我们谁身上，那也绝不是奥列格了”，

original: That’s for sure
translate: 那是肯定的，

original: Kala picks her nails with a dagger for a moment
translate: 卡菈用匕首剔了剔指甲，过了一会儿，

original: But what do I care
translate: 但我管他呢，

original: Butcher will sort him out soon enough and then he’ll become Fathers favorite
translate: 屠夫很快就会收拾掉他，然后他就会成为【父亲】的宠儿，

original: The Butcher will kill Oleg?
translate: 屠夫会杀了奥列格？

original: She grins widely
translate: 她咧嘴大笑，

original: Oh there will be plenty of blood and guts
translate: 哦，会有大把的血和内脏，

original: Don’t you worry!
translate: 你不用担心！

original: But more than anything it’s those tablets Oleg has the Butcher wants
translate: 但屠夫最想要的，是奥列格手里的那些石板，

original: Them ‘Whispering Tablets’
translate: 那些‘低语石板’，

original: The Butcher knows the brethren will flock to him if he nabs them from Oleg
translate: 屠夫知道，只要他从奥列格那里抢到石板，弟兄们就会蜂拥到他身边，

original: And he’s plenty strong to take them but he’s afraid Father will get mad if he makes too much of a mess getting them
translate: 他足够强大，能抢到石板，但他怕弄得太血腥，【父亲】会发怒，

original: What are you saying?
translate: 你在说什么？

original: Father wants order in the flock and he wants the one with the tablet to enforce it
translate: 【父亲】希望羊群里有秩序，他希望持有石板的人来维持秩序，

original: Thing is, Oleg is too weak
translate: “问题是，奥列格太弱了”，

original: The only one strong enough to force us all in line is the Butcher but he don’t have the tablets!
translate: 唯一强大到能让我们所有人乖乖听话的是屠夫，但他没有石板！

original: See?
translate: 明白吗？

original: It’s the irony of the fates
translate: 这就是命运的讽刺，

original: If the tablets were to fall into Butcher’s hands however… the bloodshed would be magnificent
translate: 不过，要是石板落到屠夫手里……那流血场面可就壮观了，

original: Her eyes seem to glimmer for a moment
translate: 她的眼睛似乎闪烁了一下，

original: I think I'll just kill you!
translate: 我想我还是直接杀了你！

original: I'll be leaving then
translate: 那我这就走，

original: Kala erupts into cruel laughter
translate: 卡菈爆发出残忍的笑声，

original: Oh I'll join him and we’ll make a bloody mess of Oleg!
translate: 哦，我会加入他，我们会把奥列格弄得血肉模糊！

original: And when the Butcher feasts on the old fool’s liver he’ll be so certain he’s won Father’s favor that he might not even feel my blade between his ribs
translate: 等屠夫享用那老傻瓜的肝脏时，他会确信自己赢得了【父亲】的宠爱，甚至可能感觉不到我的刀插进他的肋骨间，

original: There will be only one of us left standing tonight!
translate: 今晚，我们中只会剩下一个人站着！

original: Kala and her brood of reavers stalk their way into the main plaza of the city where they are met by the Butcher and his lot
translate: 卡菈和她那群劫掠者潜行进入城市的主广场，在那里遇到了屠夫和他的人马，

original: You follow from a distance and see the two reavers exchange words
translate: 你远远跟着，看到两个劫掠者交谈了几句，

original: Then Kala slips into the mist and darkness and the Butcher forms his men up in a crude line
translate: 随后卡菈溜进迷雾与黑暗中，屠夫则把他的人排成一条粗糙的阵线，

original: Soon, Oleg and his band approach from the east
translate: “很快，奥列格和他的队伍从东边逼近”，
