original: Stalking cautiously into the plaza, towards the Butchers line, the two men exchange a few crude words before an arrow flies and carnage erupts
translate: “他们小心翼翼地潜行进入广场，朝着屠夫的阵线走去，两人粗鲁地交谈了几句，随后一支箭飞来，屠杀爆发”，

original: As the fiend tears his ‘brother’s’ heart from his chest, he howls in triumph
translate: “当那恶魔从他‘兄弟’的胸膛里扯出心脏时，他胜利地嚎叫起来”，

original: Then from out of the shadows, Kala and her brood fall upon the remainder of Olegs men from the rear
translate: “接着，卡菈和她那群人从阴影中冲出，从后方袭击奥列格剩余的人马”，

original: The slaughter is complete and total and not a soul from Oleg’s band is left standing
translate: 屠杀彻底而完全，奥列格的队伍中无一人幸存，

original: As the screams die down and all the savagery is sated, the ground is slick with blood and gore
translate: “当惨叫声平息，所有的暴行得到满足，地面被血和内脏浸得滑腻”，

original: Kala stalks the battlefield like a savage animal, making short work of the wounded while the Butcher stands panting in the center of the plaza
translate: “卡菈像一头野蛮的动物在战场上踱步，迅速解决掉伤者，而屠夫则站在广场中央喘着粗气”，

original: In the darkness their eyes fix upon you, burning like white hot coals
translate: “黑暗中，他们的眼睛盯着你，像烧得白热的煤块”，

original: Kala raises her bloody sword towards you and lets out an inhuman scream
translate: 卡菈举起她血淋淋的剑指向你，发出一声非人的尖叫，

original: It seems they have one more sacrifice yet to make!
translate: 看来他们还有一个祭品要献上！

original: Butcher’s too strong for either of us to slay on our own, but if I join Oleg
translate: “屠夫太强了，我们谁也无法单独杀死他，但如果我加入奥列格”，

original: A smirk spreads across her face
translate: 她脸上露出得意的笑容，

original: Together we’ll lay that pile of fat low and then I’ll deal with Oleg myself!
translate: 我们一起把那堆肥肉放倒，然后我再亲自对付奥列格！

original: Father will finally see that, all along, it was little Kala who was deserving of his love!
translate: “【父亲】最终会明白，一直以来，值得他爱的是小卡菈！”

original: Kala lets out a terrible war-cry and her brood joins her with weapons raised
translate: 卡菈发出一声可怕的战吼，她那群人举起武器响应，

original: Kala and her band of reavers stalk their way into the main plaza of the city where they are met by Oleg and his lot
translate: 卡菈和她那帮劫掠者潜行进入城市的主广场，在那里遇到了奥列格和他的人马，

original: Then Kala slips into the mist and darkness and the Oleg forms his men up in a crude line
translate: 随后卡菈溜进迷雾与黑暗中，奥列格则把他的人排成一条粗糙的阵线，

original: Before long, the Butcher and his band approach from the west
translate: “不久，屠夫和他的队伍从西边逼近”，

original: He gives a mighty bellow as he spots Oleg and charges head-long into the fray with his men at his heels
translate: 他一看到奥列格就发出震天的吼叫，带着手下径直冲入战团，

original: Then from out of the shadows, Kala and her brood fall upon the Butcher’s lot
translate: “接着，卡菈和她那群人从阴影中冲出，扑向屠夫的人马”，

original: With the reflexes of a serpent, Kala lunges at the Butcher and plunges her blade into his fat neck
translate: “卡菈以蛇一般的反应扑向屠夫，将刀刺入他肥胖的脖子”，

original: A killing blow for sure, but Kala’s eyes widen in terror as, instead of toppling over, the Butcher grabs her by the knife-arm
translate: “这无疑是致命一击，但卡菈惊恐地瞪大了眼睛，因为屠夫非但没有倒下，反而抓住了她持刀的手臂”，

original: She desperately tries to pry her arm loose but to no avail!
translate: 她拼命想挣脱手臂，却无济于事！

original: Blood sprays from the Butcher’s mouth as he strains from the effort and with a wet, sickening snap, Kala’s arm is torn from her body
translate: “屠夫用力时，鲜血从他口中喷出，随着一声湿漉漉、令人作呕的撕裂声，卡菈的手臂被从她身体上扯了下来”，

original: They both collapse - dead
translate: 两人都倒下了——死了，

original: Suddenly all is quiet
translate: 突然，一切都安静了，

original: You’ve defeated the three Reaver chieftains
translate: 你击败了三位劫掠者首领，

original: Now Father awaits
translate: 现在，【父亲】在等着，

original: You?!
Out with it!
translate: 快说！

original: Her eyes narrow
translate: 她眯起眼睛，

original: Yes!
translate: 没错！

original: I sense it!
translate: 我感觉到了！

original: There is blood in the water and soon there will be blood in the streets!
translate: 水里有了血腥味，很快街头也会血流成河！

original: Finally we will be done with this petty bickering and Father will let us join him in the keep!
translate: 我们终于可以结束这无聊的争吵，【父亲】会让我们进入要塞与他团聚！

original: The Butcher wants you to join him in stamping out Oleg
translate: 屠夫想让你加入他，一起消灭奥列格，

original: Oleg asks you to join him against the Butcher!
translate: 奥列格请你加入他对抗屠夫！

original: My patience is running low
translate: 我的耐心快耗尽了，

original: I just wanted to ask some questions
translate: 我只是想问几个问题，

original: Hmm, I see
translate: “嗯，我明白了”，

original: And when the Butcher feast’s on the old fool’s liver he’ll be so certain he’s won Father’s favor that he might not even feel my blade between his ribs
translate: 等屠夫享用那老傻瓜的肝脏时，他会确信自己赢得了【父亲】的宠爱，甚至可能感觉不到我的刀插进他的肋骨间，

original: Blood sprays from the Butcher’s mouth as the strains from the effort and with a wet, sickening snap, Kala’s arm is torn from her body
translate: “屠夫用力时，鲜血从他口中喷出，随着一声湿漉漉、令人作呕的撕裂声，卡菈的手臂被从她身体上扯了下来”，

original: #HorrynReaverChief3
translate: #HorrynReaverChief3

original: I’ll drink your marrow and tear your flesh!!!
translate: 我要喝你的骨髓，撕碎你的血肉！！！

original: Give them to me!
translate: 把它们给我！

original: His meaty hands tremble with excitement as he greedily takes the tablets from you
translate: 他贪婪地从你手中接过石板，肥厚的手因兴奋而颤抖。

original: Mesmerized, he traces the grotesque carvings with fat, blood-smeared fingers
translate: “他着迷地用沾满血迹的粗胖手指描摹着那些怪诞的雕刻。”

original: I hear you!
translate: 我听见你了！

original: Your will shall be done!
translate: 你的意志必将实现！

original: The assembled reavers gather around and begin a low, droning chant
translate: “聚集的劫掠者们围拢过来，开始低声吟唱起单调的圣歌。”

original: He looks up at you with black eyes
translate: 他用黑色的眼睛抬头看着你。

original: My ascent to Father’s side begins!
translate: 我升往【父亲】身边之路开始了！

original: Soon I’ll join him in the keep
translate: 很快我就要在要塞中与他团聚。

original: All that is left is the sacrifice of the firstborn
translate: 剩下的就是献祭长子了。

original: Go to Kala!
translate: 去找卡菈！

original: Tell her she will be at my side and together we’ll make an offering of Oleg and his pathetic little band!
translate: 告诉她，她将站在我身边，我们一起把奥列格和他那可怜的小团伙献祭！

original: Tell her this is a knife night!
translate: 告诉她，这是个刀锋之夜！

original: A red night!
translate: 一个血红之夜！

original: Now go!
translate: 现在就去！

original: We must make ready!
translate: 我们必须做好准备！

original: A beast of a man, bald and covered in crude sailor’s tattoos stands wide legged on the stairs of the desecrated temple
translate: “一个野兽般的男人，秃头，身上布满粗犷的水手纹身，双腿叉开站在被亵渎的神殿台阶上。”

original: You come to the Butcher willingly?
translate: 你自愿来找屠夫？

original: Like some lamb crawling into the mouth of a wolf?
translate: 就像羔羊爬进狼口？

original: Perhaps there is something about you?
translate: 或许你有些特别之处？

original: Tell me
translate: 告诉我

original: Why are you here?
translate: 你为什么来这里？

original: Oleg sent me to remind you that as long as he holds the Whispering Tablets you owe him allegiance
translate: 奥列格派我来提醒你，只要他持有低语石板，你就得效忠于他。

original: I am the butcher of the weak
translate: 我是弱者的屠夫。

original: It has fallen to me to cull those that are too feeble to join Father in the keep
translate: 剔除那些太过软弱、无法在要塞中追随【父亲】的人，这任务落到了我头上。

original: With cleaver and fire I do his bidding like an obedient son
translate: 我用屠刀和火焰执行他的命令，如同一个顺从的儿子。

original: Or dog
translate: 或者说，一条狗。

original: But he’ll call upon me soon enough and I’ll be at his side doing the holy work inside the keep!
translate: 但他很快就会召唤我，我将站在他身边，在要塞内执行神圣的使命！

original: The Butcher’s eyes flicker to the tall walls of the keep to the south
translate: 屠夫的目光瞟向南边要塞的高墙。

original: I just have to bring my upstart siblings in line first
translate: 我只需先让我那些狂妄自大的兄弟姐妹们乖乖听话。

original: Father hates bickering
translate: 【父亲】讨厌争吵。

original: How do you intend to do that?
translate: 你打算怎么做？

original: Kala and Oleg
translate: 卡菈和奥列格。

original: He spits in disgust
translate: 他厌恶地啐了一口。

original: Kala is fierce
translate: 卡菈很凶猛。

original: Caught many of the weak and gave me the ones Father could not use
translate: 她抓了许多弱者，把【父亲】用不上的那些交给了我。

original: I’ll not soon forget that
translate: 我不会很快忘记这点。

original: Her sin now is idleness
translate: 她现在的罪过是懒散。

original: She and her brood sit there in their rat hole on the docks bored and stewing
translate: 她和她的那群人坐在码头那个老鼠洞里，百无聊赖，满腹怨气。

original: I’ll deal with her in time
translate: 我迟早会收拾她。

original: Oleg is first
translate: 奥列格是第一个。

original: What of him?
translate: 他怎么了？

original: He’s the oldest of us - and the weakest
translate: 他是我们中最年长的——也是最弱的。

original: However he was also the one to drag the Whispering Tablets from the seas
translate: 然而，也是他从海里捞出了低语石板。

original: Came up in his nets when he was fishing and he was the first to hear the word from the Deep
translate: 他打渔时石板随渔网浮出水面，他是第一个听到深渊之语的人。

original: He may have had his role to play but it’s over for him now
translate: 他或许曾有自己的角色要扮演，但现在对他来说已经结束了。

original: It’s time the tablets came to their rightful owner
translate: 是时候让石板归于它们真正的主人了。

original: It’s time they came to me
translate: 是时候它们归我了。

original: And all the rest of the brethren will flock to me and Father will see I’m the one deserving of his love
translate: 所有其他弟兄都会聚集到我身边，【父亲】会看到我才是配得上他宠爱的人。

original: Not that gray fool!
translate: 而不是那个白发蠢货！

original: The Butcher’s eyes narrow predatorily
translate: 屠夫的眼睛掠食般地眯了起来。

original: What are you thinking?
translate: 你在想什么？

original: The man’s laughter booms throughout the plaza
translate: 那人的笑声在广场上回荡。

original: Is that what he said?
translate: 他是这么说的？

original: That decrepit old fool is owed nothing except my axe through his head
translate: 那个老朽的蠢货什么都不配得到，只配我斧头劈进他的脑袋。

original: Father favors me and me alone and that piss-stinking old man shall be my offering to him
translate: 【父亲】只宠爱我一人，那个尿骚味的老家伙将成为我献给他的祭品。

original: But I’ll give him this
translate: 但我会给他这个。

original: The Whispering Tablets do indeed hold the word from the Deep
translate: 低语石板确实承载着深渊之语。

original: The brethren will flock to whomever possesses them
translate: 弟兄们会聚集到任何持有它们的人身边。

original: And Father’s favor will follow
translate: 而【父亲】的宠爱也会随之而来。

original: You may have a role to play in this yet
translate: 你或许还能在这件事中扮演角色。

original: I see it in your face - around your eyes
translate: 我从你脸上看出来了——在你眼睛周围。

original: Seek out the Whispering Tablets
translate: 找到低语石板。

original: Oleg hoards them well but I know where
translate: 奥列格把它们藏得很好，但我知道在哪。

original: There are tunnels under his lodge
translate: 他的住处下面有地道。

original: Deep tunnels
translate: 很深的地道。

original: A canny cutter like you would do well in looking for the hidden entrance
translate: 像你这样机灵的割喉者，寻找隐藏入口应该很在行。

original: That is if you don’t mind wading through more shit
translate: 前提是你不介意再蹚过更多污秽。

original: Could you be more clear?
translate: 你能说得更清楚些吗？

original: I already have the tablets!
translate: 我已经拿到石板了！

original: I've had enough of you madmen!
translate: 我受够你们这些疯子了！

original: You’ll find a way
translate: 你会找到办法的。

original: I smell it on you
translate: 我从你身上闻到了。

original: Go now!
translate: 现在就去！

original: Find the tablets and bring them to me - Quick and quiet
translate: 找到石板，带给我——要快，要安静。

original: There will be plenty bloodshed but I will be the one spilling the blood once the tablets are safe in my hands
translate: 会有很多流血，但一旦石板安全落入我手，流血的人将是我。

original: Now, begone!
translate: “现在，滚吧！”

original: Have you talked to Kala?!
translate: 你和卡菈谈过了吗？！

original: You must go to her!!
translate: 你必须去找她！！

original: Talk!
translate: 说话！

original: I have the tablets!
translate: 我有石板！

original: #HorrynReaverChief3
translate: #HorrynReaverChief3

original: Mesmerized, he traces the grotesque carvings with fat, blood smeared fingers
translate: “他着迷地用沾满血迹的粗胖手指描摹着那些怪诞的雕刻。”

original: WHat now?
translate: 现在怎么办？

original: #HorrynSewerJack
translate: #霍林下水道清理工

original: My badge indeed!
translate: 我的徽章，没错！

original: The sewerjack grabs the badge and tries to wipe some of the grime off of it
translate: 下水道清理工抓起徽章，试图擦掉上面的一些污垢。

original: For a moment there I thought I was in real trouble
translate: 有那么一瞬间，我以为我真的遇到麻烦了。

original: Don’t you come closer now!
translate: 现在别靠近我！

original: The man cautioned as he brandished a mace
translate: 男人挥舞着钉头锤警告道。

original: He’s covered with grime from top to toe and looks oddly at home in the muck and filth of the sewers
translate: 他从头到脚沾满污垢，在污水和污秽的下水道里看起来出奇地自在。

original: The odd man squints as he raises his lantern to get a better look at you
translate: 这个古怪的男人眯起眼睛，举起提灯想更清楚地看看你。

original: Though you’re certainly not one of those mad-men!
translate: 不过你肯定不是那些疯子中的一员！

original: Begging your pardon my lord but one can’t be careful enough these days
translate: 请原谅，大人，但如今再怎么小心也不为过。

original: Begging your pardon my lady but one can’t be careful enough these days
translate: 请原谅，女士，但如今再怎么小心也不为过。

original: I'm glad you can tell the difference
translate: 我很高兴你能看出区别。

original: Spend too much time down here and your mind begins playing tricks on you
translate: 在这里待太久，你的脑子就会开始跟你开玩笑。

original: Such is the life of a sewerjack I suppose
translate: 我想，这就是下水道清理工的生活吧。

original: Not that I’m much of one; having lost my badge of office and all!
translate: 不过我也不算什么正经的清理工；毕竟我把职务徽章都丢了！

original: Badge of office?
translate: 职务徽章？

original: Do you mean this?
translate: 你是指这个吗？

original: Offer badge
translate: 出示徽章

original: A brass badge that us sewerjack wear
translate: 我们下水道清理工佩戴的黄铜徽章。

original: Tis’ a badge of our authority you know!
translate: 这可是我们权威的象征，你知道！

original: The man puffs out his chest in the slightest
translate: 男人微微挺起胸膛。

original: But as I said, mine’s lost
translate: “但我说了，我的丢了。”

original: Must have dropped it when I scuffled with that pack of vermin near those side tunnels to the east of here
translate: 一定是我在东边那些侧隧道附近和那群虫群搏斗时掉的。

original: The man half-turns and shows you a large bloody gash torn across his back
translate: 男人半转过身，让你看他背上一条血淋淋的大口子。

original: I think I've already found it!
translate: 我想我已经找到了！

original: I'll keep an eye out
translate: 我会留意的。

original: But do you mind answering some questions first?
translate: 但你介意先回答几个问题吗？

original: These here sewers are a bit of a maze until you get to know them
translate: 这些下水道有点像迷宫，直到你熟悉它们。

original: But for the most part, as long you stay away from the beasties and muck, you can’t really get too lost
translate: “但大体上，只要你远离那些野兽和污物，就不会真的迷路。”

original: All tunnels loop back to the central cisterns one way of another
translate: 所有隧道最终都会以某种方式绕回中央蓄水池。

original: And if you’re real clever-like, you can use the tunnels to get almost anywhere in the city
translate: “如果你足够聪明，就可以利用这些隧道到达城里的几乎任何地方。”

original: There are three outlets that empty into the harbor
translate: 有三个出口通向港口。

original: The westernmost of them has planks that allow you to sneak out onto the docks
translate: 最西边的那个铺有木板，可以让你偷偷溜到码头上。

original: And if you need to get to the area by the temple, now that it’s blocked off and all, there is a side tunnel in the western part of the sewers that leads into a cellar near the temple
translate: “如果你需要去神殿附近，现在那里被封锁了，下水道西边有一条侧隧道通往神殿附近的一个地窖。”

original: Finally, in the south-eastern tunnels, you might come across a staircase leading down into the Underhalls
translate: “最后，在东南边的隧道里，你可能会遇到一段通往地下大厅的楼梯。”

original: All kinds of queer folk can be found there
translate: 那里能找到各种古怪的人。

original: Thieves and cutthroats and the like
translate: 小偷、杀手之类的。

original: They¨'re not Reavers though, mind you
translate: “不过，他们可不是劫掠者，记住。”

original: I hear they even have some kind of market down there where all kinds of wares can be had
translate: 我听说他们那里甚至有个集市，能买到各种货物。

original: But I’d give them a wide berth if I were you
translate: 但我是你的话，就会离他们远远的。

original: Best not take any chances
translate: 最好别冒险。

original: Ask away!
translate: 尽管问吧！

original: What's a 'sewerjack' exactly?
translate: “下水道清理工”到底是什么？

original: What's the layout of this place?
translate: 这个地方的布局是怎样的？

original: Any Reavers down here?
translate: 这里有劫掠者吗？

original: I have to get going
translate: 我得走了。

original: They do come down here from time to time!
translate: 他们确实时不时会下来！

original: It seems they’ve barricaded the city above off into sections and it seems using the sewers might be the easiest way to move between areas
translate: 看来他们把上面的城市封锁成了几个区域，而利用下水道可能是区域间移动最便捷的方式。

original: A small group of them came through here a few days ago
translate: 几天前，他们一小队人经过这里。

original: I shadowed them for a bit but then they rounded a corner and before I could catch up to them they were gone
translate: 我跟踪了他们一会儿，但他们拐过一个弯，我还没来得及跟上，他们就消失了。

original: Just like that
translate: 就那么消失了。

original: For the life of me, I don’t understand where they could’ve gone
translate: “我死活想不明白他们能去哪儿。”

original: I lost their trail north east of here, in the bend where the fungus-patches grow
translate: “我在东北边那个长着菌丛的弯道附近跟丢了他们。”

original: You’re back!
translate: 你回来了！

original: Good to see you’ve kept your wits about you down here!
translate: 很高兴看到你在这里还保持着清醒！

original: I need to ask you some questions!
translate: 我需要问你几个问题！

original: I found your badge
translate: 我找到了你的徽章。

original: Now listen, I don’t have anything of value on me except what’s in my noggin
translate: “听着，我身上除了脑子里的东西，没什么值钱的。”

original: Noone knows these sewers better than me, see, and the least I can do for you is give you this
translate: “没人比我更了解这些下水道，你看，我至少能为你做的就是给你这个。”

original: He pulls out a piece of paper, scribbles some notes on it and hands it to you
translate: “他掏出一张纸，在上面草草画了些标记，然后递给你。”

original: It appears to be a map of the sewers
translate: 看起来是一张下水道地图。

original: This should make it easier for you to find your way around here
translate: 这应该能让你更容易在这里找到路。

original: I have some questions now
translate: 我现在有几个问题。

original: They pay us to keep the sewers free of vermin
translate: 他们付钱让我们清理下水道里的虫群。

original: Human and otherwise!
translate: 人类和其他害虫！

original: The man chuckles
translate: 男人轻笑起来。

original: Used to be it was fine work if you could stand the smell!
translate: 以前，只要能忍受臭味，这可是份好差事！

original: But not lately
translate: 但最近不行了。

original: Sewers been overrun with beasties!
translate: 下水道被野兽泛滥了！

original: Overgrown, cruel, dangerous… monsters!
translate: “巨大、残忍、危险的……怪物！”

original: I slew a leech the size of my leg the other day and a pack of rats nearly ended me just hours ago
translate: 前几天我杀了一条跟我腿一样粗的水蛭，几小时前一群老鼠差点要了我的命。

original: What's causing it?
translate: 是什么原因造成的？

original: Causing it?
translate: 原因？

original: the man says dreamily as if he’d never stopped to consider it before
translate: 男人恍惚地说，仿佛他以前从未停下来想过这个问题。

original: Sometimes… sometimes I wonder if… if it’s not been like this all along?
translate: 有时候……有时候我在想，是不是……是不是一直就是这样？

original: I mean, it hasn’t
translate: “我的意思是，并不是。”

original: As I said: the darkness plays tricks on you down here
translate: 我说了：黑暗会在这里跟你开玩笑。

original: Why are you still down here?
translate: 你为什么还待在这里？

original: The man seems to collect his thoughts again
translate: 男人似乎重新整理了一下思绪。

original: I know these tunnels like the back of my hand and with the carnage going on above, this place is as safe as any I reckon
translate: “我对这些隧道了如指掌，而且上面正在大屠杀，我觉得这里跟任何地方一样安全。”

original: Those Reavers are dangerous people and I’d rather take my chances down here for now
translate: 那些劫掠者很危险，我宁愿暂时在这里碰碰运气。

original: Begging your pardon my Lord but one can’t be careful enough these days
translate: 请原谅，大人，但如今再怎么小心也不为过。

original: Begging your pardon my Lady but one can’t be careful enough these days
translate: 请原谅，女士，但如今再怎么小心也不为过。

original: #HorrynSewersEntrance
translate: #霍林下水道入口

original: You peer into the dark depths below
translate: 你凝视着下方黑暗的深渊。

original: The stench of raw sewage assaults your olfactory organs with such force that you struggle to keep your last meal down
translate: 未经处理的污水的恶臭猛烈冲击着你的嗅觉器官，让你拼命忍住才没把上一顿饭吐出来。

original: Kat looks up at you pale-faced
translate: 卡蒂脸色苍白地抬头看着你。

original: You can’t be seriou…“ Before she manages to finish the sentence she whirls around and vomits
translate: “你不是认真的吧……”她话还没说完，就猛地转过身呕吐起来。

original: Rolands laughter booms
translate: 罗兰的笑声轰然响起。

original: What's wrong girl?
translate: “怎么了，姑娘？”

original: Lost your appetite for adventure?
translate: “对冒险失去胃口了？”

original: You clamber down the grimy ladder and emerge into a series of vaulted tunnels
translate: 你爬下满是污垢的梯子，进入一系列拱形隧道。

original: A thick bubbling greenish-brown stew lazily floats by you
translate: 一股冒着泡的浓稠绿褐色污物懒洋洋地从你身边漂过。

original: A river of filth expertly channeled away by the city-spanning sewer-system
translate: 一条由遍布全城的下水道系统巧妙引流的污秽之河。

original: I wonder if the craftsmen of today still possess the knowledge to build tunnels such as these?
translate: “不知道如今的工匠是否还拥有建造这种隧道的知识？”

original: Iben muses
translate: 伊本沉思道。

original: The Gallian Empire has become an empire of caretakers
translate: 伽里安帝国已经变成了一个看守者的帝国。

original: A ‘custodial empire’ who no longer builds
translate: 一个不再建设的“保管帝国”。

original: Only frantically tries to fight off that great conqueror ‘decay’
translate: 只是疯狂地试图抵御那位伟大的征服者——“衰败”。

original: No?
translate: 不是吗？

original: You doubt the builders and craftsmen of today are even capable of such feats of engineering anymore
translate: 你怀疑如今的建造者和工匠是否还有能力完成这样的工程壮举。

original: Continue on your way
translate: 继续前进。

original: #HorrynSewersMap
translate: 霍林下水道地图

original: Sewer Map
translate: 下水道地图

original: The hand-drawn map has the following legend on the back
translate: 手绘地图背面有如下图例

original: Were we met. 2 - Something strange is going on near the fongos. 3 - Tunnels to underhalls
translate: 我们相遇之处。2 - 方戈斯附近正发生怪事。3 - 通往地下大厅的隧道

original: Watch out for thives. 4 - Outlet to harbor. 5 - Leds to cellar near tempel
translate: 小心盗贼。4 - 通往港口的出口。5 - 通往神殿附近的地窖

original: X - Ladder to surfes
translate: X - 通往地面的梯子

original: #HorrynSmugglerAlchemistScene
translate: #HorrynSmugglerAlchemistScene

original: A tall, hook-nosed man with eyes like glowing coals and a thick mane of shaggy, black hair is intently staring at a snake wrapped around his forearm as he slowly lowers a small mouse towards its gaping maw
translate: 一个高个子、鹰钩鼻的男人，眼睛像燃烧的煤块，浓密的黑色乱发像鬃毛一样，正专注地盯着缠在他前臂上的一条蛇，同时慢慢地将一只小老鼠放向它张开的嘴

original: Ahem
translate: 嗯哼，

original: The man gives a start and both he and the snake hisses annoyed at you
translate: 男人吓了一跳，他和蛇都恼怒地对你发出嘶嘶声

original: Insolent!
translate: 无礼！

original: Can’t you see I’m busy?!
translate: 你没看见我正忙着吗？！

original: As he talks, he palms the mouse and in a feat of prestidigitation, it seems to disappear
translate: 他一边说话，一边用手掌藏起老鼠，仿佛变戏法一样，老鼠似乎消失了

original: The snake tastes the air greedily and slithers into the sleeve of his robe and up his arm
translate: 蛇贪婪地品尝着空气，蜿蜒钻进他长袍的袖子里，沿着手臂向上爬

original: I just came to trade
translate: 我只是来做交易的

original: Not until you finish your task
translate: 等你完成任务再说

original: Now be off and do not return until you have a bag of disgusting fungi for me!
translate: 现在走吧，除非你给我带来一袋恶心的菌类，否则别回来！

original: Not so quickly
translate: 别这么快

original: The man’s eyes narrow as a menacing smile creeps across his pale face
translate: 男人眯起眼睛，苍白的脸上浮现出一丝威胁的微笑

original: Seeing as you are new here, your value is slightly above nil
translate: 鉴于你是新来的，你的价值略高于零

original: I’ll say this much
translate: 我就说这么多

original: If you wish to peruse my wares you must first perform the smallest of tasks for me
translate: 如果你想浏览我的货物，你必须先为我完成一件最小的任务

original: I require a rare and highly toxic alchemical ingredient that grows in these underhalls
translate: 我需要一种生长在这些地下大厅里的稀有且剧毒的炼金材料

original: The caps from the ‘Calivexis’ fungus - Commonly known as ‘vomit cups’
translate: 来自“卡利维克斯”菌的菌盖——俗称“呕吐杯”

original: Beyond being a prized ingredient for poison-makers, it also stinks like nothing you’ve ever encountered
translate: 除了是制毒师珍视的材料外，它的臭味也是你从未遇到过的

original: That sounds unpleasant
translate: 听起来很不愉快

original: Oh it is indeed!
translate: 哦，确实如此！

original: That is part of the reason I’m asking you to do it!
translate: 这就是我让你去做的部分原因！

original: The other reason is they’ve become more difficult to harvest
translate: 另一个原因是它们变得更难采集了

original: You see, they grow in caves right outside these very halls
translate: 你看，它们就生长在这些大厅外面的洞穴里

original: That’s indeed why I have momentarily taken up residence here
translate: 这确实是我暂时住在这里的原因

original: But
translate: 但是

original: But the caves connect to domains lorded over by one of these ‘Reaver’ chieftains
translate: 但是这些洞穴连接着由这些“劫掠者”首领之一统治的区域

original: That Oleg fellow
translate: 那个叫奥列格的家伙

original: To keep things civil, the Queen has sealed off the cave and forbidden anyone to enter it
translate: 为了维持秩序，女王封锁了洞穴，禁止任何人进入

original: She would be most irate if I were to disobey her
translate: 如果我违抗她，她会非常愤怒

original: You however are free to feign the fool’s innocence
translate: 然而，你可以假装是无辜的傻瓜

original: How do I get to these caves?
translate: 我怎么去这些洞穴？

original: The entrance to the caves is a barred gate at the end of a long hall of columns
translate: 洞穴的入口是一扇栅栏门，在一条长长的柱廊尽头

original: It lies just west of the Queen’s court
translate: 它就在女王宫廷的西边

original: There is a sentry patrolling the area and you’ll do well to avoid him
translate: 那里有一个哨兵在巡逻，你最好避开他

original: Once you pass the gate and enter the cave, you’ll find a flooded chamber with exits leading left and right
translate: 一旦你通过大门进入洞穴，你会发现一个被水淹没的房间，左右两边都有出口

original: Take the left one!
translate: 走左边那个！

original: The right one leads to Olegs domain and I dare say it’s best avoided
translate: 右边那个通向奥列格的领地，我敢说最好避开

original: I'll see what I can do
translate: 我看看我能做些什么

original: Run along now!
translate: 快去吧！

original: I require a small bag of them
translate: 我需要一小袋

original: Indeed, if you are fast and discreet, I’ll even throw in a small bag of gold
translate: 确实，如果你动作快且谨慎，我甚至会额外给你一小袋金币

original: Off you go now!
translate: 你现在就出发吧！

original: Marvelous!
translate: 太棒了！

original: You’ve proven most useful
translate: 你证明了自己非常有用

original: Esteban gingerly places the fungi in an airtight jar and throws you a small purse of gold
translate: 埃斯特班小心翼翼地把菌类放进一个密封罐里，然后扔给你一小袋金币

original: And remember
translate: 记住

original: Not a word to the queen of rodents about our little agreement
translate: 关于我们的小协议，对那个啮齿类女王一个字也别提

original: The snake hisses at you
translate: 蛇对你发出嘶嘶声

original: I wish to see your wares now
translate: 我现在想看看你的货物

original: I'll be on my way then
translate: 那我走了

original: The man is apprehensively poking a pile of papers with a stick
translate: 男人正用一根棍子不安地戳着一堆纸

original: Where’d that little bastard go?
translate: 那个小混蛋跑哪儿去了？

original: Let me see your wares!
translate: 让我看看你的货物！

original: I have your vomit cups!
translate: 我带来了你的呕吐杯！

original: I have only the finest wares
translate: 我只有最好的货物

original: #HorrynSmugglerArmandScene
translate: #霍林走私者阿曼德场景

original: The fuck do you want?
translate: 你他妈想干嘛？

original: Armand’s eyes narrow threateningly as you approach
translate: 当你靠近时，阿曼德威胁地眯起眼睛，

original: What's the fastest way out of the rat maze?
translate: 怎么最快走出这老鼠迷宫？

original: Afraid of the dark are you?
translate: 怕黑是吗？

original: Don’t like the rats nipping at your heels?
translate: 不喜欢老鼠咬你的脚后跟？

original: Well I suggest you get the fuck back to whereever you came from
translate: 那我建议你他妈滚回你来的地方，

original: Go north, east, north, east and then north again
translate: "往北，东，北，东，然后再往北"

original: And don’t come back!
translate: 别再回来了！

original: #HorrynSmugglerArtPeddlerScene
translate: #霍林走私者古董商人场景

original: Ah, surprised to find a man of such taste in a place like this, are you?
translate: 啊，在这种地方遇到如此有品味的人，很惊讶吧？

original: He chuckles sadly
translate: 他悲伤地轻笑一声

original: I once sold my wares in the Silver Halls of Vauul
translate: 我曾经在瓦乌尔银厅区出售我的货物

original: Only the very richest would even be allowed across the threshold of my establishment
translate: 只有最富有的人才能跨过我店铺的门槛

original: Alas, for some reason I cannot fathom, the Empire took a dislike to the way I conducted my business, and I had to find a more…discreet location
translate: 唉，出于某种我无法理解的原因，帝国对我做生意的方式产生了反感，我不得不找一个更……隐蔽的地方

original: The man clears his throat nervously
translate: 男人紧张地清了清嗓子

original: Put simply, the Underhalls are the perfect venue for a man of my caliber to blossom without the prying eyes of tax-collectors and Inquisitors
translate: 简单来说，地下大厅是像我这样有才干的人大展身手的最佳场所，没有税吏和审判官的窥探

original: The scenery isn’t exactly ideal, but I am resigned to suffer in silence!
translate: 这里的景色并不理想，但我已决心默默忍受！

original: Mind if I ask some more questions?
translate: 介意我再问几个问题吗？

original: You come across a conspicuously well-dressed man selling what appear to be an odd assortment of precious items and pieces of art
translate: 你遇到一个衣着显眼考究的男人，他正在出售一些看起来稀奇古怪的珍贵物品和艺术品

original: He looks remarkably out of place amongst the shadows of the Underhalls
translate: 在地下大厅的阴影中，他显得格外格格不入

original: Hail and well met!
translate: 幸会，幸会！

original: He proclaims, tipping his hat at you
translate: 他宣称道，向你抬了抬帽子

original: Tis plain to me that you are people with a keen understanding of the finer things!
translate: 我一眼就看出，你们是对高雅事物有着敏锐理解的人！

original: What say you to peruse some of the finest art in all-the Empire?
translate: 来看看全帝国最精美的艺术品如何？

original: Even the most superficial of examinations reveals that most of these “art pieces” are barely competent knock-offs and forgeries, a fact that the art dealer seems utterly unashamed by
translate: 即使是最粗略的检查也能发现，这些“艺术品”大多是勉强合格的仿制品和赝品，而这位古董商人对此似乎毫不羞愧

original: His place here makes a lot more sense now
translate: 他现在待在这里就合理多了

original: I might have some questions for you!
translate: 我可能有些问题要问你！

original: The dealer tips his hat once more
translate: 商人再次抬了抬帽子

original: I would be most delighted to assist!
translate: 我很乐意效劳！

original: What would you like to know?
translate: 你想知道什么？

original: Let me see if I have any artifacts for you
translate: 让我看看有没有什么古物给你

original: I wish to see your wares!
translate: 我想看看你的货物！

original: What do you do here beyond selling fake art?
translate: 除了卖假艺术品，你在这里还做什么？

original: If it isn’t my favorite soon-to-be customers!
translate: 这不是我最喜欢的准顾客们嘛！

original: How may I assist you?
translate: 我能帮你什么？

original: Let's talk a bit
translate: 我们聊聊吧

original: An athame
translate: 一把仪式匕首

original: The man whispers as he carefully strokes the blade
translate: 男人一边低语，一边小心地抚摸着刀刃

original: We can only begin to imagine the acts that have been performed with this blade!
translate: 我们只能想象这把刀刃曾经历过怎样的仪式！

original: How does 1200 sound?
translate: 1200金币怎么样？

original: Deal!
translate: 成交！

original: No thanks
translate: 不了，谢谢

original: Suit yourself
translate: 随你便

original: Do you have anything else?
translate: 你还有别的东西吗？

original: I have this!
translate: 我有这个！

original: Show the Nautical Guild Seal
translate: 展示航海公会印章

original: How about this?
translate: 这个怎么样？

original: Show the idol from the Santa Fury treasure
translate: 展示圣怒号宝藏中的神像

original: Look at this!
translate: 看看这个！

original: Show the black dagger from under the lighthouse
translate: 展示灯塔下方的黑色匕首

original: Not for now
translate: 暂时不了

original: Let's talk a bit instead
translate: 我们还是聊聊吧

original: Could these be worth something?
translate: 这些东西可能值点钱吗？

original: Show the Reaver Tablets
translate: 展示劫掠者石板

original: I’d be more than happy to see any curios you might be carrying!
translate: 我非常乐意看看你们可能携带的任何奇物！

original: The merchant rubs his hands together
translate: 商人搓着双手

original: Extraordinary!
translate: 非凡！

original: The man’s eyes seem to glitter with an unnatural sheen for a moment
translate: 男人的眼睛一瞬间闪烁着不自然的光芒

original: Now this is the type of item I came here to find
translate: 这才是我来这里寻找的那种物品

original: It’s… uncanny
translate: 这……太诡异了

original: He turns it slowly over in his hands
translate: 他把它在手中慢慢翻转

original: I must have it! 1500 gold!
translate: 我必须得到它！1500金币！

original: Ahh, I know this!
translate: 啊，我知道这个！

original: The man eagerly examines the seal
translate: 男人急切地检查着印章

original: This is a Captain’s seal from the Nautical Guild
translate: 这是航海行会的船长印章

original: They are quite protective of these, you know
translate: 你知道，他们对此非常保护

original: I’ll give you 1000 gold for it!
translate: 我出1000金币买下它！

original: The man traces the intricate carvings with his fingertips
translate: 男人用指尖描摹着复杂的雕刻

original: This is ancient, you know
translate: 你知道，这是古老的

original: Carved in a time before
translate: 雕刻于远古时代

original: No, it’s best not to think of such things
translate: 不，最好别去想这些事

original: What I can tell you is that there are certain collectors who would pay a great deal for these!
translate: 我能告诉你的是，有些收藏家愿意为这些出大价钱！

original: How does 1000 gold sound?
translate: 1000金币听起来如何？

original: You have a gut feeling these might still prove useful!
translate: 你有一种直觉，这些东西可能还有用！

original: The dealer lets out a dramatic sigh
translate: 商人夸张地叹了口气

original: Alas, some of my wares may be of…questionable origin…but make no mistake, I am no con-artist!
translate: 唉，我的一些货物可能来源……可疑……但别误会，我可不是骗子！

original: I am simply a man with a passion for strange and unusual objects!
translate: 我只是一个对奇异物品充满热情的人！

original: And the Outer Isles just so happens to be rife with them!
translate: 而外岛恰好盛产这些东西！

original: Explorers find them, sell them on to me, and I make sure they reach buyers on the mainland for a… fair price
translate: 探险家们找到它们，卖给我，我再确保它们以……公道的价格送到大陆买家手中

original: Is that legal?
translate: 这合法吗？

original: Let me see if I have anything
translate: 让我看看我有什么

original: Not exactly
translate: 不完全是

original: But it pays well and keeps my customers happy, so if you find any strange items on your travels, be sure to bring them to me!
translate: 但报酬丰厚，还能让我的顾客满意，所以如果你们在旅途中发现任何奇怪的物品，一定要带给我！

original: He looks around conspiratorially
translate: 他鬼鬼祟祟地环顾四周

original: Discreetly, of course
translate: 当然，要谨慎行事

original: #HorrynSmugglerBlacksmithScene
translate: #HorrynSmugglerBlacksmithScene

original: Eh, when yer mother squeezes you out in the shit and mud of the back-streets of Adler’s and leaves ya fer dead, yer fucked for choices ...I was lucky enough ta be taken in by the Queen herself
translate: 呃，当你老娘在鹰盔堡后巷的屎尿烂泥里把你生下来，然后丢下你等死的时候，你他妈根本没得选……我算是走运，被女王本人收留了

original: Saw something in me did she
translate: 她在我身上看到了什么，确实

original: Probably wouldn’t be standin’ ere if not for ‘er!
translate: 要不是她，我大概不会站在这儿！

original: His gaze goes distant in the way that teen boys sometime do
translate: 他的目光变得遥远，就像十几岁的男孩有时会的那样

original: You were saying?
translate: 你刚才说什么来着？

original: Anyway, seens as I am ‘ere an all, if ya happen across any weapons ya ain’t partial to on your travels, make sure to drop by, eh?
translate: 总之，既然我都在这儿了，要是你在旅途中碰到什么不喜欢的武器，记得过来找我，嗯？

original: I’m sure to have sumthin’ more your style
translate: 我肯定有更合你口味的东西

original: You stop before a slightly disheveled young man selling a variety of weapons and armor in a dimly lit corner of the hall
translate: 你在一处昏暗的大厅角落里停下，面前是一个略显邋遢的年轻人，正在售卖各种武器和护甲

original: ‘Ello there, free-sword!
translate: 哟，自由佣兵！

original: He flashes you a wasteland of spice-stained teeth in what passes for a smile
translate: 他向你咧嘴一笑，露出一口被香料染得斑驳的烂牙，权当是微笑

original: Fancy takin’ a look at some of ma wares?
translate: 想看看我的货物吗？

original: Come back any time, free-sword!
translate: 随时再来，自由佣兵！

original: An remember, there ain’t no better way of getting respect than what cold steel buys ya!
translate: 记住，要想赢得尊重，没什么比冷钢买来的更管用！

original: I'd like to ask some questions
translate: 我想问些问题

original: What can I do for ya, free-sword?
translate: 能为你做什么，自由佣兵？

original: Welcome back, Free-sword!
translate: 欢迎回来，自由佣兵！

original: Need something to stick someone with?
translate: 需要什么东西捅人吗？

original: #HorrynSmugglerFoodScene
translate: #霍林走私者食物场景

original: She offers you another kind smile
translate: 她又对你露出了一个友善的微笑

original: You may ask whatever you wish!
translate: 你想问什么都可以！

original: Is this really safe to eat?
translate: 这真的能吃吗？

original: Show me your wares!
translate: 让我看看你的货物！

original: Of course it is!
translate: 当然能吃！

original: she replies hastily as you stare at the food with no small amount of dubiousness
translate: 她急忙回答，而你则满腹狐疑地盯着食物

original: Everythin’ you see here is the finest, almost-fresh grub the Empire has to offer!
translate: “你在这儿看到的所有东西，都是帝国能提供的最好的、几乎新鲜的吃食！”

original: Almost-fresh?
translate: 几乎新鲜？

original: She shifts uncomfortably
translate: 她不自在地挪了挪身子

original: Well, no ones ever lived to complain, if that’s what yer worried about!
translate: “嗯，从来没人活下来抱怨过，如果你担心的是这个的话！”

original: The scent of foreign spices and not-quite-familiar meats assaults your senses as you approach what appears to be a food stall
translate: 当你走近一个看似食物摊位的地方时，异国香料和不太熟悉的肉味冲击着你的感官

original: Your interest is noted by a red-faced woman who welcomes you with a wide, genuine smile
translate: “一位红脸女人注意到了你的兴趣，她带着灿烂真诚的笑容欢迎你”

original: Fine day for some grub, wouldn’t you say?
translate: “吃点儿东西的好日子，你说呢？”

original: she grins, gesturing to the array of ‘mysterious’ meats on display
translate: “她咧嘴笑着，指了指展示的一排‘神秘’肉类”

original: I’ve got somethin’ for everyone, from the delectable richness of city-pork to the more comforting subtlety of the finest roof-chicken!
translate: “我这儿有适合每个人的东西，从美味的城市猪肉到更令人舒心的最上等屋顶鸡肉！”

original: And people actually eat this?
translate: 人们真的吃这个？

original: Like ravenous rats!
translate: 像饿极了的老鼠一样！

original: Trick is, if you season it just right, it all tastes like chicken anyways
translate: “诀窍是，只要你调味得当，它们吃起来都像鸡肉”

original: So they keep filling my purse and I keep filling their bellies
translate: 所以他们不断填满我的钱袋，而我不断填饱他们的肚子

original: Hmm, if you say so
translate: “嗯，既然你这么说”

original: Welcome back!
translate: 欢迎回来！

original: Need somethin’ to fill yer belly for the road ahead?
translate: 需要点儿东西填饱肚子好上路吗？

original: #HorrynSmugglerSentrySpotted
translate: #霍林走私者哨兵被发现

original: Hey!
translate: 嘿！

original: You’re not welcome in this part of the underhalls!
translate: 地下大厅的这片区域不欢迎你！

original: Queen’s orders
translate: 女王的命令

original: Get out of here and don’t let me catch you here again!
translate: 离开这里，别让我再抓到你！

original: The guard firmly escorts you out of the area and deposits you in the guard-room by the entrance
translate: 守卫坚决地将你护送出该区域，并将你带到入口处的警卫室。

original: #HorrynSmugglerTrinketsScene
translate: #霍林走私者小饰品场景,

original: The stall before you is crammed full of various trinkets and knick-knacks precariously balanced atop of one another
translate: 你面前的摊位上塞满了各种小饰品和小玩意儿，它们摇摇欲坠地堆叠在一起。

original: As you approach, a wiry young man with a horribly pock-marked face offers you an excited grin
translate: 当你走近时，一个瘦削的年轻人，脸上布满可怕的麻子，兴奋地对你咧嘴一笑。

original: On the hunt for some treasure, my fellow-adventurer?
translate: 在寻找宝藏吗，我的冒险者同伴？

original: Then you’ve come to the right place!
translate: 那你来对地方了！,

original: Everythin’ you see here has been carefully collected by yours truly!
translate: 你在这里看到的一切都是本人精心收集的！,

original: he gestures to the stall
translate: 他朝摊位做了个手势。

original: You wouldn’t believe the stuff just left layin’ around out there!
translate: 你不会相信外面那些随便丢着的东西！,

original: Only the other day, I found a one-of-a-kind-necklace just discarded in the mud….it was next to a corpse, mind, but it was in no condition to argue if ya know what I mean!
translate: 就在前几天，我在泥里发现了一条独一无二的项链……提醒你一下，它就在一具尸体旁边，但你知道我的意思，它可没法跟我争辩！,

original: It is clear from the merchant’s ramblings that his way of securing his wares isn’t exactly legal
translate: 从商人的胡言乱语中可以明显看出，他获取货物的方式并不完全合法。

original: But what down here is?
translate: 但在这下面，什么又是合法的呢？,

original: You suppose it won't hurt to find out more
translate: 你觉得多了解一些也无妨。

original: Ah, the life of an adventurer is a dangerous one, but it’s worth it for loot like this!
translate: 啊，冒险者的生活是危险的，但为了这样的战利品，值得！,

original: He gestures enthusiastically to his stall
translate: 他热情地朝自己的摊位做了个手势。

original: I’ve braved some of the most disgusting sewers and dug through the trash of some of the finest men in the Empire in order to obtain such coveted wares!
translate: 为了得到这些令人垂涎的货物，我闯过一些最恶心的下水道，翻过帝国一些最优秀人物的垃圾！,

original: That sounds...interesting
translate: 听起来……挺有趣的。

original: Sadly, I can’t always be out explorin’...especially not during the day
translate: 可惜，我不能总在外面探索……尤其是在白天。

original: he coughs awkwardly
translate: 他尴尬地咳嗽了一声。

original: So if you’ve got any treasures of your own you’d be happy partin’ with, make sure to pay me a visit!
translate: 所以如果你有什么自己的宝贝愿意出手，一定要来找我！,

original: The young rogue excitedly licks his lips
translate: 年轻的游荡者兴奋地舔了舔嘴唇。

original: Want to know more about my treasures, do you?
translate: 想多了解我的宝贝，是吗？

original: I’d be happy to tell you anything you want to know!
translate: 我很乐意告诉你任何你想知道的！,

original: Where did you come across these 'treasures'?
translate: 你是在哪里发现这些“宝贝”的？

original: Let's see what you have!
translate: 让我看看你有什么！,

original: The young rascal is picking intently at a bloody scab when he excitedly notices you
translate: 那个年轻的无赖正专心地抠着一块血痂，这时他兴奋地注意到了你。

original: Welcome back, fellow-adventurer!
translate: 欢迎回来，冒险者同伴！

original: Found worthwhile loot?
translate: 找到有价值的战利品了吗？

original: On the hunt for some treasure, my fellow-adventurer
translate: 在寻找宝藏，我的冒险者同伴

original: As you try to leave crabs swarm past you
translate: 当你试图离开时，螃蟹蜂拥而过你身边，

original: They consume the strange symbol ravenously
translate: 它们贪婪地吞噬着那个奇怪的符号，

original: They leave
translate: 它们离开了，

original: Entering what appears to be a fishmongers' hall, your noses are immediately assaulted by a putrid stench far beyond the expected nautical aromas
translate: 走进一个看似鱼贩大厅的地方，一股远超预期海洋气味的腐臭立即扑鼻而来

original: The room is but dimly lit, and as shadows dance in the corners it becomes apparent that the floor in front of you is covered in parts and innards from fish and other creatures of the sea
translate: 房间光线昏暗，随着阴影在角落舞动，你面前的地板上显然铺满了鱼和其他海洋生物的残肢与内脏

original: As your eyes slowly adjust, you discern that the heaps of fetid offal have been carefully arranged into a peculiar shape
translate: 当你的眼睛慢慢适应后，你发现这些发臭的杂碎堆被精心排列成了一个奇特的形状

original: Examine the shape more closely
translate: 更仔细地检查这个形状，

original: Retching and gagging, you immediately leave
translate: you immediately leave

original: YOU PICK UP THE ITEM
translate: 你捡起了物品，

original: However, the clacking noises have become louder and more insistent
translate: 然而，咔嗒声变得更响、更急促了

original: The slick, gleaming carapaces of enormous crabs suddenly flood the room
translate: 巨大螃蟹光滑闪亮的甲壳突然涌满了房间

original: No doubt drawn in by the smell
translate: 无疑是被气味吸引来的，

original: OR SOMETHING ELSE
translate: 或是别的什么，

original: Prepare for combat!
translate: 准备战斗！

original: Striving to avoid slipping on the blood-slicked floor, you fully enter the hall and investigate the overall shape of the piles of fish guts with a discerning eye
translate: 你努力避免在血滑的地板上滑倒，完全进入大厅，用敏锐的目光调查鱼内脏堆的整体形状

original: The parts are clearly arranged into a massive spiral - an ancient symbol of fertility and the sea
translate: 这些部分显然被排列成一个巨大的螺旋——一个古老的生育与海洋的象征

original: At the center of the spiral sits a particularily bloated and decayed octopus, its arms splayed outwards in all directions
translate: 螺旋的中心有一只特别肿胀腐烂的章鱼，它的触手向四面八方摊开

original: You can hear faint clacking
translate: 你能听到微弱的咔嗒声，

original: Something seems to be moving nearby
translate: 附近似乎有什么东西在移动，

original: Further examine the octopus
translate: 进一步检查章鱼，

original: Leave, quickly
translate: 快离开

original: Like a monstrous egg, the swollen and very dead octopus sits at the center of the disgusting spiral
translate: 像一颗怪异的蛋，肿胀且死透的章鱼坐在令人作呕的螺旋中心

original: A swift kick upends it, revealing something beneath: a large, rusty key!
translate: 一脚踢翻它，露出了下面的东西：一把生锈的大钥匙！

original: Pick up the key
translate: 捡起钥匙，

original: Striving to avoid slipping on the blood-slicked floor, you fully enter the hall and investigate the overall shape of the piles of fish guts
translate: 你努力避免在血滑的地板上滑倒，完全进入大厅，调查鱼内脏堆的整体形状

original: After a few moments it strikes you - they are arranged, obviously with great care and effort, into a massive spiral
translate: 过了一会儿你突然意识到——它们显然被精心排列成了一个巨大的螺旋

original: Why, you have no idea
translate: 为什么，你毫无头绪

original: #HorrynSurvivor
translate: #霍林幸存者

original: That's what the Reavers call 'im
translate: 劫掠者们就是这么叫他的

original: Far as I know, he became the head of the Fishermen's Lodge
translate: “据我所知，他成了渔会的头儿”

original: Must be the one who turned 'em to reavin'
translate: 肯定是他把他们引上了劫掠之路

original: But I aint never seen 'im afore and I've been in Horryn my whole life
translate: 但我这辈子都住在霍林，却从没见过他

original: He must be an outsider
translate: 他一定是个外来者

original: I had another question
translate: 我还有个问题

original: We must be on our way!
translate: 我们必须上路了！

original: When the Reavers went amok, they butchered folks in the street where they found them
translate: “劫掠者发狂时，在街上见人就杀”

original: But that was only in the beginning
translate: 但那只是刚开始的时候

original: Once they had control of the city, they started dragging people from their houses, roundin' 'em up
translate: “等他们控制了城市，就开始把人从家里拖出来，集中关押”

original: Only the eldest and youngest were... finished off first
translate: 只有最老的和最小的……最先被了结

original: I can't get my head around it
translate: 我实在想不通

original: One of the Reavers made 'em let me go
translate: 有个劫掠者逼他们放了我

original: Tore me from her grasp, and told me to run to the camp north of town to tell the folks there that their loved-ones would be waitin' for 'em at the keep with
translate: “把我从她手里拽开，叫我去镇北的营地，告诉那里的人，他们的亲人会在要塞等着他们，和”

original: Father
translate: 【父亲】

original: If we don't get her back before they reach the keep, she'll be dead or worse on the morrow
translate: “如果我们不能在他们到达要塞前救回她，明天她就会死，或者更糟”

original: I need some information first
translate: 我得先问些情况

original: A gaunt figure shambles out of the fog towards you
translate: 一个枯瘦的身影从雾中蹒跚向你走来

original: The man is emaciated and covered in filth
translate: 那人瘦骨嶙峋，满身污秽

original: He looks with exhausted eyes and stops dead in his tracks as he notices you
translate: 他用疲惫的双眼望来，一看到你就僵在原地

original: His eyes wide in terror but his body too frail to flee
translate: 他惊恐地瞪大双眼，但身体太过虚弱，无力逃跑

original: Please, don't kill me!
translate: “求求你，别杀我！”

original: the withered looking man cries out, as he cowers before you
translate: “那个面容枯槁的男人喊道，在你面前畏缩着”

original: I'm Philip!
translate: 我是菲利普！

original: Just a fisherman
translate: 只是个渔夫

original: Please, help me, my wife is still trapped inside the city, and... and
translate: “求求你，帮帮我，我妻子还困在城里，而且……而且”

original: And what?
translate: 而且什么？

original: What is going inside the walls?
translate: 城墙里发生了什么？

original: I beg of you, find Natia
translate: “我求你了，找到娜蒂亚”

original: She's all I got since our boy passed!
translate: 我们的儿子死后，她就是我的一切！

original: And she yet lives... you'll know by her green dress and long, auburn hair
translate: “她还活着……你看到她穿绿裙子，一头长长的赤褐色头发，就能认出来”

original: If there are survivors left inside Horryn, it is my duty to save them
translate: “如果霍林城里还有幸存者，我有责任救他们”

original: Driina says, as you turn to go
translate: 德莉娜在你转身要走时说道

original: Survivors or not - this stinks of a trap
translate: 不管有没有幸存者——这闻起来像个陷阱

original: Roland interjects
translate: 罗兰插嘴道

original: As if to echo the man's woe, a lone wail rings out from somewhere behind the city walls
translate: “仿佛在回应这人的悲痛，一声孤寂的哀号从城墙后的某处传来”

original: The Fishermen's Lodge!
translate: 渔会！

original: Some of my fellows joined - to share in the catch and ensure none went hungry!
translate: 我的一些伙计加入了——为了分享渔获，确保没人挨饿！

original: I thought about joining myself, as their nets seemed overflowing as of late
translate: “我自己也想过加入，因为近来他们的渔网似乎总是满满的”

original: Since Father took charge, I been told
translate: “自从【父亲】掌权后，我听人说”

original: But how can the Lodge go from sharing fish to reaving their own kin?
translate: 但渔会怎么会从分享渔获变成劫掠自己的同胞？

original: The man frets uncomfortably
translate: 男人不安地焦躁起来

original: Reavers?
translate: 劫掠者？

original: Father?
translate: 【父亲】？

original: The keep?
translate: 要塞？

original: Lodges?
translate: 渔会？

original: I need to move on!
translate: 我得继续赶路了！

original: How can men reach such cruel lows?
translate: 人怎么能堕落到如此残忍的地步？

original: I known some of 'em for years, good, honest fishermen - now they've gone mad!
translate: “我认识他们中有些人好多年了，善良、诚实的渔夫——现在他们都疯了！”

original: It's this 'Father' I tell you!
translate: 我告诉你，就是这个‘【父亲】’！

original: Him and his outsiders brought this upon us and poisoned the lodges!
translate: 他和他的外来者把这灾祸带给我们，毒害了渔会！

original: Now they hold the whole bloody city!
translate: 现在他们控制了整座该死的城市！

original: That is, it’s bloody bedlam in there!
translate: “就是说，里面简直是血腥的疯人院！”

original: Seems to me a few of them, the meanest and hardest are the ones who answer directly to the Father
translate: “在我看来，他们中有几个最卑鄙、最凶残的家伙，是直接听命于【父亲】的”

original: They’re the ones who took Natia and they seem to be holed up in the keep
translate: 就是他们抓走了娜蒂亚，他们似乎盘踞在要塞里

original: Only going outside to get more bodies!
translate: 只为了抓更多人才出来！

original: The man shudders
translate: 男人打了个寒颤

original: The ones that still roam the streets ‘ave all lost their minds it seems!
translate: 那些还在街上游荡的家伙，似乎全都疯了！

original: All of a sudden they started fighting each other and for a while, it seemed they were more concerned with killing each other instead of razing the city!
translate: “突然间他们开始自相残杀，有一阵子，他们似乎更热衷于互相残杀，而不是摧毁城市！”

original: Now they’re all holed up in each their corner of the city it seems
translate: 现在他们似乎都龟缩在城里的各个角落

original: Did you find Natia!?
translate: 你找到娜蒂亚了吗！？

original: What news inside the walls?!
translate: 城墙里有什么消息？！

original: Philip asks, trembling
translate: “菲利普颤抖着问道”

original: Have you found Natia yet?
translate: 你找到娜蒂亚了吗？

original: Please!
translate: 求你了！

original: I fear it might be too late already!
translate: 我怕已经太迟了！

original: I have some questions first
translate: 我先问几个问题

original: Those that are taken were dragged to the keep, and all the remains of 'em are screams... such screams
translate: “被抓走的人都被拖到要塞，他们留下的只有尖叫……那样的尖叫”

original: My wife an' I hid fer days with no food or water
translate: 我和妻子躲了好几天，没吃没喝

original: By this morning, we couldn't take it no more and made a run for it
translate: “到了今早，我们再也受不了了，就往外跑”

original: They got us before we even got within sight of the gate
translate: 我们连大门的影子都没看到，就被他们抓住了

original: They beat us like mangy dogs, even my Natia... told us Father was waiting for us
translate: “他们像打癞皮狗一样打我们，连我的娜蒂亚也……告诉我们【父亲】在等着我们”

original: Bloody, forsaken bastards - they'll be dragging her away as we speak!
translate: “该死的、天杀的混蛋——我们说话这会儿，他们正把她拖走！”

original: By the dead, you have to save her for me!
translate: “以死者之名，你一定要替我救她！”

original: She's beautiful!
translate: 她很美！

original: She’s got long auburn hair!
translate: 她有一头长长的赤褐色头发！

original: But you got away?
translate: 但你自己逃出来了？

original: The Governors keep!
translate: 总督的要塞！

original: Lies in the south-western part of town
translate: 位于镇子的西南部

original: You enter it from the docks
translate: 从码头那边进去

original: But they have it all sealed up now!
translate: 但现在他们把它完全封锁了！

original: Ain’t no way yer getting in there now!
translate: 你现在根本进不去！

original: That’s why you have to get to my Natia before they take her there!
translate: 所以你得在他们把她带到那里之前，找到我的娜蒂亚！

original: Please, we’ve wasted too much time already!
translate: “求你了，我们已经浪费太多时间了！”

original: #HorrynSurvivorCora
translate: #霍林幸存者珂菈

original: You cautiously begin to search for any potential hiding places but have no luck
translate: 你小心翼翼地开始搜寻任何可能的藏身之处，但一无所获

original: Kat sighs, her expression troubled “What a shame
translate: 卡蒂叹了口气，表情忧虑：“真可惜”

original: She looked like she could have used our help
translate: 她看起来本可以用得上我们的帮助

original: Give up and leave
translate: 放弃并离开

original: You cautiously begin to search for any potential hiding places
translate: 你小心翼翼地开始搜寻任何可能的藏身之处

original: The girl must be here somewhere
translate: 那女孩一定在这附近某处

original: You startle as a cry of pain echoes behind you
translate: 你吓了一跳，身后传来一声痛苦的叫喊

original: You little shit!
translate: 你这个小混蛋！

original: Roland shouts, clutching his hand to his chest as he backs away from a pile of trash
translate: 罗兰喊道，他紧抓着手贴在胸前，从一堆垃圾旁退开

original: The girl darts out a second later, trying to slip between you
translate: 片刻后，女孩冲了出来，试图从你们中间溜走

original: Kat throws herself at the girl and grabs hold of her before she can escape
translate: 卡蒂扑向女孩，在她逃脱之前抓住了她

original: Determined not to be outmaneuvered again, you grab hold of the girl’s arm before she can make her escape
translate: 你下定决心不再被耍，趁女孩还没逃脱，一把抓住了她的胳膊

original: Sharp teeth dig into the flesh of your hand as you reach into a pile of rags
translate: 当你伸手进一堆破布时，锋利的牙齿咬进了你的手肉里

original: The girl dashes from her hiding place, trying to slip away again
translate: 女孩从藏身处冲出来，又想溜走

original: The girl struggles against your grip, snarling at you as you attempt to speak with her
translate: 女孩在你的抓握下挣扎着，在你试图和她说话时对你咆哮

original: She can be no older than 13 winters, but her emaciated frame and grime-covered skin make it hard to tell
translate: 她最多不过十三个冬天大，但她瘦弱的身躯和满是污垢的皮肤让人难以判断

original: The girl glares up at Kat with wide, scared eyes
translate: 女孩瞪大眼睛，惊恐地抬头看着卡蒂

original: Poor thing,
translate: 可怜的小家伙

original: Kat says, patting her arm, “you must be starving
translate: 卡蒂说着，拍了拍她的胳膊，“你一定饿坏了”

original: Are you hungry?
translate: 你饿吗？

original: offer some food
translate: 提供一些食物

original: I don't think I can help you right now
translate: 我想我现在帮不了你

original: You give chase through the narrow alleyways, scrambling to keep up with the agile girl, but she is too fast; she disappears into the shadows before you can catch up to her
translate: 你在狭窄的小巷中追赶，手忙脚乱地想跟上那敏捷的女孩，但她太快了；你还没追上，她就消失在阴影中

original: Search the alley
translate: 搜索小巷

original: Give up
translate: 放弃

original: It doesn’t take long for you to catch up to the girl in the maze of back alleys
translate: 没过多久，你就在迷宫般的后巷里追上了女孩

original: Cornered, she glares at you, her lips curling in a feral snarl
translate: 被逼到角落，她瞪着你，嘴唇扭曲成野性的咆哮

original: Don’t harm her!
translate: 别伤害她！

original: Kat whispers as she moves towards the girl slowly with her hands up in front of her in a disarming gesture
translate: 卡蒂低声说着，慢慢走向女孩，双手举在身前，做出解除戒备的姿态

original: As you pass the darkened alley, you feel the eyes of someone watching you
translate: 当你经过黑暗的小巷时，你感觉到有人在注视着你

original: Peering into the shadows, you can just make out the form of what appears to be a little girl in dirty, torn clothing
translate: 向阴影中窥视，你勉强能辨认出一个穿着肮脏破烂衣服的小女孩的身影

original: Before you can get a closer look, the girl flees, disappearing into the darkness beyond
translate: 你还没来得及仔细看，女孩就逃走了，消失在远处的黑暗中

original: Kat grabs your cloak
translate: 卡蒂抓住你的斗篷

original: We have to follow her!
translate: 我们必须跟着她！

original: Ignore it and move on
translate: 无视它，继续前进

original: The girl seems unwilling to talk
translate: 女孩似乎不愿说话

original: Perhaps if she had some food in her belly?
translate: 也许她肚子里有点食物的话？

original: You look around the alley, ears straining for any sign of reavers nearby
translate: 你环顾小巷，竖起耳朵倾听附近劫掠者的任何动静

original: The thought of leaving the girl behind is not a comfortable one, but it is wiser than trying to drag her through hostile territory
translate: 把女孩留下的想法让人不安，但比试图拖着她穿过敌对区域要明智

original: For now, she is as safe as she can be
translate: 眼下，她已经尽可能安全了

original: Once the Reavers started fighting amongst themselves, they blocked off the streets
translate: 劫掠者们开始内斗后，就封锁了街道

original: Made it real hard to get around unseen, but I'm no fool
translate: 这让悄悄走动变得非常困难，但我可不傻

original: Cora smiles mischievously
translate: 珂菈调皮地笑了笑

original: I suspect not
translate: 我想也是

original: She seems pleased at the compliment
translate: 她似乎对这称赞感到高兴

original: It's too dangerous and hard to travel the streets, but under them is another thing
translate: 在街上走太危险也太难了，但地下就是另一回事了

original: There’s tunnels all under the city and if you don't mind the stench and avoid the beasties, they’ll take you wherever you need to go!
translate: 城下到处都是隧道，只要你不介意臭味，避开那些小怪物，它们就能带你去任何你想去的地方！

original: Clever girl
translate: 聪明的女孩

original: The girl still seems hesitant as she looks up at you. “....Cora,
translate: 女孩抬头看着你，仍然显得犹豫。“……珂菈”

original: she says, her voice low
translate: 她低声说道

original: But I hate it, so everybody calls me Cory. ‘Cept my ma, that is
translate: 但我讨厌它，所以大家都叫我珂莉。除了我妈，那是例外

original: And where's she now?
translate: 那她现在在哪儿？

original: As soon as the question leaves your lips you realize the mistake
translate: 问题一出口，你就意识到自己说错话了

original: You don’t push for the answer and Cora does not offer one: the silence says everything
translate: 你没有追问答案，珂菈也没有给出答案：沉默说明了一切

original: Kat gently strokes the child’s hair
translate: 卡蒂轻轻抚摸着孩子的头发

original: The girl snatches the food from you like a frightened animal and wolfs it down
translate: 女孩像受惊的动物一样从你手中抢过食物，狼吞虎咽地吃了下去

original: More!
translate: 还要！

original: she growls
translate: 她咆哮道

original: Ah, so the girl has a tongue after all!
translate: 啊，原来这女孩还是会说话的！

original: Kat offers the girl a small, reassuring smile
translate: 卡蒂对女孩露出一个小小的、令人安心的微笑

original: Don’t worry, girl
translate: 别担心，姑娘

original: You can have as much as you like
translate: 你想吃多少就吃多少

original: Are you ready to answer some questions?
translate: 你准备好回答一些问题了吗？

original: The girl absentmindedly fiddles with something, but her eyes are sharp and watchful
translate: 女孩心不在焉地摆弄着什么，但她的眼睛锐利而警觉

original: No doubt she knows a lot about the town having survived here for so long
translate: 毫无疑问，她在这里生存了这么久，对镇子了解很多

original: What's your name?
translate: 你叫什么名字？

original: Tell me about the Reavers?
translate: 跟我说说劫掠者？

original: How have you been moving around?
translate: 你是怎么四处走动的？

original: The girl looks up at you with large, tear-filled eyes
translate: 女孩抬起头看着你，大眼睛里噙满泪水

original: They mostly come out at night
translate: 他们大多在晚上出来

original: Mostly
translate: 大多时候

original: she hugs her arms around herself
translate: 她双臂抱住自己

original: At least... they used ta
translate: 至少……他们以前是这样

original: I don’t see ‘em as much anymore
translate: 我现在不怎么见到他们了

original: Not since they started fightin’ each other
translate: 自从他们开始互相打斗以来就不怎么见了

original: Fighting each other?
translate: 互相打斗？

original: She nods, her gaze distant
translate: 她点点头，目光遥远

original: One day they just turned on each other
translate: 有一天他们就突然互相攻击了

original: Started killin’ their own instead of huntin’ people….now, though, they seem to be holed up in different parts of the town
translate: 开始杀自己人，而不是猎杀人们……不过现在，他们似乎分别盘踞在镇子的不同区域

original: Almost as if…as if they’re waitin’ for somethin’
translate: 几乎像是……像是在等待着什么

original: One group seems to stay on the docks
translate: 有一群人似乎待在码头

original: They’re led by a woman named Kala I think
translate: 我想他们由一个叫卡菈的女人带领

original: I saw ‘er, once
translate: 我见过她一次

original: Never knew women could look so cruel
translate: 从不知道女人可以看起来这么残忍

original: she pauses, worrying at her lower lip
translate: 她停顿了一下，咬着下唇

original: Beside’ them, there’s another band holed up in that old walled house over there - ” she points to the north-east
translate: 除了他们，还有另一伙人盘踞在那边的老围墙房子里——”她指向东北方

original: A gray-haired man called Oleg leads them
translate: 一个叫奥列格的灰发男人带领他们

original: Are there more?
translate: 还有更多吗？

original: There are men outside the temple, led by someone they call ‘the Butcher’
translate: 神殿外还有人，由一个他们称为‘屠夫’的人带领

original: They…they’ve been doing horrible things
translate: 他们……他们一直在做可怕的事情

original: Burning
translate: 焚烧

original: she trails off before shaking her head
translate: 她声音渐弱，然后摇了摇头

original: They’ve blocked off the streets leading to the temple, so those men don’t come to this part of the city anymore
translate: 他们封锁了通往神殿的街道，所以那些人不再来城市的这一带了

original: Cora offers you a slight smile
translate: 珂菈对你微微一笑

original: Her cheeks have regained a modcium of colour; it seems getting some food in her belly seems to have done her a world of good
translate: 她的脸颊恢复了一点血色；看来肚子里有了食物对她大有好处

original: I have some questions for you!
translate: 我有些问题要问你！

original: Cora is huddled in the corner, her stick-thin arms wrapped around her knees
translate: 珂菈蜷缩在角落里，枯瘦的双臂抱着膝盖

original: She slinks further into the shadows at the sight of you
translate: 一看到你，她就溜进了更深的阴影里

original: Offer some food
translate: 提供一些食物

original: #HorrynSurvivorCora
translate: #霍林幸存者珂菈

original: Tell me about the reavers?
translate: 跟我说说劫掠者？

original: Figthing each other?
translate: 互相打斗？

original: And where's she now
translate: 那她现在在哪儿，

original: #HorrynSurvivorNatia
translate: #HorrynSurvivorNatia

original: Natia is pale and drawn
translate: 娜蒂亚脸色苍白，面容憔悴。

original: She must have lost a lot of blood
translate: 她一定失了很多血。

original: However, her wound is securely bound and she is in relative safety
translate: 然而，她的伤口包扎得很牢固，而且她处于相对安全的地方。

original: If it is within her to recover, she will
translate: 如果她能恢复，她会的。

original: Do you think you could answer some questions for me?
translate: 你能回答我几个问题吗？

original: I'll help you as best I can
translate: 我会尽力帮你。

original: What can you tell me of the men who took you?
translate: 你能告诉我关于抓走你的那些人的事吗？

original: It's time to go!
translate: 该走了！

original: Farewell!
translate: 再见！

original: Natia looks tired and pale but nonetheless in much better shape than when you first met her
translate: 娜蒂亚看起来疲惫而苍白，但比起你第一次见到她时，状态已经好多了。

original: She offers a weak smile as a greeting
translate: 她露出一个虚弱的微笑作为问候。

original: I had some questions for you!
translate: 我有一些问题要问你！

original: I just wanted to check in on you!
translate: 我只是想来看看你！

original: I did hear something!
translate: 我确实听到了一些事！

original: The man who stabbed me was taking us to the keep - to ‘meet Father’
translate: 刺伤我的那个人正带我们去要塞——去“见【父亲】”。

original: But he was angry that the Reavers in the city itself had taken to infighting
translate: 但他很生气，因为城里的劫掠者们开始内斗了。

original: Split up into groups they had
translate: 他们分成了几伙。

original: Fighting over ‘tablets’ or some such items he said
translate: 他说，他们在争夺“石板”之类的东西。

original: And what’s more, I heard him say that the tablets were currently in the possession of a Reaver he called Oleg
translate: 而且，我还听到他说，那些石板现在在一个他称为奥列格的劫掠者手里。

original: Oleg the Gray or something to that effect
translate: 灰发奥列格，或者类似的名字。

original: Thank you for your help
translate: 谢谢你的帮助。

original: #HorrynSurvivorNatia
translate: #HorrynSurvivorNatia

original: Thank you so much for saving Natia’s life
translate: 非常感谢你救了娜蒂亚的命

original: I could not have gone on without her
translate: 没有她我活不下去

original: Please, take this as a token of my gratitude!
translate: “请收下这个，聊表我的感激之情！”

original: Philip produces a gold ring and offers it to you
translate: 菲利普拿出一枚金戒指递给你

original: Accept the ring
translate: 收下戒指

original: Keep it!
translate: 留着吧！

original: Decline reward
translate: 拒绝报酬

original: The man looks stunned for a moment then smiles and bows to you in gratitude
translate: 男人愣了一下，随即微笑着向你鞠躬致谢

original: You're a fool to turn down pay for a job well done
translate: 你真是个傻瓜，干了活却不要报酬

original: Roland grumbles behind you
translate: 罗兰在你身后嘟囔道

original: I have some questions before we go
translate: 走之前我有些问题要问

original: Farewell
translate: 再见

original: Ask me anything you like and I'll help you if I can!
translate: 想问什么就问吧，我会尽力帮忙！

original: Will you be safe here?
translate: 你们在这里安全吗？

original: Is there anything more you can tell me about the Reavers?
translate: 关于劫掠者，你还能告诉我些什么吗？

original: I need to get going
translate: 我得走了

original: Not much!
translate: 不多！

original: The ones you met were part of Father’s lot
translate: 你遇到的那些是【父亲】的人

original: The ones holed up in the Keep
translate: 就是盘踞在要塞里的那伙人

original: But you should ask Natia!
translate: 不过你应该去问娜蒂亚！

original: She might have heard something while they held her
translate: 她被关押时可能听到了些什么

original: Philip seems to have regained some of the color in his face
translate: 菲利普脸上似乎恢复了些血色

original: He gently wipes Natia’s brow with a wet piece of cloth
translate: 他用一块湿布轻轻擦拭着娜蒂亚的额头

original: It is good to see you again!
translate: 很高兴再见到你！

original: I needed to ask you some questions!
translate: 我需要问你些问题！

original: Just wanted to check in
translate: 只是来看看情况

original: Goodbye!
translate: 再见！

original: The city is far from safe but Natia is too severely wounded to travel
translate: 这座城市远谈不上安全，但娜蒂亚伤势太重，无法赶路

original: Besides, from what you tell me, it seems nowhere is safe on this blasted island
translate: “再说了，照你所说，这座该死的岛上似乎没有安全的地方。”

original: Besides, the Reavers seem to be holed up in their separate parts of town for now
translate: “而且，劫掠者目前似乎各自盘踞在城里的不同区域。”

original: I pray the Golden Dead will grant you the strength to prevail against them
translate: 我祈求黄金先祖赐予你力量，战胜他们

original: Good!
translate: 好！

original: The man bows deeply as he gives you the ring
translate: 男人深深鞠躬，将戒指递给你

original: There are no doubt countless golden rings in your future
translate: 你将来无疑会得到无数金戒指

original: I doubt the same can be said of these people
translate: 但这些人恐怕就没这么好运了

original: Driina offers in a lecturing tone
translate: 德莉娜用说教的语气说道

original: Besides the reavers seem to be holed up in their separate parts of town for now
translate: 而且劫掠者目前似乎各自盘踞在城里的不同区域

original: #HoundAmbush
translate: #野狗伏击

original: A sudden sound makes you stop dead in your tracks
translate: 突如其来的声响让你猛地停下脚步

original: Someone or something is charging towards you through the tall grass!
translate: 有什么人或东西正穿过高高的草丛向你冲来！

original: A woman dressed in the livery of the nautical guild emerges from the fog!
translate: 一名身穿航海行会制服的女子从雾中现身！

original: Panic is written on her face and she’s panting heavily!
translate: 她脸上写满恐慌，气喘吁吁！

original: They’re… they’re right behind me!!
translate: 它们……它们就在我身后！！

original: the woman shouts excitedly
translate: 女子激动地喊道

original: Leva!
translate: 莱瓦！

original: What’s going on?
translate: 怎么回事？

original: Kat grabs the woman by the shoulders
translate: 卡蒂抓住女子的肩膀

original: A pack of lean, growling predators emerges from the fog
translate: “一群瘦削、低吼的掠食者从雾中现身”

original: The hounds snarl and then lunge at you!
translate: 野狗们咆哮着，然后向你扑来！

original: Bless you for saving my hide!
translate: 感谢你救了我的命！

original: I saw smoke rising from the south and was making my way there when these mongrels picked up my scent!
translate: 我看到南边升起烟，正往那边赶，这些杂种狗就嗅到了我的气味！

original: I need to get going but be sure to come visit the camp - I might have some things to trade!
translate: 我得走了，但你一定要来营地看看——我可能有些东西可以交易！

original: The woman hurriedly jogs off towards the south
translate: 女子匆匆向南边慢跑而去

original: #IagoEnterCave
translate: #伊阿戈进入洞穴

original: I understand but consider this my friend
translate: 我理解，但请考虑一下，我的朋友

original: There are many who can swing a sword as well as me but there is only one who can captain a vessel like me
translate: 能像我一样挥剑的人很多，但能像我一样指挥一艘船的人只有一个

original: And I suspect it will take all my skill to get us off this island when the time is right
translate: 而且我怀疑，时机成熟时，需要我使出浑身解数才能让我们离开这座岛

original: Go be with your crew
translate: 去和你的船员们待在一起吧

original: It is hard to say how soon we can be ready to sail again
translate: 很难说我们多久能再次准备好起航

original: I’ll know more once I’ve talked to my crew
translate: 等我和我的船员们谈过之后，我会知道更多

original: Come find me later, on the deck of the ‘Maiden’ and I shall give you my best estimate
translate: “稍后来找我，在‘天候少女号’的甲板上，我会给你我最准确的估计”

original: Farewell for now my friend!
translate: 暂时再会了，我的朋友！

original: Iago bows deeply
translate: 伊阿戈深深鞠躬

original: Iago bows deeply and kisses your hand
translate: 伊阿戈深深鞠躬并亲吻你的手

original: We'll see eachother again soon
translate: 我们很快就会再见面

original: Iago stops and regards the Weathermaiden with a sad smile
translate: 伊阿戈停下脚步，带着悲伤的微笑注视着天候少女号

original: Out of all of them, she is my only true love
translate: “在她们所有人中，她是我唯一的真爱”

original: he whispers almost to himself
translate: 他几乎自言自语地低语道

original: {PLAYER}, my friend, there is work here to be done and I must be with my crew
translate: “{PLAYER}，我的朋友，这里有工作要做，我必须和我的船员们在一起”

original: Do you think we are ready to sail soon?
translate: 你觉得我们很快就能起航了吗？

original: I could use you at my side a bit longer Iago!
translate: 伊阿戈，我本可以让你在我身边多待一会儿！

original: I’ll go ahead and talk to my crew
translate: 我先去和我的船员们谈谈

original: Please, enjoy our hospitality such as it is and come find me on the ‘maiden’ when you are ready
translate: “请享受我们这微不足道的款待，等你准备好了，就来‘天候少女号’上找我”

original: As Iago rejoins his crew, a great cheer goes up from the host gathering excitedly around him
translate: “当伊阿戈回到他的船员中时，聚集在他周围的人群爆发出热烈的欢呼声”

original: You can faintly make out how he regales them with the tales of his daring escape from the dungeons of the cruel Rat Queen
translate: 你隐约能听出他正在向他们讲述自己从残忍的鼠后的地牢中大胆逃脱的故事

original: You can’t help but become infected by the crew’s excitement
translate: 你不由自主地被船员们的兴奋所感染

original: Though great danger no doubt lies ahead, it appears you will finally be able to get off this island soon
translate: “尽管前方无疑危险重重，但看来你终于很快就能离开这座岛了”

original: Though there is still bloody work waiting for you inside Horryn’s walls you have no doubt made an important ally here today
translate: 尽管霍林的城墙内还有血腥的工作等着你，但毫无疑问，你今天在这里结交了一位重要的同伴

original: Perhaps the Weathermaiden and her crew will indeed provide a way off this island sometime in the near future?
translate: 也许在不久的将来，天候少女号和她的船员们确实会提供一条离开这座岛的途径？

original: #IagoQuartermasterScene
translate: #伊阿古军需官场景

original: Farewell and adieu!
translate: 告辞了，再见！

original: Let me know if you change your mind
translate: 如果你改变主意，告诉我

original: I’ll be here
translate: 我会在这里

original: We were headed for the mainland fully laden when we became stranded here
translate: 我们满载货物驶向大陆，却在这里搁浅了

original: I have crates and crates of food but I risk having it rot on me if we don’t get out of here soon
translate: 我有一箱又一箱的食物，但如果我们不尽快离开这里，它们可能会烂在我手里

original: He gestures to a large pile of crates nearby
translate: 他指了指附近的一大堆板条箱

original: There is a famine crisis brewing in the refugee camp
translate: 难民营里正在酝酿一场饥荒危机

original: The quartermaster strokes his chin thoughtfully
translate: 军需官若有所思地抚摸着下巴

original: Look, I’d be happy to help if I could but this here cargo is not mine to give
translate: 听着，如果我能帮忙我很乐意，但这批货物不是我的，不能随便给

original: We carry it - we don’t own it
translate: 我们只是运送，并不拥有它

original: At the very least you’d have to pay me for it
translate: 至少你得付钱给我

original: I’d say 500 gold pieces would get you enough to feed your people for weeks
translate: 我觉得500金币就能让你的人吃上好几周

original: I'll pay!
translate: 我付钱！

original: That's a lot of money
translate: 那可是一大笔钱

original: Made a decision yet?
translate: 做出决定了吗？

original: I'll pay the
translate: 我付

original: Good to hear!
translate: 很好！

original: So you have the 500 gold?
translate: 那么你有500金币吗？

original: You have {ITEM} gold pieces
translate: 你有{ITEM}金币

original: Here you go!
translate: 给你！

original: I changed my mind
translate: 我改变主意了

original: For that long and riveting tale, I’ll refer you to our illustrious first mate, Zhara
translate: 关于那个漫长而引人入胜的故事，我建议你去找我们杰出的大副扎拉

original: She should be down by the ship!
translate: 她应该在船那边！

original: Alright
translate: 好的

original: One more thing
translate: 还有一件事

original: Right then!
translate: 那好！

original: Fresh swab-monkeys I see!
translate: 我看到新来的拖把猴子！

original: Just pulling your leg
translate: 开个玩笑

original: I’m Anto
translate: 我是安托

original: Quartermaster of this here fine ship
translate: 这艘好船的军需官

original: You looking for something?
translate: 你在找什么吗？

original: I might have a few odds and ends to sell off now that we’re stuck here!
translate: 既然我们困在这里，我可能有些零碎东西可以卖！

original: I was wondering
translate: 我在想

original: That might be so but it really is the best I can do for you
translate: 也许是这样，但这确实是我能为你做的最好的了

original: Show me what you have for sale!
translate: 让我看看你有什么要卖的！

original: You seem to have a lot of food supplies
translate: 你似乎有很多食物储备

original: How did you end up in this cave?
translate: 你们怎么到这个洞穴里的？

original: About the food supplies
translate: 关于食物储备

original: Ho there landlubber!
translate: 嘿，旱鸭子！

original: Back for more?
translate: 又来要更多了？

original: Let's talk!
translate: 我们谈谈！

original: Wonderful!
translate: 太好了！

original: Tell you what
translate: 这样吧

original: Since I feel bad for taking your gold, I’ll have some of my boyos help you lug the supplies back to camp
translate: 既然拿了你的金币我过意不去，我会让我的一些伙计帮你们把补给搬回营地

original: In fact, you go ahead and return to the refugees with the good news and by the time you get there, the food will be right behind you!
translate: 其实，你先回去告诉难民们这个好消息，等你到的时候，食物随后就到！

original: The quartermaster begins organizing a work-party
translate: 军需官开始组织一支搬运队

original: You should return to Frantzo with the good news
translate: 你应该带着好消息回去找弗兰佐

original: #IagoSeaCave
translate: #伊阿戈海蚀洞窟

original: Iago offers a curteous bow
translate: 伊阿戈优雅地鞠了一躬。

original: Iago kisses your hand and offers a sultry look
translate: 伊阿戈亲吻你的手，投来一个撩人的眼神。

original: Please, do not tarry too long
translate: “请别耽搁太久。”

original: Iago is thoughtfully pacing the deck of the Weathermaiden, securing cargo and tightening knots
translate: 伊阿戈若有所思地在天候少女号的甲板上踱步，固定货物，系紧绳结。

original: The banality of the tasks appear contrary to his flamboyant personality but speaks of a deep love for the vessel
translate: 这些琐碎的工作与他张扬的个性显得格格不入，却流露出他对这艘船深深的爱。

original: You look grand!
translate: 你看起来棒极了！

original: The ‘maiden’ is ship-shape and we are ready to sail at your command!
translate: “少女”号已整装待发，我们随时听候您的命令起航！

original: My poor ship on the other hand
translate: 而我那可怜的船，另一方面，

original: She won’t sail for a while yet
translate: 她一时半会儿还开不了，

original: Let's talk for a bit
translate: 我们聊一会儿吧，

original: Then let's set sail!
translate: “然后我们就起航！”

original: Hm?
How long until we are ready to sail?
translate: “我们还要多久才能起航？”

original: Let's set sail!
translate: “我们起航吧！”

original: It’s hard to say
translate: 这很难说，

original: My men are hard at work but the damage was severe and it may take quite some time yet
translate: 我的人正在努力干活，但损伤很严重，可能还需要相当长的时间，

original: Besides, you still have work in Horryn no?
translate: “再说，你在霍林不是还有事要办吗？”

original: I feel confident that the Blind Maiden will have us sailing by the time you finish your bold quest
translate: “我相信，等你完成那项大胆的任务时，盲眼少女定会让我们扬帆起航。”

original: That seems convenient
translate: “那倒挺方便的。”

original: It is how the Blind Maiden throws her bones
translate: “盲眼少女就是这么掷骨定命的。”

original: I best get going then
translate: “那我最好这就动身。”

original: Salutations!
translate: “告辞！”

original: I apologize if I appear a bit preoccupied
translate: “如果我看起来有点心不在焉，还请见谅，”

original: There is much work to be done!
translate: “还有很多活要干！”

original: Salutations {PLAYER}!
translate: “告辞，{PLAYER}！”

original: The ‘maiden’ is ready when you are!
translate: “少女”号随时待命，就等您了！

original: I'll be back!
translate: “我会回来的！”

original: Music to my ears!
translate: “这话我爱听！”

original: We are ready when you are
translate: “我们准备好了，就等你了，”

original: Just know that you must finish your business here in the sea-caves before we go
translate: “只是要知道，在我们出发前，你必须把海蚀洞窟这里的事情办完，”

original: Leave no belonging behind or errand undone
translate: “别落下任何东西，也别留下未完成的任务。”

original: My men and I will block off the land-entrance to hide the sanctuary from would-be intruders and Imperial scum
translate: “我和我的人会封锁陆上入口，把庇护所藏起来，不让潜在的入侵者和帝国军的渣滓发现。”

original: I'm ready!
translate: “我准备好了！”

original: On second thought, I have something I need to do first!
translate: “转念一想，我还有件事得先去做！”

original: Then I shall give the order!
translate: “那我这就下令！”

original: My crew and I will maneuver the ‘maiden’ out and into open waters and await you there
translate: “我和船员们会把‘少女’号驶出这里，开到开阔水域等你。”

original: Board when you are ready and, though we may be sailing towards our doom we are certainly sailing towards great adventure
translate: “准备好就登船吧，虽然我们可能正驶向灭亡，但我们无疑正驶向一场伟大的冒险。”

original: The Weathermaiden is expertly guided out of the sea-cave and now lies at anchor awaiting your arrival
translate: 天候少女号被熟练地驶出海蚀洞窟，现在正抛锚停泊，等待你的到来。

original: #IagoWeatherMaiden
translate: #伊阿戈天候少女号

original: May the wind be in our sails!
translate: 愿风助我们扬帆！

original: Ask about JoinUs
translate: 询问加入我们

original: Something about JoinUs
translate: 关于加入我们的一些事

original: More about JoinUs
translate: 更多关于加入我们

original: Finally the last part about JoinUs
translate: 最后关于加入我们的部分

original: Ah! {PLAYER}, how goes it?
translate: 啊！{PLAYER}，近来如何？

original: I trust you are finding yourself at home on the Weathermaiden?
translate: 我相信你在天候少女号上已经感觉像在家一样了吧？

original: I am indeed
translate: 我确实如此

original: Excellent!
translate: 太好了！

original: I’ve told my gallant crew to be on their best behavior!
translate: 我已经嘱咐我英勇的船员们要表现得最好！

original: If there is nothing else, I must get back to planning our journey
translate: 如果没有别的事，我得回去规划我们的航程了

original: Iago gestures towards a pile of nautical charts and maps
translate: 伊阿戈指向一堆航海图表和地图

original: We'll talk later!
translate: 我们稍后再谈！

original: How does the Maiden treat you?
translate: 天候少女号待你如何？

original: #IdraCostalPassCombat
translate: #IdraCostalPassCombat,

original: Your ploy is for naught
translate: 你的计谋毫无用处，

original: One of the cackling cultists points in your direction and a cry of alarm goes up!
translate: 一个咯咯笑的邪教徒指向你的方向，警报声响起！

original: The beast abruptly halts its feasting and eyestalks eagerly spin around
translate: 那怪物突然停止进食，眼柄急切地转动着，

original: As it spots you, it offers a deafening roar before charging!
translate: "它一发现你，就发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，然后冲了过来！"

original: You carefully pick your way forwards when movement on the top of the cliffs catches your eyes
translate: 你小心翼翼地向前走，这时悬崖顶上的动静吸引了你的目光，

original: Robed and hooded figures emerge as they appear to be dragging something towards the edge of the cliff
translate: 穿着长袍、戴着兜帽的身影出现，似乎正拖着什么东西向悬崖边走去，

original: More of the rabid dogs
translate: 又是那些疯狗，

original: spits Roland
translate: 罗兰啐道，

original: No doubt the same mad-men you saw earlier
translate: 毫无疑问就是你之前见过的那些疯子，

original: To your horror you realize what the party is dragging
translate: 你惊恐地意识到那群人拖着的是什么，

original: A naked man and woman, bound and gagged, are struggling desperately as they are mercilessly pushed towards the edge of the cliff
translate: "一个赤裸的男人和女人，被绑住并堵住嘴，正绝望地挣扎着，被无情地推向悬崖边"

original: whispers Kat, almost too loud
translate: "卡蒂低声说，声音几乎太大了"

original: We have to do something!
translate: 我们必须做点什么！，

original: Terror rises in you as you understand what is about to unfold
translate: 当你明白即将发生什么时，恐惧在你心中升起，

original: You need to do something!
translate: 你必须做点什么！，

original: Look around
translate: 环顾四周，

original: One of the cultists shouts and points towards the surf in elation
translate: 一个邪教徒兴高采烈地大喊，指向海浪，

original: Utter terror fills the eyes of the moribund couple
translate: 那对垂死的夫妇眼中充满了极度的恐惧，

original: You follow their gaze and turn to see, emerging from the surf, a creature of sheer horror
translate: "你顺着他们的目光看去，转身看到，从海浪中浮现出一个纯粹恐怖的生物"

original: Larger than any sea-creature you’ve fought so far, a hulking shape greedily waddles towards the base of the cliffs
translate: "比你迄今为止战斗过的任何海洋生物都要大，一个庞大的身影贪婪地蹒跚着向悬崖底部走去"

original: Pincers snapping and tentacles squirming greedily
translate: 钳爪开合，触手贪婪地蠕动，

original: Before you can react further the cultists hurl the two naked forms from the cliffs
translate: 你还没来得及进一步反应，邪教徒们就把那两个赤裸的身体从悬崖上扔了下去，

original: The pair impact the ground below with a sickening splat and with surprising speed, the hulking beast falls upon their remains
translate: "那两人以令人作呕的啪嗒声撞击地面，然后以惊人的速度，那巨兽扑向他们的残骸"

original: Standing transfixed you watch as the horror consumes the remains of the unfortunate wretches
translate: 你呆立着，看着那恐怖之物吞噬着不幸可怜人的残骸，

original: Sickening snaps and wet pops fill the air as the creature feeds
translate: 令人作呕的断裂声和湿漉漉的爆裂声在空气中弥漫，那生物正在进食，

original: All the while, the robed cultists stand swaying and chanting on the ledge above
translate: "与此同时，穿着长袍的邪教徒们在上方的岩架上摇摆着吟唱"

original: Attack the terror
translate: 攻击那恐怖之物，

original: Carefully attempt to sneak away
translate: 小心地试图溜走，

original: Sink to your knees and join in the worship
translate: 跪下来加入崇拜，

original: You don’t dare to breathe as you slowly pick your way back the way you came
translate: 你不敢呼吸，慢慢地沿着来时的路往回走，

original: As soon as you feel certain you’re out of sight, panic takes over and you run as fast as you can
translate: "一旦你确定自己已脱离视线，恐慌就攫住了你，你拼命地跑"

original: By the time you stop you’re utterly exhausted but at least you are still alive
translate: 当你停下来时，你已经筋疲力尽，但至少你还活着，

original: Dropping to your knees, you close your eyes and begin mock-chanting
translate: "你跪下来，闭上眼睛，开始假装吟唱"

original: Tears press on but you find that, strangely enough, words begin to take form
translate: "泪水涌出，但你发现，奇怪的是，词语开始成形"
