original: Words that make sense then and there but that you will never again be able to recall
translate: 那些在当时当地有意义，但你再也无法回忆起来的词语，

original: A spiral burns in your mind - it calls you
translate: 一个螺旋在你的脑海中燃烧——它在呼唤你，

original: A jolt passes through you and you open your eyes wide to find the horrid creature and cultists gone
translate: 一阵震动传遍全身，你睁大眼睛，发现那可怕的生物和邪教徒都消失了，

original: How long were you gone?
translate: 你离开了多久？，

original: It felt like minutes!
translate: 感觉像是几分钟！，

original: Or was it hours?
translate: 还是几个小时？，

original: Days?
translate: 几天？，

original: Nonetheless, the terror from the deep seems to have spared you
translate: "尽管如此，来自深海的恐怖似乎放过了你"

original: You rise painfully on unsteady legs and leave
translate: 你痛苦地站起来，用不稳的双腿离开，

original: #IdraCostalPassEnter
translate: #伊德拉海岸通道入口

original: Said many a short-lived young fool
translate: 许多短命的年轻傻瓜说过，

original: Let’s just be on our bloody way!
translate: 我们赶紧上路吧，该死的！

original: The winding coastal road constricts as steep cliffs press in from the north
translate: 蜿蜒的滨海道路随着北面陡峭悬崖的逼近而变窄，

original: The dense fog reduces visibility to a mere stone’s throw and you feel an uneasiness rise in your stomach
translate: 浓雾使能见度降至仅一箭之地，你感到胃里一阵不安，

original: You swallow hard as you ponder the dangers that may lay ahead
translate: 你艰难地咽了口唾沫，思忖着前方可能潜伏的危险，

original: Then, as in response to your concern, a bizarre monstrous growl echoes through the cliffs ahead of you
translate: “接着，仿佛回应你的担忧，一声怪异骇人的咆哮在前方悬崖间回荡”，

original: Frozen mid-step you scan the mists when the unmistaken stench of rotting flesh is wafted towards you
translate: 你僵在原地，扫视迷雾，这时一股不容错辨的腐肉恶臭向你飘来，

original: Something large and deadly lies ahead
translate: 前方有什么巨大而致命的东西，

original: Though you feel well armed and prepared, the creature in the mist is no doubt dangerous
translate: “尽管你觉得自己装备精良、准备充分，但迷雾中的生物无疑十分危险”，

original: Your road lies ahead but you must proceed with caution
translate: 你的道路就在前方，但你必须谨慎前行，

original: Though you do not know what lies ahead, your gut instinct tells you that you must be cautious
translate: “虽然你不知道前方有什么，但你的直觉告诉你必须小心”，

original: You wonder if perhaps for now, you would be better off spending a bit more time preparing and arming yourself?
translate: “你想，也许眼下最好再花点时间准备和武装自己？”，

original: Roland places his hand on the hilt of his weapon as he scowls into the mist
translate: 罗兰将手放在武器柄上，皱眉凝视着迷雾，

original: Keep your wits about you
translate: 保持警惕，

original: I fear we may have our work cut out for us
translate: 我担心我们可能面临艰巨的任务，

original: Whatever lies ahead I fear it is yet beyond our mettle
translate: 无论前方是什么，我担心那仍超出我们的能力，

original: What do you recommend?
translate: 你有什么建议？，

original: I don’t need your advice old man!
translate: 我不需要你的建议，老头！，

original: Not so keen to die anymore?
translate: 不再那么想死了？，

original: I say we forge ahead
translate: 我说我们继续前进，

original: But let’s keep our wits about us
translate: 但我们要保持警惕，

original: I’m inclined to agree with the big man
translate: 我倾向于同意这个大个子，

original: Kat adds as she looks around nervously
translate: 卡蒂紧张地环顾四周，补充道，

original: I say we turn back for now
translate: 我说我们现在回头，

original: We need more time to prepare for whatever lies ahead
translate: 我们需要更多时间来准备应对前方的一切，

original: I agree
translate: 我同意，

original: Roland shoots you a look that is somewhere between hurt and enraged
translate: 罗兰向你投来一个介于受伤和愤怒之间的眼神，

original: Then, as he opens his mouth to say something he’s interrupted by yet another terrible howl
translate: “接着，他刚张嘴要说什么，就被又一声可怕的嚎叫打断了”，

original: Let’s just be on our way
translate: 我们赶紧上路吧。

original: #IdraFarmerDead
translate: #伊德拉农民之死

original: The corpse of Jakub and Ella
translate: 雅库布和艾拉的尸体

original: Jakub died attempting to shield his wife with his body
translate: 雅库布试图用自己的身体保护妻子而死

original: An ax is stuck in his back
translate: 一把斧头嵌在他的背上

original: Well, well
translate: 哎呀，哎呀

original: The fine folk of Horryn wasted no time in meting out justice it seems
translate: 看来霍林的好人们毫不拖延地伸张了正义

original: Roland remarks
translate: 罗兰评论道

original: This should have been avoided
translate: 这本该避免的

original: Driina states grimly
translate: 德莉娜阴沉地说

original: It would appear the people of Horryn wasted no time in meting out justice
translate: 看来霍林的人们毫不拖延地伸张了正义

original: He got what he deserved
translate: 他罪有应得

original: We must try to do better
translate: 我们必须努力做得更好

original: He was a cruel man no doubt, but acts like these are the last thing we need right now
translate: 他无疑是个残忍的人，但像这样的行为是我们现在最不需要的

original: This camp is hanging on by a thread as it is
translate: 这个营地本就岌岌可危

original: Driina shakes her head and sighs
translate: 德莉娜摇摇头，叹了口气

original: Let's just be on our way
translate: 我们继续赶路吧

original: Acts like these are the last thing we need right now
translate: 像这样的行为是我们现在最不需要的

original: #IdraLandingHowl
translate: 伊德拉登陆点的嚎叫

original: A blood-curdling howl cuts through the fog
translate: 一声令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫划破浓雾

original: Whatever its source, it’s not far away and it sounds dangerous
translate: "不管它是什么，离得不远，而且听起来很危险"

original: It may be unwise to proceed if you are still alone and poorly armed
translate: 如果你仍然孤身一人且装备简陋，继续前进可能不明智

original: #IdraOpenWaters
translate: #伊德拉开放水域

original: The rise of the Cabal is the surest sign that the power of the Magi-Emperors is waning
translate: 秘盟的崛起是法师帝皇权力衰落的最明确迹象

original: Even a decade ago, such consolidation of power into lay-hands would be unthinkable
translate: 即使十年前，权力如此集中到世俗之人手中也是不可想象的

original: The Cabal is shrouded in secrecy and will go to any lengths to keep it that way
translate: 秘盟笼罩在秘密之中，并将不惜一切代价保持这种状态

original: What few rumors I have heard claim that certain lay-nobles and freelenders are prominent amongst their ranks
translate: 我听到的少数传闻声称，某些世俗贵族和自由民在他们的行列中地位显赫

original: Men and women of great wealth and even greater ambition
translate: 拥有巨大财富和更大野心的男男女女

original: I cannot tell you what their ultimate design is, but these people are no amatuers to power
translate: 我无法告诉你他们的最终计划是什么，但这些人绝非权力的门外汉

original: They no doubt realize what lies beneath the Priory and the impact its recovery will have on the course of the Empire
translate: 他们无疑意识到修院之下埋藏着什么，以及它的重现将对帝国进程产生的影响

original: I also believe that if they were to achieve their end-goal, it would spell disaster for us all
translate: 我也相信，如果他们达成最终目标，将给我们所有人带来灾难

original: Enough for today
translate: 今天就到此为止

original: We'll talk again later
translate: 我们稍后再谈

original: Embla sighs and picks her nails thoughtfully
translate: 恩布拉叹了口气，若有所思地抠着指甲

original: The corpse buried underneath the Priory, it… it calls out to me
translate: 埋在修院下的尸体，它……它在呼唤我

original: I cannot tell you exactly when it began but the beckoning intensified greatly once the tomb seals were broken
translate: 我无法确切告诉你它何时开始，但墓穴封印被打破后，召唤大大增强了

original: Now it’s almost unbearable and… it’s growing stronger by the day
translate: 现在几乎无法忍受，而且……它一天比一天强烈

original: But why you?
translate: 但为什么是你？

original: There are things I’m not ready to talk about
translate: 有些事情我还没准备好谈论

original: Things from my past - from when we were young together
translate: 我过去的事情——我们年轻时一起的事情

original: What I will say is that I sense certain things
translate: 我要说的是，我能感知到某些东西

original: Things that are hidden to most other people
translate: 那些对大多数人隐藏的东西

original: Some Magi see them too but I think that, unlike them, I was born with the ability
translate: 有些法师也能看到它们，但我想，与他们不同，我天生就有这种能力

original: I believe this is why the corpse calls out to me
translate: 我相信这就是尸体呼唤我的原因

original: I'm not sure I understand
translate: 我不确定我明白了

original: To be honest, I’m not sure I understand it myself
translate: 说实话，我自己也不确定是否明白

original: What I do know is that the calling I feel is real
translate: 我所知道的是，我感受到的呼唤是真实的

original: Reaching the Priory before the region succumbs to the conjunction is critical
translate: 在该地区被交汇吞噬之前到达修院至关重要

original: In fact, I fear the survival of the entire Empire hangs on it
translate: 事实上，我担心整个帝国的存亡都系于此

original: I know this and so did the Cabal
translate: 我知道这一点，秘盟也知道

original: Tell me more about the Cabal!
translate: 告诉我更多关于秘盟的事！

original: When powerful magi pass, their corpses retain much of their reticular attunement
translate: 当强大的法师去世时，他们的尸体保留了大量网状魔谐力

original: Emperors are amongst the most powerful of all magi and needless to say, their corpses are a source of great power
translate: 皇帝是所有法师中最强大的，不用说，他们的尸体是巨大力量的源泉

original: It’s not without reason the Imperial Corpses of the Eternity Vale are guarded for so jealously by the Sepulchites
translate: 葬仪修会如此小心翼翼地守护永恒谷中的帝国遗骸，并非没有理由

original: But an Emperor?
translate: 但一位皇帝？

original: Buried on Gradla?
translate: 埋在格拉德拉？

original: It sounds incredible, but as I said before, there are corpses from the earlier dynasties that have been lost to history
translate: 听起来不可思议，但正如我之前所说，有些早期王朝的尸体已湮没在历史中

original: There were Emperors that were proscribed by the Magi
translate: 有些皇帝被法师们剥夺了身份

original: It may indeed be the corpse of one of these ‘forgotten’ Emperors that has been found on Gradla
translate: 在格拉德拉发现的可能确实是这些“被遗忘”的皇帝之一的尸体

original: But there’s more
translate: 但还有更多

original: I'm almost afraid to ask
translate: 我几乎不敢问

original: Latter day Emperors are but a shadow of the rulers of old in terms of power
translate: 后世的皇帝在力量上不过是昔日统治者的影子

original: If this is truly an Emperor of the Primarian Dynasty, and it has lain undisturbed for all these millennia, the power contained within it will be immense
translate: 如果这真是一位普里马利安王朝的皇帝，并且数千年来一直未受打扰，其中蕴含的力量将是巨大的

original: Enough to remake the Empire itself - or topple it utterly
translate: 足以重塑帝国本身——或彻底推翻它

original: Powerful enough to rend reality itself?
translate: 强大到足以撕裂现实本身？

original: So it seems
translate: 看来如此

original: My belief is that the conjuncture is caused directly by the discovery of the holy corpse
translate: 我相信，这种交汇是由圣尸的发现直接引起的

original: Its raw power has drawn the attention of ‘that which lingers in darkness’ and now its tentacles are slowly closing in around us
translate: 它的原始力量吸引了“黑暗中徘徊之物”的注意，现在它的触手正慢慢向我们收拢

original: For a moment you think you hear crude chanting in the darkness
translate: 有一瞬间，你以为听到黑暗中传来粗野的吟唱

original: It must have been the wind
translate: 一定是风声

original: How do you fit into all of this?
translate: 你在这其中扮演什么角色？

original: Embla leans back and massages her temples
translate: 恩布拉向后靠去，按摩着太阳穴

original: I’m here for you when you need to talk but I agree
translate: 当你需要倾诉时我会在这里，但我同意

original: Let’s say it’s enough for today
translate: 就说今天到此为止吧

original: She stands up slowly
translate: 她慢慢站起来

original: I’m going to go lie down
translate: 我要去躺下

original: Ship-travel does not agree with me
translate: 坐船不适合我

original: The ship is alive with nervous energy as the crew scuttles back like pieces of some well-crafted machinery
translate: 船上弥漫着紧张的气氛，船员们像精密机械的零件一样忙碌穿梭

original: Though your journey is bound to be fraught with danger, there is little doubt that being back at sea has done the crew well
translate: 尽管你的旅程注定充满危险，但毫无疑问，回到海上对船员们有好处

original: Not for the monastery itself
translate: 不是为了修道院本身

original: But what was said to lie underneath it
translate: 而是据说埋藏在它下面的东西

original: Embla grasps your wrist and leans in while her voice drops ever so slightly
translate: 恩布拉抓住你的手腕，倾身靠近，声音微微压低

original: The monks built the Priory to guard something
translate: 僧侣们建造修院是为了守护某样东西

original: A grave
translate: 一座坟墓

original: An ancient tomb from the earliest days of the Empire
translate: 帝国最初期的一座古墓

original: And if the Priory’s existence was truly lost to history, it means that at some point, the very Empire itself must have aided in the conspiracy of silence
translate: 如果修院的存在真的被历史遗忘，这意味着在某个时刻，帝国本身必定参与了这场沉默的阴谋

original: But who could be buried there to warrant such extreme measures?
translate: 但谁会被埋在那里，值得采取如此极端的措施？

original: I cannot tell you exactly how I know this, but I have not a single shred of doubt
translate: 我无法确切告诉你我是如何知道的，但我没有丝毫怀疑

original: What lies buried under that priory is the corpse of a Magos-Emperor
translate: 埋在那座修院下的是一位魔法皇帝的尸体

original: Not only that, but it must be one of the first and oldest of the line
translate: 不仅如此，它必定是血脉中最初、最古老的一位

original: That can't be!
translate: 不可能！

original: It can and it is!
translate: 可能，而且就是！

original: Not all of the corpses of the first Emperors can be accounted for and interment in the Eternity Vale did not begin until centuries after Gallian’s Ascension
translate: 并非所有最初皇帝的尸体都能被找到，而且直到伽里安升天几个世纪后，永恒谷的安葬才开始

original: The Cabal knew it to be true and as do I
translate: 秘盟知道这是真的，我也知道

original: Their expedition arrived at the island of Gradla a few months ago
translate: 他们的考察队几个月前抵达了格拉德拉岛

original: I suspect they breached the tombs underneath the temple a few weeks later
translate: 我怀疑几周后他们就闯入了神殿下的墓穴

original: Whatever they found there, its reticular reverberations were powerful enough to throw all of the Outer Isles into madness
translate: 无论他们在那里发现了什么，它的网状回响强大到足以将整个外岛群投入疯狂

original: And now we're sailing into the heart of madness?
translate: 而现在我们正驶向疯狂的中心？

original: Embla smiles weakly
translate: 恩布拉虚弱地笑了笑

original: He’s calling out to me
translate: 他在呼唤我

original: I feel it in every ounce of my being
translate: 我全身的每一分每一毫都感觉到了

original: Unfortunately, I’m not the only one to hear the call
translate: 不幸的是，我不是唯一听到呼唤的人

original: Like sharks drawn to blood in the water, ‘other’ things are drawn to it as well
translate: 就像鲨鱼被水中的血腥吸引，“其他”东西也被吸引而来

original: Things from outside
translate: 来自外界的东西

original: Embla swallows hard and her voice drops to a whisper
translate: 恩布拉艰难地咽了口唾沫，声音低至耳语

original: The Dragon
translate: 龙

original: It’s awakening and its seven eyes are fixed on the Outer Isle
translate: 它正在苏醒，它的七只眼睛紧盯着外岛

original: On the Black Priory!
translate: 盯着黑修院！

original: The nearby lanterns flicker
translate: 附近的提灯闪烁

original: Crawling tendrils of madness stretch greedily towards the Priory
translate: 疯狂的爬行卷须贪婪地伸向修院

original: It hungers for the holy corpse and if it reaches it
translate: 它渴望圣尸，如果它得到的话，

original: Embla halts, and for a moment struggles to control her breathing
translate: 恩布拉停住，片刻间努力控制呼吸

original: You know I’m right
translate: 你知道我是对的

original: You can feel it in your guts
translate: 你能在直觉中感觉到

original: There is no other path out of the Outer Isles except that which leads to the Black Priory and the secrets it holds
translate: 离开外岛群没有其他路，除了那条通往黑修院及其所藏秘密的路

original: Embla slumps and sighs
translate: 恩布拉颓然叹气

original: She looks exhausted and for a moment you see her as the quiet and aloof youngling you once knew
translate: 她看起来筋疲力尽，一瞬间你看到了她曾经那个安静而疏远的少年模样

original: True to his idiom, Iago swings in on a rope in dramatic fashion, landing elegantly next to you
translate: 伊阿戈一如他的风格，戏剧性地抓着绳子荡过来，优雅地落在你身边

original: It is good to feel the wind on our faces, no?
translate: 感受风吹在脸上真好，不是吗？

original: We are about to leave the fjord and from there we may set our course north towards Gradla
translate: 我们即将离开峡湾，从那里我们可以向北航行前往格拉德拉

original: Iago scans the horizon ahead
translate: 伊阿戈扫视前方的地平线

original: The leviathan no doubt stalks us so we must be careful from now on
translate: 利维坦无疑在跟踪我们，所以从现在起我们必须小心

original: We must keep to coastal waters and pray to the Maidens that our speed will keep us safe
translate: 我们必须保持在近海水域，并向少女们祈祷，希望我们的速度能保我们安全

original: Nonetheless, we must take every precaution
translate: 尽管如此，我们必须采取一切预防措施

original: For now, I have posted double look-outs and I’ll be manning the helm myself
translate: 目前，我已安排了双倍瞭望，并将亲自掌舵

original: I trust we are in the best of hands
translate: 我相信我们得到了最好的照料

original: Indeed you are. {PLAYER}, come see me in my quarters below later if you wish to talk further
translate: 确实如此。{PLAYER}，如果你想进一步交谈，稍后到下面我的舱室来找我

original: Iago bows and leaves
translate: 伊阿戈鞠躬离开

original: It is out there
translate: 它就在那里

original: I feel it
translate: 我感觉到了

original: You turn to see Embla standing behind you
translate: 你转身看到恩布拉站在你身后

original: The leviathan
translate: 利维坦

original: It hungers
translate: 它饥饿

original: I suspect the Deep Ones called it here
translate: 我怀疑是深潜者把它召唤到这里

original: Though, who is the master and who is the servant I cannot tell
translate: 不过，谁是主人谁是仆人，我无法分辨

original: It is certainly older than them
translate: 它肯定比它们更古老

original: You owe me answers, Embla
translate: 你欠我答案，恩布拉

original: Idra is behind us and I need to know why we’re risking our lives on this fool's errand
translate: 伊德拉已被我们抛在身后，我需要知道为什么我们要为这愚蠢的差事冒生命危险

original: I do and now is as good a time as any
translate: 我确实欠你，现在正是时候

original: Embla takes you below deck and you find a small corner in the hold that is as close to privacy as can be found on the cramped vessel
translate: 恩布拉带你到甲板下，你在货舱里找到一个尽可能私密的小角落，在这拥挤的船上

original: She takes a deep breath, as if she is about to plunge into freezing water, and begins talking
translate: 她深吸一口气，仿佛要跳入冰冷的水中，然后开始讲述

original: Two years ago I was, let’s say, put on the trail of a rumor that an expedition had been mounted to the Outer Isles
translate: 两年前，可以说，我追踪到一个传闻，说有一支考察队被派往外岛群

original: More accurately, to an island north of Idra by the name of Gradla
translate: 更准确地说，是前往伊德拉以北一个叫格拉德拉的岛屿

original: It’s a cold and barren place but it is allegedly the location of an ancient monastery referred to as “the Black Priory
translate: 那是一个寒冷荒芜的地方，但据称是一座被称为“黑修院”的古老修道院所在地

original: The Black Priory?
translate: 黑修院？

original: Though you’ve never heard the name before, it echoes in your mind as if stirring old memories
translate: 尽管你以前从未听说过这个名字，它却在你脑海中回响，仿佛搅动了旧日的记忆

original: The site was built a full age into the past and for millennia it stayed unnoticed and far removed from the affairs of the empire
translate: 该地建于整整一个纪元之前，数千年来一直不为人知，远离帝国事务

original: So much so, in fact, that it virtually passed out of the historical record centuries ago
translate: 事实上，它几乎在几个世纪前就从历史记录中消失了

original: No small feat in an Empire built on the backs of its archivists and record keepers
translate: 在一个建立在档案管理员和记录保管员背上的帝国里，这绝非易事

original: And thus it would have remained if it wasn’t for the boundless ambition of a group of powerful men known as the Cabal
translate: 如果不是一群被称为秘盟的强大之人有着无限的野心，它本会一直如此

original: I don’t know who it was that whispered in their ear but something convinced them that the Black Priory was not forgotten
translate: 我不知道是谁在他们耳边低语，但有什么东西让他们相信黑修院并非被遗忘

original: It was willfully expunged
translate: 而是被故意抹去了

original: Ask!
translate: 问吧！

original: Now is the time
translate: 现在是时候了

original: What if it's the corpse of an Emperor?
translate: 如果那是皇帝的尸体呢？

original: What more can you tell me of the Cabal?
translate: 关于秘盟，你还能告诉我什么？

original: Do you know anything else about the Black Priory?
translate: 关于黑修院，你还知道别的吗？

original: Do we stand a chance at rescuing the people who were taken from Horryn?
translate: 我们有机会救出从霍林被抓走的人吗？

original: I suspect they are already dead… or worse
translate: 我怀疑他们已经死了……或者更糟

original: You lied to Markus?
translate: 你对马库斯撒谎了？

original: Would you rather I was as blunt to him as I am to you?
translate: 你宁愿我对他像对你一样直言不讳吗？

original: Better they have a sliver of hope
translate: 最好让他们留有一丝希望

translate: 马库斯和霍林人面前还有考验，心碎地面对这些对他们没有好处

translate: 确实如此，

translate: {PLAYER}，如果你想进一步交谈，稍后到下面我的舱室来找我

translate: #伊德拉难民营医务室

translate: 疾病的气味和垂死者的呻吟弥漫在临时医务室的空气中

translate: 一位年迈的牧师来回踱步，尽力照料病人

translate: 他与德莉娜交换了一个忧虑的眼神

translate: 德拉尔微微鞠躬

translate: 你知道在哪里能找到我

translate: 关于GoingOn的一些事

translate: 更多关于GoingOn的事

translate: 最后是关于GoingOn的最后一部分

translate: 年迈的牧师看到你时，脸上露出了喜色

translate: 愿亡者祝福你！

translate: 灰胡子的牧师在你走近时，若有所思地擦着手上的血

translate: “哦，请原谅，我没看到你在这儿”

original: Are you sick?
translate: 你生病了吗？

original: Fever?
translate: 发烧？

original: Stomach pains?
translate: 胃痛？

original: Bloody stool?
translate: 便血？

original: I don't think so
translate: 我想没有

translate: 我应该担心吗？

original: And upon you
translate: 也祝福你

translate: 那人检查了你的眼睛，又看了看你的嘴里

translate: “不，你看起来确实没事”

original: Sadly many are not so lucky
translate: 可悲的是，许多人没那么幸运

translate: 情况和我们怀疑的一样糟吗？

translate: 德拉尔凑近，声音压低成耳语

translate: 恐怕更糟

translate: 某种感染正在蔓延，至今我既无法用法术也无法用药剂治愈它

original: I am, in fact, at my wit's end
translate: “事实上，我已经束手无策了”

original: A note of desperation creeps into the old man’s voice
translate: 老人的声音中透出一丝绝望

translate: 营地里爆发了某种感染，至今我既无法用法术也无法用药剂治愈它

original: If I can’t find a cure, this outbreak may be the death of us all!
translate: “如果我找不到治疗方法，这场疫情可能会让我们全部丧命！”

original: Though I wouldn’t know where to start
translate: 虽然我不知道从何入手

original: That is
translate: 也就是说

original: The old man furrows his brow
translate: 老人皱起眉头

original: A woman, Hannah, came to me with her boy
translate: “一个女人，汉娜，带着她的孩子来找我”

original: Struck down by the outbreak
translate: 被疫情击倒了

original: She appeared a simple girl and when she pleaded with me to look for a folk remedy
translate: 她看起来是个单纯的姑娘，当她恳求我去寻找民间偏方时

original: I chided her for it
translate: 我为此责备了她

original: Called her foolish
translate: 说她愚蠢

original: Surely Imperial medicine would prevail!
translate: 帝国的医术肯定会奏效！

original: Perhaps I was the fool?
translate: 也许我才是那个傻瓜？

original: I wish now I had listened to her
translate: 我现在真希望当时听了她的话

original: She left camp but I think she can be found in the little cottage south of here
translate: 她离开了营地，但我想她可以在南边的小屋里找到

original: I beg you, seek her out on my behalf and hear what she has to say!
translate: “我恳求你，替我去找她，听听她怎么说！”

original: I suggest you seek out Hannah in her cottage south of camp
translate: 我建议你去营地南边的小屋找汉娜

original: She claimed to know of a folk-remedy
translate: 她声称知道一种民间偏方

original: I’m ashamed to say that this is our best chance at this point
translate: 我很惭愧地说，这是我们目前最好的机会了

original: Drahl suspiciously accepts the potion
translate: 德拉尔怀疑地接过药水

original: He grimaces as he examines the murky liquid against the light
translate: 他对着光检查浑浊的液体时，做了个鬼脸

original: These are dark days indeed when the most holy order of Sepulchites must resort to folk cures and lay medicine
translate: 这确实是黑暗的日子，连最神圣的葬仪修会都不得不求助于民间偏方和世俗医药

translate: “不过话说回来，我觉得我们此刻已经别无选择了”

original: With Driina’s help, the two clerics go from patient to patient administring the foul brew
translate: “在德莉娜的帮助下，两位牧师挨个给病人灌下那难闻的汤药”

original: Now we wait
translate: 现在我们等待

original: The old man begins going from patient to patient, administring the foul brew
translate: “老人开始挨个给病人灌下那难闻的汤药”

original: Have you found anything?
translate: 你找到什么了吗？

original: I have the medicine!
translate: 我拿到药了！

original: What do you need my child?
translate: 你需要什么，我的孩子？

original: About the outbreak
translate: 关于疫情

original: Ask about GoingOn
translate: 询问关于GoingOn

original: The effect does not take long to manifest and within hours the patients seem to be back on their feet
translate: 效果很快就显现出来，几个小时内，病人们似乎都恢复了

original: Drahl appears both relieved and pensive
translate: 德拉尔显得既宽慰又沉思

original: We, you, cured them!
translate: “我们，你，治好了他们！”

original: I was certain their lives were forfeit and yet here they walk out on their own two legs
translate: 我本来确信他们性命难保，可他们现在却自己走着出去了

original: Though at what price I wonder?
translate: 但我不知道代价是什么？

original: In any case, I took the time to gather some items that might serve you well in the trials that no doubt lie ahead of you
translate: “无论如何，我花时间收集了一些物品，它们或许能在你今后无疑会面临的考验中帮到你”

original: He hands you a collection of potion-bottles
translate: 他递给你一堆药水瓶

original: Go now
translate: 去吧

original: I’ll remain here if I am needed
translate: 如果需要，我会留在这里

original: May the Dead ever watch over you
translate: 愿亡者永远守护你

original: Driina pats the old man gently on the back
translate: 德莉娜轻轻拍了拍老人的背

original: You did well my old friend
translate: 你做得很好，我的老朋友

original: So, what news?
translate: “那么，有什么消息？”

original: Is a cure in sight?
translate: 治疗方法有眉目了吗？

original: About that
translate: 关于那个

original: No news yet but I have other questions
translate: 还没有消息，但我有其他问题

original: I do have a small surplus of supplies, yes
translate: “我确实有一些多余的物资，是的”

original: Also, if you're gravely wounded or suffering from disease and the like, I can assist you
translate: “另外，如果你受了重伤或患有疾病之类，我可以帮助你”

original: #IdraWreckRatAmbush
translate: #伊德拉沉船鼠伏击

original: Suddenly an echoing cacophony of chittering and screeching erupts from the narrow ravines around you!
translate: 突然，一阵回荡的吱吱声和尖叫声从你周围的狭窄沟壑中爆发出来！

original: A wave of mangy fur and snapping jaws dripping diseased mucus rolls towards you
translate: 一波肮脏的皮毛和滴着病态粘液的咬合下颚向你涌来

original: #IntroBerrynGuard
translate: #贝林守卫介绍

original: A guardsman dressed in the livery of the noble house Berryn
translate: 一名身穿贝林家族制服的守卫

original: The guard scowls somewhat at you
translate: 守卫对你有些怒目而视

original: Armsmaster Lyra awaits you at the main entrance
translate: 军械长莱拉在主入口等你

original: You best talk to her if you've not already done so
translate: 如果你还没和她谈过，最好去和她谈谈

original: You'll find the kitchen in the eastern end of the courtyard
translate: 厨房在庭院的东端

original: The garden and hedge-maze is to the west
translate: 花园和树篱迷宫在西边

original: And I needn't remind you that it's a poor idea to enter the maze without a lantern
translate: 而且不用我提醒你，不带提灯进入迷宫是个糟糕的主意

original: Have a good evening m'lord
translate: 晚安，大人

original: Have a good evening m'lady
translate: 晚安，夫人

original: A guardsman dressed in the livery of the noble house Berryn scowls at you
translate: 一名身穿贝林家族制服的守卫对你怒目而视，

original: #IntroCato
translate: #IntroCato

original: Cato stands - with poorly concealed effort
translate: 卡托站起身——带着难以掩饰的吃力，

original: And {PLAYER}
translate: 还有{PLAYER}，

original: You stand, and meet his gaze
translate: “你站起身，迎上他的目光”

original: Return her to me
translate: 把她还给我，

original: There is no other outcome of this affair
translate: 这件事没有别的结果，

original: Shake his hand, and leave
translate: “握了握他的手，然后离开”

original: Remain silent, and leave
translate: “保持沉默，然后离开”

original: You have my word, Cato
translate: “我向你保证，卡托”

original: LEAVE
translate: 离开

original: Cato Berryn
translate: 卡托·贝林，

original: Cato Berryn sits tall in a tasteful, but modest reception room
translate: “卡托·贝林端坐在一间雅致而简朴的会客室里”

original: He looks less imposing than you remember - and with a few more crow's feet
translate: 他看起来没你记忆中那么威严——眼角也多了几道鱼尾纹，

original: Nonetheless, he's lost none of his composure or air of casual authority
translate: “尽管如此，他的沉着和那种不经意的威严气度丝毫未减”

original: Continue
translate: 继续

original: You take a seat across a formidable desk from him
translate: 你在他对面一张气派的书桌前坐下，

original: This study, like the rest of the villa, is half-lit, giving a morose cast to its opulence
translate: “这间书房，和别墅其他地方一样，光线半明半暗，给它的奢华蒙上了一层阴郁的色彩”

original: The older man's face creases into a tired, but genuine smile, which momentarily lifts some of the room's oppressive mood
translate: “老人脸上挤出一个疲惫但真诚的微笑，暂时驱散了房间里的一些压抑气氛”

original: It's a mercy to see you again - your own man and in your prime
translate: 能再见到你真是幸事——你已独当一面，正值壮年，

original: Cato says, before a frown consumes his smile
translate: “卡托说道，随即眉头一皱，笑容消失了”

original: It's just a shame our reunion is overshadowed by the fates of those we love
translate: 只可惜我们的重逢被所爱之人的命运蒙上了阴影，

original: But perhaps, together, we can yet improve our collective circumstances?
translate: “但或许，我们联手，还能改善我们共同的处境？”

original: It's a mercy to see you again - your own woman and in your prime
translate: 能再见到你真是幸事——你已独当一面，正值盛年，

original: Why have you summoned me?
translate: 你为什么召我来？

original: So, you know my Father is dead
translate: “那么，你知道我的【父亲】已经死了”

original: Cato leans forward, hands clasped beneath his chin
translate: “卡托身体前倾，双手在下巴下交握”

original: I shan't deny it
translate: 我不否认，

original: I was saddened to hear of his passing
translate: 听到他去世的消息，我很难过，

original: Despite everything, I remember him fondly
translate: “尽管发生了那么多事，我仍对他怀有美好的回忆”

original: You drove him to drink and mercenary work
translate: 是你逼得他酗酒，去当雇佣兵，

original: No need to dwell on the past
translate: 不必沉湎于过去，

original: Cato leans back again, and his eyes go distant
translate: “卡托又向后靠去，眼神变得遥远”

original: He failed in his duties
translate: 他失职了，

original: For an arms-master, there is no greater shame than a lapse of vigilance
translate: “对一名军械长来说，没有比警惕松懈更大的耻辱了”

original: He drove himself into exile
translate: 他自我放逐，

original: Lyra shifts slightly behind Cato
translate: 莱拉在卡托身后微微动了动，

original: If he failed, then it was never possible to succeed
translate: “如果他失败了，那这件事本就绝无成功的可能”

original: Say nothing
translate: 什么也别说，

original: A pregnant pause
translate: 一阵意味深长的停顿，

original: He failed her
translate: 他辜负了她，

original: Your father's exile was a sorrow to me
translate: 你父亲的流放令我痛心，

original: Yet he could not remain in the household - for Embla's sake
translate: 但他不能留在家族里——为了恩布拉，

original: The loss of a mother is tragedy enough, without being reminded of it
translate: “失去母亲已是莫大的悲剧，无需再被时时提醒”

original: Embla?
translate: 恩布拉？

original: Do not hide behind your daughter
translate: 别拿你女儿当挡箭牌，

original: The past is done with!
translate: 过去的事已经过去了！

original: Tell me why I'm here!
translate: 告诉我为什么叫我来！

original: That may be so
translate: 或许如此，

original: But it is done
translate: 但事已至此，

original: I regret his loyalty could not be rewarded
translate: 我很遗憾他的忠诚未能得到回报，

original: Sometimes...the tapestry's weave is not so easy to discern
translate: 有时候……命运之网的编织并不那么容易看清，

original: Cato's face is still mild, yet you sense his tone hardening
translate: “卡托的脸色依旧温和，但你感觉到他的语气强硬起来”

original: Fine
translate: 好吧，

original: I'm sure we've both moved on
translate: 我相信我们都向前看了，

original: By exiling him, you condemned me as well
translate: “你流放了他，也等于判了我的罪”

original: Your anger is understandable
translate: 你的愤怒可以理解，

original: The hardships you must have suffered on the road are written in your face
translate: 你在路上必定吃了不少苦，都写在脸上了，

original: Such is the cost of mercenary work, I suppose
translate: “我想，这就是雇佣兵生涯的代价吧”

original: But do not presume to understand the forces that were at play
translate: 但别自以为能理解当时起作用的那些力量，

original: And still are
translate: 而且至今仍在起作用，

original: Just tell me why I'm here, old man!
translate: “直接告诉我为什么叫我来，老头！”

original: Cato is caught off-guard for a moment, before letting out a deep breath
translate: “卡托一时措手不及，然后深深叹了口气”

original: Then the years have bestoweed you with wisdom
translate: 看来岁月赋予了你智慧，

original: I am glad, for it has forsaken the House of Berryn
translate: “我很欣慰，因为贝林家族已被智慧抛弃”

original: Why have you called me here?
translate: 你为什么叫我来？

original: Embla is missing
translate: 恩布拉失踪了，

original: Cato's voice quivers momentarily, betraying his stoic features
translate: “卡托的声音一时颤抖，出卖了他坚忍的表情”

original: Now I beg of you, {PLAYER}
translate: “现在我恳求你，{PLAYER}”

original: Help me find my daughter
translate: 帮我找到我的女儿，

original: Help her return home, where she belongs
translate: “帮她回家，回到她所属的地方”

original: Why me?
translate: 为什么是我？

original: What's happened to her?
translate: 她出了什么事？

original: Is it not obvious?
translate: 这还不明显吗？

original: You've clearly grown to inherit your fathers resourcefulness - and besides - Embla has trusted you since before either of you could speak
translate: 你显然继承了你父亲的足智多谋——再说——恩布拉从你们俩还不会说话时就信任你，

original: And now the fool has got herself into trouble?
translate: 现在那个傻瓜自己惹上麻烦了？

original: She left without notice, a week ago
translate: “她一周前不告而别”

original: From the scant clues we had, we believe she boarded a ship bound for one of the Outer Isles, Idra
translate: “根据我们掌握的零星线索，我们相信她登上了前往外岛群之一的伊德拉的船”

original: She went of her own free will
translate: 她是自愿走的，

original: At the time I thought little of it
translate: 当时我没太在意，

original: Cato begins to glower
translate: 卡托开始怒目而视，

original: Since then, however, there have been 'reports'
translate: “然而，从那以后，就有了一些‘报告’”

original: Grave ones
translate: 很严重的报告，

original: Reports?
translate: 报告？

original: Something has been building in her for years
translate: 多年来，她体内有某种东西在积聚，

original: An 'aptitude' of sorts
translate: 某种‘天赋’，

original: But I suspect you already knew?
translate: 但我猜你早就知道了？

original: In any case, it's grown much stronger lately and drives her in ways I cannot understand
translate: “无论如何，它最近变得强大了许多，并以我无法理解的方式驱使着她”

original: I suspect she is looking for... answers
translate: 我怀疑她在寻找……答案，

original: But why Idra?
translate: 但为什么是伊德拉？

original: An aptitude?
translate: 天赋？

original: What am I to do?
translate: 我该做什么？

original: An aptitude of the worst kind
translate: 最糟糕的那种天赋，

original: It does not spring from the canonical Imperial praxis
translate: 它并非源自正统的帝国修行体系，

original: Instead it comes from elsewhere
translate: 而是来自别处，

original: It is the kind the Empire does not suffer to exist
translate: 是帝国不容存在的那种，

original: I hope it's only answers that she seeks
translate: 我希望她只是在寻找答案，

original: I see
translate: 我明白了，

original: What can I do?
translate: 我能做什么？

original: Why indeed?
translate: 确实，为什么？

original: There is little on the island save the port of Horryn
translate: 岛上除了霍林港几乎没什么别的，

original: If Idra was her destination, she must have landed there
translate: “如果伊德拉是她的目的地，她一定在那里登陆了”

original: Horryn?
translate: 霍林？

original: What of her 'aptitude'?
translate: 她的‘天赋’是怎么回事？

original: Yes
translate: 是的，

original: An old Imperial port and home to a few hundred whalers, traders and the occasional smuggler
translate: “一个古老的帝国港口，居住着几百名捕鲸者、商人和偶尔出没的走私者”

original: We can only speculate as to what drew her there, but it's our only lead
translate: “我们只能猜测是什么吸引了她，但这是我们唯一的线索”

original: How can I help her?
translate: 我怎样才能帮她？

original: You mentioned her 'aptitude'?
translate: 你提到了她的‘天赋’？

original: Hire mercenaries, travel to Idra and begin your search in the port of Horryn
translate: “雇佣佣兵，前往伊德拉，从霍林港开始搜寻”

original: From there, I trust you to do what needs be done
translate: “到了那里，我相信你会做该做的事”

original: Spare no cost, just bring back my daughter
translate: “不惜代价，只要把我女儿带回来”

original: Mercenaries?
translate: 佣兵？

original: The man is a grizzled veteran - he may have slowed with age, but his experience and reliability more than make up for it
translate: “那人是个头发花白的老兵——岁月或许让他动作慢了，但他的经验和可靠足以弥补”

original: He's also much respected by similar men - and so will be instrumental in hiring a reliable crew
translate: 他在同类人中也很受尊敬——因此在雇佣可靠的队伍时会很有用，

original: I'll take it into consideration
translate: 我会考虑的，

original: I trust your instincts, but I beseech you consider him - he's no great dinner guest, but he's been irreplaceable elsewhere
translate: “我相信你的直觉，但我恳请你考虑他——他虽不是个好的宴客，但在其他方面无可替代”

original: Is that so?
translate: 是吗？

original: Very well
translate: 很好，

original: Cato shows you his upturned palms, beseeching,
translate: “卡托向你摊开双手，恳求道，”

original: I know this thing I ask of you is fraught with danger
translate: 我知道我求你做的这件事充满危险，

original: But this is your chance at improving your fortune - materially, and in honour
translate: “但这是你改善命运的机会——无论是物质上，还是荣誉上”

original: What say you?
translate: 你怎么说？

original: I accept - for Embla's sake
translate: 我接受——看在恩布拉的份上，

original: Very well - For my family's name
translate: 很好——为了我家族的名誉，

original: I'll do it
translate: 我会做的，

original: For the gold
translate: 为了金子，

original: What makes you think I care?
translate: 你凭什么以为我在乎？

original: A chill draught causes a nearby candle to flicker, and you see the cold mirrored in Cato's features
translate: “一阵冷风让近旁的烛火摇曳，你看到卡托脸上也映出寒意”

original: You are not to blame for the decline in your family's fortune
translate: 你家族财富的衰落不该怪你，

original: But you could be responsible for restoring it
translate: 但你可以负责恢复它，

original: We'll see
translate: 走着瞧，

original: I will be
translate: 我会的，

original: Cato smiles softly, visibly relieved, and for a moment he looks like the man you remember
translate: “卡托温和地笑了，明显松了口气，有那么一瞬间，他看起来就像你记忆中的那个人”

original: Have you any final questions or matters to discuss?
translate: 你还有什么最后的问题或要讨论的事吗？

original: Time is, as I'm sure you appreciate, of the essence
translate: “我相信你明白，时间至关重要”

original: Let's just get on with it
translate: 我们这就开始吧，

original: If nothing else, the port will be dangerous enough
translate: “别的不说，港口本身就够危险了”

original: That is why I have summoned a Roland Greyeye to me - a crude but effective sell-sword - that I've made good use of before
translate: 所以我召来了罗兰·灰眼——一个粗鲁但有效的佣兵——我以前就用得很顺手，

original: He shall accompany you on this task
translate: 他将在这项任务中陪同你，

original: Roland Greyeye?
translate: 罗兰·灰眼？

original: I work alone!
translate: 我单干！

original: I met the man just before seeing you
translate: 我来见你之前刚见过那人，

original: No one, and no word has left Idra in days
translate: “几天来，没有人，也没有任何消息从伊德拉传出”

original: Rumor has it even the Imperial augurs are in the dark
translate: “有传言说，连帝国的占卜官都一无所知”

original: I know not how this touches the fate of my daughter, but she must be returned to me, one way or another
translate: “我不知道这与我女儿的命运有何关联，但她必须回到我身边，无论如何”

original: Any idea why she left?
translate: 知道她为什么离开吗？

original: #IntroCellar
translate: #酒窖入口

original: Empty bottles litter the floor of this room
translate: 空瓶子散落在这个房间的地板上

original: You chuckle to yourself as you imagine the kitchen staff in their wine tasting sessions
translate: 你想象着厨房员工品酒的情景，不禁暗自轻笑

original: No doubt, much revelry has taken place here
translate: “毫无疑问，这里曾有过许多狂欢”

original: Then a cool gust of air from the passage to the north
translate: 这时，一阵凉风从北边的通道吹来

original: The wine cellar lies that way and you can almost hear faint sobbing
translate: 酒窖就在那边，你几乎能听到微弱的啜泣声

original: Ghosts no doubt
translate: 毫无疑问是鬼魂

original: #IntroChef
translate: #厨师介绍

original: Ha!
translate: 哈！

original: The old wretch is too cowardly to come himself so he sends you instead?
translate: 那个老东西太懦弱了，不敢自己来，所以派你来了？

original: The brandy will be the end of him I say
translate: 我说，白兰地会要了他的命

original: Then again, who am I to deny the old fool his few pleasures
translate: 不过话说回来，我有什么资格剥夺那个老傻瓜仅有的这点乐趣呢

original: You'll find a crate of fine Gorremian brandy in the north-east corner of the wine cellar
translate: 你会在酒窖的东北角找到一箱上好的戈雷米亚白兰地

original: Hold on!
translate: 等等！

original: Let me see what you made!
translate: 让我看看你做了什么！

original: Armand excitedly licks his lips
translate: 阿曼德兴奋地舔了舔嘴唇

original: Present the Sandwich for inspection
translate: 拿出三明治来检查

original: The chef offers a short bow and a tired but sincere smile
translate: 厨师微微鞠了一躬，露出疲惫但真诚的微笑

original: I am chef Armand and my humble kitchen is at your disposal m'lord
translate: 我是厨师阿曼德，我这简陋的厨房听候您的差遣，大人

original: I am chef Armand and my humble kitchen is at your disposal m'lady
translate: 我是厨师阿曼德，我这简陋的厨房听候您的差遣，女士

original: Sadly I was told of your arrival only minutes ago and my oven must be fired up again
translate: 可惜几分钟前才有人告诉我您来了，我的炉子得重新生火

original: You must be famished?
translate: 您一定饿坏了吧？

original: Indeed I am
translate: 确实饿了

original: Splendid!
translate: 太好了！

original: The pantry is west of the wine cellar, and the cheese is kept in the northernmost room
translate: 食品储藏室在酒窖西边，奶酪放在最北边的房间里

original: Return when you have the cured ham and cheddar and I shall provide bread and instructions
translate: 等你拿到熏火腿和切达干酪再回来，我会给你面包和指示

original: Now, venture forth into the underworld!
translate: 现在，向地下世界进发吧！

original: Where is the cellar?
translate: 地窖在哪里？

original: Kydeon has asked me to fetch him a bottle of brandy
translate: 凯迪恩让我给他拿一瓶白兰地

original: Perfect!
translate: 太好了！

original: First of all, here is some bread
translate: 首先，这里有些面包

original: Now, the cauldron is quite empty and just warm enough for you to use
translate: 现在，大锅是空的，温度刚好适合你用

original: Remember
translate: 记住，

original: You need both the bread, ham and cheese to make the perfect sandwich!
translate: 你需要面包、火腿和奶酪才能做出完美的三明治！

original: Now, go give it a try and bring me the result!
translate: 现在，去试试吧，把成品带给我！

original: I shall see if you have it in you!
translate: 我倒要看看你有没有这个本事！

original: Chef Armand wanders back and forth, tending the fire and keeping his kitchen tidy
translate: 厨师阿曼德来回踱步，照看着炉火，把厨房收拾得井井有条

original: He has the gait of a man who has been on his feet for far too many hours
translate: 他走路的姿态像是一个站了太久的人

original: I have the ham and cheese!
translate: 我拿到火腿和奶酪了！

original: Present the sandwich for inspection
translate: 拿出三明治来检查

original: Where is the cellar again?
translate: 地窖在哪里来着？

original: Use the hatch in the floor over there!
translate: 用那边地板上的活板门！

original: Armand points towards a wooden hatch by the wall
translate: 阿曼德指向墙边的一个木制活板门

original: It's quite dark down there, but there should be a lantern in a chest near the stairs
translate: 下面很黑，但楼梯附近的箱子里应该有一盏提灯

original: Good luck!
translate: 祝你好运！

original: #IntroMadSailors
translate: #疯狂水手登场

original: Sailors
translate: 水手们

original: The sailors stare at you wide-eyed and terrified
translate: 水手们瞪大眼睛，惊恐地盯着你

original: Dead Emperors!
translate: 死去的帝皇！

original: It's coming for us!
translate: 它冲我们来了！

original: It whispers to me!
translate: 它对我低语！

original: One of them draws a weapon with shaking hands
translate: 其中一人颤抖着手拔出了武器

original: Get away from me!
translate: 离我远点！

original: Calm yourself - You're guild sailors!
translate: 冷静点——你们是公会的水手！

original: Half-insane with terror, the sailors scream and lunge at you!
translate: 被恐惧逼得半癫狂的水手们尖叫着向你扑来！

original: Attack
translate: 攻击

original: The men stop dead in their tracks - seemingly shocked back from their momentary lapse of sanity by your words
translate: 这些人突然停住脚步——似乎被你的话语从短暂的失智中震醒过来

original: The pair blinks towards you in a moment of indecision and then stumbles up to the main deck and the tumult that seems to be taking place there
translate: 两人犹豫地朝你眨了眨眼，然后跌跌撞撞地爬上主甲板，那里似乎正一片混乱

original: #IntroMonster
translate: #IntroMonster

original: You dash towards the ship's fractured rail, dodging holes in the deck and wounded men, beseeching you for help
translate: 你冲向船体断裂的栏杆，躲开甲板上的破洞和向你求救的伤员

original: Roland hangs by one arm from the side of the ship
translate: 罗兰用一只手臂挂在船舷上

original: Try to grab him!
translate: 试着抓住他！

original: Before Estavo can smirk in satisfaction, a tentacle whips into the lifeboat, leaving a dark smear against the now buckling hull
translate: 埃斯塔沃还没来得及得意地笑，一条触手就抽进了救生艇，在正在变形的船体上留下一道暗色污迹

original: Looking up, you see the remaining tentacles high above you, poised for the coup de grace
translate: 抬头望去，你看到其余的触手高高悬在你上方，准备给予致命一击

original: Abandon ship!
translate: 弃船！

original: You lunge for Roland's arm, but he loses his grip and your fingers close only around thin air - you missed him by an inch
translate: 你扑向罗兰的手臂，但他松开了手，你的手指只抓住了空气——你差一点就抓住他了

original: He falls wordlessly downwards
translate: 他无声地坠落下去

original: You regard the tentacles with morbid fascination
translate: 你带着病态的着迷注视着那些触手

original: Their colouration seems to shift and swim, and their tips are cruelly barbed
translate: 它们的颜色似乎在流动变幻，尖端长着残忍的倒钩

original: They sway, almost hypnotically, before crunching into the ship again
translate: 它们摇曳着，几乎令人催眠，然后再次嘎吱作响地砸进船体

original: One of the tentacles narrowly misses you, but the impact sends you flying overboard
translate: 其中一条触手险些击中你，但冲击力把你抛出了船外

original: The impact of the water winds you, the waves pummel you down, the currents beseech you to go deeper
translate: 水面的冲击让你喘不过气，海浪把你往下捶打，水流恳求你沉得更深

original: Ever deeper
translate: 越来越深

original: Peaceful blackness
translate: 宁静的黑暗

original: The Terror of Idra
translate: 伊德拉之怖

original: You rest your sword-arm, and survey the carnage
translate: 你放下持剑的手臂，环顾四周的惨状

original: Then suddenly a loud crash as something collides violently with the hull
translate: 突然，一声巨响，有什么东西猛烈地撞上了船体

original: Surviving mercenaries and crewmen alike fight to keep their footing as the ship lurches
translate: 幸存的雇佣兵和船员都在船身倾斜时拼命站稳脚跟

original: Suddenly, huge, monstrous tentacles burst from the water around the ship
translate: 突然，巨大而狰狞的触手从船周围的水中破浪而出

original: For a split-second, before the terror sets in, you wonder what Estavo must be thinking as the monstrosities loom over him
translate: 在恐惧袭来之前的一瞬间，你心想，当这些怪物逼近时，埃斯塔沃会作何感想

original: You pace the main deck, as the coast of Idra sails into clear view
translate: 你在主甲板上踱步，伊德拉的海岸清晰地驶入视野

original: You may have kept the crew alive, but they're still tense and skittish
translate: 你或许保住了船员的性命，但他们仍然紧张不安

original: The ships captain catches your eye, and nods in gratitude
translate: 船长与你目光相接，感激地点了点头

original: There is a scream from the crow's nest
translate: 桅杆瞭望台传来一声尖叫

original: Momentarily, you understand why - huge, monstrous tentacles have burst from the water around the ship
translate: 你瞬间明白了原因——巨大而狰狞的触手从船周围的水中破浪而出

original: You hear the captain cry out in terror as one of them wraps around his leg and plucks him from the deck
translate: 你听到船长惊恐地大叫，一条触手缠住了他的腿，把他从甲板上拽走

original: After reaching their full height, the tentacles curve inwards and smash into the ship
translate: 触手伸到最高处后，向内弯曲，猛砸在船上

original: Some pierce straight through the deck - Others snap the masts like they were matchsticks
translate: 有些直接刺穿了甲板——另一些则像折断火柴棍一样折断了桅杆

original: You stand frozen in place
translate: 你僵在原地

original: Through a haze of splintered wood and panicked screams, you notice Roland
translate: 透过纷飞的木屑和惊恐的尖叫，你注意到了罗兰

original: He throws himself out of the way of a tentacle, but begins to fall overboard as the ship lurches once more
translate: 他躲开了一条触手，但船身再次倾斜时，他开始向船外跌落

original: Go to Roland's aid!
translate: 去救罗兰！

original: Leave Roland to his fate
translate: 任由罗兰自生自灭

original: Through a haze of splintered wood and panicked screams, you watch as the tentacles rise for another strike
translate: 透过纷飞的木屑和惊恐的尖叫，你看着触手再次升起，准备下一次攻击

original: You notice a few of the mercenaries are rushing towards the lifeboats
translate: 你注意到几个雇佣兵正冲向救生艇

original: Join the mercenaries
translate: 加入雇佣兵

original: Observe the tentacles
translate: 观察触手

original: You reach the lifeboat just as the mercenaries begin lowering it into the sea
translate: 你赶到救生艇旁时，雇佣兵们正开始把它放下海

original: Estavo brandishes his sword at you
translate: 埃斯塔沃向你挥舞着剑

original: I think not
translate: 我看不行

original: Get in!
translate: 上来！

original: Estavo bellows
translate: 埃斯塔沃吼道

original: If you're ok with doubling our fee, of course
translate: “当然，如果你不介意把我们的酬金翻倍的话”

original: You watch as he is swallowed by the raging sea
translate: 你眼睁睁看着他被汹涌的大海吞没

original: The ship is listing fatally - and you see the great tentacles high above you, poised for the coup de grace
translate: 船身致命地倾斜着——你看到巨大的触手高高悬在你上方，准备给予致命一击

original: As you jump, you hear the terrible rending of wood giving in to flesh
translate: 你跳下时，听到木头在血肉面前可怕地撕裂的声音

original: Roland plummets wordlessly over the ship's rail
translate: 罗兰无声地从船舷坠落

original: Meanwhile, you notice a few of the mercenaries are rushing towards the lifeboats
translate: 与此同时，你注意到几个雇佣兵正冲向救生艇

original: Follow the mercenaries
translate: 跟随雇佣兵

original: Sink
translate: 沉没

original: #IntroMutiny
translate: #暴动序章

original: The mercenary leader, Estavo, flicks his dark eyes to you, but keeps his blade fixed on the desperate captain
translate: 雇佣兵首领埃斯塔沃用他黑色的眼睛瞥了你一眼，但手中的刀剑仍指着绝望的船长。

original: There's a reason he's known as 'Fireblood' to his men
translate: 他在手下中被称作“烈血者”是有原因的。

original: Estavo
translate: 埃斯塔沃

original: You'll get your money but let me handle this
translate: 你会拿到你的钱，但让我来处理这件事。

original: Estavo - enough of the theatrics
translate: 埃斯塔沃——别再演戏了。

original: A cruel smile twitches into life on Estavo's wind-weathered face
translate: 埃斯塔沃饱经风霜的脸上浮现出一丝残忍的微笑。

original: There's only one rich noble girl
translate: 只有一个富有的贵族女孩。

original: But we can always find more sailors
translate: 但我们总能找到更多的水手。

original: The ship's captain bristles at these words
translate: 船长听到这些话，怒发冲冠。

original: Captain, why have we not dropped anchor?
translate: “船长，我们为什么还不抛锚？”

original: Mutiny
translate: 暴动

original: You emerge onto the deck, and see two groups of men facing each other with weapons drawn
translate: “你来到甲板上，看到两群人手持武器对峙着。”

original: The ship shakes violently in the grip of a storm as lightning tears across the sky
translate: 船在风暴中剧烈摇晃，闪电撕裂天空。

original: There is desperation in the captain's voice
translate: 船长的声音中带着绝望。

original: We are seasoned sailors - we do not balk at shadows!
translate: 我们是经验丰富的水手——我们不会因阴影而退缩！

original: You need to be alive to rescue this girl you speak of!
translate: 你得活着才能去救你所说的那个女孩！

original: We're out of time
translate: 我们没时间了。

original: Sail us in, or argue the point with Estavo
translate: “把我们驶进去，或者跟埃斯塔沃争论这一点。”

original: You speak sense, Perhaps it is better to turn around?
translate: “你说得有道理，也许掉头更好？”

original: Estavo!
translate: 埃斯塔沃！

original: Have at it!
translate: 动手吧！

original: A few of the ship's crew lower their weapons
translate: 几名船员放下了武器。

original: The captain's eyes flit between you, and Estavo's murderous grin
translate: “船长的目光在你和埃斯塔沃杀气腾腾的笑容之间来回扫视。”

original: He sheathes his blade and speaks softly, his voice barely audible over the snapping sails
translate: “他收起刀剑，轻声说道，声音几乎被噼啪作响的船帆盖过。”

original: So be it
translate: 那就这样吧。

original: May the deep have mercy
translate: 愿深海怜悯我们。

original: You gain 300 XP
translate: 你获得了300经验值。

original: Hah!
translate: 哈！

original: Theatrics you say?
translate: 你说演戏？

original: It is not my men who cower like children!
translate: 像孩子一样畏缩的可不是我的人！

original: For what?
translate: 为了什么？

original: Shadows in the water?
translate: 水中的阴影？

original: Shadows will not keep me from my pay!
translate: 阴影休想阻止我拿到报酬！

original: I refuse to stand by and let you butcher the crew
translate: 我拒绝袖手旁观，任由你屠杀船员。

original: Do as you wish
translate: 随你便。

original: Estavo's grin begins to show teeth as he hears your words
translate: 埃斯塔沃听到你的话，笑容中开始露出牙齿。

original: The color drains from the Captain's face
translate: 船长的脸色变得苍白。

original: There is a moment's silence then a crash and a shudder as something strikes the ship's hull
translate: 片刻的寂静之后，一声巨响和震动传来，有什么东西撞上了船体。

original: In the confusion, a mercenary's throwing dagger flies; lodging in a sailor's throat
translate: “混乱中，一名雇佣兵的飞刀飞出，扎进了一名水手的喉咙。”

original: Fight the crew
translate: 与船员战斗。

original: Estavo lets out a short, hoarse laugh
translate: “埃斯塔沃发出一声短促、嘶哑的笑声。”

original: Danger, I don't mind
translate: “危险，我不在乎。”

original: Working for fools - that's how people get killed
translate: 为蠢货卖命——那才是送命的原因。

original: Before you can reply, Estavo whistles, and his men charge at you and the ship's crew!
translate: “你还没来得及回答，埃斯塔沃吹了声口哨，他的手下就向你与船员们发起了冲锋！”

original: Fend off the mercenaries
translate: 击退雇佣兵。

original: Amidst the din of the storm and their frantic arguments, you bellow for the attention of the assembled crewmen and mercenaries
translate: “在风暴的喧嚣和他们疯狂的争吵声中，你大声呼喊，吸引聚集的船员和雇佣兵的注意。”

original: Both the ship's Captain, and the leader of the mercenaries you hired - a coarse, thug of a man named Estavo - turn their attention to you
translate: “船长，以及你雇佣的雇佣兵首领——一个名叫埃斯塔沃的粗鲁暴徒——都将注意力转向了你。”

original: They look ready to use the unsheathed weapons in their hands at the slightest provocation
translate: 他们看起来随时准备在稍有挑衅的情况下就使用手中出鞘的武器。

original: Address the ship's captain
translate: 对船长说话。

original: Address the mercenary leader
translate: 对雇佣兵首领说话。

original: You direct your attention to the ship's captain
translate: 你将注意力转向船长。

original: You know him to be a reasonable, but suggestible man
translate: “你知道他是个通情达理，但容易受他人影响的人。”

original: At present, his usually placid eyes are wild with panic - or anger
translate: “此刻，他平时平静的眼睛里充满了恐慌——或是愤怒。”

original: I paid you for passage to the shore - did I not?
translate: 我付了钱让你送我们上岸——不是吗？

original: Why have we not dropped anchor?!
translate: 我们为什么还不抛锚？！

original: The captain lowers his weapon, and speaks earnestly
translate: “船长放下武器，恳切地说道。”

original: The coast of Idra is cursed!
translate: 伊德拉的海岸被诅咒了！

original: We'd heard tales, and assumed them grog-drenched rumors only - but there is something between us and the shore that will drag us all to a watery grave!
translate: “我们听过传说，以为那只是喝醉后的谣言——但海岸与我们之间确实有什么东西，会把我们都拖进水墓！”

original: What are you talking about?
translate: 你在说什么？

original: What have you seen?
translate: 你看到了什么？

original: We must sail on, to land and the girl
translate: “我们必须继续航行，前往陆地，找到那个女孩。”

original: Something dire stalks these shores
translate: 某种可怕的东西在这片海岸徘徊。

original: We cannot approach without risking the ire of that horror
translate: 我们不能冒险靠近，以免激怒那恐怖之物。

original: A jittery mutter of agreement rises from the sailors causing Estavo's eyes to darken even further
translate: 水手们发出一阵紧张不安的赞同低语，这让埃斯塔沃的眼神更加阴沉。

original: What horror?
translate: 什么恐怖之物？

original: Captain!
translate: 船长！

original: Take us closer or there will be consequences!
translate: 带我们靠近点，否则后果自负！

original: Naught but glimpses
translate: 只是瞥见而已。

original: My men have seen the shadow of something deep in water, stalking us
translate: “我的人看到了深水中有什么东西的影子，在跟踪我们。”

original: Nothing natural moves like that
translate: 自然之物不会那样移动。

original: Estavo glares murderously at the captain
translate: 埃斯塔沃杀气腾腾地瞪着船长。

original: You renege on our deal based on a glimpse?
translate: 你因为瞥见一眼就违背我们的约定？

original: Foolish superstition!
translate: 愚蠢的迷信！

original: Take us in now!
translate: 现在就带我们进去！

original: Do as you wish!
translate: 随你便！

original: Estavo turns his steely gaze from you to the captain
translate: 埃斯塔沃将钢铁般的目光从你身上转向船长。

original: Let me spell this out for you, sea-dog - we contracted to rescue the girl
translate: “让我给你说清楚，老海狗——我们签了合同要救那个女孩。”

original: But if you don't get us to the shore, we'll gut you for free
translate: “但如果你不把我们送上岸，我们就免费给你开膛破肚。”

original: The mercenaries you hired all shift their weight in anticipation of making good on that promise
translate: 你雇佣的雇佣兵们都调整了重心，准备兑现那个承诺。

original: Captain - he's right
translate: 船长——他说得对。

original: Do what you were hired to do!
translate: 做你被雇来该做的事！

original: Convince the man!
translate: 说服这个人！

original: Something changes in the Captain's expression
translate: 船长的表情发生了变化。

original: He stands tall
translate: 他挺直了身子。

original: I will not order my ship and my men to certain doom!
translate: 我不会命令我的船和我的手下走向必然的灭亡！

original: We shall not get any closer to the coast while I have command
translate: 只要我还指挥，我们就不会再靠近海岸。

original: I'm sorry captain
translate: 对不起，船长。

original: You leave us no choice
translate: 你让我们别无选择。

original: I defer to your judgement, captain
translate: “我听从你的判断，船长。”

original: Estavo - stand down
translate: 埃斯塔沃——退下。

original: I believe you - but my contract with these men does not mention your survival
translate: 我相信你——但我和这些人的合同里可没提到你的死活。

original: #IntroRats
translate: #IntroRats

original: You stop dead as you narrowly avoid stepping in a rust-red puddle
translate: 你猛地停住，险些踩进一滩锈红色的水洼，

original: The stench of blood fills your nostrils and as you look around in the dim light of the hold, you realize someone, or something fought for their life here
translate: 血腥味充斥着你的鼻腔，当你借着船舱里昏暗的光线环顾四周时，你意识到有人，或有什么东西曾在这里拼死搏斗，

original: The same moment the thought hits you, a hiss sounds from the shadows!
translate: 就在这个念头闪过你脑海的同一瞬间，阴影中传来一声嘶嘶声！

original: You squint towards the shadows as a hunched, feral looking form slowly slinks forwards
translate: 你眯起眼朝阴影处看去，只见一个佝偻着身子、野性十足的身影缓缓地向前潜行，

original: Tiny, disgustingly human-like hands, yellow fangs and a grotesquely dexterous pink tail leave no doubt of the creature's rodent nature
translate: 那细小、令人作呕的类人手掌，黄色的獠牙，以及那条灵活得怪异的粉红色尾巴，毫无疑问地揭示了这生物属于啮齿类，

original: Though as it emerges from the shadows, it becomes abundantly clear that what may have started life as a common ship-rat, has now grown into something that has no right to exist
translate: 然而，当它从阴影中完全现身时，事情变得再清楚不过：这个或许原本只是普通船鼠的生物，如今已长成了某种本不该存在的怪物，

original: A second hiss sounds behind you and the abominations lunge at you!
translate: 第二声嘶嘶声在你身后响起，那些畸形生物向你扑来！

original: #IntroRoland
translate: #IntroRoland

original: Roland
translate: 罗兰

original: You emerge onto the ship's lower deck
translate: 你来到船的下层甲板

original: As your eyes adjust to the darkness you become aware of a hulking figure standing in the shadows
translate: 当你的眼睛适应黑暗时，你注意到阴影中站着一个魁梧的身影

original: {PLAYER}!
translate: {PLAYER}！

original: Here at last
translate: 终于来了

original: growls a rough voice
translate: 一个粗哑的声音咆哮道

original: Who’s there?
translate: 谁在那儿？

original: Show yourself!
translate: 现身吧！

original: Freeze and listen carefully
translate: 别动，仔细听

original: Lunge at the figure
translate: 扑向那个身影

original: Have you lost your bloody mind?!
translate: 你他妈的疯了吗？！

original: Nobody is going to feel calmer for seeing you
translate: 没人会因为看到你而感到更安心

original: Until you hear screams, stay here
translate: “在你听到尖叫之前，待在这里”

original: You're right
translate: 你说得对

original: Follow me!
translate: 跟我来！

original: Fine, and be careful - I hear it's bad luck to kill a guild-sailor
translate: “好吧，小心点——我听说杀死公会水手会带来厄运”

original: Feeling jumpy?
translate: 感到紧张吗？

original: the brute growls with a smile
translate: 那个粗人微笑着咆哮道

original: Roland?!
translate: 罗兰？！

original: Why're you skulking in the shadows?
translate: 你为什么在阴影里鬼鬼祟祟的？

original: You tend to have that effect on people
translate: 你总是对人有这种影响

original: Where are we?
translate: 我们在哪儿？

original: And you'll regret not stopping our boys from murdering them, if you don't get to the damn deck
translate: “如果你不到那该死的甲板上去，你会后悔没有阻止我们的人杀了他们”

original: Besides, we'll need an escape route
translate: “此外，我们需要一条逃生路线”

original: Agreed
translate: 同意

original: They deserve disciplining, not death
translate: “他们应该受纪律处分，而不是死亡”

original: Listen
translate: 听着

original: I've been doing this since you were at the teat
translate: 我从你还在吃奶的时候就在干这个了

original: Let’s go
translate: 我们走

original: For all the good it will do
translate: 尽管这没什么用

original: Wait here, Roland
translate: “在这儿等着，罗兰”

original: There are two doors ahead - take the left, and we should be able to sneak past them without any trouble
translate: “前面有两扇门——走左边，我们应该能毫不费力地溜过去”

original: Anything else I should know?
translate: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

original: Famous last words
translate: 这话可不吉利

original: The figure in the shadows twists nimbly past your clumsy lunge, before thick arms wrap around your neck in a vice-like grip
translate: “阴影中的身影敏捷地躲过你笨拙的扑击，然后粗壮的手臂像老虎钳一样箍住你的脖子”

original: Your assailant could surely snap your neck in an instance
translate: 袭击你的人肯定能瞬间扭断你的脖子

original: Just as your vision begins to narrow and your legs go limp, he relases you and you stumble forewards before spinning around
translate: “就在你的视野开始变窄、双腿发软时，他放开了你，你踉跄向前，然后转过身来”

original: Who's there?
translate: 谁在那儿？

original: It’s Roland
translate: 是罗兰

original: Where the tides have you been?
translate: 你他妈的去哪儿了？

original: Why are you skulking around?
translate: 你为什么鬼鬼祟祟的？

original: Below decks, planning our landing
translate: “在甲板下面，计划我们的登陆”

original: Why?
translate: 为什么？

original: Mind your own fucking business!
translate: 管好你自己的事！

original: What's going on?
translate: 怎么回事？

original: The brute chuckles
translate: 粗人轻笑道

original: Shadows suit a face like this just fine
translate: 阴影很适合我这张脸

original: No matter
translate: 没关系

original: There is trouble and you’re needed on deck
translate: 有麻烦了，甲板上需要你

original: Now
translate: 现在

original: What for?
translate: 为什么？

original: What’s all that noise?
translate: 那是什么声音？

original: Have we arrived?
translate: 我们到了吗？

original: Let's get this over with
translate: 让我们把这事了结吧

original: The island is in sight, but the damn guilders refuse to land
translate: “岛屿就在眼前，但那些该死的公会成员拒绝登陆”

original: They want to turn back
translate: 他们想掉头回去

original: If we turn back - we lose our shot at the girl
translate: 如果我们掉头——我们就失去了抓住那女孩的机会

original: Did they say why?
translate: 他们说了为什么吗？

original: Ha
translate: 哈

original: the old veteran grunts in what passes as laughter for him
translate: 这位老练的战士咕哝着，这对他来说就算是笑了

original: Only superstitious bilge
translate: 只是迷信的胡话

original: They claim they saw something in the water
translate: 他们声称在水里看到了什么东西

original: Either way, our boys are about to show them some very real steel
translate: “不管怎样，我们的人就要让他们见识见识真刀真枪了”

original: If we can't land - we lose our shot at the girl
translate: 如果我们不能登陆——我们就失去了抓住那女孩的机会

original: I knew I'd regret chartering a guilder ship
translate: 我就知道我会后悔租了一艘公会的船

original: And no-one gets paid
translate: 而且没人能得到报酬

original: Listen here, I know our boys better than most
translate: “听着，我比大多数人都更了解我们的人”

original: We've hired them to go to Idra and kill
translate: 我们雇他们去伊德拉杀人

original: If we don't pay them, things will go bad quickly
translate: “如果我们不付钱给他们，事情很快就会变糟”

original: But the sailors are bloody terrified
translate: 但水手们吓得要死

original: They claim something is hunting us
translate: 他们声称有东西在追猎我们

original: Wait
translate: 等等

original: There're a few sailors up ahead, rattled as a pair of rabbits
translate: “前面有几个水手，像一对兔子一样惊慌失措”

original: We're not here to make friends, if that's what you're suggesting
translate: “我们不是来交朋友的，如果你是这个意思的话”

original: Is there a way past them?
translate: 有办法绕过他们吗？

original: Spill sailor-blood and the guild will want to make you pay
translate: 让水手流血，公会会让你付出代价

original: Take the left door ahead, and spare us some trouble, and a pay cut
translate: “走前面左边的门，省得我们惹麻烦，也省得被扣钱”

original: Perhaps
translate: 也许吧

original: Anything else you feel compelled to tell me?
translate: 还有什么你觉得必须告诉我的吗？

original: Let's just get off this bloody boat
translate: 我们赶紧离开这该死的船吧

original: Motioning for you to take the lead, Roland falls in behind you.'
translate: “罗兰示意你带路，然后跟在你身后。”

original: From above agitated shouts can be heard
translate: 从上方传来激动的喊叫声

original: Why
translate: 为什么？

original: #IntroShipAwaken
translate: #序章船内苏醒

original: The Zephyr
translate: 西风号

original: On the wine-dark, raging seas of the Outer Isles, a lone caravel struggles against the winds and waves towards the accursed island of Idra
translate: 在外岛群酒暗色、汹涌的海面上，一艘孤零零的卡拉维尔帆船正与风浪搏斗，驶向被诅咒的伊德拉岛

original: The moan of creaking timbers
translate: 嘎吱作响的木料发出呻吟

original: The tang of preserved fish
translate: 腌鱼的强烈气味

original: Your eyes slowly adjust to the darkness of the ship's dimly lit hold
translate: 你的眼睛慢慢适应了船舱里昏暗的光线

original: Suddenly, something strikes the hull and the ship rocks violently
translate: 突然，有什么东西撞上了船体，船剧烈摇晃起来

original: Your heart begins to pound and a feeling of unease grows in your stomach
translate: 你的心开始怦怦直跳，胃里涌起一阵不安

original: Rise, well rested and ready to go
translate: 起身，休息充分，准备出发

original: Get up, mouth dry and head pounding
translate: 起床，口干舌燥，头痛欲裂

original: Rouse yourself from deep meditation
translate: 从深度冥想中唤醒自己

original: You get to your feet and become aware of agitated voices shouting up on deck
translate: 你站起身来，听到甲板上传来激动的喊叫声

original: Something is not right
translate: 有些不对劲

original: You should make your way up top and get a bearing on the situation
translate: 你应该到上面去，弄清楚情况

original: Be on your way
translate: 出发吧

original: WARNING
translate: 警告

original: You are about to skip the intro and go straight to the mainland
translate: 你即将跳过序章，直接前往大陆

original: This is for PLAY-TESTING only and it is not the intended experience!
translate: 这仅用于游戏测试，并非预期的体验！

original: Never mind!
translate: 算了！

original: SKIP INTRO
translate: 跳过序章

original: #IntroShipLockedDoor
translate: #IntroShipLockedDoor

original: A Locked Door
translate: 一扇上锁的门

original: To your surprise, you realize that this door has been locked from the outside!
translate: 你惊讶地发现，这扇门竟然是从外面锁上的！

original: It doesn't budge - perhaps you could slip the lock with a thin blade or use something to smash it?
translate: 它纹丝不动——也许你可以用薄刃撬开锁，或者用什么东西砸开它？

original: Use Dagger
translate: 使用匕首

original: Use Club
translate: 使用棍棒

original: As the door swings open, you can now clearly make out cries from the deck above
translate: 随着门打开，你现在能清楚地听到上方甲板传来的哭喊声

original: You should make haste
translate: 你得赶快

original: You slip the dagger through a gap in the door and lift the bar that was locking you in
translate: 你把匕首从门缝里伸进去，挑起了把你锁在里面的门闩

original: The door begins to creak open
translate: 门开始吱呀作响地打开

original: Using the club, you smash the lock in a fell swoop
translate: 你用棍棒一下子砸开了锁

original: #IntroSurgeonJournal
translate: #船医日志引言

original: Surgeon's Journal
translate: 船医的日记

original: Written on the day of departure from mainland
translate: 写于离开大陆的那一天

original: Left Adler's Helm today with a full cargo of passengers
translate: 今天满载乘客离开了鹰盔堡

original: Mercenaries by the looks of it
translate: 看起来像是雇佣兵

original: Paid well
translate: 报酬丰厚

original: Ship was dispatched by Guild before we could fully restock medical supplies
translate: 船在公会派遣前我们还没来得及充分补充医疗物资

original: Hopefully we won't need them
translate: 希望我们用不上它们

original: Then again, our passengers make me uneasy
translate: 不过话说回来，我们的乘客让我感到不安

original: Writtern 5 days ago
translate: 5天前写的

original: Brawl in mess - had to set nose
translate: 食堂斗殴——不得不接好鼻子

original: Men seem on edge
translate: 船员们似乎很紧张

original: Also, Igan came to me today with a bite-wound that he sustained whilst working in the hold
translate: 另外，伊根今天来找我，他在货舱工作时被咬伤了

original: Didn't see creature and I would say it was a rat's bite if it weren't for the size and some aspect of the dentition that I find hard to explain properly
translate: 没看到那生物，要不是因为伤口大小和齿痕的某些特征让我难以解释清楚，我会说那是老鼠咬的

original: I recommend captain sends detail to capture and kill creature
translate: 我建议船长派一队人去捕捉并杀死那生物

original: Written two days ago
translate: 两天前写的

original: Was visited today by navigator Aslam
translate: 今天航海长阿斯拉姆来找我

original: He asked for Whitefern - a sedative
translate: 他要白蕨——一种镇静剂

original: Claimed he had trouble sleeping
translate: 声称他难以入睡

original: Suspected he was not fully forthcoming and when pushed, he mumbled something about the stars being 'odd'
translate: 我怀疑他没有完全说实话，当我追问时，他嘟囔着说星星有些‘古怪’

original: Not sure what he meant and he left before I could push him further
translate: 不确定他是什么意思，我还没来得及进一步追问他就离开了

original: Written today
translate: 今天写的

original: Men are about to break
translate: 船员们快要崩溃了

original: We cannot maintain our course for Idra
translate: 我们无法维持前往伊德拉的航线

original: Captain advised me today to make ready the surgery and to expect casualties
translate: 船长今天通知我准备好手术，并预计会有伤亡

original: I suspect he intends to inform our passengers that he refuses to land on the island
translate: 我猜他打算告诉乘客们他拒绝在那个岛上登陆

original: If this is my last
translate: 如果这是我的最后一篇，

original: The entry trails off
translate: 记录到此中断，

original: #IntroVilla
translate: #IntroVilla

original: One you recognize immediately
translate: 你一眼就认出了她，

original: Valeria Berryn - the mistress of the house
translate: 瓦莱里娅·贝林——这座宅邸的女主人，

original: You remember her as a gray ghost
translate: 你记忆中的她如同一个灰暗的幽灵，

original: Absent and unwell
translate: 心不在焉，病体恹恹，

original: The other statue depicts the girl you once knew so well
translate: 另一尊雕像刻画的是你曾经无比熟悉的那个女孩，

original: Embla Berryn - daughter of the house, and now a woman grown strong and clear-eyed - her likeness has none of her mother's cowed timidness
translate: “恩布拉·贝林——贝林家之女，如今已长成一位坚强而目光清澈的女子——她的雕像上丝毫不见她母亲那种畏缩怯懦的神情”，

original: How is mistress Valeria these days?
translate: 瓦莱里娅夫人近来可好？

original: How fares Embla?
translate: 恩布拉怎么样了？

original: The mistress is 'vacationing' in the countryside
translate: 夫人正在乡间“休养”，

original: Lyra answers curtly
translate: 莱拉简短地回答，

original: And what of Embla?
translate: 那恩布拉呢？

original: Lyra's eyes flicker ever so slightly
translate: 莱拉的眼神微微闪烁了一下，

original: We should hasten to Master Berryn - he's long been impatient to see you
translate: 我们得赶紧去见贝林大人——他早就等不及要见你了，

original: But what of mistress Valeria?
translate: 但瓦莱里娅夫人呢？

original: Memories
translate: 回忆，

original: The opulence is faded, the shadows longer - clearly much has changed since the last time you were here
translate: “昔日的奢华已然褪色，阴影拉得更长——显然，自你上次来此之后，这里已发生了许多变化”，

original: Try to remember how long it's been
translate: 试着回想一下已经过去了多久，

original: I didn't come here to reminisce
translate: 我不是来此怀旧的，

original: The Statues
translate: 雕像，

original: Flanking the doorway are two marble statues
translate: 门口两侧立着两尊大理石雕像，

original: The craftsmanship is stunning, but the sight of the two women depicted fills you with sadness
translate: “工艺令人惊叹，但看到所描绘的这两位女子，你心中充满了悲伤”，

original: Examine them
translate: 仔细端详它们，

original: It's been years, perhaps decades since you were here, not since your father was the house arms-master
translate: “你离开这里已有多年，或许几十年了，自从你父亲担任这座宅邸的军械长之后，你就再没回来过”，

original: Not since
translate: 自从那以后，

original: You must have your wits about you and perhaps now is not the time to dwell on painful memories?
translate: 你必须保持清醒，也许现在不是沉湎于痛苦回忆的时候？

original: Not since your father's exile
translate: 自从你父亲被放逐之后，

original: You were no more than 12 when you were driven from the household
translate: 你被赶出家门时不过十二岁，

original: Hard were the years that followed; the mercenary life is bloody and unforgiving
translate: 随后的岁月异常艰辛；佣兵生涯充满血腥，毫不留情，

original: Those years stole your childhood, and eventually they took your father too
translate: “那些年夺走了你的童年，最终也夺走了你的父亲”，

original: But your father had always insisted, to his dying breath, that his failure had been his own - that he had gotten the fate he deserved
translate: “但你父亲至死都坚持说，他的失败是他自己的过错——他得到了应得的命运”，

original: The memories are painful nonetheless
