translate: 别难过

original: All it would have bought you, was time to see the killing blade
translate: 它最多只能给你争取到看见致命刀剑的时间

original: You whirl around to the right, grasping instinctively at the weapon that isn't hanging by your side
translate: 你猛地向右转身，本能地去抓那柄没挂在身边的武器

original: The figure standing in the shadows behind you is laden with the promise of violence
translate: 站在你身后阴影中的身影充满了暴力的预兆

original: In the corner of your eye you register Lyra biting her lip in gleeful anticipation
translate: 眼角余光瞥见莱拉咬着嘴唇，一副幸灾乐祸的期待神情

original: The figure's slow laugh has the texture of an avalanche as he slowly emerges from the shadows
translate: 那身影缓缓从阴影中走出，低沉的笑声带着雪崩般的质感

original: You’d be dead either way
translate: 不管怎样你都是死

original: But at least you’d get a chance to see the blade
translate: 但至少你能有机会看见那把刀剑

original: The servant offers a startled shriek as she spots you
translate: 仆人发现你时发出一声惊叫

original: The plate she drops echoes through the vaulted dining hall
translate: 她掉落的盘子在拱顶餐厅里回响

original: Lyra emerges from the shadows behind you, apparently amused by your clumsiness
translate: 莱拉从你身后的阴影中现身，显然被你的笨拙逗乐了

original: With feigned sadness she pats your cheek
translate: 她假装悲伤地拍了拍你的脸颊

original: I had expected more from you
translate: 我本来对你期望更高的

original: She leads you from the dining hall back to the foyer
translate: 她带你离开餐厅，回到门厅

original: The room around you lies silent and seemingly empty save the crackling of burning logs
translate: 四周的房间一片寂静，除了燃烧木柴的噼啪声，似乎空无一人

original: The fire casts a dim light and dancing shadows
translate: 炉火投下昏暗的光和舞动的阴影

original: A single goblet stands half empty on a small table
translate: 一只高脚杯半满着立在旁边的小桌子上

original: Lyra’s warm breath on your ear startles you as she whispers near imperceptibly
translate: 莱拉温热的呼吸拂过你的耳朵，她近乎无声的低语吓了你一跳

original: We have walked into a trap
translate: 我们走进了一个陷阱

original: The beast has laid an ambush for us
translate: 那小畜生给我们设下了埋伏

original: Can you sense him preparing to strike?
translate: 你能感觉到他正准备出击吗？

original: Hairs stand up on your neck
translate: 你脖子上的汗毛竖了起来

original: If it is from latent danger or something else, you cannot tell
translate: 是因为潜在的危险还是别的什么，你分辨不出

original: No!
translate: 不！

original: Do not look!
translate: 别看！

original: She whispers, louder now
translate: 她低语道，声音大了些

original: Close your eyes
translate: 闭上眼睛

original: Let your sensing be the absence of action
translate: 让你的感知成为无为

original: Become empty for the ambience to flow into you
translate: 放空自己，让周遭的氛围流入你体内

original: Now, is he to our right or left side?
translate: 现在，他在我们右边还是左边？

original: Empty your mind
translate: 清空你的思绪

original: Lyra leads you back through the dining hall
translate: 莱拉带你穿过餐厅往回走

original: A slight sense of urgency has crept into her step
translate: 她的脚步中透出一丝紧迫感

original: Follow
translate: 跟上

original: Wait!
translate: 等等！

original: What about the wager?
translate: 赌约怎么办？

original: Roland's good eye, shifts momentarily to Lyra who interjects
translate: 罗兰那只好眼睛瞬间转向莱拉，莱拉插话道

original: One of my master's foremost skills is his ability to recognize and attract resourceful individuals
translate: 我主人最出众的技能之一，就是能识别并吸引足智多谋的人才

original: Roland is one such individual
translate: 罗兰就是这样的人

original: As are you, it seems
translate: 看来你也是

original: Now, my master has waited long enough, and you two will have enough time to get to know one another later
translate: 好了，我主人已经等得够久了，你们俩以后有的是时间互相了解

original: Lyra offers a short bow to Roland who returns it in a surprisingly respectful manner
translate: 莱拉向罗兰微微鞠躬，罗兰以出人意料的恭敬态度回礼

original: We must go
translate: 我们必须走了

original: Ah; The wager!
translate: 啊；赌约！

original: What is a fitting prize for such a feat?
translate: 什么样的奖品才配得上这样的壮举？

original: The glory alone will suffice
translate: 荣耀本身就足够了

original: Teach me something!
translate: 教我点什么！

original: A kiss?
translate: 一个吻？

original: #IntroVillaVeteran
translate: #老兵别墅介绍

original: Tell me boy, what would yer father say if he knew you considered yourself the better of his old friends?
translate: 告诉我，小子，要是你父亲知道你认为自己比他那些老朋友还强，他会怎么说？

original: Though his voice is full of gravel, there's now a glint in his eyes, as though the old coals have begun to warm up
translate: 尽管他的声音沙哑，但此刻眼中闪过一丝光芒，仿佛那些旧煤块又开始升温了

original: Tell me girl, what would yer father say if he knew you considered yourself the better of his old friends?
translate: 告诉我，姑娘，要是你父亲知道你认为自己比他那些老朋友还强，他会怎么说？

original: Kydeon!?
translate: 凯迪恩！？

original: Is that you?
translate: 是你吗？

original: I have no time for the ghosts of my father's past
translate: 我没空理会我父亲过去的幽灵

original: Say nothing, and keep walking
translate: 什么也别说，继续走

original: Disappointment clouds the man's face, and he calls after you
translate: 失望笼罩着男人的脸，他在你身后喊道

original: Very well, I suppose you're no longer the lad I remember
translate: 很好，我想你已经不再是我记得的那个小伙子了

original: Lyra awaits at the main entrance
translate: 莱拉在主入口等着

original: She'll take you to the Master, for better or worse
translate: 她会带你去见卡托大人，无论好坏

original: Kydeon smiles sadly
translate: 凯迪恩悲伤地笑了笑

original: An old soldier's greeting
translate: 一个老兵的问候

original: Something one mercenary would say to another as a prayer to not dwell on painful memories
translate: 佣兵之间会说的话，像是一种祈祷，不要沉湎于痛苦的回忆

original: The kind that comes with the work
translate: 这种痛苦是这份工作带来的

original: Your father and I
translate: 你父亲和我

original: Kydeon halts momentarily and looks at you
translate: 凯迪恩停顿片刻，看着你

original: Your father and I would always part with those words
translate: 你父亲和我总是用那句话告别

original: Now, I've held you long enough
translate: 好了，我耽搁你够久了

original: If it’s the hedge maze you mean, just head west and then north
translate: 如果你指的是树篱迷宫，往西然后往北走就行

original: Then again you must have known that?
translate: 不过你应该知道吧？

original: Had to drag you out o’ there enough times
translate: 以前可没少把你从那儿拖出来

original: I won't betray my Master's confidence by saying more
translate: 我不会再多说，以免辜负卡托大人的信任

original: Best you see him yourself
translate: 最好你亲自去见他

original: The man offers a smile but it fails to iron out the concerned creases around his eyes
translate: 男人挤出一个微笑，但没能抚平他眼周忧虑的皱纹

original: I'll go look for the Master-at-Arms
translate: 我去找军械长

original: Never could pull the wool over your eyes
translate: 从来都骗不了你

original: Truth is, many a day's been dark of late for House Berryn
translate: 说实话，贝林家族近来日子很不好过

original: Perhaps it all started when you and your father left
translate: 也许这一切都是从你和你父亲离开时开始的

original: A guilty grimace flashes across his face
translate: 他脸上闪过一丝愧疚的怪相

original: Or maybe it started even earlier
translate: 或者开始得更早

original: Kydeon pauses to blow out a long breath
translate: 凯迪恩停下来，长呼一口气

original: I'll go to the Master-at-Arms
translate: 我去找军械长

original: A single bark of laughter emanates from the dense beard as he embraces you in a crushing bear-hug
translate: 一声大笑从他浓密的胡须中传出，他给了你一个令人窒息的熊抱

original: Kydeon may be older and grayer but from the force of his hug, you don't reckon you'd have any more chance of beating him now than you did as a 12 year old
translate: 凯迪恩也许更老更灰白了，但从他拥抱的力道来看，你觉得现在打败他的机会并不比12岁时多

original: Go easy, you old boar
translate: 轻点，你这老野猪

original: It's good to see some things haven't changed
translate: 很高兴看到有些东西没变

original: Kydeon steps back and allows you to breathe again, before grabbing you by the shoulders
translate: 凯迪恩退后一步让你喘口气，然后抓住你的肩膀

original: We heard of your father's passing
translate: 我们听说了你父亲的过世

original: Truly, he sits with the Golden Dead now
translate: 真的，他现在与黄金先祖同在了

original: Tell me, how did he die?
translate: 告诉我，他是怎么死的？

original: In glorious battle - at my side
translate: 在光荣的战斗中——在我身边

original: Drunk and reeking of his own piss
translate: 喝醉了，浑身尿骚味

original: Let's not dwell on old wounds
translate: 别纠结旧伤了

original: Do you know why I'm here?
translate: 你知道我为什么来这里吗？

original: Kydeon's eyes narrow
translate: 凯迪恩眯起眼睛

original: Then the old warrior died a fitting death
translate: 那么这位老战士死得其所

original: Kydeon is quiet for a moment then breaks into a grin
translate: 凯迪恩沉默片刻，然后咧嘴一笑

original: We'll raise a cup to his name, together, you and I!
translate: 我们一起为他举杯，你和我！

original: Soon as you're done with Cato, and I can rustle up some ale fit for a guest
translate: 等你和卡托谈完，我弄些适合客人的麦酒

original: Kydeon, why am I here?
translate: 凯迪恩，我为什么在这里？

original: It's been that long has it?
translate: 有那么久了吗？

original: Well, kitchen's still in that building over on the east end of the property
translate: 嗯，厨房还在庄园东头的那栋建筑里

original: Just follow yer nose
translate: 跟着鼻子走就行

original: And the wine cellar's underneath it
translate: 酒窖就在它下面

original: The old man fails to suppress the impulse to lick his lips
translate: 老人没能忍住舔嘴唇的冲动

original: If you want to explore, for old time's sake, take this lantern
translate: 如果你想探索，看在旧日情分上，拿着这盏提灯

original: Lord Berryn will wait - and we don't want you getting lost in the hedge-maze again!
translate: 贝林勋爵会等着的——我们可不想你又迷路在树篱迷宫里！

original: The man laughs heartily and hands you a small, brass lantern
translate: 男人开怀大笑，递给你一盏小小的黄铜提灯

original: Whatever may come to pass, it did this old warrior a barrel of good to see you again boy!
translate: 不管发生什么，能再见到你，小子，可让这老战士高兴坏了！

original: The old man slaps you on the shoulder in parting, almost knocking you off balance
translate: 老人告别时拍了拍你的肩膀，差点让你失去平衡

original: He then seems to remember something as he leans in conspiratorially
translate: 然后他似乎想起了什么，神秘兮兮地凑过来

original: Whatever may come to pass, it did this old warrior a barrel of good to see you again girl!
translate: 不管发生什么，能再见到你，姑娘，可让这老战士高兴坏了！

original: Kydeon
translate: 凯迪恩

original: An aging, armoured man in the livery of House Berryn stands and scowls at you
translate: 一个身穿贝林家族制服的衰老盔甲男子站在那里，对你怒目而视

original: Eyes like coal peer out from a craggy face fringed top and bottom with wild, white hair
translate: 煤块般的眼睛从一张布满皱纹的脸上凝视着，脸的上方和下方都长着狂野的白发

original: Return his challenging stare
translate: 回敬他挑衅的目光

original: Walk on by
translate: 径直走过

original: The man's eyelids droop, near fully closed
translate: 男人的眼皮耷拉下来，几乎完全闭上了

original: It was a cruel fate that befell your father
translate: 降临在你父亲身上的命运很残酷

original: And yours, crueller still
translate: 而你的，更加残酷

original: For what it's worth, I'll bear memory of him as the good, honest man he was, before
translate: 不管怎样，我会记住他曾经是个善良、诚实的人，在那之前

original: Kydeon is quiet for a moment then offers a sad smile
translate: 凯迪恩沉默片刻，然后露出悲伤的微笑

original: Soon as you're done with the Master!
translate: 等你和卡托大人谈完！

original: But first
translate: 但首先

original: Don't keep Lyra waiting any longer!
translate: 别再让莱拉等了！

original: Talk to her first and I'll be here for later
translate: 先和她谈谈，我晚点在这儿

original: Have you seen Lyra yet?
translate: 你见到莱拉了吗？

original: Best not keep her waiting!
translate: 最好别让她等着！

original: I have your medicine
translate: 我有你的药

original: Where was the kitchen again?
translate: 厨房又在哪儿来着？

original: Where do I find the garden?
translate: 我在哪儿能找到花园？

original: Where did you say Lyra was?
translate: 你说莱拉在哪儿？

original: May your sleep be dreamless?
translate: 愿你无梦安眠？

original: The older man crosses his massive arms, steps forward and leans towards you
translate: 年长的男人交叉起粗壮的双臂，走上前，向你倾身

original: So, young sellsword, come looking for a scrap have you?
translate: 那么，年轻的佣兵，来找茬的吗？

original: Kydeon, you old fool!
translate: 凯迪恩，你这老傻瓜！

original: Stand aside old man
translate: 让开，老头

original: I have business with your lord
translate: 我和你的领主有要事

original: Have you not gone to see her yet?
translate: 你还没去见她吗？

original: You best hurry then!
translate: 那你最好快点！

original: She's on the stairs right behind me there!
translate: 她就在我身后的楼梯上！

original: Master Cato will chew your ear plenty when you see him, {PLAYER}
translate: 等你见到卡托大人，他会唠叨个没完，{PLAYER}

original: Lyra, the new Master-at-Arms awaits you by the main entrance
translate: 莱拉，新任军械长，在主入口等你

original: She'll escort you - and don't ask her not to
translate: 她会护送你的——别让她别这么做

original: If you think I had a temper
translate: 如果你觉得我脾气不好

original: The joke fails to hide the note of anxiety in the grizzled House guard's voice
translate: 这个玩笑没能掩盖这位头发斑白的家族守卫声音中的焦虑

original: I shall look for this Lyra
translate: 我会去找这位莱拉

original: What are you hiding from me, old boar?
translate: 你在瞒着我什么，老野猪？

original: #IntroWineCellar
translate: #酒窖序幕

original: Your father jolts upright, the bloodshot whites of his eyes glaring out of the darkness
translate: "你的父亲猛地坐直，布满血丝的眼白在黑暗中瞪视着"

original: We found her!
translate: 我们找到她了！

original: Wandering the forests outside the estate!
translate: 在庄园外的森林里游荡！

original: Mistress Valeria
translate: 瓦莱里娅夫人

original: Help him stand
translate: 扶他站起来

original: Haltingly, and leaning heavily on you, your father manages to stand
translate: "他步履蹒跚，重重地靠在你身上，你的父亲总算站了起来"

original: She was never the same
translate: 她再也不是从前的她了

original: Whatever happened broke her
translate: 无论发生了什么，都把她击垮了

original: It was the girl, you know?
translate: "是那个女孩，你知道吗？"

original: The seed was planted in Valeria that night
translate: 那晚，种子在瓦莱里娅体内种下

original: But how could you know?
translate: 但你怎会知道？

original: You were but a babe yourself
translate: 你自己也还是个婴儿

original: You help lead the now sobbing man out of the cellar
translate: 你搀扶着这个现在啜泣不止的男人走出地窖

original: Stop it, father!
translate: "别说了，父亲！"

original: Lord Cato trusted me!
translate: 卡托领主信任我！

original: And I failed him - but Valeria was the one to pay the price: mind broken and that spawn of a child
translate: 而我辜负了他——但付出代价的却是瓦莱里娅：心智崩溃，还有那个孽种

original: Your father's voice seethes with fury
translate: 你父亲的声音因狂怒而颤抖

original: Enough!
translate: 够了！

original: Don't talk back to me, you bastard!
translate: "别跟我顶嘴，你这杂种！"

original: What do you know about honor!?
translate: 你懂什么荣誉！？

original: As much as your harlot mother!
translate: 跟你那妓女母亲一样多！

original: Your father steps away from you, unsteadily, tears streaming down his contorted face
translate: "你的父亲踉跄着从你身边退开，泪水顺着他扭曲的脸庞流淌"

original: Shut up, shut up, shut up!
translate: "闭嘴，闭嘴，闭嘴！"

original: Turn and run
translate: 转身逃跑

original: Strike the man
translate: 揍这个男人

original: You draw a ragged breath and snap out of the memory, your knuckles white
translate: "你深吸一口气，从记忆中挣脱出来，指节发白"

original: You're alone in the damp cellar and don't particularly feel like dwelling there
translate: 你独自待在这潮湿的地窖里，并不想在此久留

original: You're gripped by a long-hidden memory upon entering this part of the cellar
translate: 一踏入地窖的这个区域，你便被一段尘封已久的记忆攫住

original: You sealed it away - but in so doing, preserved its strength
translate: "你将它封存——但正因如此，也保留了它的力量"

original: And now, it demands freedom
translate: "而现在，它要求自由"

original: You can still recall smelling him before you could make out his writhing shape in the dim light of the cellar
translate: 你仍记得，还没看清他在昏暗地窖中扭动的身形，就先闻到了他的气味

original: Mistress Valeria!
translate: 瓦莱里娅夫人！

original: Open the door!
translate: 开门！

original: Your father doesn't even notice you in the throes of his intoxicated ramblings
translate: 你的父亲在醉醺醺的胡言乱语中甚至没注意到你

original: How could they take her?
translate: 他们怎么能带走她？

original: Her chambers were locked from inside!
translate: 她的房间是从里面锁上的！

original: Where is she!?
translate: 她在哪儿！？

original: Try to shake some sense into him
translate: 试着让他清醒一点

original: #MercuryPool
translate: #水银池

original: A single clear note rings out and for a moment the chirping of exotic birds dies down
translate: 一声清脆的音符响起，片刻间异域鸟儿的啁啾声沉寂下来

original: Somewhere a metallic clang sounds and then the mercury begins to circle some unseen drain
translate: 某处传来金属的铿锵声，随后水银开始围绕某个看不见的排水口旋转

original: Slowly but surely steps come into view
translate: 缓慢而坚定地，台阶浮现眼前

original: With a final gurgle, the last of the liquid is drained away and at the end of the descending stairways a door can now be seen
translate: 随着最后一阵咕噜声，最后一滴液体被排尽，在向下延伸的阶梯尽头，一扇门现在清晰可见

original: The ‘down below’ awaits
translate: ‘下方’在等待

original: The strange pool ahead of you is filled with a silvery fluid that looks like liquid metal
translate: 你面前这口奇异的池子盛满了一种银色的液体，看起来像液态金属

original: Mercury perhaps?
translate: 也许是水银？

original: Play the Silver Flute
translate: 吹奏银笛

original: #MineExit
translate: #矿井出口

original: You stand at the foot of the stairs for a moment
translate: 你在楼梯脚下站了一会儿，

original: It’s as if something is holding you back
translate: 仿佛有什么东西在阻止你，

original: If you take even the first step, events will be set in motion that can never be undone
translate: “哪怕你只迈出第一步，就会启动无法挽回的事件”，

original: Then the strangest thought strikes you
translate: 然后一个最奇怪的念头击中了你，

original: You’ve always been climbing these stairs and you will keep climbing them until the universe ends
translate: 你一直在爬这些楼梯，你会一直爬下去，直到宇宙终结，

original: Take the first step
translate: 迈出第一步，

original: The morbid thought is soon dispelled by the endless monotony of the climb
translate: 这个病态的念头很快就被无尽单调的攀爬驱散了，

original: The shaft goes straight forwards and up at a steep angle
translate: 竖井笔直向前，并以陡峭的角度向上延伸，

original: There is no bend or curve
translate: 没有弯曲或弧度，

original: Just the same infinitely ascending stairs perfectly carved through the heart of the mountain
translate: 只有同样的无限向上的楼梯，完美地凿穿山体中心，

original: For the longest time, the only change is the drop in temperature as you get higher
translate: “在很长一段时间里，唯一的变化是随着你越爬越高，温度在下降”，

original: Then, finally you catch the first glimpse of natural light in a long time
translate: “然后，你终于看到了许久以来的第一缕自然光”，

original: The exit is in sight!
translate: 出口就在眼前！，

original: The exhilaration fills you with energy and rejuvenates your aching thighs
translate: 兴奋感让你充满能量，让你酸痛的大腿重新焕发活力，

original: With a final exertion, you make it to the top and emerge onto the barren plains of the interior plateau
translate: “用尽最后一丝力气，你到达了顶部，出现在内陆高原的荒芜平原上”，

original: The Black Priory awaits you
translate: 黑修院在等着你，

original: #MineFaultyBeam
translate: #矿井故障横梁

original: The support-beam appears to be close to giving in
translate: 支撑梁似乎快要撑不住了，

original: It seems that if this beam breaks, this whole section of tunnel will collapse
translate: 看来如果这根梁断裂，整段隧道都会坍塌

original: If you have some rope, you might be able to take advantage of this to rig a trap of sorts
translate: 如果你有绳子，或许可以利用这一点设置某种陷阱

original: Use rope to rig trap
translate: 使用绳子设置陷阱，

original: A makeshift trap
translate: 一个临时陷阱，

original: If you had a reason to do so, you could cause this section of tunnel to collapse - crushing anyone inside under tons of rock
translate: 如果你有理由这么做，你可以让这段隧道坍塌——将里面的人压在数吨岩石之下

original: You carefully tie the rope around the beam in such a way that if you give it a good tug, the beam will cause the tunnel ahead to collapse
translate: 你小心地将绳子绑在横梁上，只要用力一拉，横梁就会导致前方的隧道坍塌

original: #MineSecretDoor
translate: #MineSecretDoor,

original: This section of wall appears to be close to collapsing
translate: 这面墙看起来快要塌了

original: If you have a pick-axe you could likely break through to the other side
translate: 如果你有镐子，应该能凿穿到另一边

original: Use pick-axe!
translate: 使用镐子！

original: You make short work of the wall and in no time it collapses to reveal that you have just linked up to the mine entrance
translate: 你三下五除二就凿开了墙，它很快坍塌，露出你刚刚打通的矿井入口

original: This will no doubt serve as a handy short-cut should you have the need to return to Adler’s Helm
translate: 这无疑会是一条便捷的捷径，日后你若需要返回鹰盔堡，就能派上用场

original: # NPC
translate: # 他人

original: #NPCRoland
translate: #NPCRoland

original: Hrm?
translate: 嗯？

original: What do you want!
translate: 你想干嘛！

original: #OverlandEnterBadland
translate: #OverlandEnterBadland

original: Katabatic winds howl through the valley
translate: 下沉风呼啸着穿过山谷

original: To the north, great snow-covered peaks loom over you like the ramparts of some great, cosmic fortress
translate: 北面，巨大的雪峰耸立在你们头顶，宛如某座宏伟宇宙堡垒的城墙

original: Embla leans in and shouts over the wind
translate: 恩布拉凑近身子，在风中喊道

original: These are the interior mountains!
translate: 这就是内陆山脉！

original: We must find a way to ascend them to reach the plateau and the Priory!
translate: 我们必须找到攀登它们的方法，才能抵达高原和修道院！

original: And we'll find that in Adler's Helm?
translate: 我们能在鹰盔堡找到方法吗？

original: All I know is that the Cabal expedition traveled there, and that means we must too
translate: 我只知道秘盟考察队去过那里，所以我们也必须去

original: I’m sure once we get there, the way will somehow reveal itself
translate: 我确信一旦到了那里，道路自然会显现

original: That's a lot to hope for
translate: 这希望也太渺茫了

original: For now, let’s just try to get there in one piece
translate: 眼下，咱们先想办法平安抵达那里吧

original: From what I understand, Adler’s Helm lies somewhere near the north-eastern parts of this mountain-range
translate: 据我所知，鹰盔堡位于这片山脉东北部某处

original: If we follow its circumference, I believe we’ll eventually arrive there
translate: 如果我们沿着山脉边缘走，我相信最终会到达那里

original: # PartyMembers
translate: # 队伍成员

original: #PrioryCaveAncientRoom
translate: 修道院洞穴古室

original: Like the tons of stone that presses down from above, so does this chamber convey the weight of untold eons
translate: 如同上方压下的无数吨岩石，这个房间也传达着无数纪元的重量

original: Rows of embalmed corpses line the wall, sitting in perfect stillness with empty eye-sockets that stare into eternity
translate: 一排排经过防腐处理的尸体沿墙排列，静坐不动，空洞的眼窝凝视着永恒

original: How long have they been here?
translate: 他们在这里多久了？

original: These men and women came here to worship long before the first stone of the Empire was laid
translate: 这些男男女女早在帝国的第一块基石铺设之前就来此朝拜了

original: Their corpses were already ancient when Gallian landed on Erdahn’s shores
translate: 当伽里安踏上厄尔丹的海岸时，他们的尸体早已古老

original: A strange thought occurs to you
translate: 一个奇怪的念头浮现在你脑海中

original: These corpses are ‘dreaming’
translate: 这些尸体在‘做梦’

original: Waiting and dreaming
translate: 等待与做梦

original: Waiting on what?
translate: 在等待什么？

original: They… are ‘dreaming’
translate: 他们……在‘做梦’

original: You turn and realize it was Kat who spoke
translate: 你转过身，意识到是卡蒂在说话

original: She looks surprised
translate: 她看起来很惊讶

original: I don’t know why I said that
translate: 我不知道我为什么这么说

original: The thought just came to me!
translate: 这个念头突然冒了出来！

original: But, they ARE dreaming
translate: 但是，他们确实在做梦

original: Sharing the Sleeper’s dream
translate: 分享着沉睡者的梦境

original: Waiting for him to return to them
translate: 等待着他回到他们身边

original: Where are these thoughts coming from?!
translate: 这些念头是从哪里来的？！

original: Can we please leave?
translate: 我们能离开这里吗？

original: Yes, let's move
translate: 好，我们走吧

original: #PrioryCaveBossFight
translate: #修道院洞穴Boss战

original: The strange construct rises menacingly above you
translate: 那个奇怪的构造物在你上方威胁性地升起

original: As you approach, the fungal growths that cling to it writhe in greedy anticipation - clawing impotently at the portal set into the structure’s side
translate: 当你靠近时，附着其上的真菌生长物在贪婪的期待中扭动——无力地抓挠着嵌在构造物侧面的传送门

original: You cannot easily discern the material used in its construction nor the hands that made it beyond the fact that there is an aspect about it that makes you think of the artifacts that the Magi sometimes employ
translate: 你无法轻易辨别其构造所用的材料，也无法知晓是何人之手造就了它，只是它有一种特质，让你想起法师们有时使用的法器

original: Now, its outer skin is pockmarked and weathered by the shifting of stone over endless millennia
translate: 如今，它的外壳因无尽千年的岩石移动而变得坑坑洼洼、饱经风霜

original: For the briefest moment you see it in your mind's eye, free of stone, moving over a landscape of jagged mountains and jungle-clad hills
translate: 在那一瞬间，你在脑海中看到它挣脱了岩石，在一片嶙峋山脉和丛林覆盖的山丘之上移动

original: Great ferns sway in the humid breeze, and in the distance you see great, singing towers
translate: 巨大的蕨类植物在潮湿的微风中摇曳，远处你看到宏伟的、歌唱的高塔

original: A sudden tremor shakes you out of it
translate: 一阵突如其来的震动将你从中惊醒

original: This one more violent than the previous ones
translate: 这一次比之前的更加猛烈

original: As you reel from the quake, Embla walks past you, moving towards the portal with her hand outstretched like a sleepwalker
translate: 当你因震动而踉跄时，恩布拉从你身边走过，像梦游者一样伸着手朝传送门走去

original: The air hums with energy that appears to be emanating from the portal itself
translate: 空气中嗡嗡作响，能量似乎正从传送门本身散发出来

original: The fungal tentacles begin to thrash wildly in anticipation
translate: 真菌触手在期待中开始疯狂抽打

original: The tremors return, more powerful now, and around you stones fall from the cave’s roof
translate: 震动再次袭来，现在更加强烈，你周围的洞顶石块纷纷坠落

original: Embla, wait!
translate: 恩布拉，等等！

original: She does not hear you and before you can grab her, she has touched the door
translate: 她没有听见你的呼喊，你还没来得及抓住她，她已经触碰了那扇门

original: The effect is instant
translate: 效果立竿见影

original: Strangely shaped glyphs set into the portal begin to glow with a light so bright it’s nearly blinding
translate: 嵌在传送门上的形状奇特的符文开始发出光芒，亮得几乎让人目眩

original: An undulating vibration that you feel in your bones rises and echoes through the cave and for a moment it sounds as if someone, or something is howling madly
translate: 一阵你骨子里都能感受到的起伏振动升起，在洞穴中回荡，有那么一瞬间，听起来仿佛有人或什么东西在疯狂嚎叫

original: Then sudden silence
translate: 然后突然一片寂静

original: What was
translate: 刚才那是，

original: Before you can finish your sentence, the ground again shakes violently, knocking you to the ground
translate: 你还没来得及说完，地面再次剧烈震动，将你击倒在地

original: Rocks and debris explode outwards from the center of the cave and an inhuman roar so loud it causes your ears to bleed emits from the horror that emerges into the cave
translate: 岩石和碎片从洞穴中心向外炸开，一声非人的咆哮如此响亮，以至于你的耳朵开始流血，这声音来自那从洞穴中出现的恐怖之物

original: Bursting forth from the depths below, it towers above you
translate: 它从下方的深渊中冲出，高耸在你之上

original: A squirming mass of untold millions of strands of fungal growths animated into a gigantic, mawed worm-horror
translate: 一团由无数真菌生长丝组成的蠕动之物，被赋予了生命，化作一只巨大的、长着大嘴的蠕虫般的恐怖怪物

original: Tentacles thrash wildly with enough force to break rock as the abomination claws its way out of the emergence hole and towards you
translate: 触手疯狂抽打，力道足以击碎岩石，那畸形生物从出现的洞口爬出，向你扑来

original: Embedded into its roiling half-flesh are the forms and faces of men
translate: 在它翻滚的半血肉之中，嵌着人类的形体和面孔

original: You know with certainty that these are indeed the final members of the Cabal expedition
translate: 你确信，这些正是秘盟考察队的最后成员

original: Stagger to your feet
translate: 你踉跄着站起身来

original: The creature lumbers towards you, emitting yet another terrible scream
translate: 那生物蹒跚着向你走来，发出又一声可怕的尖叫

original: Your heart sinks as you set to receive the charge
translate: 当你准备迎接冲锋时，你的心沉了下去

original: From around you echoes dozens of replies as its smaller siblings are called forth to the feast
translate: 从你周围传来数十声回应，它那些较小的同类被召唤前来赴宴

original: #PrioryCaveSpottedShip
translate: #PrioryCaveSpottedShip

original: The cave expands into a vast chamber littered by the remains of what you deem to be the final resting-place of the Cabal expedition to the Black Priory
translate: 洞穴扩展成一个巨大的洞室，散落着你认为的秘盟考察队前往黑修院的最终安息之地的遗骸

original: Large quantities of stone and dirt have been shifted in what appears like an attempt to excavate… what?
translate: 大量的石头和泥土被移动过，看起来像是在试图挖掘……什么？

original: Your eyes strain in an attempt to make sense of the structure partially protruding from the rock
translate: 你眯起眼睛，试图看清从岩石中部分突出的结构

original: Your mind reels at the thought that whatever this is, it must have been placed here thousands, nay, hundreds of thousands of years ago
translate: “一想到这东西，不管它是什么，一定是在数千，不，数十万年前就被放置在这里，你的思绪就一阵眩晕。”

original: What’s more, despite seeing just a small segment of the structure, you feel certain that whatever is buried here is vast
translate: “而且，尽管只看到了结构的一小部分，你确信埋在这里的东西非常庞大。”

original: We’re here!
translate: 我们到了！

original: We’ve made it!
translate: 我们成功了！

original: All these years, this is what was buried under the Priory
translate: “这么多年，这就是埋在修院下面的东西。”

original: This is where the Sleeper awaits!
translate: 这就是沉睡者等待的地方！

original: Emblas voice trembles like a prisoner who senses that freedom is finally within reach
translate: 恩布拉的声音颤抖着，就像一个感觉到自由终于触手可及的囚犯

original: T-this thing
translate: 这-这东西

original: It cannot exist
translate: 它不可能存在

original: It should not!
translate: 它不应该存在！

original: Who can build something like this?
translate: 谁能建造这样的东西？

original: Driina’s voice is the closest to panic you’ve ever heard her
translate: 德莉娜的声音是你听过的她最接近恐慌的一次

original: This is the very heart of madness itself
translate: 这就是疯狂本身的核心

original: Roland whispers to himself
translate: 罗兰自言自语道

original: The sleeper awaits
translate: 沉睡者等待着

original: #PrioryDreamChamber
translate: #修道院梦境室

original: I think the monks came down here to commune with him using those machines
translate: 我想僧侣们下来这里是用那些机器与他交流

original: Dreaming his dreams
translate: 梦着他的梦

original: You walk over to the shaft and peer down it
translate: 你走到竖井旁向下窥视

original: There is no end in sight
translate: 一眼望不到底

original: Whatever lies at the bottom, lies far below this level of the catacombs
translate: 无论底部有什么，都远在这层地下墓穴之下

original: The octagonal room has four throne-like machines arranged around a central aperture
translate: 八角形的房间中央开口周围排列着四台王座般的机器

original: Thick, squirming tentacles spew forth from the shaft, and you can’t help but wonder where it terminates
translate: 粗壮蠕动的触手从竖井中涌出，你不由得想知道它通向何处

original: A strange humming can be felt, rather than heard, coming from the center of the room
translate: 房间中央传来一阵奇异的嗡鸣，与其说是听到，不如说是感觉到

original: Examine the machines
translate: 检查这些机器

original: Though no doubt some form of arcane machinery, it’s beyond your ken and you feel loath to examine it further
translate: 尽管无疑是某种奥术机械，但这超出了你的认知，你不愿再细究

original: Leaning in, you examine the indentation further and notice inlays of pure sylver radiating out from where the user’s skull would be
translate: 你凑近细看那凹陷处，发现纯银辉金镶嵌从使用者头骨所在的位置向外辐射

original: You follow the inlays, and find that they seem to converge towards the room’s central shaft
translate: 你顺着镶嵌纹路看去，发现它们似乎汇聚向房间中央的竖井

original: Intricately wrought in a complex design that appears more like machinery than decoration, each throne has an indentation that would accommodate a human figure
translate: 每张王座都精雕细琢，复杂的设计更像是机械而非装饰，上面都有一个能容纳人类形体的凹陷

original: If you were to guess, you’d say that this machinery somehow attunes and connects the user to Reticular vibrations emanating from the shaft
translate: 如果要猜的话，你会说这台机器以某种方式调谐并连接使用者与竖井散发出的网状振动

original: As to what is generating those vibrations
translate: 至于是什么产生了这些振动

original: Could it be the holy corpse?
translate: 会不会是那具圣尸？

original: As you enter the hall, a mass of misshapen flesh and slavering jaws spill forth from shadows and darkened side-passages!
translate: 当你踏入大厅，一大团畸形血肉与淌着涎水的巨口从阴影与黑暗的侧廊中蜂拥而出！

original: You can’t help but think that the glistening and slimy horrors before you look as if they were birthed into existence recently
translate: 你不由得觉得眼前这些湿亮黏滑的恐怖之物仿佛才刚被催生到世上不久，

original: No doubt they are now ravenously hungry
translate: 毫无疑问，它们此刻正饥肠辘辘，

original: Forces pull at you - driving you inexorably forwards
translate: 力量拉扯着你——无情地驱使你向前，

original: You are, you are no doubt, nearing something
translate: 你，毫无疑问，正在接近什么东西

original: What’s wrong?
translate: 怎么了？

original: Why do we stop?
translate: 我们为什么停下？

original: Embla asks impatiently
translate: 恩布拉不耐烦地问道，

original: I have a strange feeling
translate: 我有种奇怪的感觉

original: A feeling we’re being watched!
translate: 感觉我们被监视了！

original: snarls Roland as he turns to face the amorphous eye-things that glide silently down from the ceiling to prey upon you!
translate: 罗兰咆哮着，转身面对那些从天花板无声滑落、以你为猎物的无定形眼状怪物！

original: Before you can finish the thought, movement catches your eye and you whirl around to face the amorphous eye-things that glide silently down from the ceiling to prey upon you!
translate: 你还没来得及想完，一个动静吸引了你的目光，你猛地转身，面对那些从天花板无声滑落、以你为猎物的无定形眼状怪物！

original: Our path takes us into peerless darkness then?
translate: 我们的道路将我们带入无与伦比的黑暗之中吗？

original: Iben rubs his chin thoughtfully
translate: 伊本若有所思地揉着下巴，

original: We’ve survived countless horrors thus far but I dare say, we must keep our wits about us now and proceed with the utmost caution
translate: “我们迄今为止经历了无数恐怖，但我敢说，我们现在必须保持警惕，并以最大的谨慎前进。”

original: I can think of few fates worse than being lost and waylaid in this morass of darkness
translate: “我想不出比在这片黑暗的泥沼中迷路和遭到伏击更糟糕的命运了。”

original: You must keep your wits about you if you are to proceed
translate: “如果你要继续前进，就必须保持警惕。”

original: Take all precautions not to lose your way and ensure all possible preparations are made before you set forth
translate: “采取一切预防措施以免迷路，并在出发前做好一切可能的准备。”

original: The tunnel ahead is ancient, narrow and dark
translate: “前方的隧道古老、狭窄而黑暗。”

original: Walking down it, you cannot help but feel as if you are descending into some deeper abyss - far more ancient than the Priory and reluctant to give up its mysteries
translate: “沿着它走下去，你会不由自主地感觉自己正在坠入某个更深的深渊——远比修道院更古老，且不愿交出它的秘密。”

original: Nonetheless, you also cannot help but feel as if you are once more being pulled forwards
translate: “尽管如此，你也不由自主地感觉自己再次被向前牵引。”

original: Something awaits you at the other end of these tunnels and it’s beckoning for you to proceed
translate: “在这些隧道的另一端有什么东西在等着你，它在召唤你前进。”

original: You feel it too now don’t you?
translate: “你现在也感觉到了，不是吗？”

original: Embla attempts to peer into the darkness ahead
translate: 恩布拉试图凝视前方的黑暗，

original: This is the way
translate: “就是这条路。”

original: The tomb-chamber was never what the Priory was built to protect
translate: “墓室从来就不是修道院建造来保护的东西。”

original: There must be even older mysteries below
translate: “下面一定有更古老的秘密。”

original: I suspect many of the monks themselves didn’t know of this
translate: “我怀疑许多僧侣自己也不知道这件事。”

original: Perhaps initiates offered praise to a false tomb for centuries while the Grandmasters kept the lie?
translate: “也许几个世纪以来，新入会者向一座假墓致敬，而大导师们则维持着这个谎言？”

original: Let's move onwards then
translate: “那我们继续前进吧。”

original: Not to interrupt your theosophic ramblings but there’s something you might want to see {PLAYER}
translate: “不是要打断你的神智学漫谈，但有些东西你可能想看看，{PLAYER}。”

original: Kat has walked up to the edge of the light and is carefully extending her arm into the darkness
translate: 卡蒂走到光亮边缘，小心地将手臂伸入黑暗中，

original: The darkness will not yield to the light
translate: “黑暗不会向光明屈服。”

original: It’s as thick as tar
translate: “它像焦油一样浓稠。”

original: Some kind of ward perhaps?
translate: “也许是某种结界？”

original: I suspect we’ll need to navigate these tunnels blindly
translate: “我怀疑我们需要盲目地穿越这些隧道。”

original: You walk up to the edge of the light and realize that the darkness does not appear to lift no matter how much light is present
translate: “你走到光亮边缘，意识到无论有多少光，黑暗似乎都不会消散。”

original: The tunnels appear to be kept in some kind of perpetual darkness and it seems you must navigate them blindly
translate: “这些隧道似乎被保持在某种永恒的黑暗中，看来你必须盲目地穿越它们。”

original: #PrioryDungeonGong
translate: #修道院地牢锣

original: You strike the gong a third time but as you utter the last name, the note sounds foul and discordant
translate: 你第三次敲击锣，但当你念出最后一个名字时，声音变得刺耳而不和谐

original: Whatever you did you suspect it was somehow wrong
translate: 无论你做了什么，你怀疑这有些不对劲

original: Perhaps you should start over?
translate: 也许你应该重新开始？

original: A large, gilded gong that no doubt must have served some kind of ceremonial purpose
translate: 一面巨大的镀金锣，无疑曾用于某种仪式

original: Etched into it in fine lettering is the following text
translate: 上面用精细的字体刻着以下文字：

original: He who wishes to pass so bold, Speak the names of masters of old!
translate: “欲大胆通过者，须念出昔日大师之名！”

original: And before the sleeper he beseech, Shall offer up a strike for each!
translate: “并在沉睡者前恳求，每念一名便敲击一次！”

original: Ring the Gong
translate: 敲锣

original: You speak the name
translate: 你念出名字

original: Strike again and say the name 'Rothrax'
translate: 再次敲击并念出名字“罗斯瑞克斯”

original: Strike again and say the name 'Carroleth'
translate: 再次敲击并念出名字“卡罗莱斯”

original: Strike again and say the name 'Kalamar'
translate: 再次敲击并念出名字“卡拉玛”

original: You strike again and speak the second name
translate: 你再次敲击并念出第二个名字

original: You strike the gong with the mallet and a pure, deep note reverberates through the complex
translate: 你用木槌敲击锣，一声纯净而深沉的音符在整个建筑群中回荡

original: Say the name 'Rothrax'
translate: 念出名字“罗斯瑞克斯”

original: Say the name 'Carroleth'
translate: 念出名字“卡罗莱斯”

original: Say the name 'Kalamar'
translate: 念出名字“卡拉玛”

original: You strike the gong with whatever is at hand and a dull note emanates from it
translate: 你用手边的随便什么东西敲击锣，发出一声沉闷的声响

original: You suspect only striking it with the correct tool will produce a proper note
translate: 你怀疑只有用正确的工具敲击才能发出恰当的声音

original: You ring the gong a third time and speaks the last name
translate: 你第三次敲锣并念出最后一个名字

original: The sound echoes more strongly than before through the catacombs and the grinding of stones can be heard in the room ahead
translate: 声音比之前更强烈地在地下墓穴中回荡，前方房间传来石头摩擦的声音

original: Whatever you did, you suspect it was the right thing
translate: 无论你做了什么，你怀疑这是正确的

original: #PrioryDungeonPitTrap
translate: 修道院地牢陷坑陷阱

original: With a mechanical click, the floor gives way under your
translate: 随着一声机械咔嗒声，你脚下的地板突然塌陷

original: Your short drop is arrested by the vicious spikes that cover the floor of the pit
translate: 你短暂的坠落被坑底密布的凶残尖刺所阻止

original: Your adventure has come to an end
translate: 你的冒险到此结束了

original: #PrioryDungeonSpottenTomb
translate: #PrioryDungeonSpottenTomb,

original: Embla points through the passage to the north
translate: 恩布拉指向北方的通道，

original: A golden tomb!
translate: 一座金色的墓穴！，

original: We must be close now
translate: 我们现在一定很接近了，

original: Finally we shall know!
translate: 我们终于要知道了！，

original: What do we do if you're right?
translate: 如果你是对的，我们该怎么办？，

original: I do not know
translate: 我不知道，

original: But the answers will reveal themselves to us when we stand before the glorious corpse
translate: 但当我们站在那荣耀的尸体前时，答案自然会显现，

original: I just pray we’re not too late!
translate: 我只祈祷我们没有太迟！，

original: The corpse of an Emperor?
translate: 帝皇的尸体？，

original: In a place like this?
translate: 在这种地方？，

original: I refuse to believe it
translate: 我拒绝相信，

original: #PrioryEnterCave
translate: #进入洞穴

original: The air down here is thick with the metallic smell of ozone and a throbbing ache grows in your teeth
translate: 这里的空气弥漫着浓重的金属臭氧味，牙齿间隐隐作痛。

original: Each step down the narrow, winding tunnel takes you deeper and closer to… what?
translate: 沿着狭窄蜿蜒的隧道每走一步，都让你更深入、更接近……什么？

original: But you have come this far, and you cannot help but feel a surge of determination at being so close to the end of your search
translate: 但你已经走了这么远，在如此接近搜寻终点时，你不禁感到一阵决心涌上心头。

original: It is so close now
translate: 现在它如此之近。

original: The call is almost too much to bear
translate: 那呼唤几乎让人难以承受。

original: Embla touches her forehead and for a moment seems to sway
translate: 恩布拉摸了摸额头，一时间似乎有些摇晃。

original: Are you unwell?
translate: 你不舒服吗？

original: But there is but one way to cure it now
translate: 但现在只有一种方法能治愈它。

original: We must proceed
translate: 我们必须继续前进。

original: Embla straightens
translate: 恩布拉挺直了身子。

original: Driina’s eyes narrow
translate: 德莉娜眯起眼睛。

original: This place is not for us
translate: 这地方不适合我们。

original: The deeper we go, the further I feel we are from the Golden Light
translate: 我们走得越深，我就越觉得我们离金色光芒越远。

original: We must go on!
translate: 我们必须继续！

original: Surely, we must go on?
translate: 我们当然必须继续，对吧？

original: Iben insists with an uncharacteristic intensity
translate: 伊本以一种异乎寻常的强烈态度坚持道。

original: We press on
translate: 我们继续前进。

original: #PrioryEnterFirstFloor
translate: #进入修道院一楼

original: The heavy wooden doors swing open slowly on ancient, rusted hinges and you apprehensively step inside the darkened halls of the grim edifice
translate: 沉重的木门在古老生锈的铰链上缓缓打开，你忐忑不安地踏入这座阴森建筑黑暗的大厅

original: Inside, you find the air thick with dust and particles of swirling matter and your eyes adjust slowly to the darkness
translate: 里面空气弥漫着厚厚的灰尘和旋转的微粒，你的眼睛慢慢适应了黑暗

original: There is more
translate: 还有更多

original: A strange feeling as if something is stirring in anticipation at your arrival
translate: 一种奇怪的感觉，仿佛有什么东西在期待你的到来而骚动

original: Driina’s voice interrupts your train of thought
translate: 德莉娜的声音打断了你的思绪

original: This place is alien to me
translate: 这个地方对我来说很陌生

original: There is nothing here that marks this as an Imperial place of worship
translate: 这里没有任何标志表明这是帝国的礼拜场所

original: We must be on our guard
translate: 我们必须保持警惕

original: Embla points ahead
translate: 恩布拉指向前面

original: Lumerods
translate: 流明棒

original: They must have been set up by the Cabal expedition
translate: 它们一定是秘盟考察队设立的

original: Perhaps we can find some clue as to what fate befell them?
translate: 也许我们能找到一些线索，了解他们遭遇了什么命运？

original: I’ll tell you what befell them
translate: 我来告诉你他们遭遇了什么

original: Roland growls
translate: 罗兰咆哮道

original: Nothing good, is what
translate: 没什么好事，就是这样

original: #PrioryGanglion1
translate: #PrioryGanglion1

original: A large, pulasting sack grows from the side of the fungal infection
translate: 一个巨大的、搏动的囊从真菌感染的一侧长出

original: There is something inside it
translate: 里面有东西

original: Cut it open
translate: 切开它

original: Leave it
translate: 不管它

original: To your disgust and horror, a rotting corpse riddled with fungi spills forth
translate: 令你感到厌恶和恐惧的是，一具布满真菌的腐烂尸体倾泻而出

original: As it does, it drops a small journal
translate: 与此同时，它掉落了一本小日志

original: You pocket the book and move on
translate: 你把书装进口袋，继续前进

original: #PrioryGroundsEnter
translate: #修道院庭院进入

original: You enter the courtyard of the walled priory only to find it eerily quiet and surprisingly temperate
translate: 你走进有围墙的修道院庭院，却发现这里安静得诡异，而且出奇地温暖，

original: Not even in Vauul are the Imperial gardens still heated in the winter
translate: 即使在瓦乌尔，帝国的花园在冬天也不会供暖了，

original: It is a sad thing to see for an Empire that was built on the subjugation of climate by man and magi, no?
translate: “对于一个建立在人类与法师征服气候之上的帝国来说，这景象真令人悲伤，不是吗？”

original: The nearly imperceptible humming felt through the ground tells that an ancient environmental ward is miraculously still active
translate: 地面传来的几乎难以察觉的嗡鸣声表明，一个古老的环境结界奇迹般地仍在运转，

original: Truly a lost wonder of Imperial magical engineering
translate: 真是帝国魔法工程失落的奇迹，

original: Strange vegetation bursts out of the ground in grotesque mockeries of trees and writhing tendrils of fleshy pseudopods creep obscenely forth from the well
translate: 奇异的植被从地面破土而出，扭曲地模仿着树木的形状，蠕动的肉质伪足触须从井中淫秽地爬出，

original: As you approach, the tentacles creep slowly but greedily in your direction
translate: “当你靠近时，触手缓慢而贪婪地向你爬来，”

original: Driina stomps the nearest tendril
translate: 德莉娜踩向最近的触须，

original: That blasted infestation seems to grow like a cancer throughout these isles!
translate: 那该死的虫群像癌症一样在这些岛屿上蔓延！

original: Wherever we set foot, we find it festering in some dark corner
translate: “无论我们走到哪里，都会发现它在某个黑暗角落里溃烂，”

original: she spits in disgust
translate: 她厌恶地啐了一口，

original: Mesmerized, you allow it to slowly begin winding up your leg
translate: “你被迷住了，任由它慢慢开始缠绕你的腿，”

original: A wave of disgust washes over you to snap you out of your reverie and you hurriedly step away
translate: 一阵厌恶感席卷了你，将你从恍惚中惊醒，你急忙退开，

original: Embla, what is that thing?
translate: “恩布拉，那是什么东西？”

original: It’s the fungi from outside
translate: 是外界的菌，

original: It infests Warda, growing through the veil and into the very matter of the world
translate: “它侵染着沃尔达，穿透帷幕，渗入世界的物质本身，”

original: Her voice drops to a whisper
translate: 她的声音低成耳语，

original: It’s the herald of the Dragon
translate: 它是龙的先驱，

original: The tentacles squirm with increased fervor at the very mention of that blasted name
translate: 一提到那个该死的名字，触手就更加狂热地蠕动起来，

original: Stop it!
translate: 别说了！

original: Embla seems frozen in fear for a moment before she nods weakly in agreement
translate: 恩布拉似乎因恐惧而僵住了一会儿，然后虚弱地点点头表示同意，

original: You both feel it
translate: 你们都感觉到了，

original: The horrid certainty that seven terrible eyes are now fixed on you
translate: 那种可怕的确定感：七只恐怖的眼睛正盯着你们，

original: Driina grabs your arm, her face a determined mask
translate: “德莉娜抓住你的手臂，脸上是一副坚定的表情，”

original: There are some things we must not discuss here
translate: 有些事我们不能在这里讨论，

original: #PrioryInteriorAmbush
translate: #修道院内部伏击

original: As you pass through the ancient library, you cannot help but be awestruck by the number and age of the assembled volumes
translate: 当你穿过古老的图书馆时，你不由自主地对这些藏书的数量和年代感到敬畏。

original: Surely there are texts here that exist nowhere else in the Empire
translate: 毫无疑问，这里有些典籍在帝国其他地方根本不存在，

original: It’s a melancholy thought
translate: 这真是个令人忧郁的念头，

original: This priory is a time-capsule to an age that is long past and you cannot help but linger for a moment on all that has been lost over the long centuries of steady decline
translate: 这座修道院是一个时间胶囊，封存着早已逝去的时代，你不由自主地驻足片刻，思索着在漫长世纪中持续衰落所失去的一切，

original: You draw out a random volume and examine it: ‘On the Reticular Properties of Salts’
translate: 你随手抽出一卷书，仔细端详：《论盐的网状特性》，

original: As you turn the beautifully bound volume over in your hands, you stop
translate: 当你把这本装帧精美的书卷在手中翻转时，你停了下来，

original: Did you just see something move in the shadows?
translate: 你刚才是不是看到阴影中有东西在动？

original: You squint into the darkness and see only rows and rows of books
translate: 你眯起眼睛望向黑暗处，只看到一排排的书架，

original: Then, you see it again
translate: 然后，你又看到了，

original: It’s as if reality itself ripples
translate: 仿佛现实本身泛起了涟漪，

original: To your horror you realize that you are surrounded by a pack of some kind of chameleonic horrors!
translate: 你惊恐地意识到，自己被一群某种变色龙般的恐怖生物包围了！

original: #PrioryInteriorSpottedCamp
translate: #修道院内部发现营地

original: Crates of supplies, camp equipment and mining gear litter this room
translate: 成箱的补给、营地装备和采矿工具散落在这个房间里

original: It appears you’ve found the Cabal expedition’s base-camp
translate: 看来你找到了秘盟考察队的基地营地

original: I wonder what happened to them all?
translate: 我很好奇他们都遭遇了什么？

original: Kat muses
translate: 卡蒂沉思道

original: and what they left behind
translate: 以及他们留下了什么

original: She absent-mindedly kicks an empty sack
translate: 她心不在焉地踢了一个空袋子

original: The camp appears abandoned in a hurry and you wonder if the expedition may have left behind clues as to their fate
translate: 营地似乎被匆忙遗弃，你怀疑考察队是否留下了关于他们命运的线索

original: Your eyes fall on the floor
translate: 你的目光落在地板上

original: It’s covered by an intricate mosaic so life-like in its execution that the figures seem to shift
translate: 地板上覆盖着精美的马赛克，工艺栩栩如生，图案似乎在移动

original: You stand mesmerized
translate: 你站在那里，被迷住了

original: Embla hisses
translate: 恩布拉嘶声道

original: Did you hear something?
translate: 你听到什么了吗？

original: Look here
translate: 看这里

original: The floor
translate: 地板

original: Drinna walks into the chamber, kicking away dust from the intricate mosaic that is laid out before you
translate: 德莉娜走进房间，踢开面前精美马赛克上的灰尘

original: The imagery, there’s something wrong with it
translate: 这些图案，有些不对劲

original: Shh!
translate: 嘘！

original: Embla interrupts
translate: 恩布拉打断道

original: Out of the shadows, grotesque forms lumber towards you
translate: 从阴影中，怪异的形体蹒跚着向你走来

original: These are not the desiccated forms of the ancient dead but fresh corpses swollen with squirming tentacles of the Fungi from Outside
translate: 这些不是古代死者的干尸，而是新鲜的尸体，肿胀着来自外域的菌的蠕动触手

original: I’d wager we’ve found the expedition’s members!
translate: 我敢打赌我们找到了考察队的成员！

original: Roland snarls as he braces to receive the onslaught
translate: 罗兰咆哮着，准备迎接冲击

original: I seems you’ve found the expedition’s members
translate: 看来你找到了考察队的成员

original: #PrioryOpenFakeTomb
translate: #修道院假墓开启

original: A cursory examination of the area reveals nothing
translate: 粗略检查这片区域一无所获

original: Nonetheless, your instinct tells you there is something here
translate: 尽管如此，你的直觉告诉你这里有什么东西

original: You’ll need to examine the chamber inch by inch
translate: 你需要一寸一寸地检查这个房间

original: You close your eyes and for a moment all is still
translate: 你闭上眼睛，片刻间万籁俱寂

original: Then you feel it
translate: 然后你感觉到了

original: The faintest of drafts seems to be coming from the south-west corner of the chamber
translate: 一丝极其微弱的气流似乎从房间的西南角传来

original: There is no doubt
translate: 毫无疑问

original: There is another way out of here
translate: 这里有另一条出路

original: My faith in the Golden Dead is unfailing and it screams at me that something here is not as it seems
translate: 我对黄金先祖的信仰坚定不移，它向我呐喊，这里有些东西并非表面所见

original: But we’ve come this far and now that we stand before the tomb I say we get to the bottom of this charade
translate: 但我们已经走到这一步，既然站在墓前，我说我们得揭穿这场骗局

original: Embla, what about you?
translate: 恩布拉，你呢？

original: Open the tomb
translate: 打开墓穴

original: It still becons me
translate: 它仍在召唤我

original: Though… standing here now something feels off
translate: 不过……现在站在这里，感觉有些不对劲

original: Nonetheless, as I see it there is only one way forward
translate: 尽管如此，在我看来只有一条路可走

original: We must open the tomb
translate: 我们必须打开墓穴

original: Driina, how about you?
translate: 德莉娜，你呢？

original: The golden tomb stands before you in all its glory
translate: 金色的墓穴矗立在你面前，尽显辉煌

original: Have you arrived, at last, at the object of your quest?
translate: 你终于到达了任务的目标吗？

original: Embla, what are you thinking?
translate: 恩布拉，你在想什么？

original: Driina, what do you think?
translate: 德莉娜，你怎么看？

original: It could be worse I suppose
translate: 我想情况可能更糟

original: Kat adds as she pats your shoulder
translate: 卡蒂拍了拍你的肩膀补充道

original: It could have been a trap
translate: 这本来可能是个陷阱

original: But where to now?
translate: 但现在去哪儿呢？

original: Scanning the room you can’t help but agree with Embla
translate: 扫视房间，你不由得同意恩布拉的看法

original: There is something about this chamber
translate: 这个房间有些不对劲

original: The taint of ancient secrets
translate: 古老秘密的污迹

original: Suddenly a massive portcullis slams down behind you and to your horror, thick greenish smoke billows into the chamber through unseen apertures
translate: 突然，一扇巨大的落栅门在你身后轰然落下，令你惊恐的是，浓密的绿色烟雾通过看不见的孔洞涌入房间

original: Oh, that’s not good!
translate: 哦，这可不好！

original: Kat says as her eyes widen in terror
translate: 卡蒂惊恐地睁大眼睛说道

original: If you do not find a way out of here, this will very quickly end up as your tomb as well
translate: 如果你找不到出路，这里很快就会成为你的坟墓

original: You brace yourself and push with all your strength but find that the lid slides back easily and locks into position with a slight click
translate: 你稳住身体，用尽全力推，却发现盖子轻松滑开，并随着一声轻响锁定到位

original: It’s as if the lid has been designed to open and close
translate: 仿佛这盖子就是设计成可以开合的

original: Nonetheless, the sarcophagus’ content now lies before you
translate: 尽管如此，石棺里的东西现在展现在你面前

original: Look inside
translate: 往里看

original: You draw a collective gasp as the content is revealed
translate: 当里面的东西显露出来时，你们齐声倒吸一口凉气

original: Nothing - The sarcophagus is utterly empty
translate: 什么都没有——石棺完全是空的

original: Roland’s laughter booms through the tomband you can hear Driina offer a whispered prayer of relief
translate: 罗兰的笑声在墓穴中回荡，你能听到德莉娜低声发出如释重负的祈祷

original: Embla, somehow, looks less than surprised
translate: 恩布拉，不知怎的，看起来并不怎么惊讶

original: Roland’s laughter booms through the tomb
translate: 罗兰的笑声在墓穴中回荡

original: Nothing but dust has ever lain hereand you can hear Driina offer a whispered prayer of relief
translate: 这里除了灰尘从未有过任何东西，你能听到德莉娜低声发出如释重负的祈祷

original: Nothing but dust has ever lain here
translate: 这里除了灰尘从未有过任何东西

original: What is this?
translate: 这是什么？

original: A false tomb
translate: 一个假墓

original: A decoy perhaps?
translate: 也许是个诱饵？

original: Like a chest with a false bottom?
translate: 就像有假底的箱子？

original: I suspect the true meaning of this tomb lies deeper than we first suspected
translate: 我怀疑这座墓的真正含义比我们最初猜测的更深

original: Embla muses
translate: 恩布拉沉思道

original: There is something we’ve missed
translate: 我们遗漏了什么

original: Some hidden secret
translate: 某个隐藏的秘密

original: Roland’s laughter booms through the tomb and you can hear Driina offer a whispered prayer of relief

original: And underneath it: an artifact wrapped in rough linen
translate: 而在它下面：一个用粗麻布包裹的器物

original: As you reach for it, a ringing rises in your ears and you go light headed
translate: 当你伸手去拿时，耳边响起一阵嗡鸣，你感到头晕目眩

original: Excitement?
translate: 是兴奋？

original: Something else
translate: 还是别的什么

original: The bundle tumbles from your hands and as it does, it becomes unwrapped
translate: 包裹从你手中掉落，随之散开

original: Laying on the ground in front of you is a hideous idol carved from some unknown greenish-black rock
translate: 躺在地上的是一个丑陋的神像，由某种未知的墨绿色岩石雕刻而成

original: An amorphous shape of eyes, mouths and tentacles that manages to convey a sense of immensity in spite of the effigy’s small size
translate: 一个由眼睛、嘴巴和触手组成的无定形形状，尽管雕像尺寸很小，却传达出一种浩瀚无垠的感觉

original: Hand over the idol
translate: 把神像交出来

original: The voice cuts through the mist like a dagger
translate: 声音像匕首一样划破雾气

original: You turn around to see Carylla and a handful of other shapes approaching threateningly with weapons drawn
translate: 你转过身，看到卡莉拉和几个身影手持武器，气势汹汹地逼近

original: I can’t bloody believe it!
translate: 我真他娘的不敢相信！

original: It worked!
translate: 成功了！

original: I told you all it would
translate: 我告诉过你们会的

original: one of the men flanking Carylla rants excitedly before she cuts him off with a poisonous glance
translate: 卡莉拉身旁的一个男人兴奋地咆哮着，她恶狠狠地瞪了他一眼，打断了他

original: Shut your bloody trap Pieter!
translate: 闭上你的臭嘴，皮特！

original: You!
translate: 你！

original: she points her sword towards you
translate: 她用剑指向你

original: Hand over the idol!
translate: 把神像交出来！

original: Kick it over
translate: 踢过来

original: Not going to happen!
translate: 休想！

original: The men I work for
translate: 我效力的那些人

original: They will go so much further than just spilling your blood to get what they seek
translate: 为了得到他们想要的东西，他们可不止会让你流血那么简单

original: A smile, strangely sympathetic, flashes over her face
translate: 她脸上闪过一丝奇怪而同情的微笑

original: Then she clicks her tongue and the men flanking her charge!
translate: 然后她咂了咂舌，她两侧的男人发起了冲锋！

original: #SantaFury2
translate: #SantaFury2

original: Come to think of it, a bit of bloodshed might be just what I need right now!
translate: 仔细想想，眼下见点血或许正是我需要的！

original: Come on then, you bastard
translate: 那就来吧，你这杂种

original: There are people, groups even, you just do not talk about and I’m not about to start with you
translate: 有些人，甚至有些组织，是根本不能谈论的，我也不打算跟你开这个头

original: Since you’re moments away from death however, I’ll give you this much
translate: 不过，既然你离死不远了，我就告诉你这么多

original: There are secrets in the Empire so deeply hidden you’ll only ever be able to perceive the faintest of their outlines
translate: 帝国中有些秘密藏得如此之深，你最多只能窥见其最模糊的轮廓

original: So monumental are they, that even though they’re in front of your very nose, you’re unable to perceive them
translate: 它们如此庞大，即便就在你眼皮底下，你也无法察觉

original: The rest of Carylla’s group looks at her anxiously
translate: 卡莉拉队伍里的其他人不安地看着她

original: Cary, you shouldn't
translate: 卡莉，你不该这样

original: one of them whispers to her
translate: 其中一人对她低语

original: Carylla’s eyes narrow
translate: 卡莉拉眯起眼睛

original: Have no fear Pieter
translate: 别怕 皮特

original: This one’s at the end of the road
translate: 这家伙走到头了

original: Wait, I had some more questions first!
translate: 等等，我还有些问题要先问！

original: Prepare to die you bitch!
translate: 准备受死吧 你这贱人！

original: The group exchanges nervous glances
translate: 这群人紧张地交换着眼神

original: I’m paid well to not ask questions and that’s a particularly dangerous question to ask
translate: 我拿高薪就是为了不问问题 而这个问题尤其危险

original: Let’s just say, someone was willing to put a lot of gold towards recovering this
translate: 这么说吧，有人愿意花大把金子来找回这东西

original: Carylla pats the bag hanging by her side
translate: 卡莉拉拍了拍挂在身侧的袋子

original: So, shall I gut you now?
translate: 那么，我现在就给你开膛？

original: I had some more questions first
translate: 我还有些问题要先问

original: Who's paying you?
translate: 谁在付你钱？

original: Let's dance!
translate: 来战吧！

original: As you approach the camp, a group of armed men and women whirl to face you
translate: 当你靠近营地时，一群全副武装的男女猛地转身面对你

original: You recognize them as the troupe who ‘relieved’ you of the Santa Fury idol
translate: 你认出他们正是从你手中“夺走”圣怒号神像的那伙人

original: They do, however, look quite a bit rougher compared to when you saw them last
translate: 不过，比起你上次见到他们时，他们看起来狼狈了不少

original: Carylla, the leader of the group draws her sword and points it at you
translate: 卡莉拉，这伙人的头领，拔出剑指向你

original: You?
translate: 是你？

original: Tell me, is your death-wish truly that strong?
translate: 告诉我，你当真这么想死？

original: All I want is to get paid for this bloody idol and leave this fucking island!
translate: 我只想拿这该死的破神像换钱，然后离开这座鬼岛！

original: Turns out that’s rather difficult at the moment and now I have to take time off from my drinking to spill your stinking guts as well?!
translate: 结果眼下这事变得相当棘手 现在我还得放下酒杯 来把你那臭烘烘的肠子也捅出来？！

original: Wait, let's parlay!
translate: 等等，我们谈谈！

original: What are we waiting for?
translate: 我们还在等什么？

original: I'll indulge you
translate: 我就迁就你一下

original: What is that idol?
translate: 那神像是什么？

original: Who hired you?
translate: 谁雇的你？

original: How about I just take the idol of your hands?
translate: 不如我直接从你手里拿走神像？

original: Enought talk!
translate: 废话少说！

original: Time to die!
translate: 受死吧！

original: Carylla lets out a sound somewhere between a snort and a laugh
translate: 卡莉拉发出一声介于嗤笑和大笑之间的声音

original: Pray tell, why would I do that?
translate: 请问，我为什么要那么做？

original: For all her bravado, there is something
translate: 尽管她虚张声势，但有些东西

original: The slightest hint of doubt
translate: 一丝极细微的疑虑

original: Hand it over and I'll let you live
translate: 把它交出来 我就饶你一命

original: One of the lackeys look pleadingly at her but Carylla is adamant
translate: 一个手下恳求地看着她 但卡莉拉态度坚决

original: You don’t understand do you?
translate: 你不明白 对吧？

original: There are forces at work far more powerful and much darker than you can fathom
translate: 有远比你能想象的更强大、更黑暗的力量在运作

original: Your threats pale in comparison to what they would do
translate: 你的威胁跟他们要做的事比起来 根本不值一提

original: The group quickly and quietly slinks off into the forest leaving you behind with the idol
translate: 这伙人迅速而安静地溜进森林 留下你和那尊神像

original: As you remove it from the sack and gaze upon the grotesque form, a ringing rises in your ears
translate: 当你把它从袋子里取出，凝视着那怪诞的形态时，一阵耳鸣在你脑中响起

original: This is no mere mundane item - of that you have no doubt
translate: 这绝非寻常凡物——对此你毫不怀疑

original: As you stow it in your pack, you can’t help but wonder if Carylla’s final words were true
translate: 当你把它收进背包时，不禁怀疑卡莉拉最后的话是否属实

original: Have you drawn the ire of other, darker forces?
translate: 你是否已经招来了其他更黑暗力量的怒火？

original: One of the men leans in, speaking to Carylla
translate: 一个男人凑过来，对卡莉拉说

original: Cary, ’s onto something yeah?
translate: 卡莉，他说得有点道理，对吧？

original: Let’s get out of here and leave that bleedin’ thing for them?
translate: 我们离开这儿，把那该死的东西留给他们？

original: Let them deal with it!
translate: 让他们去处理吧！

original: Carylla swallows hard
translate: 卡莉拉艰难地咽了口唾沫

original: Then throws you a sack with something heavy in it
translate: 然后扔给你一个沉甸甸的袋子

original: Have the fucking thing!
translate: 拿走这该死的玩意儿！

original: Maybe I’ll finally get to sleep now
translate: 也许我终于能睡个安稳觉了

original: But hear me
translate: 但你听好

original: Men will be coming for that
translate: 会有人来找这东西的

original: Men far more powerful than me and my lot
translate: 比我和我这帮人强大得多的人

original: So you best sleep with one eye open from now on
translate: 所以你最好从现在起睁着一只眼睡觉

original: If you’re able to sleep at all, that is
translate: 如果你还能睡得着的话

original: Take the idol
translate: 拿走神像

original: Cary, he’s onto something yeah?
translate: 卡莉，他说得有点道理，对吧？

original: Cary, she’s onto something yeah?
translate: 卡莉，她说得有点道理，对吧？

original: #ShrineAgility
translate: #神龛敏捷

original: A pilgrim's shrine
translate: 朝圣者的神龛

original: Driina answers as she thoughtfully strokes the ancient masonry
translate: 德莉娜一边若有所思地抚摸着古老的石砖，一边回答道

original: There are a number of these spread throughout the Outer Isles
translate: 外岛各处散布着许多这样的神龛

original: Pilgrims would come from throughout the Empire to pray at them
translate: 朝圣者会从帝国各地前来祈祷

original: It is said to bring good luck and clarity
translate: 据说能带来好运和清明

original: But you have not visited them?
translate: 但你还没去过吗？

original: I’m a Sepulchite
translate: 我是葬仪修会的

original: My order is not required to do pilgrimages and I’ve had little time to wander in my time here
translate: 我的修会不要求朝圣，而我在这里的这段时间也没什么空闲四处游历

original: That being said, it would give me great joy to be able to visit all the shrines one day
translate: “话虽如此，有朝一日能遍访所有神龛，会让我非常开心”

original: Say, pilgrims traveling to the shrines pass through Horryn
translate: “话说，前往神龛的朝圣者会途经霍林”

original: We might still find some there
translate: 我们或许还能在那里找到一些

original: Perhaps they could teach us the proper prayers and rituals to perform at these sites?
translate: 也许他们能教我们在此处进行恰当的祈祷和仪式？

original: Yes let's keep an eye out for them
translate: 好，我们留意一下他们

original: An ancient, weathered Imperial way-shrine stands before you
translate: “一座古老、饱经风霜的帝国路旁神龛矗立在你面前”

original: Despite its remote location you suspect it still sees occasional use
translate: 尽管地处偏远，你怀疑它仍偶尔有人使用

original: Pray at the shrine
translate: 在神龛前祈祷

original: Driina, what is this?
translate: “德莉娜，这是什么？”

original: Examine the shrine
translate: 检查神龛

original: You are a bit rusty on your Imperial religious history and have no clue as to the way-shrine’s purpose
translate: 你对帝国宗教史有些生疏，完全不知道这路旁神龛的用途

original: This is one of several pilgrim sites in the Outer Isles
translate: 这是外岛的几处朝圣地点之一

original: It is said that to pray at them offers wholeness of body and clarity of mind
translate: 据说在此祈祷能带来身体的完整与心智的清明

original: However, you have no idea of the proper prayers and rituals to perform
translate: “然而，你不知道该进行怎样的恰当祈祷和仪式”

original: Perhaps there are pilgrims in the region for you to ask?
translate: 也许这地区有朝圣者可以让你问问？

original: You kneel by the way-shrine and begin to recite the pilgrim’s prayer
translate: 你在路旁神龛旁跪下，开始念诵朝圣者的祈祷文

original: You successfully complete the ritual
translate: 你成功完成了仪式

original: Traveling north along the coast, you notice a young man standing at the side of the road
translate: 沿着海岸向北行进，你注意到路边站着一个年轻人

original: # Shrines
translate: # 神龛

original: #Shrines General
translate: #神龛通用

original: {PLAYER} gained Ability
translate: {PLAYER} 获得了能力

original: Blessing of Fortitude Kat gained Ability
translate: 卡蒂获得了坚韧祝福能力

original: #SpiderCaveSon
translate: #蜘蛛洞穴之子

original: Ol’ mother Katak’s cottage lies to the north-east
translate: 老卡塔克嬷嬷的小屋在东北方

original: Has a great big tree growing through it so you can’t miss it
translate: 有棵大树从屋里长出来 你不会错过的

original: Ol’ lady’s a bit strange but she knows things!
translate: 老太太有点古怪 但她知道不少事情

original: Potions and herbs and such
translate: 药水和草药之类的

original: Might even have some to sell you
translate: 说不定还能卖你一些

original: Anything else?
translate: 还有别的吗

original: Aye!
translate: 嗯

original: There’s a bit of marshland north of the big oak
translate: 大橡树北边有一片沼泽地

original: I’d stay out of there
translate: 我劝你别去那儿

original: There’s lizards and such and they say even a single bite is enough to kill ya on account of the disease they carry in their mouths!
translate: 那里有蜥蜴之类的 据说只要被咬一口就足以致命 因为它们嘴里带着病

original: Thanks!
translate: 谢谢

original: I'll get going then
translate: 那我走了

original: Tombs bless you!
translate: 愿墓群保佑你

original: If... when you find my dar, tell him I’ll be waiting for him at home!
translate: 如果……等你找到我爹 告诉他我会在家等他

original: The boy sets off into the woods and once more, the forest is quiet
translate: 男孩动身走进树林 森林再次安静下来

original: To your surprise, a young man crashes through the undergrowth ahead of you
translate: 出乎你的意料 一个年轻男子从你前方的灌木丛中冲了出来

original: His face is red and he’s panting heavily as he spots you
translate: 他满脸通红 气喘吁吁地看到了你

original: He... help!
translate: 他……救命

original: They took ‘im!
translate: 他们抓走了他

original: They took who?
translate: 他们抓走了谁

original: My dar!
translate: 我爹

original: We were working at the lumber-camp when they just burst out of the trees!
translate: 我们正在伐木营地干活 他们突然从树林里冲了出来

original: My dar took a swing at em with ‘is axe an told me to run!
translate: 我爹用他的斧子朝他们挥了一下 叫我快跑

original: The boy breaks down and sobs
translate: 男孩崩溃了 抽泣起来

original: But I saw ‘em take ‘im and drag ‘im into the forest!
translate: 但我看到他们抓走了他 把他拖进了森林

original: What took your father?
translate: 是什么抓走了你父亲

original: I couldn’t tell you because they kind of hid in the undergrowth!
translate: 我说不上来 因为他们躲在灌木丛里

original: But they were large as hounds and all I saw was the gleam from their terrible eyes!
translate: 但他们像野狗一样大 我只看到他们可怕的眼睛闪着光

original: Please
translate: 求你了

original: You have to go look for 'im!
translate: 你得去找他

original: He’s all I got left since ma died!
translate: 自从我妈死后 他是我唯一的亲人了

original: I'll try
translate: 我会试试

original: Camp’s to the east of here!
translate: 营地在东边

original: Just go past the big oak and then you’ll eventually see our lean-to and campfire!
translate: 只要经过那棵大橡树 你最终会看到我们的棚屋和篝火

original: Please hurry!
translate: 请快点

original: Anything else of note in the area?
translate: 这附近还有什么值得注意的吗

original: I’ll make my own way out
translate: 我会自己想办法出去

original: Surely my boy is waiting
translate: 我的孩子肯定在等我

original: Fare thee well and be careful - These are dark times
translate: 保重，小心——如今世道黑暗

original: The man bows deeply and leaves
translate: 那人深深鞠躬后离开了

original: You recoil in shock as the cocoon shifts under your hands!
translate: 当茧在你手下蠕动时，你震惊地缩回手！

original: Whatever is inside is still alive
translate: 里面的东西还活着

original: As you stand there dumbstruck, you can hear faint moaning
translate: "当你目瞪口呆地站在那里时，能听到微弱的呻吟声"

original: Cut open the cocoon
translate: 割开茧

original: You carefully cut open the cocoon and a large man stumbles out
translate: 你小心地割开茧，一个高大的男人跌跌撞撞地摔了出来

original: No doubt shaken and disoriented from the ordeal, the poor fellow looks at you with wide eyes
translate: 显然是被这番磨难吓坏了，这可怜的家伙睁大眼睛看着你

original: What
translate: 什么

original: Who
translate: 谁

original: Where?
translate: 在哪里？

original: Your son sent me to look for you!
translate: 你儿子派我来找你的！

original: Recollection creeps back into the man’s eyes
translate: 回忆渐渐回到男人的眼中

original: So
translate: 那么

original: So Lon’s alive?
translate: 那么朗还活着？

original: He made it!?
translate: 他成功了！？

original: Thank the Golden!
translate: 感谢黄金之神！

original: And you
translate: 还有你

original: You risked your own life to save me?
translate: 你冒着生命危险来救我？

original: How can I ever repay you?
translate: 我该如何报答你？

original: No reward is necessary
translate: 不需要报酬

original: Surely you have something?
translate: 你肯定有什么想要的吧？

original: In that case, you have my eternal gratitude my lord!
translate: 那样的话，你永远拥有我的感激，领主大人！

original: In that case, you have my eternal gratitude my lady!
translate: 那样的话，你永远拥有我的感激，女士！

original: Here
translate: 给

original: Take my axe!
translate: 拿着我的斧子！

original: It's as well crafted as they come and I'm sure it'll fetch you a pretty penny at the market!
translate: 这把斧子做工精良，肯定能在市场上卖个好价钱！

original: Thank you!
translate: 谢谢你！

original: In that case, you have my eternal gratitude my Lord!
translate: 那样的话，你永远拥有我的感激，领主大人！

original: In that case, you have my eternal gratitude my Lady!
translate: 那样的话，你永远拥有我的感激，女士！

original: #StarstriderShip_Awakening
translate: #星行者飞船觉醒

original: Darkness
translate: 黑暗

original: The feel of cold metal on bare skin
translate: 裸露皮肤上冰冷金属的触感

original: A smell in the air
translate: 空气中有一股气味

original: The pungent mix of spices, ozone and untold eons past
translate: 香料、臭氧与无数纪元过去的刺鼻混合物

original: Consciousness eludes you however, and you slip back into the abyss
translate: 然而意识离你而去，你滑回深渊之中

original: You dream of floating
translate: 你梦见漂浮

original: Of stars
translate: 梦见星辰

original: A blue orb wreathed in a shimmering veil
translate: 一个被闪烁光幕包裹的蓝色球体

original: But there is more; A rift!
translate: 但还有更多；一道裂隙！

original: Something seeps through
translate: 有什么东西渗了进来

original: Like venom entering a wound
translate: 如同毒液渗入伤口

original: Coiling
translate: 盘绕

original: Roiling
translate: 翻腾

original: Primordial
translate: 原初

original: Suddenly a scream of pain and terror cuts into your mind like an acid knife!
translate: 突然，一声痛苦与恐惧的尖叫像一把强酸刀一样刺入你的脑海！

original: Shocked awake, the scream echoes in your mind
translate: 惊醒过来，那尖叫仍在脑海中回荡

original: Was it real or part of the dream?
translate: 那是真实的还是梦境的一部分？

original: Stirring slowly, you find you’re lying on some kind of table
translate: 慢慢动弹，你发现自己正躺在某种桌子上

original: You’re naked and cold and, as far as you can tell, all alone
translate: 你赤身裸体，浑身冰冷，而且就你所知，孤身一人

original: You stand up and find your head spinning
translate: 你站起身来，感到天旋地转

original: Even in the faint light, the vague outlines hint of proportions and dimension not meant for men
translate: 即使在微弱的光线下，模糊的轮廓也暗示着非为人类而设的比例与维度

original: What immortal hand could have framed such things?
translate: 何等不朽之手方能塑造此等事物？

original: Perhaps the concealing darkness is a blessing to your wracked senses
translate: 或许这遮蔽的黑暗对你饱受折磨的感官是一种恩赐
