translate: #星行者飞船控制台

original: Something about Doors
translate: 关于门的一些事

original: More about Doors
translate: 更多关于门的事

original: The machine abides
translate: 机器在等待

original: The inner doors have been unlocked
translate: 内部的门已解锁

original: Issue another query
translate: 发出另一个查询

original: A discordant sound blears at you from the machine in what can only be described as contempt
translate: 机器发出一种刺耳的声音，只能用轻蔑来形容

original: The aperture dies down and the machine appears to some sort of hibernation state
translate: 光圈暗淡下来，机器似乎进入了某种休眠状态

original: The image is one of deep timeless sleep
translate: 画面是一种深沉永恒的睡眠

original: Millennias passing in silence
translate: 千年在寂静中流逝

original: Then a sound
translate: 然后一个声音

original: Something banging on the outer skin
translate: 有什么东西在敲击外壳

original: Children!
translate: 孩子们！

original: They have descended from the trees and multiplied
translate: 他们从树上下来，繁衍增多

original: In their greed for knowledge and power they now come to disturb us
translate: 出于对知识和力量的贪婪，他们现在来打扰我们

original: But something else has crept in
translate: 但别的东西已经悄悄潜入

original: They have torn the veil!
translate: 他们撕开了帷幕！

original: It is here now!
translate: 它现在就在这里！

original: It claws at our skin!
translate: 它抓挠着我们的外壳！

original: We are holding for now but we grow weak
translate: 我们暂时还能支撑，但我们正在变弱

original: The navigator must awaken
translate: 领航员必须醒来

original: The longer you play with it, the more the strange sounds and images resonate with you
translate: “你越是摆弄它，那些奇怪的声音和图像就越与你产生共鸣”

original: You begin seeing them for what they are
translate: 你开始看清它们的本质

original: Terms in some great cosmic equation
translate: 某个宏大宇宙方程中的项

original: A language of pure logic
translate: 一种纯逻辑的语言

original: No longer are the notes mere sounds
translate: 音符不再仅仅是声音

original: With each note a number resonates
translate: 每个音符都有一个数字在共鸣

original: As if sensing your dawning understanding, the great machine offers you a prompt
translate: “仿佛察觉到你逐渐理解，这台伟大的机器向你发出了提示”

original: How do you respond?
translate: 你如何回应？

original: Enter '4'
translate: 输入“4”

original: Enter '5'
translate: 输入“5”

original: Enter '6'
translate: 输入“6”

original: The machine prompts you to enter the next number
translate: 机器提示你输入下一个数字

original: Enter '8'
translate: 输入“8”

original: Enter '10'
Enter '12'
The machine prompts you to enter the final number
translate: 机器提示你输入最后一个数字

original: Enter '13'
Enter '14'
Enter '15'
The interior of the aperture appears like a churning vortex of some black oily substance
translate: 光圈内部看起来像某种黑色油状物质翻腾的漩涡

original: Within it motes of light appear, looking almost like miniature stars that are born and die within the span of moments
translate: “其中出现了光点，看起来几乎像微型的星星，在瞬息之间诞生又消亡”

original: Images form
translate: 图像形成

original: Strange geometric shapes that combine and recombine in strange infinite fractals
translate: 奇怪的几何形状，以奇异的无限分形组合再组合

original: Looking around for a way to operate the strange machine, your hand passes over the liquid-filled basins
translate: “四处寻找操作这台奇怪机器的方法时，你的手拂过了装满液体的盆子”

original: A strangely musical note can be heard
translate: 可以听到一个奇特的乐音

original: Soft at first and then much stronger as your fingers lightly graze the surface of the liquid
translate: 起初轻柔，然后随着你的手指轻轻掠过液体表面，声音变得响亮得多

original: Dipping your fingers into the liquid at different points produces unique notes - almost like playing an instrument - and as you do so, the images on the aperture shift
translate: “将手指浸入液体不同位置会产生独特的音符——几乎就像在演奏乐器——而当你这样做时，光圈上的图像也随之变化”

original: You find yourself mesmerized
translate: 你发现自己被迷住了

original: The auditory and visual patterns seem utterly incomprehensible and yet
translate: 这些听觉和视觉模式似乎完全无法理解，然而

original: There is something there
translate: 那里有什么东西

original: Something stirring in the back of your mind
translate: 有什么东西在你脑海深处搅动

original: A sonorous, polyphonic wave of equations issues forth from the aperture
translate: “一阵洪亮、复调般的方程式波动从光圈中涌出”

original: Like a veil being lifted, you find that you now understand the machine’s language on an instinctual level
translate: “就像帷幕被揭开，你发现自己现在本能地理解了机器的语言”

original: The aperture on the wall is strangely mesmerizing though at the present, you have a feeling it is somehow inactive
translate: “墙上的光圈有一种奇异的魅力，不过目前，你感觉它似乎处于非活跃状态”

original: You look over at the empty basins flanking it
translate: 你看向两侧的空盆子

original: Perhaps they are involved somehow?
translate: 也许它们与此有关？

original: The machine serves at your command
translate: 机器听从你的命令

original: Unlock the doors!
translate: 解锁门！

original: What is the status of this place?
translate: 这个地方的状态如何？

original: The black surface vibrates in anticipation as you approach it
translate: 当你靠近时，黑色的表面期待地振动着

original: Interact
translate: 互动

original: Something about Status
translate: 关于状态的一些事

original: More about Status
translate: 更多关于状态的事

original: Finally the last part about Status
translate: 最后关于状态的部分

original: #StarstridershipConsolePools
translate: #星舰控制台池

original: Smooth, empty basins line the console
translate: 光滑的空盆排列在控制台上

original: Narrow grooves seem to connect them and you get a feeling that they’re part of some kind of machine
translate: 狭窄的凹槽似乎将它们连接起来，你感觉它们是某种机器的一部分

original: Whatever this is, it appears dormant at the moment and has likely been so for a long time
translate: 不管这是什么，它目前似乎处于休眠状态，而且很可能已经休眠了很长时间

original: Fill Basins
translate: 填满盆子

original: Carefully, you empty the fluid from the vessels into the basins
translate: 你小心翼翼地将容器中的液体倒入盆中

original: Seeming to move of its own volition, the fluid spreads from basin to basin through the inset grooves and slowly the entire room hums into life
translate: 液体似乎自行移动，通过嵌入的凹槽从一个盆扩散到另一个盆，慢慢地整个房间嗡嗡作响，恢复了生机

original: It appears you have conjured something back into life
translate: 看来你让什么东西重新焕发了生机

original: #StarstriderShipDriina
translate: #星行者飞船德莉娜

original: The Driina’s whispered prayers echo softly throughout the strange hallway
translate: 德莉娜的低语祈祷声在这条奇怪的走廊里轻轻回荡，

original: Over and over she recites the same lines as she rocks gently back and forth
translate: 她一边轻轻前后摇晃，一边一遍又一遍地重复着同样的祷词，

original: Driina!
translate: 德莉娜！

original: I tried to talk to her
translate: 我试着和她说话，

original: To make her see
translate: 想让她明白，

original: But it’s too late
translate: 但太迟了，

original: I couldn’t stop her
translate: 我阻止不了她，

original: Who?
translate: 谁？

original: She is so close now
translate: 她现在离得很近了，

original: He calls to her
translate: 他在呼唤她，

original: I really did try to stop her
translate: 我真的试过阻止她，

original: But I see now
translate: 但我现在明白了，

original: We have always come here - and we always will
translate: 我们总是来到这里——而且我们永远都会来，

original: She will need your help before the end
translate: 在结束之前，她会需要你的帮助，

original: She lapses back into reciting her prayer
translate: 她又陷入了祈祷的背诵中，

original: There is nothing more to be done for her
translate: 对她已经无能为力了，

original: #StarstriderShipIben
translate: #星行者飞船伊本

original: Your hands shake as you contemplate what you must do!
translate: 当你思考必须做的事情时，双手不住颤抖！

original: To release him, you must no doubt inflict more pain onto his tortured form
translate: “要释放他，你无疑必须给他饱受折磨的身躯带来更多痛苦”

original: Fumbling, you reach into the open chest-cavity searching for his heart
translate: “你摸索着，将手伸进敞开的胸腔，寻找他的心脏”

original: You find it but the feeling of it beating in your hands is enough to make you vomit
translate: 你找到了它，但它在手中跳动的感觉足以让你呕吐

original: You try again, tears streaming down your face and, with much effort, you eventually manage to end his torment
translate: “你再次尝试，泪水顺着脸颊流淌，费了很大力气，你终于结束了他的痛苦”

original: You control your breathing as best you can
translate: 你尽力控制住呼吸

original: Iben is already gone - You’re just setting him free
translate: 伊本早已离去——你只是在让他解脱

original: With deft hands you reach into the open chest cavity and find the still-beating heart
translate: 你灵巧地伸手进入敞开的胸腔，找到了仍在跳动的心脏

original: You end his torment
translate: 你结束了他的痛苦

original: The scene ahead of you is one of utter horror frozen in time
translate: 眼前的景象是凝固在时间中的彻底恐怖

original: The form of a man utterly unmade with a master chirurgeon's precision
translate: 一个被外科大师以精准手法彻底拆解的人形

original: And for what purpose?
translate: 又是出于什么目的？

original: Cruelty perhaps?
translate: 也许是残酷？

original: This body was taken apart by curious hands
translate: 这具身体被好奇的双手拆开

original: Like a child would pick apart some clever clockwork toy to get at the secrets within
translate: 就像孩子拆开精巧的发条玩具，想探寻其中的秘密

original: Murder to dissect
translate: 为解剖而谋杀

original: Examine the body more closely
translate: 更仔细地检查尸体

original: Reluctantly you approach the mangled face of the corpse
translate: 你极不情愿地靠近那具面目全非的尸体脸庞

original: Disassembled into its anatomical component pieces it’s nonetheless familiar to you
translate: 尽管被拆解成解剖学上的各个组件，但你仍然觉得熟悉

original: This is the corpse of Iben
translate: 这是伊本的尸体

original: The man who fought so valiantly at your side through horrors untold
translate: 那个曾在你身边英勇奋战，历经无数恐怖的人

original: There was no warrior’s death for him; just pain and terror
translate: 他没有得到战士的死亡；只有痛苦与恐惧

original: Good bye old friend
translate: 再见了，老朋友

original: The corpse’s eyes open wide!
translate: 尸体的眼睛猛然睁开！

original: Impossibly, Iben is still alive
translate: “不可思议，伊本竟然还活着”

original: The chirurgeon has taken great care to maintain the integrity of the circulatory system and for the first time you notice that the splayed body-parts are still connected by pulsating blood vessels!
translate: 外科医生极其小心地保持了循环系统的完整，你这才第一次注意到，那些摊开的身体部件仍由搏动的血管连接着！

original: Eyes stare at you in wordless terror and, no doubt, pain beyond measure!
translate: “那双眼睛无言地凝视着你，充满恐惧，毫无疑问，还有无法衡量的痛苦！”

original: Do what must be done
translate: 做必须做的事

original: Dazed you stumble away from the horrid scene
translate: 你茫然地踉跄着离开这可怕的场景

original: There is nothing more for you here now
translate: 这里现在已没有你留下的理由

original: You must push ahead
translate: 你必须继续前进

original: #StarstriderShipKat
translate: #StarstriderShipKat

original: Movement catches your eye ahead
translate: 前方有什么动静吸引了你的目光

original: Something small and pale
translate: 一个小小的、苍白的东西

original: Crouching like a frightened animal
translate: 像受惊的动物一样蜷缩着

original: Your heart sinks as you see who it is
translate: 当你认出那是谁时，你的心一沉

original: Kat
translate: 卡蒂

original: She throws herself at you and clings to you like a shivering child
translate: 她扑向你，像个颤抖的孩子一样紧紧抱住你

original: T-they took him!
translate: 他-他们把他带走了！

original: They did… they made h-him
translate: 他们……他们把他变成了……

original: T-they took us!
translate: 他-他们把我们也抓了！

original: We’re powerless!
translate: 我们无能为力！

original: The little men!
translate: 那些小人！

original: They live in the walls!
translate: 他们住在墙壁里！

original: I saw them take us
translate: 我看见他们抓走了我们

original: Stripped us down like beasts going to the butcher’s cleaver!
translate: 像牲畜被拖去屠夫的屠刀下一样剥光了我们的衣服！

original: They don’t sleep like he does
translate: 他们不像他那样睡觉

original: They stay awake so he can sleep!
translate: 他们保持清醒，好让他能睡觉！

original: Who do you mean?
translate: 你指的是谁？

original: The king!
translate: 国王！

original: The navigator
translate: 领航员

original: He’s slept for so long but they say it’s time for him to wake up now
translate: 他已经沉睡了很久，但他们说现在是他醒来的时候了

original: They say they’re glad we came here
translate: 他们说很高兴我们来到这里

original: We did good
translate: 我们做得很好

original: But I don’t believe them
translate: 但我不相信他们

original: We should never have come!
translate: 我们根本就不该来！

original: Gods walk these halls!
translate: 众神行走在这些厅堂中！

original: We need to get out of here!
translate: 我们必须离开这里！

original: Kat’s expression vacillates between a smile and sheer terror
translate: 卡蒂的表情在微笑和纯粹的恐惧之间摇摆不定

original: The little men say we can’t leave
translate: 那些小人说我们不能离开

original: The king must awaken before the crawling doom finds its way inside
translate: 国王必须在蠕行之厄找到进来的路之前醒来

original: She tilts her head slightly to one side as if hearing something
translate: 她微微歪着头，仿佛在倾听什么

original: And they say it’s time for me to go now
translate: 他们说我现在该走了

original: I’m next
translate: 下一个是我

original: She takes a step backwards
translate: 她向后退了一步

original: Kat?
translate: 卡蒂？

original: She holds your gaze, her smile almost apologetic, as she backs up against the wall
translate: 她凝视着你，笑容近乎歉意，一边后退靠在了墙上

original: The strange biomechanical material convulses and a fissure opens up
translate: 那奇异的生物机械材料抽搐起来，裂开了一道缝隙

original: Half a dozen grotesque, small hands reach out and wrap around Kat!
translate: 六只怪异的小手伸出来，缠住了卡蒂！

original: Before you have time to react she is pulled in and the fissure seals shut with a disgusting smack
translate: 你还没来得及反应，她就被拖了进去，裂缝伴随着一声令人作呕的啪嗒声合上了

original: You are left dumbfounded and alone
translate: 你目瞪口呆，独自一人留在原地

original: #StarstriderShip_Misc
translate: #StarstriderShip_Misc

original: A strange membranous substance blocks the road ahead
translate: 一种奇怪的膜状物质挡住了前方的道路

original: You suspect this may be some kind of door though there is no opening mechanism nearby
translate: 你怀疑这可能是某种门，尽管附近没有开启机关

original: #StarstriderShipServitor
translate: #StarstriderShipServitor

original: The simulacra of a humanoid form stands before you
translate: 一个人形拟像站在你面前

original: Is this a machine imitating life or some living thing imitating a machine?
translate: 这是一台模仿生命的机器，还是某种模仿机器的活物？

original: A strange, viscous liquid fills its cupped hands as if it’s offering it to you
translate: “一种奇怪的粘稠液体充满了它捧起的双手，仿佛在将它献给你。”

original: Fill Vessel
translate: 填充容器

original: The vessel slots into the machine-creature and fills liquid
translate: 容器插入机器生物中，装满了液体

original: You take it back
translate: 你把它拿了回来

original: Perhaps this can be of some use?
translate: 也许这能派上什么用场？

original: #StarstriderShipVaultEnter
translate: #StarstriderShipVaultEnter

original: You stand in the halls of titans
translate: 你站在巨人的殿堂中

original: No man was ever meant to see this!
translate: 凡人本不该目睹此景！

original: Why did you come here?
translate: 你为何来到这里？

original: It was her wasn’t it?
translate: 是因为她，对吗？

original: Or was it?
translate: 还是另有原因？

original: Did you ever really have a choice?
translate: 你真的有过选择吗？

original: Was there some unseen hand driving you towards this doom?
translate: 是否有一只无形之手，将你推向这厄运？

original: Breathing fast and head reeling, your eyes fix on something utterly out of place in its mundanity
translate: 呼吸急促，头晕目眩，你的目光落在一样极其平凡、却与此地格格不入的东西上

original: A discarded shoe
translate: 一只被丢弃的鞋

original: Look behind you
translate: 回头望去

original: You sense her before you see her
translate: 你未见其人，先感知到她的存在

original: A luminous phantom in the darkness
translate: 黑暗中一个发光的幻影

original: Naked and emaciated there is nonetheless something in her bearing
translate: 赤身裸体，瘦骨嶙峋，但她的举止中却透着某种东西

original: Acceptance?
translate: 是接受？

original: An aura of maternal comfort?
translate: 一种母性慰藉的光环？

original: She strokes your cheek
translate: 她轻抚你的脸颊

original: Don’t be afraid
translate: 别害怕

original: We’re with him now
translate: 我们现在与他同在

original: What is happening?
translate: 发生了什么？

original: Look upon him
translate: 注视他

original: She takes you by the hand and leads you to the base of the massive throne
translate: 她牵着你的手，带你走到巨大王座的基座前

original: Stars flash before your eyes as you force yourself to look at the statue seated on it
translate: 当你强迫自己看向端坐其上的雕像时，眼前星光闪烁

original: Or is it something… more?
translate: 还是说，它不止于此……？

original: A sleeping king?
translate: 一位沉睡的君王？

original: A god!
translate: 一位神祇！

original: Your heart begins racing
translate: 你的心开始狂跳

original: You cannot bear standing in its presence
translate: 你无法承受站在它面前

original: Embla begins laughing as tears stream down her face
translate: 恩布拉开始大笑，泪水却顺着脸颊流淌

original: A tremor violently shakes the structure and you feel, more than hear, an otherworldly scream coming from somewhere outside
translate: 一阵剧烈的震动摇晃着建筑，你与其说是听到，不如说是感觉到，从外面某处传来一声非人间的尖叫

original: Embla’s eyes are wide
translate: 恩布拉瞪大了眼睛

original: I must do what I was summoned here for and you must help me
translate: 我必须完成我被召唤至此的使命，而你必须帮助我

original: Help you do what?
translate: 帮你做什么？

original: The King must awaken before the Dragon reaches him
translate: 必须在龙抵达之前唤醒君王

original: He’s slept for so long and there is so little of his essence left
translate: 他沉睡了太久，所剩的精华已寥寥无几

original: He needs fresh life
translate: 他需要新鲜的生命

original: The glass sarcophagus opens as Embla approaches
translate: 随着恩布拉走近，玻璃石棺打开了

original: To your amazement you see that the inside is molded to perfectly fit a human form
translate: 你惊讶地发现，内部被塑造成完美贴合人类形体的形状

original: The dire implications of the device are unmistakable
translate: 这装置的可怕用途毋庸置疑

original: It can't end like this!
translate: 不能就这样结束！

original: I'm supposed to take you to your father!
translate: 我应该带你去见你的父亲！

original: Don’t you understand?
translate: 你还不明白吗？

original: She smiles sadly
translate: 她悲伤地微笑着

original: I’m already with my father
translate: 我已经与我的父亲同在

original: She softly strokes your cheek
translate: 她轻柔地抚摸你的脸颊

original: I’ve always come here and you’ve always brought me
translate: 我一直都来到这里，而你也总是带我前来

original: Time and time again we’ve stood here - in this place
translate: 一次又一次，我们站在这里——在这个地方

original: And every time you do the right thing
translate: 而每一次，你都做了正确的事

original: That is the entirety of my universe now
translate: 那便是我如今的全部宇宙

original: Him in front - you behind
translate: 他在前——你在后

original: But you'll die!
translate: 但你会死的！

original: All things die
translate: 万物皆有终结

original: But I’ll be with him
translate: 但我会与他同在

original: I wonder if I will look out from behind his eyes?
translate: 不知我是否会透过他的双眼向外张望？

original: Slowly and painfully, Embla hoists herself onto the rim of the sarcophagus
translate: 缓慢而痛苦地，恩布拉将自己撑上石棺的边缘

original: With much effort she swings her legs up and lies down in the device
translate: 她费力地抬起双腿，躺入装置之中

original: Her body seems to have aged years just since you entered the chamber but now a look of utter relief washes over her face
translate: 自你进入这房间以来，她的身体仿佛衰老了数年，但此刻，一种全然解脱的神情浮现在她脸上

original: The machine emits an oddly beautiful note
translate: 机器发出一声奇异而优美的音调

original: A ritual has begun and it is time for you to take your part
translate: 仪式已经开始，该你扮演你的角色了

original: Interact with the machine
translate: 与机器互动

original: A torrent of resonant wave-form logic floods into you and the machine now awaits your command
translate: 一股共振波形逻辑的洪流涌入你的脑海，机器现在等待你的指令

original: Commence the ritual
translate: 开始仪式

original: A huge tremor once again shakes the craft
translate: 又一次巨大的震动摇晃着飞船

original: The howl that sounds this time is much more forceful
translate: 这次响起的嚎叫更加猛烈

original: Something is about to breach the craft’s outer hull
translate: 有什么东西即将突破飞船的外壳

original: Embla half-open eyes remain fixed on you as you feed the machine the harmony that sets the ritual in motion
translate: 恩布拉半睁的双眼依然凝视着你，你向机器输入启动仪式的和声

original: The faintest trace of a smile plays across her lips
translate: 一丝最微弱的笑意掠过她的唇边

original: Snaking tendrils emerge from holes in the machine, seeking out the body encased within
translate: 蜿蜒的触须从机器的孔洞中伸出，探寻着被包裹在内的躯体

original: She jolts as they plunge into her flesh
translate: 当它们刺入她的血肉时，她猛地一颤

original: For a moment she is quiet then she breaks out into violent spasms
translate: 她安静了片刻，随即爆发出剧烈的痉挛

original: The machine begins to whir and the tendril-plugs pulsate obscenely with peristaltic motion
translate: 机器开始嗡嗡作响，触须插头以蠕动的方式淫邪地搏动着

original: It has begun!
translate: 已经开始了！

original: Let the ritual proceed
translate: 让仪式继续

original: The room shakes violently
translate: 房间剧烈震动

original: Light streaming from the anti-womb into the sleeping King as Embla is utterly unmade
translate: 光芒从反子宫涌入沉睡的君王，恩布拉则被彻底分解

original: He who sat undying for eons stirs!
translate: 那永世不灭的存在，动了！

original: HE RISES!
translate: 他站起来了！

original: You are but an insect at the feet of gods
translate: 你不过是众神脚下的蝼蚁

original: All is darkness
translate: 一切陷入黑暗

original: #StarstriderShipVaultThrone
translate: #星行者飞船宝库王座

original: Ask about HelpEmbla
translate: 询问关于帮助艾姆布拉

original: Ask about StopEmbla
translate: 询问关于阻止艾姆布拉

original: Ask about AnotherWay
translate: 询问关于另一种方法

original: Something about HelpEmbla
translate: 关于帮助艾姆布拉的一些事

original: More about HelpEmbla
translate: 更多关于帮助艾姆布拉

original: Finally the last part about HelpEmbla
translate: 最后关于帮助艾姆布拉的部分

original: Something about StopEmbla
translate: 关于阻止艾姆布拉的一些事

original: More about StopEmbla
translate: 更多关于阻止艾姆布拉

original: Finally the last part about StopEmbla
translate: 最后关于阻止艾姆布拉的部分

original: Something about AnotherWay
translate: 关于另一种方法的一些事

original: More about AnotherWay
translate: 更多关于另一种方法

original: Finally the last part about AnotherWay
translate: 最后关于另一种方法的部分

original: #TowerOfAshElevator
translate: #灰烬之塔电梯

original: The elevator stands ready to take you up to the upper level of the dungeon
translate: 电梯已准备好带你前往地牢的上层

original: Ascend
translate: 上升

original: The plate set into the floor bobs slightly as you step onto it
translate: 当你踏上时，嵌入地板的平台微微晃动

original: It appears to be a kind of elevator leading down to the level below
translate: 这似乎是一种通往下方楼层的电梯

original: #UnderhallsFungusCluster
translate: #地下大厅菌簇,

original: A cluster of giant 'vomit cup' fungi grow in these cave
translate: 一簇巨大的“呕吐杯”菌生长在这些洞穴中

original: They emit an odor so foul you would only touch them if you were paid to do so
translate: 它们散发出极其恶臭的气味，除非有人付钱，否则你绝不会去触碰它们

original: Carefully gather some of the caps for Esteban
translate: 小心地为埃斯特班收集一些菌盖

original: You slice off a few of the larger caps and place them in a bag
translate: 你切下几个较大的菌盖，放进袋子里

original: The stench is almost overwhelming
translate: 恶臭几乎令人难以忍受

original: The stench is overwhelming and leaves you stricken with nausea
translate: 恶臭令人难以忍受，让你感到恶心

original: #WizardDungeonAlchemyBench
translate: #巫师地下城炼金台

original: The device hums with life and you get the impression it’s ready for use
translate: 装置发出嗡嗡声，充满活力，你觉得它已经准备就绪。

original: Craft the Salts of Elthanyr
translate: 制作埃尔萨尼尔之盐

original: Taking great care to place the ingredients into the catalyzer in the correct order, the process of transmutation begins
translate: 你小心翼翼地将材料按正确顺序放入催化器中，嬗变过程开始了。

original: Loud mechanical noises and hisses of steam sound as the machine vibrates violently
translate: 机器剧烈震动，发出响亮的机械噪音和蒸汽的嘶嘶声。

original: Then to your amazement a beaker emerges - filled with a cerulean substance that no doubt is the Salts of Elthanyr
translate: 然后，令你惊讶的是，一个烧杯出现了——里面装满了蔚蓝色的物质，毫无疑问就是埃尔萨尼尔之盐。

original: Take the salts
translate: 拿起盐。

original: It seems you have done what Calipero asked you to do
translate: 看来你已经完成了卡利佩罗要求你做的事。

original: Now you must make your way down into the summoning chamber and prepare to face whatever you find there
translate: 现在你必须前往召唤室，准备面对你在那里发现的任何东西。

original: This appears to be some form of exotic alchemical crafting device
translate: 这似乎是某种奇特的炼金制作装置。

original: However, at the moment it appears to be somehow inactive
translate: 然而，此刻它似乎不知为何处于非活跃状态。

original: #WizardDungeonCloneRoom
translate: #巫师地牢克隆室

original: The pathetic creatures howl in rage and terror and around them flickering reticular energies begin to form!
translate: 这些可怜的生物在愤怒和恐惧中嚎叫，周围开始形成闪烁的网状能量！

original: A handful of naked forms flail about the room, attacking with their bare hands the strange machines that fill it
translate: 几个赤裸的身影在房间里乱挥乱打，徒手攻击着满屋的奇怪机器。

original: Their eyes are wild and staring and they drool as they bleat forth their non-verbal cries of fear and rage
translate: 他们眼神狂野而呆滞，流着口水，发出非言语的恐惧与愤怒的咩叫。

original: Suddenly they spot you and as one they freeze in place with a mask of terror on their face
translate: 突然他们发现了你，一齐僵在原地，脸上露出惊恐的表情。

original: Look at these machines!
translate: 看看这些机器！

original: This is where he… creates these poor creatures?
translate: 这就是他……制造这些可怜生物的地方？

original: They must have escaped when their master somehow failed to attend to them
translate: 他们一定是在主人不知何故未能照料他们时逃出来的。

original: Born into a world comprised solely of this subterranean nightmare
translate: 出生在一个完全由这地下噩梦构成的世界，

original: Embla looks around in wonder
translate: 恩布拉惊奇地环顾四周，

original: But that means
translate: 但那意味着，

original: They’re like children?
translate: 他们就像孩子？

original: Kat adds
translate: 卡蒂补充道，

original: Go!
translate: 快走！

original: Get out of here!
translate: 离开这里！

original: Let's put them out of their misery!
translate: 让我们结束他们的痛苦吧！

original: Wild eyed and confused, the pathetic creatures first hesitate and then, in a sudden burst of mad energy, bolt towards the exit to the overworld
translate: 眼神狂野而困惑，这些可怜的生物先是犹豫，然后突然爆发出疯狂的能量，冲向通往地表世界的出口。

original: Bah!
translate: 呸！

original: What chance do they stand out there?
translate: 他们在外面能有什么机会？

original: Better we had put them to the sword and saved them their misery
translate: 我们还不如用剑结束他们，免得他们受苦，

original: Roland scoffs
translate: 罗兰嗤笑道，

original: As they flee, you cannot help but wonder what chance they stand out there
translate: 当他们逃跑时，你不禁想知道他们在外面能有什么机会。

original: The feral apprentices seem less than intimidated by your display and instead a certain predatory aspect creeps into their stances
translate: 这些野性的学徒似乎并未被你的展示吓倒，反而他们的姿态中透出一丝掠食者的意味。

original: It occurs to you that they might not have eaten in a while
translate: 你意识到他们可能有一阵子没吃东西了。

original: #WizardDungeonDrainage
translate: 巫师地下城排水道

original: Bracing your back against the wall of the chute you attempt to make a controlled descent
translate: 你背靠着滑槽的墙壁，试图进行有控制的下降

original: It proves more difficult than you had hoped however and you lose your grip and plummet into the dark cave below
translate: 然而这比你预想的要困难得多，你失去了抓握，坠入了下方黑暗的洞穴

original: You splash roughly into a shallow pool of water and though the landing has shaken you, at least you’re still alive
translate: 你重重地溅落在一洼浅水中，虽然落地震得你七荤八素，但至少你还活着

original: Bracing your back against the wall of the chute you make a controlled descent until the chute emerges into a larger natural cavern
translate: 你背靠着滑槽的墙壁，有控制地下降，直到滑槽通入一个更大的天然洞穴

original: A short drop remains but as the floor below is covered with water you take the chance and successfully drop into the chamber
translate: 还剩一小段落差，但下方的地面被水覆盖，你抓住机会，成功跳入了这个洞室

original: A large drain is set into the floor
translate: 地板上嵌着一个巨大的排水口

original: Though you cannot tell where the chute beyond leads, you could easily fit in should you dare
translate: 虽然你不知道后面的滑道通向何方，但只要你敢，很容易就能钻进去

original: Climb Down
translate: 爬下去

original: #WizardDungeonElevatorBlocked
translate: #巫师地下城电梯受阻

original: The room ahead of you contains a large stone platform that appears to be hovering in some kind of shaft leading down
translate: 前方的房间里有一个巨大的石台，似乎悬浮在某种向下延伸的竖井中。

original: As you take your first step into the room however, the voice of Calipero booms throughout the chamber
translate: 然而，当你踏入房间的第一步时，卡利佩罗的声音在整个房间中回荡。

original: You’ve not crafted the Salts of Elthanyr!
translate: 你还没有制作埃尔萨尼尔之盐！

original: You cannot enter the summoning chamber without it!
translate: 没有它，你不能进入召唤室！

original: Don’t tarry - I can’t hold much longer!
translate: 别磨蹭——我撑不了多久了！

original: #WizardDungeonGenerator
translate: #巫师地牢生成器

original: The strange machine appears to hum with latent energy
translate: 这台奇怪的机器似乎因潜在的能量而发出嗡嗡声

original: It appears to have been damage by the strange fire-creatures that occupied the room but you think you could probably reactivate it through some trial and error
translate: 它似乎被占据房间的奇怪火焰生物损坏了，但你觉得通过一些试错或许能重新激活它

original: Reactivate it
translate: 重新激活它

original: The droning hum coming from the machine rises in pitch and a subtle vibration can be felt through the floor now
translate: 机器发出的嗡嗡声调升高，现在可以感觉到地板传来轻微的震动

original: You believe you’ve reactivated this device, though to what end you’re not certain
translate: "你相信自己重新激活了这个装置，尽管不确定最终会有什么结果。"

original: Strange creatures seemingly composed of fire and molten lava stand around a large arcane machine of some sort
translate: 一些似乎由火焰和熔岩构成的奇怪生物围着一台大型奥术机器

original: They appear to be swaying and you almost get the impression they’re drawing energy from the machine; almost as if feeding upon it
translate: 它们似乎在摇摆，你几乎觉得它们正在从机器中汲取能量；仿佛在以此为食

original: One of the creatures suddenly appears to notice you
translate: 其中一个生物突然似乎注意到了你

original: One by one they turn to face you
translate: 它们一个接一个地转身面对你

original: It seems they are protective of their food-source
translate: 看来它们很保护自己的食物来源

original: The machine hums along with a low drone that reverberates throughout the dungeon
translate: 机器发出低沉的嗡嗡声，回荡在整个地牢中

original: There is nothing more for you to do here
translate: 这里没有更多你能做的事了

original: #WizardDungeonQuest1
translate: #WizardDungeonQuest1

original: I’ve not heard of these Salts of Elthanyr before
translate: 我以前从未听说过这些埃尔萨尼尔之盐

original: If we find his laboratory, perhaps we can find a recipe of sorts?
translate: “如果我们找到他的实验室，也许能找到某种配方？”

original: Nonetheless, I say we press on and do what we can to aid this man
translate: “尽管如此，我认为我们应该继续前进，尽我们所能帮助这个人”

original: As I’ve said before
translate: 正如我之前所说

original: A Magos is not an ally to scoff at
translate: 一位法师可不是能轻视的同伴

original: I cast my voice into your mind from my summoning chamber - deep beneath your feet
translate: 我从我的召唤室——就在你们脚下深处——将声音投射到你们脑海中

original: I have become… detained there and it shall be your privilege to render your assistance in freeing me!
translate: 我被……困在那里了，而你们将有幸协助我脱身！

original: And how did you end up so detained?
translate: 那你是怎么被困住的？

original: Through certain rites I was calling up that which lies beyond
translate: 通过某些仪式，我召唤了来自彼界的存在

original: What came through however, was not… what I expected
translate: “然而，过来的东西……并非我所预料的那样”

original: It tried to overpower me but I was faster
translate: 它试图压制我，但我更快

original: By my immense willpower alone am I keeping my foe at bay
translate: 仅凭我强大的意志，我正将敌人压制住

original: I can hold him for a long time - but not forever
translate: 我能长时间压制他——但并非永远

original: But what can I do?
translate: 但我能做什么？

original: The voice sounds strained now
translate: 声音现在听起来很吃力

original: I need
translate: 我需要

original: I need Salts of Elthanyr
translate: 我需要埃尔萨尼尔之盐

original: It can be created in my laboratory
translate: 它可以在我的实验室里制作

original: You just need the three ingredients
translate: 你只需要三种材料

original: Find
translate: 找到

original: The voice cuts out
translate: 声音中断了

original: Find what?!
translate: 找到什么？！

original: Just craft the Salts of Elthanyr and bring them to the summoning chamber below!
translate: 只需制作埃尔萨尼尔之盐，然后带到下面的召唤室来！

original: Hurry
translate: 快

original: Cannot ho
translate: 无法……

original: What do you make of it Embla?
translate: 恩布拉，你怎么看？

original: As you walk past the statue in the corridor a voice suddenly rings out from it
translate: 当你走过走廊里的雕像时，一个声音突然从中响起

original: Sharp and terrible, like two metal bars being clanged together, it seems to resonate in your very bones
translate: “尖锐而可怕，就像两根金属棒撞击在一起，仿佛在你的骨头里产生共鸣”

original: Interloper!
translate: 闯入者！

original: You stand in the halls of Calipero the Tempestuous!
translate: 你正站在暴风卡利佩罗的大厅里！

original: Serve me well and I shall forgive you your transgression
translate: 好好侍奉我，我将原谅你的冒犯

original: Are... are you inside the statue?
translate: 你……你在雕像里面吗？

original: Serve you?
translate: 侍奉你？

original: What makes you think I want to serve you?
translate: 是什么让你觉得我想侍奉你？

original: I am no statue!
translate: 我不是雕像！

original: You are talking to none other than
translate: 你正在与不是别人，正是

original: Calipero the Tempestous!
translate: 暴风卡利佩罗！

original: Once the court-master to the High Wizard of Freymark
translate: 曾是弗雷马克大巫师的宫廷术师长

original: But where are you talking to me from?
translate: 但你是在哪里跟我说话？

original: And what makes you think I want to assist you?
translate: 又是什么让你觉得我想协助你？

original: Insolent mortal!
translate: 无礼的凡人！

original: You shall serve because I ask it of you!
translate: 你必须侍奉，因为我要求你这么做！

original: Besides
translate: 此外

original: I’ll pay well
translate: 我会付好价钱

original: Just pay attention!
translate: 专心听好！

original: My grip is failing!
translate: 我的控制正在减弱！

original: What's happening?
translate: 发生什么了？

original: Why?
translate: 为什么？

original: #WizardDungeonRecipeBook
translate: #巫师地牢配方书

original: The large book appears to be a collection of different, obscure alchemical recipes
translate: 这本大书似乎是一本收录了各种晦涩炼金术配方的合集

original: Flipping through it you eventually find the entry for ‘Salts of Elthanyr’
translate: 翻阅时你最终找到了“埃尔萨尼尔之盐”的条目

original: Read the Recipe
translate: 阅读配方

original: Summoning forth that which dwells beyond is one of the most dangerous tasks that a Magos can undertake
translate: 召唤彼界存在是法师所能进行的最危险的任务之一

original: What comes through may not always be what was intended
translate: 召唤而来的未必总是预期之物

original: The Salts of Elthanyr must always be kept at hand when attempting such rituals
translate: 尝试此类仪式时必须随时备好埃尔萨尼尔之盐

original: It is antithetical to that which has been called forth
translate: 它与被召唤之物相克

original: Strewing it in a circle around the summoning focus confines the outsider
translate: 将其撒在召唤焦点周围形成一个圈可以困住异界存在

original: Casting the salts upon the outsider utterly unmakes it
translate: 将盐撒在异界存在身上可将其彻底瓦解

original: The salts are difficult to create and may only be crafted in a Protoplasmic Catalyzer
translate: 这种盐难以制造只能在原生质催化器中炼制

original: Three ingredients must be used and added in this precise order
translate: 必须使用三种材料并严格按此顺序添加

original: First add Sylversalt
translate: 首先加入银盐

original: Second, add Salamander’s Horn
translate: 其次，加入火蜥角

original: Finally, add Lotus Petals
translate: 最后，加入莲花花瓣

original: First, add Sylversalt
translate: 首先，加入银盐

original: #WizardDungeonSarcophagus
translate: #WizardDungeonSarcophagus

original: You examine the sarcophagus as best you can but fail to make much sense of its purpose beyond it not appearing to be used for burial
translate: 你尽力检查石棺，但除了它似乎不是用于埋葬之外，你无法理解它的用途

original: Pressing down on the bottom of the interior it appears to give ever so slightly - almost as if it was hinged in some way
translate: 按下内部的底部，它似乎微微下沉——几乎像是某种铰链连接

original: Taking a step back you scan the area around the sarcophagus only to spot a stone tile that is polished almost smooth by years of wear
translate: 后退一步，你扫视石棺周围的区域，发现一块石砖因多年磨损而几乎光滑如镜

original: No doubt this is a switch of some sort
translate: 毫无疑问，这是某种开关

original: Press the switch
translate: 按下开关

original: In the middle of this room stands a large golden sarcophagus-like chest that is richly engraved with complex, arcane-looking symbols
translate: 房间中央立着一个巨大的金色石棺状箱子，上面雕刻着复杂的、看起来像奥术的符号

original: Carved in beautiful letters on a lid of the sarcophagus is the following
translate: 石棺盖上用优美的字体刻着以下文字：

original: For thy service to thy Lord, Ascension is thy sweet reward
translate: “为汝对领主的服务，升天是汝甜蜜的奖赏。”

original: Open it
translate: 打开它

original: Examine the decorations
translate: 检查装饰

original: The lid of the sarcophagus slides open with surprising ease revealing an interior molded to the form of a human form
translate: 石棺盖轻松滑开，露出内部塑造成人形的空间

original: All along the interior walls, more of the strange looking sigils are carved giving the sarcophagus the appearance of being some sort of ‘machine’
translate: 内壁四周刻着更多奇怪的符文，使石棺看起来像是某种“机器”

original: Carefully pressing down on the switch with your foot, the effect is immediate
translate: 用脚小心地按下开关，效果立竿见影

original: The false bottom of the sarcophagus swings to one side, opening up to a shaft below
translate: 石棺的假底摆向一侧，露出下方的竖井

original: As soon as it does, scorching jets of flame roar up the shaft
translate: 刚一打开，灼热的火焰便从竖井中咆哮而上

original: Had someone been laying in the sarcophagus they would have been totally and utterly incinerated
translate: 如果有人躺在石棺里，他们会被彻底焚化

original: Reduces to ash in an instance
translate: 瞬间化为灰烬

original: Driina’s eyes go wide with shock
translate: 德莉娜震惊地睁大了眼睛

original: Is this how those apprentices are repaid for their servitude?
translate: 这就是那些学徒为他们的服务得到的回报吗？

original: He uses them and then disposes of them like leprous corpses when they can serve no more?
translate: 他利用他们，然后当他们无法再服务时，就像处理麻风病人的尸体一样丢弃他们？

original: What monster could do such a thing?!
translate: 什么样的怪物会做出这种事？！

original: You shudder at the implication
translate: 你为这暗示不寒而栗

original: How many of this man’s ‘apprentices’ have ended their life in this way?
translate: 这个人的“学徒”中有多少人就这样结束了生命？

original: The symbols carved into the sarcophagus appear to be magical in nature
translate: 石棺上雕刻的符号看起来具有魔法性质

original: Beyond that however, you have no idea of their meaning or purpose
translate: 然而除此之外，你对它们的含义或目的毫无头绪

original: At first glance, the symbols carved into the sarcophagus appear to be magical in nature
translate: 乍一看，石棺上雕刻的符号似乎具有魔法性质

original: This however, is only at first glance
translate: 然而，这只是第一印象

original: Further examination reveals that they are nothing but purely decorative patterns of no arcane significance
translate: 进一步检查发现，它们不过是纯粹的装饰图案，没有任何奥术意义

original: In fact, you feel certain that the gold-leaf covering the structure is fake as well
translate: 事实上，你确信覆盖这结构的金箔也是假的

original: #WizardDungeonSummoningChamber1
translate: #巫师地下城召唤室1

original: Howling winds scream through these halls
translate: 呼啸的狂风在这些厅堂中尖啸

original: Though you feel it clawing at your exposed skin there is something strange about it
translate: 虽然你感觉到它抓挠着你裸露的皮肤，但其中有些奇怪之处

original: A ghost wind
translate: 一阵幽灵之风

original: Only partially of the material world
translate: 只有部分属于物质世界

original: The other half coming from beyond
translate: 另一半来自彼岸

original: No doubt Calipero’s summoning chamber lies ahead
translate: 毫无疑问，卡利佩罗的召唤室就在前方

original: #WizardDungeonSummoningChamberFinal
translate: #巫师地牢召唤室终章,

original: You fling the vial of salt at the horrid creature but a gust of that terrible witch-wind catches the bottle instead
translate: 你把盐瓶扔向那可怕的生物，但一阵恐怖的巫风却卷住了瓶子，

original: It misses its mark and shatters against the wall and the Salts of Elthanyr spread into the roiling vortex
translate: 它偏离了目标，撞在墙上碎裂，埃尔萨尼尔之盐散入翻腾的漩涡中，

original: Each grain that strikes the pillar of smokes explodes into a tiny shower of sparks but it does not have the intended effect
translate: 每一粒击中烟柱的盐粒都爆裂成细小的火花雨，但并未产生预期的效果，

original: Instead something roars in the beyond and in an explosion of white light Calipero’s ward collapses
translate: 相反，彼岸传来一声咆哮，在白色光芒的爆炸中，卡利佩罗的结界崩溃了，

original: You have failed your quest
translate: 你的任务失败了，

original: The howling witch-winds rise as you push south into what must be the summoning chamber
translate: 当你向南推进，进入那必定是召唤室的地方时，呼啸的巫风愈发猛烈，

original: Emerging from the central pool is a great whirling plume of black smoke
translate: 从中央池中升起一股巨大的旋转黑烟柱，

original: Bluish light flashes inside it like lightning and, for a few mercifully brief moments, illuminates something vast swimming inside the smoke
translate: "蓝光在其中如闪电般闪烁，在几个短暂的仁慈瞬间，照亮了烟雾中游动的某个庞然大物"

original: The thing claws at the threshold of reality, desperate to break through - like a drowning man trapped under the thinnest of ice-sheets
translate: "那东西抓挠着现实的边界，绝望地想要突破——就像被困在最薄冰层下的溺水者"

original: Standing in front of the hideous thing is a single robed human figure
translate: 站在那丑恶之物前面的，是一个身着长袍的人类身影，

original: Calipero no doubt
translate: 无疑是卡利佩罗，

original: Encased in some glimmering sphere of force, Calipero’s form is utterly frozen in time
translate: "被某种闪烁的力场球体包裹，卡利佩罗的身形完全凝固在时间中"

original: Nonetheless, his statue-like form conveys superhuman effort
translate: "尽管如此，他那雕像般的形态传达出超人的努力"

original: He has held the monstrosity from beyond at bay this long but his grip is no doubt failing
translate: "他这么久以来一直将彼岸的怪物拒之门外，但他的掌控无疑正在减弱"

original: Throw the salt at the pillar of smoke
translate: 把盐扔向烟柱，

original: The man who stands before you looks much like his apprentices
translate: 站在你面前的这个人，看起来很像他的学徒们，

original: Or perhaps it is more accurate to say they look a lot like him for no doubt this is the original
translate: 或者更准确地说，他们很像他，因为毫无疑问，他才是原型，

original: He regards you with cold eyes, head slightly cocked to one side, but says nothing
translate: "他用冷漠的眼神打量着你，头微微偏向一侧，但一言不发"

original: You open your mouth to speak and he snaps his fingers
translate: 你张嘴欲言，他打了个响指，

original: A rush of air and sudden vertigo and then you are somewhere else
translate: 一阵气流和突如其来的眩晕，然后你便身处别处，

original: You fling the vial at the pillar of black smoke and watch in awe as the salt ignites, turning the pillar from a pillar of smoke to a pillar of multi-colored flame instead
translate: "你把瓶子扔向黑烟柱，敬畏地看着盐燃烧起来，将烟柱变成了五彩的火焰柱"

original: Something screams in terror from beyond
translate: 彼岸传来惊恐的尖叫，

original: At first the roar of some great beast then the whimper of a child
translate: 起初是某种巨兽的咆哮，然后是一个孩子的呜咽，

original: Then, suddenly, all is quiet and the thing is no more
translate: "然后，突然，一切归于寂静，那东西不复存在"

original: You reel from the shock of the unmaking and for a moment your vision is obscured by the bright afterimages of the arcane light
translate: 你因毁灭的冲击而踉跄，一时间，奥术光芒的明亮残影遮蔽了你的视线，

original: Slowly, your eyesight readjusts to the now darkened chamber and you see the Magos rising slowly to his feet
translate: "慢慢地，你的视力重新适应了如今黑暗的房间，你看到法师缓缓站起身来"

original: Calipero I presume?
translate: 我猜是卡利佩罗？

original: A man dressed in the colorful garb of a traveling theater performer walks onto the stage and the crowd falls utterly silent
translate: 一个身着巡回剧团演员鲜艳服装的男人走上舞台，人群顿时鸦雀无声，

original: #WizardsTowerEnter
translate: #WizardsTowerEnter

original: You mind reels as you look around the lush interior of the tower
translate: 当你环顾塔内郁郁葱葱的内部时，你的思绪开始晕眩

original: Colorful, fragrant flowers abound and exotic songbirds sing in every bush
translate: “五彩缤纷、芬芳四溢的花朵随处可见，异国情调的鸣禽在每一丛灌木中歌唱”

original: Stranger still, the tower’s interior is somehow much larger than its exterior seems to allow
translate: “更奇怪的是，塔的内部不知怎的比其外部看起来要大得多”

original: Kat looks around in awe
translate: 卡蒂敬畏地环顾四周

original: This place is… impossible
translate: 这地方……不可能

original: I wonder what hands could have shaped such beauty?
translate: 我想知道是什么样的手塑造了如此美景？

original: No doubt this is the work of some Magos, yes?
translate: “毫无疑问，这是某位法师的作品，对吧？”

original: Let’s not be blinded by the splendor
translate: 我们不要被这壮丽景象蒙蔽了双眼

original: Iben muses as he carefully prods at one of the orchids with his weapon
translate: 伊本一边沉思，一边用他的武器小心地戳着一株兰花

original: Looking around, You cannot help but wonder what hands could have shaped such beauty
translate: “环顾四周，你不禁想知道是什么样的手塑造了如此美景”

original: #WizardTowerQuestBegin
translate: #WizardTowerQuestBegin

original: Embla strokes her chin
translate: 恩布拉摸着下巴，

original: The scent of the Reticulum is about this
translate: 这里弥漫着魔网的气息，

original: I would wager much that this ‘Master’ he speaks of is a sorcerer of sorts
translate: 我敢打赌，他所说的“主人”是某种术士，

original: A Magos even
translate: 甚至可能是一位法师，

original: Though time is against us, another Magos could be a powerful ally and our path to Gradla takes us past Eryll in any case
translate: “虽然时间紧迫，但另一位法师可能成为强大的同伴，而且我们去格拉德拉的路无论如何都会经过埃里尔。”

original: I say, we should at least investigate this further
translate: “我说，我们至少应该进一步调查此事。”

original: Let's be on our way for now
translate: 我们先赶路吧，

original: From his skin and nails to his jaundiced eyes and missing teeth, this young man appears to have been stricken by some disease
translate: “从他的皮肤、指甲，到发黄的眼睛和脱落的牙齿，这个年轻人似乎患上了某种疾病。”

original: Beyond that, you’ve never seen anything quite like it and have no idea how to classify it
translate: “除此之外，你从未见过类似的情况，也不知道该如何归类。”

original: So, what is this about your master then?
translate: “那么，关于你的主人是怎么回事？”

original: From his skin and nails to his jaundiced eyes and missing teeth, the young man’s condition is perplexing
translate: “从他的皮肤、指甲，到发黄的眼睛和脱落的牙齿，这个年轻人的状况令人费解。”

original: Some of these symptoms are similar to those suffered by Magi upon exposure to strong magics over time but this is far too severe - especially considering the man’s young age
translate: 其中一些症状与法师长期接触强大魔法后出现的症状相似，但这要严重得多——尤其是考虑到他还这么年轻。

original: It’s as if he’s quite literally falling apart in front of your eyes
translate: 他简直就像在你眼前分崩离析。

original: Strangest of all, it appears as if the man is oblivious to his condition
translate: “最奇怪的是，这个人似乎对自己的状况浑然不觉。”

original: Traveling north along the coast, you notice a young man standing at the side of the road
translate: “沿着海岸向北行进时，你注意到一个年轻人站在路边。”

original: His tattered robes, bald head and unhealthy pallor reminds you of a magos, though this boy is surely too young?
translate: “他破烂的长袍、光头和不健康的苍白脸色让你想起法师，但这男孩未免太年轻了吧？”

original: He follows your passing with an idiotic smile draped over his round bland face
translate: 他用一张圆润而平淡的脸上挂着的傻笑目送你们经过，

original: Can I help you?
translate: 需要帮忙吗？

original: Ignore the man
translate: 无视这个人，

original: We have come
translate: 我们前来，

original: he stops for a long moment and thinks
translate: 他停顿了许久，思索着，

original: to beg for aid!
translate: 乞求援助！

original: Our Master is missing down below and we are not allowed to enter and search for him
translate: 我们的主人失踪在下面，我们不被允许进入寻找他，

original: Something is wrong - we know it!
translate: 出事了——我们知道！

original: A note of agitation, bordering on panic, creeps into his voice
translate: “一丝焦躁，近乎恐慌，悄然渗入他的声音。”

original: Suddenly he stops, choughs slightly, and then smiles again
translate: “他突然停下，轻轻咳了一声，然后又露出笑容。”

original: Bloody drool runs down his chin along with one of the man’s teeth
translate: 带血的口水顺着他的下巴流下，还带着一颗牙齿。

original: What of your master?
translate: 你的主人怎么了？

original: Help!
translate: 救命！

original: the young man croaks as you pass him
translate: 年轻人用沙哑的声音喊道，当你们经过他时，

original: He blinks as if he was equally surprised as you at the outburst - all the while smiling moronically
translate: 他眨了眨眼，仿佛对这声喊叫和你一样惊讶——同时仍傻笑着，

original: Well!
translate: 喂！

original: Speak up boy or you’ll get the back of my hand!
translate: 小子，大声点，不然就吃我一巴掌！

original: Roland grumbles at the man
translate: 罗兰对着那人咕哝道，

original: We beseech you
translate: 我们恳求你们，

original: Travel to Eryll
translate: 前往埃里尔，

original: Seek out the Tower of Ash
translate: 找到灰烬之塔，

original: Find us there and learn of our Master’s fate
translate: 在那里找到我们，了解我们主人的命运，

original: But please, time is of the essence and for each second you tarry, hope fades
translate: “但请务必抓紧时间，每耽搁一秒，希望就渺茫一分。”

original: The words flow as if rehearsed and then, as he speaks the last words he lets out a deep sigh and sits down on the ground
translate: “这些话像是排练过一样流畅，说完最后一句，他深深叹了口气，坐倒在地。”

original: Eryll?
translate: 埃里尔？

original: Tower of Ash?
translate: 灰烬之塔？

original: Why, I’ve never felt better
translate: “哎呀，我感觉再好不过了。”

original: The man seems taken aback by the question
translate: 那人似乎被这个问题吓了一跳，

original: Please, it is my master who needs help
translate: “求求你们，需要帮助的是我的主人。”

original: Driinas eyes narrow as she grabs one of his hands with the skilled touch of a healer
translate: 德莉娜眯起眼睛，用医者娴熟的手法抓住他的一只手，

original: You’re not well at all
translate: 你病得不轻，

original: she mumbles to herself
translate: 她自言自语道，

original: Let me just take a look at you none the less
translate: 不过还是让我看看你吧，

original: His eyes are glassy and distant
translate: 他的眼神呆滞而遥远，

original: Find us there
translate: 在那里找到我们，

original: he repeats before his voice trails off
translate: 他重复道，随后声音渐渐消失，

original: Fool’s mind is gone
translate: 这傻瓜已经神志不清了，

original: He’ll be food for crows come nightfall and it’ll be a mercy
translate: 天黑后他就会成为乌鸦的食物，那倒是一种解脱，

original: Roland mumbles
translate: 罗兰咕哝道，

original: Are you just going to sit there?
translate: 你就打算这么坐着？

original: The man rolls over on his side - eyes staring stiffly ahead
translate: 那人翻了个身侧躺着——眼睛直直地盯着前方，

original: Though he still appears to be alive, no prodding or prompting raises any kind of response from him
translate: “虽然他看起来还活着，但无论怎么戳弄或呼唤，他都没有任何反应。”

original: There appears to be nothing more you can do for this lost soul save consider his request
translate: 看来对于这个迷失的灵魂，你除了考虑他的请求外，已无能为力。

original: I'm not sure what ot make of this
translate: 我不确定这到底是怎么回事，

original: That is why you are travelling to the Black Priory
translate: 这就是你们前往黑修院的原因，

original: #WizardTowerTopFloor
translate: #巫师塔顶层

original: It is where our Master goes to do his sacred work
translate: 那是我们主人进行他神圣工作的地方

original: But he is missing!
translate: 但他失踪了！

original: Please, you must go there now
translate: “求你了，你现在必须去那里”

original: Find him
translate: 找到他

original: Use the silver flute and go through the mercury lake!
translate: 使用银笛，穿过水银湖！

original: And if I do, what's in it for me?
translate: “如果我做了，我有什么好处？”

original: I'll get going
translate: 我这就出发

original: Master is still missing!
translate: 主人还是失踪了！

original: Go down below now!
translate: 现在下去下面！

original: The apprentices again begin to whimper in terror like caged animals
translate: 学徒们再次像笼中的动物一样恐惧地呜咽起来

original: You emerge into what appears to be an observatory of sorts
translate: 你出现在一个看起来像是某种天文台的地方

original: Astronomical glyphs cover the floor and in the center of the room stands what appears to be a huge telescope
translate: 天文符号覆盖着地板，房间中央矗立着一台巨大的望远镜

original: Strangely though, there does not appear to be any form of aperture in the roof that would allow it to observe the sky
translate: “但奇怪的是，屋顶上似乎没有任何形式的开口可以让它观测天空”

original: Four robed figures huddle together under the strange construct like frightened animals
translate: 四个穿着长袍的人影像受惊的动物一样蜷缩在这个奇怪的构造物下

original: Come out so I can see you!
translate: 出来让我看看你们！

original: Slowly the four figures creep forwards into the half-light and to your astonishment you see that all four have identical faces
translate: 慢慢地，四个人影向前挪到半明半暗的光线中，你惊讶地发现他们四个有着一模一样的脸

original: Indeed they all appear to be identical to the strange man you met on Idra
translate: 确实，他们看起来都和你之前在伊德拉遇到的那个奇怪男人一模一样

original: You come for Master!
translate: 你们来找主人！

original: one of the men states, rather than asks, with a serene smile on his face
translate: “其中一个人陈述道，而不是询问，脸上带着安详的微笑”

original: What in the Magi’s Loins is going on here?
translate: 法师的血脉啊，这里到底发生了什么？

original: Kat blurts out as she stares in fascinated awe at the quadruplets
translate: 卡蒂脱口而出，她着迷而敬畏地盯着这四胞胎

original: We are apprentices of Calipero the Tempestuous
translate: 我们是暴风卡利佩罗的学徒

original: one of the others answers with a smile
translate: 另一个人微笑着回答

original: But… our Master if miffing!
translate: 但是……我们的主人失踪了！

original: lisps an apprentice toothlessly
translate: 一个没牙的学徒口齿不清地说

original: As one, the four men begin to whimper
translate: “四人齐声呜咽起来”

original: Though all four men are identical, they all seem to be afflicted by varying degrees of the strange decomposition that you observed in their 'brother' on Idra
translate: “虽然这四个人一模一样，但他们似乎都不同程度地遭受着你之前在伊德拉的他们‘兄弟’身上观察到的那种奇怪的腐烂”

original: Missing?
translate: 失踪？

original: Explain!
translate: 解释！

original: Master has gone down below
translate: 主人已经下去下面了

original: To his work
translate: 去做他的工作

original: But he has not returned!
translate: 但他没有回来！

original: Something is wrong!
translate: 出事了！

original: Danger!
translate: 危险！

original: DANGER!
translate: 危险！

original: Like frightened animals the four apprentices fret anxiously about
translate: 像受惊的动物一样，四个学徒焦急地走来走去

original: Down below?
translate: 下面？

original: One of them whispers
translate: 其中一人低语道

original: We’re not allowed to go there
translate: 我们不被允许去那里

original: Not until we ascend
translate: 直到我们升天

original: But you can go!
translate: 但你可以去！

original: Even without ascending!
translate: 甚至不用升天！

original: As one the four apprentices’ moronic smiles return and they all nod in agreement
translate: 四人一齐露出傻乎乎的笑容，都点头同意

original: You go now!
translate: 你现在就去！

original: How would I even get there?
translate: 我到底要怎么去那里？

original: One of the men pushes a small, silver flute into your hands
translate: “其中一人把一支小小的银笛塞到你手里”

original: This is the key
translate: 这就是钥匙

original: Blow it and the mercury lake will open for you
translate: 吹响它，水银湖就会为你打开

original: It’s where we go to ascend but we’re not allowed there without him!
translate: 那是我们去升天的地方，但没有他我们不被允许去那里！

original: So you must go instead!
translate: 所以你必须替我们去！

original: Embla looks at the flute with fascination
translate: 恩布拉着迷地看着长笛

original: He must mean the mercury lake down on the ground floor
translate: 他一定是指楼下的那个水银湖

original: The affairs of Magi indeed
translate: 法师的事务果然如此

original: I wonder what knowledge a man such as this Calipero could be hiding in his secret halls?
translate: 我想知道像卡利佩罗这样的人在他的秘密厅堂里隐藏着什么样的知识？

original: she muses
translate: 她沉思道

original: Keep his knowledge for yourself Embla - I’d be happier with a fistful of diamonds
translate: 恩布拉，你自己留着那些知识吧——我宁愿要一把钻石

original: Kat chimes in
translate: 卡蒂插话道

original: Let's try to get some answers first
translate: 我们先试着找些答案吧

original: Let's be on out way then
translate: 那我们出发吧

original: We serve Calipero the Tempestuous!
translate: 我们侍奉暴风卡利佩罗！

original: all four answer in unison
translate: 四人齐声回答

original: As kind and loving as he is wise - Our joy is to serve him until we one day ascend to join him in the ranks of the holy Magi!
translate: 他既仁慈又充满爱心，如同他的智慧一样——我们的快乐就是侍奉他，直到有一天我们升天，加入神圣法师的行列！

original: Ascend?
translate: 升天？

original: But how come you all look so similar?
translate: 但你们怎么都长得这么像？

original: When we are judged ready, we go down below
translate: “当我们被判定准备好了，我们就下去下面”

original: Under the mercury pool and into and enter the ascension chamber and the golden machine!
translate: 到水银池下，进入升天室和黄金机器！

original: There we shall transcend this weak flesh and take our place amongst those who are giants amongst men!
translate: 在那里我们将超越这脆弱的肉身，在那些人中巨人之间占据我们的位置！

original: What more can you tell me about the area below?
translate: 关于下面的区域，你还能告诉我些什么？

original: The four apprentices stare at you with blank smiles
translate: 四个学徒带着茫然的微笑盯着你

original: Tell me about this master of yours!
translate: 跟我说说你们这位主人！

original: What kind of reward are we looking at here?
translate: 我们能得到什么样的奖励？

original: What lies down below?
translate: 下面有什么？

original: This young man smiles serenely at you as you approach
translate: 当你走近时，这个年轻人安详地对你微笑

original: His round face is eerily identical to that of all of his ‘brothers’
translate: 他圆圆的脸与他所有“兄弟”的脸惊人地一模一样

original: Where is Master?
translate: 主人在哪里？

original: I'm still searching
translate: 我还在找

original: Our Master is rich beyond comparison!
translate: 我们的主人富有得无与伦比！

original: Beyond count will be the joys and gifts he will bestow upon you!
translate: 他将赐予你们的欢乐和礼物将数不胜数！

original: The four apprentices simply smile absentmindedly as if they didn’t hear or understand the question
translate: 四个学徒只是心不在焉地微笑着，仿佛没听见或没听懂这个问题

original: After a short while one of them repeats
translate: 过了一会儿，其中一人重复道

original: #ZharaIagoReturned
translate: #ZharaIagoReturned

original: A tall, muscular woman, beautiful but for a scar across the cheek, stands looking over papers whilst apparently counting under her breath
translate: 一位高大健壮的女人，面容姣好，只是脸颊上有一道伤疤，她站在那里翻阅文件，同时似乎在低声计数。

original: Her flamboyant outfit marks her not only as a southerner but likely also an officer
translate: 她那华丽的装束不仅表明她来自南方，还很可能是一位军官。

original: So it's you we have to thank for our captain's return?
translate: 我们得感谢你让我们的船长归来？

original: Well, the Weathermaiden is in your gratitude
translate: 嗯，天候少女号对你感激不尽。

original: She grins revealing a golden tooth
translate: 她咧嘴一笑，露出一颗金牙。

original: I’m at your service - but if it’s all the same to you I have much to do
translate: 我随时为你效劳——不过如果你不介意的话，我还有很多事要做。

original: #ZharaScene
translate: #扎拉场景

original: Be careful out there!
translate: 小心点！

original: He is the finest sea-captain from here to the Sea-Gates
translate: 他是从这里到港门一带最出色的船长

original: If you’ve not heard of him it is because he prefers it so
translate: 如果你没听说过他 那是因为他喜欢这样

original: Such is the nature of our vocation
translate: 这就是我们职业的性质

original: Vocation?
translate: 职业？

original: As I said, our cargo is often less than legal
translate: 如我所说 我们的货物常常不太合法

original: There is trouble brewing in the Freymark and plenty of people looking to acquire goods outside the Imperial trade network
translate: 弗雷马克正酝酿着麻烦 许多人想在帝国贸易网络之外获取物资

original: We carry it and people like the Rat Queen sell it
translate: 我们负责运输 而鼠后那样的人负责销售

original: Ah - I see sell-swords have come to answer the maiden’s plea!
translate: 啊——我看到佣兵们来回应少女的恳求了！

original: Her smile however, does not quite reach her eyes
translate: 然而 她的笑容并未真正到达眼底

original: We met your man Dono in the refugee camp
translate: 我们在难民营见到了你的人多诺

original: I am Zhara
translate: 我是扎拉

original: First mate of the illustrious Weathermaiden
translate: 赫赫有名的天候少女号的大副

original: She gestures grandly to the anchored ship
translate: 她夸张地朝停泊的船做了个手势

original: As she proceeds a shadow falls over her face
translate: 她说着 脸上掠过一片阴影

original: We were on our way to the mainland when we encountered… something ancient
translate: 我们在前往大陆的途中遇到了……某种古老的东西

original: We lost many a good man and the ship was gravely damaged
translate: 我们失去了许多好手 船也严重受损

original: However, by the grace of the Blind and our captain's good fortune, we outran the beast and made it to the shallows
translate: 然而 靠着盲神的恩典和船长的好运 我们跑赢了那怪物 抵达了浅滩

original: It did not pursue us there and we suspect it will not stray too far from deeper waters
translate: 它没有追到那里 我们猜测它不会远离深水区太远

original: Thankfully, we were close to the sea-cave and we’ve been holed up here since
translate: 幸好 我们当时离海蚀洞窟很近 从那以后就一直躲在这里

original: The Behemoth
translate: 海怪

original: It sunk our ship as well as we attempted to land
translate: 我们试图靠岸时 它也击沉了我们的船

original: Behemoth indeed
translate: 果然是海怪

original: What a strange fate that we should both be survivors of something so deadly
translate: 多么奇妙的命运 我们居然都是如此致命之物的幸存者

original: In our case we made as good an escape as can be had against such a horror
translate: 就我们而言 面对如此恐怖之物 我们已经尽了最大努力逃脱

original: The ‘Maiden’ is fast but more so, our captain, Iago zha Droma, is the finest captain to sail these waters
translate: ‘少女号’很快 但更重要的是 我们的船长 伊阿戈·扎·德罗马 是在这片海域航行过的最出色的船长

original: Be their sails black or white
translate: 无论他们的船帆是黑是白

original: And where is your Captain now?
translate: 那你们的船长现在在哪？

original: That is where I hope you might be of assistance
translate: 这正是我希望你能帮忙的地方

original: While we await repairs, our cargo is rotting in our holds
translate: 在我们等待修理的时候 我们的货物正在货舱里腐烂

original: The Captain decided to venture into Horryn and seek out the Rat Queen and her black market in a bid to offload what he could
translate: 船长决定冒险进入霍林 寻找鼠后和她的黑市 想尽量把货脱手

original: I advised him against it as the ‘Queen’ is cruel and fickle
translate: 我劝过他别去 因为那位‘鼠后’残忍又善变

original: Black market?
translate: 黑市？

original: As you may have surmised, our operation is less than sanctioned by the Empire
translate: 你可能已经猜到了 我们的行动并未得到帝国的许可

original: We must ply our trade in the shadows and we deal with those we can, I suppose
translate: 我们不得不在阴影中经营 只能和那些我们能打交道的人交易 我想

original: In any case, you no doubt know as well as I what has befallen this island
translate: 无论如何 你肯定和我一样清楚这座岛遭遇了什么

original: Horryn is overrun by mad-men and I fear that the Captain was still inside its walls when the city fell
translate: 霍林被疯子们占领了 我担心城市陷落时船长还在城墙之内

original: In any case we have not seen him for days and I fear the worst
translate: 总之 我们已经好几天没见到他了 我担心最坏的情况

original: A slight hint of desperation creeps into her voice
translate: 她的声音里透出一丝绝望

original: And now you want me to look for him?
translate: 现在你想让我去找他？

original: If you can make it inside the walls, you would be doing a favor to the finest captain in the Outer Isles if you could venture to rescue him
translate: 如果你能进入城墙内 若能冒险去救他 就是帮了外岛最出色的船长一个大忙

original: Surely that must be worth something?
translate: 这肯定值得点什么吧？

original: I'll keep an eye out for him
translate: 我会留意他的

original: Zhara looks relieved
translate: 扎拉看起来松了口气

original: That is all I ask!
translate: 这就是我全部所求！

original: I would begin the search at the Rat Queen’s court
translate: 我会从鼠后宫廷开始搜寻

original: I’ve never seen it myself but I hear it lies deep in the sewers under the city
translate: 我自己从未见过 但我听说它位于城市下方深处的下水道里

original: Just be careful and trust no one - least of all the Rat Queen
translate: 千万小心 别相信任何人——尤其是鼠后

original: Zhara spits in contempt
translate: 扎拉轻蔑地啐了一口

original: Where did you say I should look for Iago?
translate: 你说我该去哪里找伊阿戈？

original: Tell me more about your Captain
translate: 再跟我多说说你们船长的事

original: How long until you can take to sea again?
translate: 你们还要多久才能再次出海？

original: The ‘maiden’ took quite a beating and we’ll be here for quite some time yet
translate: ‘少女号’挨了顿狠揍 我们还得在这儿待上好一阵子

original: And in any case, we’re not leaving until we learn Iago’s fate
translate: 而且无论如何 在得知伊阿戈的命运之前 我们不会离开

original: That being said, monster or no monster, we’re not staying a moment more than we need on this accursed island
translate: 话虽如此 不管有没有怪物 我们都不会在这座被诅咒的岛上多待一刻

original: There is something… wrong here
translate: 这里……有些不对劲

original: I feel it in my bones
translate: 我骨子里能感觉到

original: Do you think you can outrun the creature again?
translate: 你觉得你们能再次跑赢那怪物吗？

original: If there is one captain and one ship that could, it's Iago at the helm of the ‘Maiden’
translate: 如果有一位船长和一艘船能做到 那就是掌舵‘少女号’的伊阿戈

original: We may need to be cautious and stay close to shore but I’m willing to roll those dice
translate: 我们可能需要谨慎行事 紧靠海岸 但我愿意赌一把

original: The Blind has her hand over us
translate: 盲神在护佑着我们

original: What news of Captain Iago?
translate: 有伊阿戈船长的消息吗？

original: As I said, he made his way towards the black markets that lie under Horryn
translate: 如我所说 他去了霍林下方的黑市

original: All I know is that they can be entered via the sewers that lie under the city
translate: 我只知道可以通过城市下方的下水道进入

original: Though the black market is no doubt a nest of vipers, I fear the biggest problem for now is finding a way into the city itself
translate: 虽然黑市无疑是蛇窝 但我担心眼下最大的问题是找到进入城市本身的路

original: Perhaps allying yourself with the survivors in the refugee camp is a wise course of action?
translate: 或许与难民营的幸存者结盟是个明智之举？

original: #ZharaWeathermaiden
translate: #扎拉天候少女号

original: There is an oven going over on the fore-castle where you can cook your meals
translate: 前甲板上有个烤箱，你可以在那里做饭

original: And before you ask
translate: 在你问之前

original: The forecastle is at the front of the boat
translate: 前甲板在船的前部

original: He’s around somewhere!
translate: 他就在附近某个地方！

original: Have you tried his cabin below?
translate: 你试过下面的他的船舱了吗？

original: If he's not there now, just keep checking in and you'll run into him eventually!
translate: "如果他此刻不在那里，就继续找，你最终会碰到他的！"

original: Zhara expertly mans the helm while keeping a steady eye on the horizon
translate: 扎拉熟练地掌着舵，同时稳稳地注视着地平线

original: She appears to revel in the fact that she’s back at sea and as she sees you she lets out a howl of joy
translate: 她似乎陶醉于重回大海的事实，看到你时，她发出一声喜悦的嚎叫

original: By all of the Blind Maidens it is good to feel the wind on my face again!
translate: 以所有盲眼少女之名，再次感受到风吹在脸上的感觉真好！

original: This is the good life, no?
translate: "这才是好生活，不是吗？"

original: Winds behind and adventure in front!
translate: 身后是风，前方是冒险！

original: Ah yes
translate: 啊，是的

original: Argh!
translate: 啊！

original: In the meantime I had some questions
translate: 与此同时，我有一些问题

original: Not to worry!
translate: 别担心！

original: We’ve set aside a cabin for you down below - next to the captain's quarter
translate: 我们在下面为你留了一间船舱——就在船长室旁边

original: Feel free to rest there and to store any items you might wish to
translate: 你可以在那里休息，存放任何你想放的物品

original: I can assure you, they’ll be quite safe!
translate: "我可以向你保证，它们会很安全！"

original: Nothing I'd rather do than answer your questions!
translate: 我最乐意回答你的问题了！

original: I need to see the captain!
translate: 我需要见船长！

original: I need to rest!
translate: 我需要休息！

original: Is there any place to cook my food?
translate: 有地方做饭吗？

original: I wanted to ask you something!
translate: 我想问你点事！
